rows.title: Tivano secures CHF 500k to accelerate CO2 removal across Namibia
rows.summary: Aiming to address Namibia’s bush encroachment challenge and climate change, Tivano leverages its Swiss expertise to develop carbon vaults for the long-term storage of invasive woody biomass. The company has been awarded CHF 500,000 REPIC rollout grant to support further development and activities in the country.

rows.title: Major wins for Swiss startups
rows.summary: Cleantech, Medtech and AI startups from Switzerland have won competitions organized by organizations in various parts of the worldwide, including Anthropic. Prizes range from cash and partnership deals to joining accelerator programs that support further development.

rows.title: Strategic investment fuels Riveros’ expansion in Central and Eastern Europe
rows.summary: Rivero, the European payment operations platform, attracted Elevator Ventures, the corporate venture capital fund of Austria’s second-largest bank Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI), as an investor. The partnership will support Rivero’s continued expansion across Europe, with a particular focus on Central and Eastern European markets.

rows.title: From positive clinical developments to support offers for biotech startups
rows.summary: Muvon Therapetics, Neurosterix and Nuclidium are successfully advancing clinical studies for their drug candidates targeting stress urinary incontinence, schizophrenia and prostate cancer, respectively. Other startups have garnered recognition and secured a spot in a scientific publication. Meanwhile, Switzerland Innovation Park Basel will next year open doors to its new lab for early-stage startups.

rows.title: Anapaya inks major client deal to launch SCION across three continents
rows.summary: SCION is an enterprise networking technology solution for enhanced Internet security and connectivity. Developed by Anapaya, this solution is now available across Europe, North America and Asia through Colt Technology Services, the first network provider to bring it to enterprises.

rows.title: First three ventures emerge from SFF Studio’s inaugural cohort
rows.summary: SFF Studio, the venture-building arm of early-stage venture capital firm Swiss Founders Fund (SFF), is a 14-week program initiated to support experienced entrepreneurs in establishing their businesses from the initial stage to launching a new company. Three companies have emerged from the program, with initial milestones already reached.

rows.title: hooq will mit individuellen Kletterschuhen im Markt Fuss fassen
rows.summary: Das Winterthurer Startup hooq ermöglicht via 3D-Fussscan und eigens entwickeltem Schuhformgenerator die Fertigung von optimal passenden Kletterschuhen. Diese Möglichkeit stösst in der Kletter- und Boulderszene auf Interesse und hooq konnte kürzlich die fünfte Produktionsrunde in Auftrag geben.

rows.title: Nexoya nearly triples ARR as enterprise business gains momentum
rows.summary: MarTech company Nexoya is entering a new growth phase as its AI-powered platform gains traction among large enterprises, with ITA Airways recently recording up to 58.63% more short-term bookings. A wider rollout across 700 routes is planned. On the business side, the company’s recurring revenue (ARR) has almost tripled over the past three years, surpassing CHF 3 million in early 2026.

rows.title: Luzerner Innovationsbeitrag: 110 Millionen für die erste Runde
rows.summary: Die Luzerner Stimmbevölkerung hat Ende September die geplanten Massnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung der kantonalen Standortförderung gutgeheissen. Dazu gehört auch die gesetzliche Verankerung eines neuen Förderinstrumentes, dem «Luzerner Innovationsbeitrag». Davon profitieren können grundsätzlich auch im Kanton Luzern gegründete Startups. Gesuche um Förderbeiträge können seit 1. Oktober 2026 eingereicht werden.

rows.title: Swiss Future Award presents winners with CHF 50,000
rows.summary: Droople and Cellx Biosolutions have each received a cash prize of CHF 25,000 and tailored coaching upon winning the 2026 Swiss Future Award, which recognizes companies whose solutions have a lasting impact on the economy and environment. The Public Choice Award went to Symactiv.

rows.title: Turning Quizzes into Learning
rows.summary: Kwiiz was born out of a simple observation made in the classroom: most quiz tools assess knowledge but do not help students learn. A wrong answer is marked with a red X, and then the class moves on to something else. That is precisely what founders Bastien Muster and Quentin Joliat based in Biel, set out to change when they launched successfully their edtech platform this year.

rows.title: $8million to internationalise agentic software testing platform
rows.summary: Building on its European growth, Klarent is now planning to bring its autonomous software testing platform into the United States. The secured seed funding totalling $8 million will fuel this expansion.

rows.title: Infineon and ZuriQ partner to scale quantum processing units toward commercial systems
rows.summary: Infineon Technologies AG and ETH Zurich spin-off ZuriQ AG expand their collaboration to advance scalable quantum computing hardware. The partnership combines ZuriQ’s pioneering trapped-ion quantum computing architecture with Infineon’s expertise in semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, and integrated photonics. The partners have already demonstrated the feasibility of their approach by setting a world record.

rows.title: London-based enterprise surveillance software company acquires Apiax
rows.summary: Apiax, the Zurich-based Embedded Compliance provider for the financial services industry, has joined Behavox, the AI-native controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and commodity firms. The acquisition adds Apiax’ interpretation layer to Behavox’ platform as well as engineering and regulatory expertise to the Behavox team.

rows.title: Scanvio Assist Receives World’s First CE Mark for AI-Assisted Ultrasound in Endometriosis
rows.summary: Scanvio Assist has received CE marking as a Class IIa medical device software under the European Medical Device Regulation. The certification enables Scanvio Medical to begin bringing Scanvio Assist into clinical use across Europe.

rows.title: 4 million for Besso's trade regulation intelligence platform
rows.summary: Bern-based SaaS-Startup Besso has secured CHF 4 million in new funding to accelerate its next phase of growth. The investment comes from a large European single family office. The funding follows a period of strong commercial traction.

rows.title: Swibeco rachète l’activité e-commerce de Premium Brand Solutions SA
rows.summary: Swibeco a racheté l’activité e-commerce de Premium Brand Solutions SA (« PBS »), spécialiste des ventes privées en entreprise en Suisse. Dès le 26 octobre, les collaborateurs des entreprises clientes de Swibeco profiteront d’un assortiment élargi sur la Plateforme Swibeco.

rows.title: Swiss companies prepare to take center stage at Bio Europe
rows.summary: A delegation of 26 organizations, including 12 Swiss startups, will be exhibiting their solutions at Bio-Europe, Europe’s leading conference for the biotech sector, while exploring potential partnerships and investment opportunities. Seven of the 12 participating startups are supported through the GoGlobal initiative as part of the Innosuisse startup coaching programme.

rows.title: IFF-Preis: Finalisten stehen fest
rows.summary: Neun Freiburger Unternehmen sind für den IFF-Preis 2026–2027 (Innovation Fribourg Freiburg) nominiert. In der Kategorie Startup wurden drei Jungunternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen ausgewählt – von Stressprävention über Drohnentechnologie bis hin zu Energieeffizienz. Die Preisträgerinnen und Preisträger werden am 11. November bekannt gegeben.

rows.title: AI startup Visorway raises pre-seed funding
rows.summary: Zurich-based Startup Visorway, the AI-native service firm for sourcing and procurement, has closed its pre-seed financing round. The investment will be used to expand the services customers run on Visorway and to grow the network of domain experts behind them.

rows.title: KI-Startup SalesPort treibt Expansion voran
rows.summary: Das Luzerner Startup SalesPort unterstützt mit seiner KI-Software Vertriebs- und Business-Development-Teams dabei, potenzielle Kunden und passende Ansprechpartner zu identifizieren. Gestartet 2024 ist SalesPort heute in 25 Ländern aktiv und zählt neben dem ORF auch globale Weltmarktführer aus der Fertigungsindustrie zu seinen Kunden. Vor Kurzem erfolgte der Markteintritt in den USA und Kanada; zudem verstärkt das Startup seine Aktivitäten in der Schweiz.

rows.title: UniSieve raises $9M to move towards broader commercial deployment
rows.summary: UniSieve, the Zürich-based deep tech company developing high-precision membranes for industrial gas separation and carbon capture, has raised USD 9 million in Series A funding. The round brings UniSieve’s total funding to date to USD 25 million and will enable the start-up to scale its technology in existing markets and expand into additional industrial applications.

rows.title: Ascento accelerates US expansion with New York office
rows.summary: Robotics startup Ascento is accelerating its international expansion by opening an office in New York, as the US becomes the company’s fastest-growing market. The ETH Zurich spinoff, which develops and commercializes autonomous security robots through a robotics-as-a-service model, has hired its first employee to lead activities in the US market.

rows.title: L’accélérateur InnoJura dévoile sa cohorte 2026
rows.summary: InnoJura Accélérateur, programme initié par Basel Area Business and Innovation et soutenu par Switzerland Innovation Park Basel Area, accompagne start-up et scale-up dans leur développement et vient d’annoncer sa nouvelle cohorte. Les dix projets sélectionnés (7 de Suisse) ont démarré le programme en juillet 2026 sur le site du Switzerland Innovation Park Basel Area – Jura. Ils proposent des solutions novatrices dans des domaines variés: intelligence industrielle, applications de connaissances réutilisables, copilotes métaboliques pour sportifs d’endurance, impression métallique micrométrique ou interventions neuro-endovasculaires avancées.

rows.title: Executive changes to fuel further growth
rows.summary: For startups, industry experience and a strong network are critical to scaling fast, entering new markets, and reaching major milestones. Recent C‑suite hires at Readily3D, Visium, BLP, and Scait deliver exactly that. Among the new managers are several people who led a start-up before.

rows.title: Swiss-US company Namespace closes USD 42 million Series B round
rows.summary: Following a Series A in March 2026, Namespace announced the closing of its Series B, bringing the total funding to USD 65 million. The company builds a development platform for the coding agent age. Namespace is registered in the US with a strong footprint in Switzerland.

rows.title: DeepPsy’s obtains CHF 1.99 million for four-year multicenter study
rows.summary: The Swiss National Science Foundation has awarded CHF 1,990,000 to PRECISE MDD, a randomized controlled trial by digital health company DeepPsy. Running across three psychiatric centers, the study plans to include 500 patients with major depressive disorders.

rows.title: Längere Zeitspanne für Verlustverrechnungen per 2028
rows.summary: Unternehmen können Stand heute ihre steuerlichen Verluste innerhalb von sieben Jahren mit erwirtschafteten Gewinnen verrechnen. Davon profitieren unter anderem Startups mit längeren Aufbau- und Investitionszyklen. Neu wird die Frist auf zehn Jahre ausgeweitet. Die Reform tritt per 1. Januar 2028 in Kraft.

rows.title: Startups erhalten Förderung vom Pionierfonds
rows.summary: Seit Anfang 2026 hat der Migros-Pionierfonds mehrere neue Projekte in seine Förderung aufgenommen. Darunter befinden sich mehrere Deeptech-Startups aus dem Energiesektor, ein Healthtech-Unternehmen sowie Projekte zur Biodiversitätsförderung in der Landwirtschaft und zur Unterstützung geflüchteter Menschen beim Zugang zum Schweizer Arbeitsmarkt.

rows.title: Baio Labs obtains funding to accelerate drug discovery with generative AI
rows.summary: EPFL spin-off Baio Labs has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance its generative AI platform for early-stage drug discovery. By designing novel molecules for specific therapeutic targets in seconds, the startup aims to help researchers identify promising drug candidates faster and at significantly lower cost.

rows.title: Y-Combinator backs Swiss trailblazer Ageospatial
rows.summary: Ageospatial has just been selected for Y-Combinator’s Fall 2026 cohort, thereby securing its financial support. Currently in its launch phase in San Francisco, the Vaud-based start-up led by Maaz Sheikh helps organizations to remotely assess the risks associated with their physical assets (property, land, infrastructure) using satellite imagery.

rows.title: Alentis and CSL enter USD 1.6 billion partnership
rows.summary: CSL and Alentis announce global partnership to develop and commercialise lixudebart for rare kidney and liver diseases. Alentis will receive USD 355 million initial payment and up to USD 1.2 billion in commercial milestones, with global profits shared.

rows.title: Milan Aircraft sammelt Seed-Kapital für Antriebsstrang-Prototyp ein
rows.summary: Das Berner Startup Milan Aircraft hat eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen. Daran beteiligt haben sich Business Angels, davon mehrere aus dem Umfeld von SICTIC und Aare Ventures sowie einige Privatpersonen. Die frischen Mittel fliessen in den Bau des Antriebsprototypen und die Weiterentwicklung der Flugzeugzelle des vollelektrischen Flugzeuges.

rows.title: A stronger voice for Swiss startups in Bern
rows.summary: The Parliamentary Group for Startups and Entrepreneurship met again during Parliament’s autumn session, running from 14 September to 2 October 2026. Relaunched in summer 2026 by the Swiss Startup Association (SSA), the group is identifying political priorities and developing concrete proposals to strengthen Switzerland’s startup ecosystem.

rows.title: SensorX Solutions raises CHF 1.5 million to accelerate international scale-up
rows.summary: Swiss climate-tech company SensorX Solutions AG has secured CHF 1.5 million seed capital  to scale methane monitoring technology globally. The financing package combines a loan guarantee from the Swiss Technology Fund with equity capital from private investors and the founding team.

rows.title: Umbera: Guter Start für Alternative zu klassischen Umzugsportalen
rows.summary: Das Solothurner Startup Umbera will die Umzugsvermittlung effizienter machen, für Kundinnen und Kunden ebenso wie für Umzugsunternehmen. Über die Plattform laufen bereits mehrere hundert Umzugsanfragen pro Monat. Ein Grund für den Erfolg ist die KI-basierte Technologie, mit der selbst aufgenommene Videos von Wohnungen analysiert, das Inventar erfasst und der Umfang eines Umzugs eingeschätzt werden.

rows.title: Crowd-Support für Spezialpfanne, vegane Bäckerei und Diebstahl-Prävention
rows.summary: Während 4Fondue soeben einen soliden Start in seine Crowdfunding-Runde auf Conda hingelegt hat, haben Bakery Bakery und ExpertVision ihre Crowdinvestment-Kampagnen auf Oomnium abgeschlossen und können mit dem frischen Kapital das weitere Wachstum in Angriff nehmen.

rows.title: Strategic growth investment for Aurachain
rows.summary: Aurachain provides the execution layer through which regulated institutions can transform obligations, risk signals, intelligence and AI into auditable, governed action relating to client lifecycle compliance, financial crime, fraud investigations, third-party risk and operational resilience. Headquartered in Zurich, the company operates mainly from the United States and has won the support of Evolution Equity Partners, a leading technology investment firm specialising in cybersecurity, AI and enterprise software.

rows.title: Swiss cloud pioneer Infomaniak achieves successful stock market debut
rows.summary: Following the completion of the reverse takeover with Pierrot Duval, Infomaniak shares have been trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange since yesterday. After the first day, the market capitalisation stood at just under CHF 400 million.

rows.title: La deeptech neuchateloise NovoViz ravit le Prix BCN Innovation 2026
rows.summary: La startup neuchâteloise NovoViz décroche le Prix BCN Innovation 2026. Elle empoche le montant de CHF 150'000 pour sa nouvelle génération de solutions d’imagerie ultraperformante à photon unique. La cérémonie de remise du prix s’est déroulée le jeudi 1er octobre au Théâtre du Passage à Neuchâtel, devant un parterre de 300 personnes.

rows.title: Healthtech PolaSight receives $100K investment at Constructor Start Demo Day
rows.summary: At the fourth Constructor Start’s Demo Day, held at the end of September, three deep-tech start-ups each secured a $100,000 investment from Constructor Capital, including PolaSight. This spin-off from the University of Bern has developed a label-free imaging device for use during cancer surgery, drastically reducing the time required for tissue assessment.

rows.title: CHF 150,000 to tackle innate-immune-driven chronic inflammation at its source
rows.summary: The UZH spin-off Innunity Therapeutics has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance a new treatment approach for chronic inflammatory diseases driven by the innate immune system. By targeting the initiating step of the inflammatory cascade, the biotech startup aims to help patients who are poorly served by today's therapies.

rows.title: Start-ups and scale-ups are shaping the Swiss robotics sector
rows.summary: The Swiss robotics sector is highly dynamic. Almost half of the companies are less than seven years old. Many of them have managed to attract investors. This puts Switzerland in a very strong position by international standards, as a new analysis by Raiffeisen Switzerland shows. It also provides a good overview of the companies, their products and their fields of application.

rows.title: Project Eleven acquires Riva Labs to expand post-quantum research and engineering
rows.summary: Project Eleven, the company building post-quantum security infrastructure for digital assets, has announced its acquisition of Riva Labs. The Lugano-based company has built a reputation for translating post-quantum cryptographic research into practical blockchain systems.

rows.title: FOOD FOUNDERS Studio raises €4 million to build foodtech companies
rows.summary: FOOD FOUNDERS Studio, the Zurich-based venture studio that builds B2B food and beverage technology companies from existing science, has closed an oversubscribed EUR 4 million funding round. The round was backed by family offices and angel investors. After launching SentiaNova, the studio is recruiting a CEO and co-founder for its second company, with the new funding supporting further ventures.

rows.title: Deutscher Messtechnik-Konzern übernimmt IOT-Spezialisten akenza
rows.summary: Der Messtechnikhersteller VEGA aus Baden-Württemberg übernimmt die Schweizer Akenza AG mit Sitz in Zürich. Mit diesem strategischen Schritt verbindet VEGA die mehr als 60-jährige Erfahrung in der industriellen Prozessautomation mit der ausgewiesenen IoT-Expertise von akenza.

rows.title: High marks for Switzerland and food for thought on deep-tech start-ups
rows.summary: Switzerland has once again topped the WIPO Global Innovation Index. However, the Global Innovation Index’s focus topic – deep tech start-ups – also provides important insights into the challenges and weaknesses that persist in Switzerland, despite the country’s many strengths. on the other hand new data from Stripe Economics shows that founders of Swiss start-ups are much more satisfied with the business environment than their counterparts in other countries.

rows.title: Thriving Aurora’s Grid to enter new growth phase
rows.summary: Aurora’s Grid recently announced a new partnership with ILB Helios Holding AG, a recognized Zug-based player in the energy sector. Initially launched in Bulgaria, the collaboration brings together Aurora’s Grid’s E.M.M.A. energy management system with Shanghai Electric’s BES and Cabinet BESS solutions. But Bulgaria is just the beginning.

rows.title: Five startups add key executive appointments to support growth
rows.summary: With the appointment of new members to the executive team, five startups developing solutions across AI-powered platforms, biotech, wearables, among others have set the stage to reach their growth ambitions.

rows.title: Bee People sichert sich 1,3 Millionen Franken
rows.summary: Das St. Moritzer Startup Bee People entwickelt Nahrungsergänzungskapseln sowie Bio-Propolis- und Honigprodukte und ist in der Schweiz und Asien aktiv. Für die weitere Expansion, darunter den geplanten Markteintritt in Deutschland, hat Bee People nun eine Seed-Runde über 1,3 Millionen Franken abgeschlossen.

rows.title: Twenty female founders shaping Switzerland’s AI, data-science and robotics ecosystem
rows.summary: The second edition of “Top 100+ Women in AI + Data + Robotics in Switzerland 2026” report is out, providing a snapshot of women who are making significant contributions to Switzerland’s AI, data science, and robotics ecosystems. The report published by ETH AI Center and Greater Zurich Area AG (GZA) contains 20 women in the “Startup / Entrepreneurship” category.

rows.title: Ex-Google KI-Spezialisten lancieren Matching-Plattform «vaib»
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Tech-Startup Iris Labs kombiniert KI-gestütztes Matching mit fundierter Beziehungspsychologie, um Menschen im realen Leben für Freizeitaktivitäten und Dating zusammenzubringen. Nach dem Launch in der Region Zürich verzeichnet Iris Labs ein stetiges Nutzerwachstum und bereits mehrere generierte Real-Life-Matches.

rows.title: $3million to scale Cotierra's biochar production system
rows.summary: Cotierra, a Zurich-based company developing decentralized biochar systems for agricultural value chains, has completed a $3 million funding round led by PINC, the venture arm of international food and beverage company Paulig. The round follows successful pilots and will now support commercial deployments across coffee supply chains.

rows.title: An encouraging review of the ecosystem
rows.summary: The book Venture Capital Success, edited by Christian Hugo Hoffmann and Sebastian Hersberger, provides an overview of the development, challenges and key debates within the Swiss start-up ecosystem. The topics are examined from various perspectives by practitioners – primarily investors – as well as by ecosystem insiders.

rows.title: Tech4Trust to empower 30 startups securing AI
rows.summary: Trust Valley has just announced the 30 startups—including 15 from Switzerland—selected for the eighth edition of Tech4Trust, its global accelerator dedicated to digital trust and cybersecurity. The cohort was unveiled at EPFL (Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne) during the Trust Valley Days 2026. Starting in September 2026 the program will lead to the Global AI Summit to be held in Geneva in June 2027.

rows.title: Phylax Intelligence holt sich den *zünder Award 2026
rows.summary: Mit der Preisverleihung im Verkehrshaus der Schweiz ging der diesjährige *zünder accelerator zu Ende. Drei Startups wurden mit einem *zünder Award ausgezeichnet, zudem wurde ein Publikumspreis vergeben. Der mit 15'000 Franken dotierte Hauptpreis ging an das Zuger Startup Phylax Intelligence für seine KI-gestützte Lösung für Sicherheits- und Krisenteams.

rows.title: RheoCarti awarded CHF 150,000 to advance hydrogel-articulated joint implants
rows.summary: Based in Zurich, RheoCarti is developing a new generation of joint implants designed to mimic the properties of natural cartilage. Combining titanium with a low-friction, shock-absorbing hydrogel, the startup aims to enable smoother, more natural joint movement and address implant-related complications, particularly in younger and more active patients. The CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick will be used to advance this solution.

rows.title: Grand prize in Italy and more for Swiss startups
rows.summary: Medtech startup CC Cardio and its partner have been awarded €160,000 from the Tech Europe Foundation to further develop its single-ventricle pump while Besfort Biljali, cofounder of Lighting tech company Lumvin received the swissalbs Entrepreneur Award, recognizing his professional success, innovation, and social engagement. In Helsinki, 14 startups are contesting to win half a million Euros as part of the Slush Top100 competition.

rows.title: Vito New Energies prend une participation majoritaire dans Helvetiqua
rows.summary: La neuchâteloise Vito New Energies Solutions SA, qui opère sous la marque VITO Energies, filiale à 100 % de Vitogaz Switzerland AG - leader suisse de l’énergie propane —, annonce la prise d'une participation de 60 % dans le capital d'Helvetiqua SA, acteur reconnu de la rénovation énergétique en Suisse romande.

rows.title: Swiss Activities lanciert digitalen Helfer für Freizeitplanung
rows.summary: Auf seiner Buchungsplattform für Freizeitaktivitäten hat Swiss Activities mittlerweile über 3’1000 direkt buchbare Erlebnisse und mehr als 12'000 weitere Freizeitideen vereint. Nun fokussiert sich das Zürcher Startup auf den Traffic-Ausbau und will mit einer Neuerung langfristig mehr Buchungen für seine Partner realisieren.

rows.title: CHF2 million to integrate quantum processors in high-performance computers
rows.summary: Qambria builds the classical engine designed to address the bottlenecks between quantum and classical compute. The company from the Canton of Thurgau has closed a pre-seed round backed by a an international group of family offices, VCs and specialist investors.

rows.title: Climate Collider exposes Swiss startups to New York and Boston
rows.summary: The fifth edition of Climate Collider, a climate-tech program Startup Camp powered by Innosuisse and managed by Swissnex has taken place with eight Swiss startups. From 14 to 25 September, they traveled to Boston and New York to explore the US ecosystem, build transatlantic partnerships and took part in the Climate Week NYC, one of the largest annual climate events of its kind.

rows.title: Neural Concept expands in India with new hubs
rows.summary: Neural Concept, the Swiss AI-native scale-up, just announced the establishment of a direct commercial presence in India, with teams based in Bengaluru and Pune, marking the company's first official, dedicated footprint in the country. The move follows growing demand from Indian and global manufacturers already using the Engineering Intelligence platform in the region, including MAHLE, and gives them direct access to local commercial support, training and coordination with Neural Concept’s global engineering expertise as they scale AI across design and simulation workflows.

rows.title: Food Brewer bringt kakaofreien Snackriegel mit Schokoladengeschmack in SBB-Züge
rows.summary: Food Brewer entwickelt nachhaltige Alternativen zu Rohstoffen wie Kakao und Kaffee. Ab sofort sind die YODEL BITES des Zürcher Foodtech Startups in allen SBB-Zügen mit Speisewagen erhältlich. Der Dessert-Snackriegel wird ohne Kakao auf der Basis von lokal bezogenen Zutaten hergestellt.

rows.title: BODDY's strategic realignment meets with positive response
rows.summary: BODDY, founded as a travel-focused fitness platform expands into the loyalty and benefits market, helping companies give their customers, cardholders and employees access to meaningful experiences across wellness, lifestyle and travel through one single platform. The shift was driven by market demand.

rows.title: CSEM launches Start-up Elevate Program for Swiss deep-tech
rows.summary: CSEM is launching Start-up Elevate, a new program that will give five pre-Series A selected deep-tech start-ups CHF 50,000 worth of targeted technology development support each to overcome one critical technical barrier to growth. The initiative targets a technology development gap that can emerge as start-ups move from prototype to industrial deployment.

rows.title: USD 5.4 Million to advance Prevision Medicine’s functional precision oncology platform
rows.summary: Prevision Medicine closed its seed round. The funding will accelerate the commercialization of its precision medicine test for hematological malignancies and solid tumors.

rows.title: Geneva startup runs sovereign AI and open-sources agent cockpit
rows.summary: Geneva-based NINABOT just launched SOKKAN 2.0, an open-source dashboard designed for teams running multiple AI inference agents in parallel. In total NINABOT, which was founded only a few months ago, already operates four interconnected products. Behind this lies a clear strategy which, on the one hand, utilises AI to develop products, whilst, on the other hand, also implements purposeful initiatives to maintain a long-term competitive edge over rivals.

rows.title: Planik wird Teil der LogObject-Gruppe
rows.summary: Per 1. Oktober 2026 wird die Planik AG Teil der LogObject-Gruppe. Die regelbasierte Personaleinsatzplanung von Planik ergänzt die Lösungen von LogObject für Dienstplanung, Einsatzsteuerung und Zeiterfassung. Gemeinsam eröffnen die Angebote die Möglichkeit, Abläufe künftig noch durchgängiger zu unterstützen.

rows.title: ClearSpace versatile new docking capability lands ESA contract
rows.summary: ClearSpace has signed a contract with the European Space Agency (ESA) for the next phase of Phoenix, its GEO satellite life-extension mission. Building on development supported by Luxembourg, the new phase with ESA will mature Phoenix’s rendezvous, docking and servicing technologies towards commercial GEO life-extension services.

rows.title: Positive clinical trials boost confidence of Swiss biotechs
rows.summary: Biotech companies Tolremo, Opterio Health and AC Immune have reported positive results in ongoing clinical trials for therapies aiming to address solid tumors, chronic kidney disease and Parkinson’s disease, respectively. These promising milestones allow the startups to proceed to the next step, advancing them toward potential market entry.

rows.title: Energy Vault acquires Goshe Energy Storage assets and increases credit facility
rows.summary: With the acquisition of a portfolio of U.S. battery energy storage system development projects from Goshe Energy Storage, Energy Vault is expanding its assets vault platform. This transaction adds 2.3+ GW of BESS development, including 350 MW Ready to build. Energy Vault has also secured a credit facility commitment of $40 million to support the development, construction and operations of the acquired portfolio.

rows.title: Albatross secures first client in the US
rows.summary: After real-time AI discovery deed pilot lifts engagement to 84%, OfferUp, the mobile marketplace that helps millions buy, sell, and connect locally across the United States, has agreed to a long-term partnership with Swiss AI firm Albatross to deploy real-time adaptive discovery technology across its marketplace.

rows.title: Positive echo for newly launched AI platform for FMCG sector
rows.summary: Two former El Tony Mate colleagues are bringing artificial intelligence to the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) industry with Sellva (formerly smartNsales), an AI-native software platform designed to help commercial teams turn fragmented information into actionable insights. Starting with the Food and Beverages market, the company has already onboarded its first customers and secured funding.

rows.title: Bosch setzt auf c.technologys Plattform für die Fahrzeugindustrie
rows.summary: Die Zürcher c.technology, spezialisiert auf Cloud- und Plattformlösungen für Fahrzeughersteller und OEMs, spannt mit Bosch Mobility zusammen. Die gemeinsam entwickelte Lösung ist inzwischen bei einem ersten Kunden im Einsatz. Nun arbeiten die Partner an der weiteren Skalierung.

rows.title: Frisches Kapital und neuer strategischer Partner fürs Stromkonto
rows.summary: Das Startup NRGY One hat eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen, an der sich bestehende Partner und Investoren beteiligt haben. Neu ist zudem das Bau- und Gebäudetechnikunternehmen GLB Gruppe als strategischer Partner mit an Bord. Mit der Finanzierung und dem neuen Partner will sich NRGY One mit seiner Plattform Stromkonto bei der Öffnung des Schweizer Strommarkts als «Neo Energy Supplier» bereit sein.

rows.title: Birds&Co, Piccovélo et Woofy accélérées par GENILEM
rows.summary: Trois nouveaux projets entrepreneuriaux romands ont été sélectionnés pour intégrer le programme d’accélération de GENILEM. Pendant trois ans, Birds&Co., Piccovélo et Woofy bénéficieront d’un accompagnement personnalisé pour consolider leur modèle, développer leurs ventes et accélérer leur implantation sur le marché.

rows.title: Bluelion to support nine startups accelerate development
rows.summary: This autumn, nine promising pre-seed startups will obtain support from the Bluelion ecosystem, including workshops, hands-on guidance and access to its network with the aim of enabling the teams transform their ideas into sustainable business cases. The selected teams are working on solutions across AI, biotech, climate tech and beyond.

rows.title: EQT sells Ontinue stake to Scottish cybersecurity company
rows.summary: Private Equity firm EQT has signed a definitive agreement to sell Zurich-based Ontinue, a provider of AI-powered managed cybersecurity services focused on the Microsoft ecosystem, to Scotland-based Quorum Cyber. Under EQT’s ownership Ontinue doubled in scale and strengthened its financial position since 2022.

rows.title: Startups on national and global pedestals
rows.summary: Across the world, four Swiss startups collected award prizes and tickets to prestigious support programs such as the Morgan Stanley Inclusive & Sustainable Ventures program, giving them with the opportunity to further accelerate advance their solutions and gain access to a global network. In Switzerland, Zentralschweizer Neuunternehmerpreis, the Helbling challenge and the Swiss Excellence Product Award revealed the winners.

rows.title: Rising Perovskia scales up and eyes space tech
rows.summary: Over the past few months, Perovskia Solar has achieved some major milestones: the company has moved from the laboratory stage to large-scale production, is now supplying customers who are developing energy-autonomous electronic devices, and is embarking on a new chapter in India, where it has signed a key memorandum of understanding to explore the potential of next-generation perovskite solar technology for space applications.

rows.title: LUKB-Zukunftspreis: 4 Startups nominiert
rows.summary: In drei Kategorien hat die Luzerner Kantonalbank LUKB je drei Projekte für den Zukunftspreis nominiert. Darunter sind auch die vier Startups Energy Control, Precira, Nettle Circle und Kiyo. Vom 21. September bis 5. Oktober 2026 läuft die Online-Abstimmung und entscheidet, welches der Projekte zum Kategoriensieger erkoren wird.

rows.title: Mit Crowdinvesting das Wachstum ankurbeln
rows.summary: Während Aspivix seine Crowdinvesting-Kampagne mit knapp 800’000 Franken abschliessen konnte, haben Care und Bakery Bakery kurz nach dem Start ihrer Runden bereits grosse Summen eingesammelt. Und auch Magic Heidi hat nach wenigen Tagen bereits mehr als die Hälfte des Sammelziels beisammen.

rows.title: Strüngmann Award-Gewinner zum 3. Mal in Folge mit Schweiz-Bezug
rows.summary: Der Biotech-Unternehmer Jonathan Talbot gewinnt den mit 100.000 Euro dotierten Strüngmann Award 2026. Talbot hat mehrere Startups im Bereich Life-Sciences – darunter Mosanna Therapeutics - aufgebaut und von der Gründung bis in die klinische Entwicklung überführt. Heute leitet er das Basler Biotech Melodia Therapeutics.

rows.title: Swisscanto leads USD 25 million growth financing for Piomic Medical
rows.summary: Piomic Medical, an emerging medtech company focused on complex tissue healing, closed a growth financing of USD 25 million. Proceeds fund the timely completion of the company’s current clinical development program, including the MAVERICKS IDE pivotal trial and the NAZARÉ trial, U.S. market approval filing and market entry for the COMS One Therapy System, and expansion of the COMS platform into future applications.

rows.title: Following a CHF 2.4 million seed round, Aseptuva progressed to preclinical validation
rows.summary: Last year Swiss-UK Medtech startup Aseptuva raised CHF 2.4 million from prominent healthcare entrepreneurs and investors. The financing has enabled Aseptuva to progress from early prototyping to preclinical validation in Europe.

rows.title: Die Finalisten des Swiss Technology Award 2026
rows.summary: Aus über 120 erstklassigen Bewerbungen hat eine Fachjury die neun Nominierten für den diesjährigen Swiss Technology Award ausgewählt – darunter sechs Startups. Wer die Technologie-Auszeichnung mit nach Hause nehmen darf, entscheidet sich am Donnerstag, 26. November 2026, an der Swiss Technology Award Night im Rahmen des Innovationsanlasses Open-i in Zürich.

rows.title: Time to scale with IMD & Innovaud
rows.summary: Moving from startup to scale-up requires more than a great product and access to capital. It means evolving as a CEO, building an organization that can grow with you, and making high-stakes strategic decisions — often at speed. Created by Innovaud and IMD, the six-month, hands-on LeadiNNg to Scale-up program brings together a select group of ambitious CEOs of Swiss-based startups who are ready to accelerate their next phase of growth.

rows.title: 2026 FIT Impact Grand Prix crowns Littlecubes
rows.summary: Bringing together more than 100 people, the third edition of the FIT Impact Awards ceremony took place on Thursday 17 September 2026, as part of Showcase, the event organised by the Enterprise for Society Centre (E4S) and dedicated to responsible innovation. LittlesCubes won the Grand Prix of CHF 20’000 and the People’s Choice Award of CHF 5’000.

rows.title: IQ Venture Club steigt bei naoo ein
rows.summary: Die Zuger naoo AG, Betreiberin einer KI-gestützten Social Discovery, Activation & Commerce Platform gewinnt mit dem in Zug ansässigen IQ Venture Club einen neuen Investor. Naoo gewinnt einen Partner, , der neben Kapital auch unternehmerische Erfahrung, strategisches Sparring und ein internationales Netzwerk in die weitere Entwicklung des Unternehmens einbringen kann.

rows.title: Embodied AI launches with International Consortium backing
rows.summary: Embodied AI, a Europe-wide start-up based in Lausanne, launches to tackle key automation challenges. Backed by a global group of investors, Embodied AI is developing intelligent robots designed to operate alongside humans in real-world environments.

rows.title: Eight startups kick off Energy & Environment Accelerator program
rows.summary: The second edition of the Energy and Environment Accelerator kicked off on Tuesday with eight startups from Geneva and Lausanne and Zurich. The six-months program will support them in finding the right teams, industry partners and investors as they advance their solutions.

rows.title: Proton to integrate Apertus into its AI assistant
rows.summary: Swiss technology company Proton, which specializes in privacy-focused services, and the research team behind the fully open language model Apertus are partnering to advance open and sovereign AI in Switzerland and Europe. Proton is integrating Apertus 1.5 into its AI assistant, Lumo, making it an available option to tens of millions of users and sharing their feedback with the Apertus team to help improve the model.

rows.title: Ski-Star Niels Hintermann steigt bei Schweizer Fintech Kredo ein
rows.summary: Der ehemalige Schweizer Ski-Profi Niels Hintermann beteiligt sich am Schweizer Fintech-Unternehmen Kredo. Gleichzeitig wird der Speed-Spezialist neuer Markenbotschafter des Unternehmens.

rows.title: Swedish company acquires Planlabs
rows.summary: Endra, a Stockholm-based company providing AI tools for mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) engineering, has acquired Switzerand-based Planlabs to further expand into mechanical engineering. The Swiss team will join the new company.

rows.title: Giotto Sovereign AI seduces Groupe Mutuel
rows.summary: Giotto.ai, the Swiss artificial intelligence company specialising in advanced reasoning systems, and Groupe Mutuel, Switzerland’s only global insurer serving over 1.3 million clients, have started a collaboration to deploy the AI model Giotto across some use cases. Currently, the insurer is exploring the potential of Giotto’s model by testing it across various use cases and business domains.

rows.title: Das sind die *zünder-Finalisten 2026
rows.summary: Während dem *zünder accelerator Programm bekommen ausgewählte Startups die Möglichkeit, an einer 10monatigen Ausbildungs-Serie teilzunehmen. Zum Abschluss treten nun sechs der teilnehmenden Startups zum Finale während dem *zünder Startup Takeoff im Verkehrshaus in Luzern an.

rows.title: Helvo financial operating system for Swiss SMEs goes live
rows.summary: Following a beta with around 50 businesses, Swiss fintech Helvo is now available to SMEs across Switzerland. Built on a Swiss business account with CHF and EUR IBANs, Helvo brings accounts, payments, invoicing, accounting, payroll and financial insight into one system. Led by Julien Barbotin-Larrieu, Helvo aims to reach 500 Swiss businesses by the end of 2026 as it scales across the SME market.

rows.title: ETFBOOK raises $13 million to expand ETF data intelligence layer
rows.summary: ETFBOOK (SquaredData AG) has raised $13M in a funding round led by Expedition Growth Capital, with participation from existing investor BlackFin Capital Partners. The proceeds will fund the next growth phase, including expanding the default intelligence layer for the global ETF market and scaling it from EMEA to the US and Asia Pacific.

rows.title: Swiss scale-ups examined
rows.summary: The first Swiss Scale-up Report paints a detailed, data-based picture of growth companies, ranging from their economic importance and financing to their market success, challenges and exit strategies. The generally positive picture is marred by widespread plans to relocate and the preference of scale-ups for exits abroad.

rows.title: Blitzstart in Spanien für Vermietungsplattform storabble
rows.summary: Ohne Niederlassung und mit der Unterstützung von KI expandiert storabble nach Spanien – mit und nach Standorten bisher grösstes Land. Nach zwei Wochen am Markt hat das St. Galler Startup bereits einen grösseren Self-Storage-Anbieter als Kunden gewonnen und über 700 Lagerflächen vermittelt.

rows.title: Startup Nights 2030: high ambitions and a new location
rows.summary: Starting 2027, the annual startup Nights conference will take place at Messe Zurich, providing room for over 14’000 visitors as the event enters a new decade. The new location aligns with the programs Vision 2030 that was presented yesterday to around 100 guests highlighting the ambition to transition from a two-day to a full-week-event with over 50’000 participants and 150 side events.

rows.title: IRISgo mit 500'000 Euro-Deal bei «Die Höhle der Löwen Deutschland»
rows.summary: Das Luzerner Startup IRISgo hat bei der TV-Sendung «Die Höhle der Löwen» auf dem deutschen TV-Sender VOX einen Deal mit Investor Andreas Herb abgeschlossen. Das Investment beträgt 500'000 Euro. Zusammen mit dem Löwen will IRISgo das Geschäft zunächst in der DACH-Region weiter ausbauen.

rows.title: Stellar Alpina acquires Etanox’s assets
rows.summary: Spacetech company Stellar Alpina has strengthened its core technology with the acquisition of Etanox assets including propulsion hardware, equipment and development infrastructure. This move, along with welcoming an experienced engineer, allows the Zurich startup to progress towards delivering a flight-capable engine by 2028.

rows.title: Insolight au cœur de la plus grande installation agrivoltaïque de Suisse
rows.summary: À Lovatens dans le canton de Vaud, Insolight, Romande Energie et le producteur Olivier Pichonnat viennent d’inaugurer la grande installation agrivoltaïque de Suisse en présence des conseillères d'État Valérie Dittli et Isabelle Moret. L’installation associe protection des cultures et production d'électricité renouvelable sur une même surface.

rows.title: Ingredients innovator Ferm Labs secures €3M
rows.summary: One year following its incorporation, Swiss-Italian startup Ferm Labs AG has announced the closing of a €3M funding round. The capital will be used to scale the company’s bioprocessing platform which enables the production of saltless, clean‑label flavour enhancers for industrial food manufacturers.

rows.title: Flottando exits stealth driven by strong italian demand and pre-seed funding
rows.summary: Flottando, the Geneva-based software startup behind the Fleet Intelligence category, today announced the closing of a pre-seed funding round led by HFGA Investment Holding.The round marks the first institutional capital in a company built for three years by its founders and backed by Swiss angel investors and FONGIT, during which its platform was developed, tested and deployed with hundreds of Italian and European companies.

rows.title: Japanese company supports Swiss dental specialist Odne
rows.summary: Switzerland based Odne, an upcoming innovator in endodontic treatments, has entered a capital and business alliance with MANI, Inc., a leading Japanese manufacturer of medical and dental devices. Under the agreement, MANI will make an investment in Odne, and the two companies will collaborate to accelerate the global expansion of Odne’s root canal treatment technologies.

rows.title: Following a seed extension, AEON acquires consumer blood diagnostics platform
rows.summary: Aeon, the Zurich-based preventive healthcare company focussed on AI-powered whole-body health check-ups, closed a seed extension round bringing the total money raised in this round to USD 14 million. The investment funds the integration of technology and team of Germany's leading consumer blood diagnostics platform, Aware Health, alongside Aeon's accelerated European roadmap.

rows.title: Verretex lands SPEI sustainable collaborative project
rows.summary: Swiss cleantech Verretex, together with MAD skis and Suter Kunstoffe, has been awarded CHF 100,000 in financial support from the State of Vaud through the SPEI’s sustainable collaborative projects programme.

rows.title: United Airlines Ventures invests in Assaia
rows.summary: Assaia, a leader in artificial intelligence and computer vision for airport operations, attracted an investment from United Airlines Ventures (UAV), the venture capital arm of United Airlines. The investment combined with industry expertise will support the development of a new stand and gate management product.

rows.title: CHF 250,000 SurfAce Pre-Seed Round to Advance Compostable coating Technology
rows.summary: SurfAce Cleantech, a Swiss deep-tech startup developing a patent-pending coating technology for compostable flexible packaging, has closed a CHF 250,000 pre-seed financing round. The round was backed by Swiss business angels, including an investor from the SICTIC network, as well as Stiftung HSG START Accelerator.

rows.title: FE+MALE report: fixing the funding bias may be more practical than political
rows.summary: Women remain significantly underrepresented among the Swiss founders securing venture capital, but closing the gap will require more than good intentions. A new FE+MALE Think Tank report argues that changing how investors, accelerators and funding institutions evaluate, connect with and allocate capital to founders could help narrow the gap.

rows.title: Startups sammeln Wachstumskapital bei der Crowd
rows.summary: Die drei Startups Nullpunkt, Walnut Planet und ONESTO haben frisches Kapital von der Crowd für ihre Eisspeicher-Wärmepumpen, Walnuss-Plantagen und Fairtrade-Kaffee eingesammelt. Nun machen sie sich daran, ihre jeweiligen Technologien und Produkte zu skalieren.

rows.title: Key approvals, positive study results and a partnership deal to fast track new medications
rows.summary: The US Food and Drug Administration and the European Medicines Agency have granted two biotechs with Fast Track designation and Orphan Drug designation, respectively for therapies targeting ventilator-associated bacterial pneumonia and thymic epithelial tumours. Windward Bio and Pharvaris announced postive results from late-stage clinical trials. A new strategic collaboration for Avrios Therapeutics will see the company advance its AVR-001, an advanced preclinical gene therapy candidate for certain familial forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

rows.title: Medtech-Branche hadert mit Kostendruck und wittert neue Chancen
rows.summary: Während das Umsatzwachstum in den vergangenen beiden Jahren stark ausfiel, zeigt die aktuelle Branchenstudie von Swiss Medtech, dass die Schweiz für Unternehmen der Medizintechnikindustrie bezüglich Standortattraktivität schwächelt. Dies hat Auswirkungen auf die Rekrutierungs- und Investitionsabsichten.

rows.title: vyzn holt neuen Investor an Bord
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup vyzn, das eine Software für die ganzheitliche Gebäudeanalyse anbietet, will sein internationales Wachstum vorantreiben. Nach einer Seed-Runde Ende 2025 erhält das Unternehmen nun zusätzliche Unterstützung von buildify.earth, einem Schweizer Investor für nachhaltiges und zirkuläres Bauen.

rows.title: Dexterous Endoscopes and Precisia Care get FIT backing
rows.summary: The Foundation for Innovation and Technology (FIT) has announced its support for two new start-ups from Vaud. Dexterous Endoscopes has been awarded a Tech Seed loan of CHF 100’000 for its endoscope, which is capable of switching from a flexible to a rigid state during the same procedure. Precisia Care is also receiving a Tech Seed loan of CHF 100’000 for its hospital data analytics platform designed to anticipate patients’ needs and the workload of healthcare staff.

rows.title: siabit übernimmt Mitbewerber-Software und gewinnt neuen Investor
rows.summary: Das Aargauer Softwareunternehmen siabit baut seine Forstplattform ForstControl mit einer Akquisition der mobile Holzerfassungslösung MobiPolter von Raurica Wald weiter aus. Zudem beteiligt sich Raurica mit rund 8 Prozent an siabit. Das zusätzliche Kapital soll insbesondere in die Markteinführung der integrierten Holzerfassung und den weiteren Ausbau der ForstControl-Plattform fliessen.

rows.title: Corintis, DeepJudge and PAVE Space make up the podium of the Top100 Swiss Startup Award
rows.summary: The Top100 Swiss Startup Award again brought together Switzerland's most promising entrepreneurs, leading investors, industry executives, policymakers, and media representatives. Widely regarded as the "Oscars of Swiss Startups," the annual event celebrates the country's most innovative startups while highlighting Switzerland's position as the world's leading deep tech nation. The Top100 Swiss Startup Award is organized by Venturelab, in collaboration with its presenting partner UBS.

rows.title: Möbelmiete für Unternehmen: Lyght wächst in der Schweiz
rows.summary: Das in Basel ansässige Unternehmen Lyght bietet Firmen Möbel zur Miete an und übernimmt dabei den gesamten Prozess von der Planung bis zur Rücknahme. Seit der Gründung der eigenständigen Schweizer AG 2023 hat Lyght sein Geschäft in der Schweiz kontinuierlich ausgebaut und dabei rund 100 Möblierungsprojekte für Kunden wie Emirates Airline und Manor umgesetzt.

rows.title: Fresh funding for Gaia Tech
rows.summary: Kielder Agro Group, a Swiss-based responsible agriculture and sustainable development enterprise, has joined Gaia Tech as a strategic investor. Their investment and expertise will enable the startup to accelerate the development of its upcycled ingredients platform.

rows.title: Erste Krankenkasse setzt auf Medi-Check-Programm von TOM Medications
rows.summary: TOM Medications erreicht mit seiner App für Medikamentenmanagement mittlerweile rund drei Millionen Interaktionen von Userinnen und Usern pro Monat. Nebst der Steigerung der Therapietreue kann die App nun auch durch die Medikationsanalyse zur Senkung von Gesundheitskosten beitragen. Das steigert das Interesse von Versicherern und Pharmafirmen und trägt zum starken Umsatzwachstum bei.

rows.title: New advances signal the return of the Future of Health Grant
rows.summary: With six new startups selected from over 600 applications, and the launch of its first three hospital pilot projects involving alumni through its new” Pilot Factory,” the Future of Health Grant (FoHG) program supported by CSS and EPFL Innovation Park is off to a strong start of the season focused on scaling innovation.

rows.title: Fusionality raises CHF 3 million to take fusion devices next level
rows.summary: Fusionality today announced a CHF 3 million pre-seed round co-led by Founderful and Playfair. The company is building technologies that enable fusion companies to operate, monitor and analyze their devices.

rows.title: KI-Startup Studyond gibt Gas im Schweizer Markt
rows.summary: Nach einer Finanzierungsrunde über 2 Millionen Franken im Frühjahr baut Studyond seine Präsenz in der Schweiz weiter aus. Gleichzeitig hat das St. Galler Startup bereits erste Fühler ins Ausland ausgestreckt, wurde in das MIT Accelerator-Programm aufgenommen und plant für das kommende Jahr den Markteintritt im DACH-Raum.

rows.title: Synhelion expands into Morocco
rows.summary: Following the establishment of its Moroccan branch, Synhelion has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Morocco with the aim of developing a large-scale commercial synthetic fuel plant in the country’s southern Tan-Tan province. The facility is planned to produce 100’000 tons of renewable fuel per year.

rows.title: Goodwall, Roofless Labs and Infera Neuro awarded FIF Funding
rows.summary: Goodwall, Roofless Labs and Infera Neuro are the latest companies to receive funding from the FIF, the Canton of Geneva’s innovation financing programme supporting technology-driven startups, scale-ups and SMEs. Goodwall has been awarded CHF 400’000 in FIF Growth funding for its skills and careers platform for young people. Roofless Labs has received CHF 50’000 in FIF Seed Tech funding for K4MERA, its digital stereoscopic camera, and Infera Neuro has been awarded a FIF Grant of CHF 50’000 to advance its neural decoding chips for non-invasive thought-to-speech interfaces.

rows.title: New batch enrols in the HSG START Accelerator
rows.summary: Nine startups from Switzerland, France, Germany and Austria have joined the latest edition of the HSG START Accelerator to further advance their solutions, connect with mentors and investors, and become investor-ready.

rows.title: smarli. sichert sich frisches Kapital für weiteres Wachstum
rows.summary: Seit der Gründung 2023 wird die Smart-Home-Lösung des St. Galler Startups smarli. in zahlreichen Wohnungen und Büros eingesetzt. In seiner zweiten Finanzierungsrunde nimmt smarli. nun mehr als 2 Millionen Franken auf, um sein Partnernetzwerk auszubauen und die Smart-Home-Lösung weiterzuentwickeln.

rows.title: Proptech startup SCAIT to enhance construction tenders
rows.summary: Using the CHF 150’000 funding from Venture Kick, SCAIT is set to advance its AI platform for construction tendering. It turns thousands of pages of project documents into a structured tender workflow, identifies contractual risks, and automates bid preparation, providing companies with a basis for every bid decision and lets them process up to 60% more tenders.

rows.title: Boostbar kommt bei Valora zum Zug
rows.summary: Valora modernisiert gemeinsam mit dem Zürcher Vending-Startup Boostbar die mehreren hundert k kiosk Verkaufsautomaten in der Schweiz. Boostbar übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der Automaten, stellt die Software und Nutzeroberfläche bereit sowie die regelmässige Befüllung der Automaten sicher. Die Zahl der Automaten soll weiter steigen.

rows.title: Tech startups to scale growth with new executives
rows.summary: Five fast-growing start-ups are restructuring their management teams. The changes include a new CEO at viboo, a new leadership structure at EDWATEC, and new, experienced C-level executives at GoBugFree, Cleverdist and Exeon.

rows.title: Jaipur Robotics raises EUR 4.3 million
rows.summary: Ticino-based Jaipur Robotics has developed a SaaS platform powered by AI vision technology for waste-to-energy plants. The cleantech startup today announced the closing of a EUR 4.3 million Seed round to expand its AI operating system to more Waste-to-Energy and other industrial plants in new regions.

rows.title: Boldbrain Startup Challenge presents new cohort
rows.summary: Boldbrain, Ticino’s accelerator for innovative early-stage startups, has announced the twenty teams that will participate in its three-month acceleration programme. Now in its ninth year, the Boldbrain Startup Challenge received more than 100 eligible applications for the first time.

rows.title: DataHow secures bridge financing to expand its digital bioprocess development solution
rows.summary: DataHow, a leader in AI-powered solutions for biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing, has closed a bridge financing round extending its Series A. The new capital will be used to accelerate real-time and downstream expansion of DataHowLab.

rows.title: Sensopro gewinnt Schweizer NHL-Profi Nico Hischier als Mitinhaber
rows.summary: Das Berner Fitness- und Gesundheitsunternehmen Sensopro zählt heute zu den führenden Anbietern von Trainingsgeräten für Koordinationstraining. Mit seinen Produkten ist Sensopro in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Österreich, den Benelux-Ländern und Skandinavien auf dem Markt. Nun kann das Unternehmen für die nächste Wachstumsphase auf den Spitzensportler Nico Hischier als Investor und Mitinhaber zählen.

rows.title: Stellar Alpina’s innovation opens new possibilities for orbital mobility
rows.summary: The robotics startup Stellar Alpina is developing rotating detonation rocket engines (RDREs), which can reduce the size and complexity of propulsion systems while improving performance. The Zurich-based company has now obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop a new generation of compact rocket engines for moving spacecraft once they reach orbit.

rows.title: PostFinance erweitert Angebot mit Hilfe zweier Startups
rows.summary: PostFinance arbeitet neu mit Properti und iqtax zusammen. Die Partnerschaft mit Properti ermöglicht es PostFinance-Kundinnen und Kunden, den Verkauf ihrer Liegenschaft digital gestützt und zu transparenten Konditionen abzuwickeln. Und im Rahmen eines Pilotprojekts im Kanton Zürich vertreibt PostFinance das Produkt von iqtax, mit dem die Erstellung einer Steuererklärung drastisch verkürzt wird.

rows.title: 2026 AI Track powered by UBS selects four trailblazers
rows.summary: The Startup Launchpad AI Track powered by UBS, is the first Swiss grant program dedicated to AI. Following the selection of six inaugural grantees in 2025, this second call supports four new EPFL projects, which will share CHF 160,000 in funding to accelerate their journey from lab to real-world impact. All the projects are expected to be incorporated in the coming months.

rows.title: KimboCare's Resilia prevention platform is off to a strong start
rows.summary: Resilia, a newly launched KimboCare platform that transforms prevention into a performance driver for businesses, has gotten off to a flying start: in nine months, it has secured its first three-year contracts with clients totaling more than 1,000 committed employees. In addition, this startup co-founded by Franck Tiambo has already won over more than 500 healthcare providers in Switzerland’s six major cities.

rows.title: NewBiologix lands Partner to Advance Stable rAAV Manufacturing
rows.summary: NewBiologix S.A., a Swiss biotechnology company pioneering stable cell line technologies for recombinant adeno-associated virus (rAAV) manufacturing, just announced an agreement with Synastra Biotechnology Inc. to develop a stable producer cell line for Synastra's investigational Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) gene therapy program. Synastra is a Türkiye-based gene therapy company established through a collaboration between Üsküdar University and Unifon-Biotech GSYF Venture Capital Investment Fund.

rows.title: Yann Sommer investiert in Plattform für Krankenkassenvergleiche
rows.summary: Der ehemalige Schweizer Nationaltorhüter Yann Sommer steigt beim Schweizer Start-up SnapCheck als Investor und Partner ein. Die Plattform ist seit kurzem live; zwischenzeitlich wurden hunderte Offerten und Vergleiche über das Portal erstellt.

rows.title: Startup projects from CHUV and EPFL get FIT support
rows.summary: The Foundation for Innovation and Technology (FIT) has announced the award of new Tech Grants, worth CHF 100’000 each, to five projects in the Canton of Vaud: three grants have been awarded to Chorus Tre, HeteroSight and Sixtine AI, all originating from the CHUV, and two grants have been awarded to Cookd Labs and Endobotica, projects originating from EPFL.

rows.title: Finfluencer Fabio Marchesin invests in Relai’s funding round
rows.summary: Famous from his finance platform ‘FinanzFabio’, Fabio Marchesin has built a community with over 250’000 followers across his channels. He is now taking on an active role in fintech startup Relai, providing capital and marketing expertise to further strengthen the company’s position. Additional investors participated in the round, jointly investing $2.5 million in the startup.

rows.title: NovaGo Secures USD 30 Million to Advance Proof-of-Concept Study in Acute Spinal Cord Injury
rows.summary: NovaGo Therapeutics AG, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, develops anti-Nogo-A biologics with the goal of delivering the first regenerative treatment for patients with acute spinal cord injury. Proceeds from the financing will be used to advance NovaGo's lead program into a proof-of-concept (PoC) study in patients with acute spinal cord injury.

rows.title: Santelle launches pilot in Swiss pharmacies
rows.summary: After closing its CHF 120,000 angel round, Geneva-based femtech startup Santelle has now launched a two-month pilot under Galenica’s "Consultation Plus” framework with 15 Swiss pharmacies for its CE-marked vaginal infection self-test and companion app.

rows.title: FluoSphera powers ahead with Debiopharm and Leica Microsystems
rows.summary: FluoSphera entered into a license agreement for use of AbYlink, Debiopharm’s proprietary antibody conjugation technology. The agreement enables FluoSphera to offer biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies an integrated workflow combining regio-selective antibody labeling, high-throughput testing in human-relevant three-dimensional models and quantitative imaging analysis.

rows.title: Panda Therapeutics set to advance a multi-target Alzheimer’s therapy
rows.summary: By targeting multiple harmful protein deposits in the brain with a single therapy, PANDA Therapeutics aims to improve treatment effectiveness of Alzheimer’s disease and slow its progression. The early-stage company has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance its platform and fast-track company formation.

rows.title: Stryker acquires ZuriMED to enhance its shoulder offering
rows.summary: Medical technology giant Stryker has signed a definitive agreement to acquire ZuriMED, developer of the FiberLocker System, a commercialized technology that provides a novel approach for rotator cuff augmentation designed for increased biomechanical strength. The FiberLocker system received FDA clearance in February 2025.

rows.title: Chinese distributor acquires assets of Smixin
rows.summary: Fullydo Technology, based in Suzhou close to Shanghai, has signed a definitive Asset Sale and Purchase Agreement to acquire the tangible and intangible operating assets of Biel-based Smixin AG. Smixin’s patented water-saving, touchless hand-hygiene systems are widely deployed across medical institutions, educational facilities, office buildings, transportation hubs, hospitality venues and clinics.

rows.title: xorlab raises EUR 5 Million to build Europe’s sovereign email security platform
rows.summary: Trusted by some of Europe's most demanding organizations across financial services, critical infrastructure, healthcare, and the public sector, xorlab is scaling rapidly as European enterprises seek to reduce their dependence on U.S.-controlled infrastructure. The capital from the round led by Spicehaus Partners will accelerate this expansion.

rows.title: Rocket Day + Impact Award 2026: REEcover gewinnt.
rows.summary: Rund 250 Gäste, acht herausragende Start-ups und eine Gewinnerin: Am Rocket Day + Impact Award 2026 im Kraftwerk Zürich trafen Innovation, Unternehmertum und nachhaltige Entwicklung aufeinander. Der diesjährige Impact Award geht an REEcover, das mit einer Technologie zur Rückgewinnung seltener Erden aus Elektroschrott Jury und Publikum überzeugte.

rows.title: Femtech KOVE medical eyes First in Human study after CHF1.6 million seed round
rows.summary: KOVE medical develops a solution to reduce the risk of preterm birth following surgeries made on the fetus during pregnancy. It unleashes the potential of in-utero surgeries by making those interventions safer, contributing in saving babies before they are born.

rows.title: Geschäftskonto eröffnen: Was Startups frühzeitig wissen sollten
rows.summary: Produkt entwickeln, erste Kund:innen gewinnen, Finanzierung sichern: Wer ein Startup gründet, hat viel zu tun. Das Geschäftskonto geht dabei schnell vergessen. Dabei kann eine schlecht vorbereitete Kontoeröffnung wertvolle Zeit kosten, etwa wenn eine Finanzierungsrunde ansteht oder die erste grosse Rechnung gestellt werden muss. Dieser Leitfaden zeigt, welche Unterlagen wichtig sind, wann welches Konto nötig ist und wie Startups Verzögerungen vermeiden.

rows.title: Foldcast receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to cut concrete waste with paper moulds
rows.summary: With its recyclable paper moulds USI spin-off Foldcast aims to reduce material use and carbon emissions while enabling high-performance building elements with greater design freedom. The CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick will fund Foldcast’s transition from validation to market entry.

rows.title: Cleantech start-ups expand with European partners
rows.summary: Voltiris partnered with Novagric, a greenhouse technology company in Spain with 50 years of experience. eMost and UK-based Think Energy Group have entered into a reciprocal agreement, to make the partner’s products available in their respective countries.

rows.title: Swiss industrial company Bystronic acquires Isochronic
rows.summary: Bystronic has entered into an agreement to acquire Isochronic AG, a Swiss automation technology company founded in 2020 and specializing in high-speed robotic sorting systems and software for sheet metal processing. Isochronic will continue to operate under its own name.

rows.title: Three deep tech start-ups from the healthcare sector honoured
rows.summary: Bewe Lab wins the first Global Leverage Award. Optohive is selected by the University of Bremen and the winner of Falling Walls Lab Switzerland is breaking the wall of pregnancy drug testing.

rows.title: Shedding light on the reasons behind start-up relocations
rows.summary: Drawing on the latest research findings and data, a new report by the UBS Chief Investment Office (CIO) examines the reasons why Swiss start-ups are relocating and compares the situation with that in other countries. The study is the first in a multi-part series that takes an in-depth look at the diverse challenges facing the Swiss startup and scaleup ecosystem from different perspectives.

rows.title: Viso.ai reports strong early adoption
rows.summary: Viso Now, viso.ai’s platform that enables anyone to build a working computer vision application in minutes, was launched successfully: Viso Now has already seen over 1,000 users creating more than 3,500 vision applications, with a median time to first application of less than 3 minutes, signalling immediate market acceptance of a faster, more accessible approach to computer vision.

rows.title: Stärken und Schwächen der Schweiz als Startup Standort
rows.summary: Im Rahmen einer Studie von aws und Strand Partners wurden maximal zwei Jahre alte Schweizer Startups nach Umzugsplänen und Gründen für das Bleiben oder Gehen befragt. 32% erwägen einen Wegzug. Die Top 3 Gründe sind die bessere Verfügbarkeit von Finanzmitteln, geringere Betriebskosten und die schnellere Möglichkeit zur internationalen Skalierung.

rows.title: Entrepreneur Of The Year 2026: Die Finalisten stehen fest
rows.summary: Das Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmen EY vergibt seit 29 Jahren einen nationalen Unternehmerpreis. Fünf der neun Unternehmen im Final stammen aus dem Schweizer Start-up- und Scale-up-Ökosystem.

rows.title: vVARDIS drill-free treatment adopted by Bupa Dental Care
rows.summary: Bupa Dental Care will offer Curodont Repair, the non-invasive early-decay treatment made by Zug-based vVARDIS, across its 380 UK practices. It is the second large-scale UK provider agreement for the Swiss medtech unicorn this year, following a deal with mydentist in January.

rows.title: Addex sells shares to extend runway into 2027
rows.summary: Addex Therapeutics has raised gross proceeds of USD 2.8 million through its at-the-market programme with US investment bank H.C. Wainwright & Co. The clinical-stage biotech said the sale extends its cash runway to the fourth quarter of 2027.

rows.title: FIT supports WasteFlow, DOCumenter, Nextrainers and RiveLock
rows.summary: The FIT Foundation is supporting four new Vaud start-ups through its Digital programmes. WasteFlow has received a CHF 200,000 Digital Growth loan to make waste-sorting centres safer and more efficient. DOCumenter and Nextrainers have each received CHF 50,000 Digital Seed grants for tools that reduce doctors’ administrative workload and automate football training preparation, respectively. RiveLock has received a CHF 20,000 Digital Grant for its secure payment solution for renovation work.

rows.title: Adaptyv raises $40M to build automated lab for agentic biology
rows.summary: Biopôle-based Adaptyv Biosystems just raised a $40M Series A to build the automated lab for agentic biology, The Swiss startup develops a protein engineering platform powered by synthetic biology, nanofluidics and machine learning.

rows.title: Exentis secures an order volume of CHF 22 million for 15 production systems in Asia
rows.summary: Exentis has signed a framework agreement with a new customer in Asia for 15 of its additive production systems, in an order worth approximately CHF 22 million. The systems will be used for large-scale manufacturing of consumer electronics components.

rows.title: Three Swiss biotechs promote from within
rows.summary: Avrion Therapeutics, InSphero and Opterion Health have each filled senior roles from within: a co-founder takes over as interim CEO at Avrion, while InSphero and Opterion elevate long-term insiders.

rows.title: Objectis s’allie à Dgtis pour digitaliser l’industrie suisse
rows.summary: Dgtis SA et Objectis SA, deux éditeurs de logiciels industriels établis à Yverdon-les-Bains, annoncent la réunion de leurs compétences. Les solutions Seganto, InstantUX et Concept/Convergence, ainsi que les compétences et les collaborateurs qui les accompagnent, rejoignent dgtis.

rows.title: Successful Pilot spawns First Sun-Ways Project in Italy
rows.summary: Four months after unveiling its pilot solar power plant in Buttes, in the Neuchâtel mountains, Sun-Ways is shifting into high gear by teaming up with a commercial partner in Italy to install its first solar panel array. Building on this momentum, the company has also started working for SNCF in France. And this is just the beginning.

rows.title: Scaling Specialist AI: HGF Expands Qthena for Firm-Wide Patent Practice
rows.summary: After years of successful deployment, HGF and ipQuants have partnered long-term to support the continued use and development of secure, attorney-controlled AI across HGF’s patent practice. HGF is one of Europe’s leading intellectual property firms, with offices across the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands, Germany, Switzerland, France and Austria.

rows.title: Swiss adventure company e-Alps doubles guest numbers
rows.summary: Founded in 2018, Valais-based e-Alps creates premium guided e-mountain bike journeys across the Swiss Alps. The company reports an average annual growth rate of 50% over the past three years and doubled the number of guests served in 2026.

rows.title: Lookthrough acquires BuildingMinds from Schindler
rows.summary: The transaction brings together two complementary businesses into one profitable AI software company serving institutional investors, governments and global technology companies, strengthening its position for further international growth. Together, the companies own one of the world's largest institutional real estate datasets with AI-powered decision intelligence across more than 100,000 buildings in 64 countries on 6 continents.

rows.title: Private-Equity backed SEPPmail acquires CyberPilot
rows.summary: SEPPmail takes over CyberPilot and begins building a leading European platform for email security. The German private equity firm LEA Partners acquired SEPPmail in September 2025 with a view to building a European Email Security Suite.

rows.title: I-RIIDE franchit un cap clé à Fribourg
rows.summary: I-RIIDE, la startup romande portée par Dereck Gibeyo vient d’annoncer le lancement d’une collaboration officielle avec le Service de la mobilité de l’État de Fribourg (SMoFR), une étape importante dans le déploiement de solutions de mobilité numérique intégrée au sein du Canton. La jeune entreprise vient aussi de rejoindre le programme NVIDIA Inception, une reconnaissance qui valide sa vision à long terme.

rows.title: Traction and a new AI Platform for Logmind
rows.summary: Since Logmind latest funding round in 2025, the EPFL spinoff led by Ketevani Zaridze has come a long way, working with organizations across different industries but also hiring a Chief Commercial Officer and launching a new generation of its AI platform for IT operational intelligence.

rows.title: BitVault launches Bitcoin self-custody app worldwide, backed by CHF 500,000 in funding
rows.summary: The Lugano-based startup is rolling out its Bitcoin security app worldwide: already a few hundred paying users, CHF 500,000 raised from a Swiss family office and a Canadian angel investor, and a $1.5 million seed round planned for 2027.

rows.title: Swiss startups secure European funds
rows.summary: Four Swiss startups have won European backing this summer. AMiquam and Gravity Pull Systems are part of a EUR 2.2 million consortium working on precision metal 3D printing, Weight Space Labs was selected for SPRIND's EUR 125 million Next Frontier AI Challenge, and ProSeed has secured EUR 500,000 from EIT Food to cut the energy use of its drying technology.

rows.title: Trust Square Ecosystem welcomes two strategic shareholders
rows.summary: The Onchain Foundation and venture builder Inacta Ventures have become strategic shareholders in Zurich-based Trust Square Ecosystem, backing the company's push to take its events and community business international.

rows.title: Schub für nachhaltigen Flugtreibstoff
rows.summary: Mit dem Verfahren des Zürcher Startups Metafuels lässt sich grünes Methanol in synthetisches Kerosin umwandeln. Auf dem Areal des Paul Scherrer Instituts PSI wurde jetzt eine Demonstrationsanlage eingeweiht.

rows.title: Three Swiss startups join DayOne's 2026 accelerator cohort
rows.summary: Isospec Analytics, MOLECL and Humaniche are among 15 early-stage biotech and healthtech startups selected for the 2026 DayOne Accelerator. The ventures will receive support from various experts and key industry players to advance their business ideas and expand their network.

rows.title: Newcomer fordern etablierte Business-Software-Anbieter heraus
rows.summary: Zwei Startups aus dem Kanton Waadt wollen administrative Aufgaben mit ihren Softwarelösungen vereinfachen. Magic Heidi unterstützt Selbstständige und Einzelunternehmen bei der Buchhaltung, während Numezis administrative Prozesse in kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen automatisiert.

rows.title: Frisches Geld und starkes Wachstum für UpGrid
rows.summary: Die Plattformbetreiberin für das Management von lokalen Energiegemeinschaften UpGrid hat in einer Seed-Runde knapp eine Million Euro eingesammelt. Damit soll unter anderem das Team ausgebaut und die Plattform weiterentwickelt werden. Zu den Investoren zählen unter anderem Jürg Schwarzenbachs Investmentvehikel Marcaro, der Gründerfonds Ruhr, Climate Founders, Swisspreneur sowie einige Angel Investoren.

rows.title: 10 cleantech startups selected for Munich investor roadshow
rows.summary: Ten startups developing solutions for clean energy, sustainable materials, industrial decarbonization, and climate resilience will join the Swiss National Startup Team 2026. The startups will travel to Munich in November to accelerate their growth and expand their international presence.

rows.title: Milestone wins drive Dyneo Growth and Expansion
rows.summary: Amid ongoing tensions around fossil fuels, district heating networks are emerging as critical infrastructure for energy sovereignty, while their distribution losses amount to billions of euros every year across Europe. It is against this backdrop that the Geneva-based company Dyneo, driven by its vision and expertise, is experiencing rapid growth.

rows.title: Vattenfall and terralayr bring industry's first virtual battery toll into full operation
rows.summary: Following a staged ramp-up since January, Vattenfall now has the full 55 MW from the seven-year tolling contract available in live operation. Via its LAYR flexibility platform, terralayr aggregates eight decentralised large-scale storage systems in Germany into a single, easily dispatchable, aggregated virtual battery.

rows.title: Coople rebuilds its platform and focuses on Switzerland
rows.summary: Coople has rebuilt the technical foundation of its flexible staffing platform in less than a year, using AI in its own development work to speed delivery, and since August has onboarded all newly registered companies directly onto the new system. The rebuild comes as the Zurich company concentrates on its home market, having closed its UK operations on 1 January.

rows.title: Bewe awarded Biopôle Pre-Clinical Top-Up
rows.summary: Biopôle SA just announced that Bewe has been awarded the Pre-Clinical Top-Up, marking the next phase of a long-standing relationship between our campus and the University of Fribourg spin-off, which is developing a neuroscience-based digital intervention for unhealthy food cravings.

rows.title: Three Swiss biotechs report progress across their clinical programmes
rows.summary: MoonLake's lead candidate met clinical endpoints at week 16 of a Phase 3 psoriatic arthritis trial, while AC Immune has received FDA Fast Track designation for its Parkinson's immunotherapy, and Vandria has presented Phase 1 data indicating that its Alzheimer's candidate acts on the human brain.

rows.title: CO2-Rechner von Zelsius gewinnt an Reichweite
