rows.summary: Nach einem Jahr intensiver Nutzung und Tests hat das Startup Zelsius seine Plattform zur Erfassung von Emissionen und der Berechnung einer CO₂-Bilanz für KMU aus zusätzlichen Branchen erweitert. Das Spin-off der Hochschule Luzern konnte die Anzahl Kunden verdoppeln und generiert mittlerweile einen sechsstelligen Umsatz – ein Grossteil davon stammt aus wiederkehrenden jährlichen Leistungen.

rows.title: Digital Health-Startup Aepsy übernimmt Kinastic
rows.summary: Aepsy erweitert mit der Akquisition des Schweizer Marktführers für betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung Kinastic sein Angebot um Prävention und betreut künftig über 150 Partnerunternehmen in der Schweiz. Das Kinastic-Team und die Plattform werden über die kommenden Monate integriert und gehen schrittweise in Aepsy auf.

rows.title: Ascend Sport Technology’s IPO plans confirmed
rows.summary: Swiss Exchange-listed EvoNext Holdings confirms advanced discussions on a reverse merger with Ascend Sport Technology AG. Ascend is at the forefront of sport marketing and digital perimeter advertising.

rows.title: Gravis Robotics Raises $200M for Construction Autonomy
rows.summary: Today, Gravis Robotics has officially announed a $200M investment from SoftBank Investment Advisers, the largest ever Series A raised in construction robotics history. With systems already deployed alongside global infrastructure leaders across four continents and proven across diverse real-world machinery and sites – the ETH Zurich spin-off has now both the technology and capital to scale rapidly.

rows.title: Two medtechs advance with regulatory approvals
rows.summary: Geneva-based Spineart and Vaud-based Distalmotion have each cleared a new regulatory hurdle for their surgical technologies. Spineart has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval for its cervical disc replacement system, while Distalmotion has received FDA clearance for its surgical robot for ventral hernia repair.

rows.title: DEC Energy secures a Swiss bank as customer and advances Italian pipeline
rows.summary: Ticino-based DEC Energy develops a fintech platform that enables companies to contract operational renewable energy plants, generate green certificates and participate in the revenues generated by the electricity produced and sold by the assets. The startup has now reached an important commercial milestone with BancaStato, the Ticino Cantonal bank, becoming a fully contracted, paying and operational customer.

rows.title: Indivi attracts Infosys Innovation Fund as strategic investor
rows.summary: Together with Infosys, Indivi aims to fundamentally unlock early-stage clinical development elevating tech-science at the epicenter of precision drug development in neurology. With its platform Indivi wants to support biopharmaceutical sponsors in detecting early signals of treatment effect, starting with Parkinson's disease and extending to other neuroscience indications.

rows.title: Bruker makes minority investment in Atinary
rows.summary: Bruker Corporation entered into an expanded strategic collaboration with Atinary Technologies Inc., the pioneer of Self-Driving Labs technologies and AI-driven R&D with applications in pharmaceuticals, chemicals, energy, and materials. The strategic investment in Atinary advances Bruker’s goal to combine differentiated analytical technologies with lab automation, scientific software and AI-guided experimentation.

rows.title: Boehringer Ingelheim acquires equine health startup Evax
rows.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has acquired Evax AG, a Swiss biotech company focused on therapeutic vaccines to address significant unmet needs in horses, particularly for the treatment of allergic skin diseases.

rows.title: Fresh capital for SUIND’s autonomous spraying platform
rows.summary: The Swiss-Indian agritech startup SUIND has raised around CHF 1.75 million (INR 20.5 crore) in a seed funding round led by Transition VC, with participation from IIMA Ventures. The startup will use the new funding to increase the commercial deployment and manufacturing of Bumblebee, its autonomous spraying platform.

rows.title: DriveLab übernimmt Fahrschulvergleich todrive.ch
rows.summary: Die DriveLab GmbH übernimmt das Schweizer Vergleichsportal todrive.ch. Mit diesem Schritt erweitert DriveLab sein digitales Angebot rund um Fahrausbildung und Führerschein. Beide Plattformen bleiben eigenständig und laufen unverändert weiter. Gemeinsam weiterentwickelt werden sie künftig unter dem Dach der DriveLab GmbH.

rows.title: London-based market intelligence company acquires Square Commodities
rows.summary: FGE NexantECA has completed the acquisition of Morges-based Square Commodities ("SquareCo"), the leading research and data analytics platform specialising in the global renewable fuels market. Founded in 2012 by Olivier Pellegrinelli, SquareCo has built a distinctive position in regulatory-driven demand analysis for the renewable fuels sector, serving an impressive client base including major oil companies, biofuels producers and trading houses.

rows.title: Circet übernimmt Technik Partner
rows.summary: Das 2020 gegründete Zürcher Unternehmen Circet Schweiz übernimmt Technik Partner, einen Spezialisten für die Glasfasererschliessung von Gebäuden und Wohnungen. Durch die Übernahme kann Circet sein Angebot im Bereich der Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur erweitern und angrenzende Geschäftsfelder erschliessen.

rows.title: Fintech Aisot Technologies sichert sich weitere zwei Millionen Franken
rows.summary: Aisot Technologies AG, das ETH-Zürich-Spin-off für KI-gestützte Portfolio-Intelligenz für institutionelle Investoren, hat eine Seed-Extension-Finanzierungsrunde über CHF 2 Millionen erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Felix Haldner, ehemaliger Partner bei Partners Group, beteiligt sich als neuer Investor.

rows.title: Oculis acquires development and commercial rights to Privosegtor
rows.summary: Biotech company Oculis will acquire all worldwide development and commercial rights to Privosegtor, one of its two core product candidates, from Accure. This acquisition will result in the termination of Oculis’ existing license agreement. The transaction consideration includes a $3.8 million up-front cash payment at closing and up to 2,050,000 Oculis ordinary shares.

rows.title: Two startups make progress in clinical research
rows.summary: PeriVision and Positrigo are advancing the clinical use of their technologies. PeriVision has reported new findings from a study of its VR-based eye-testing platform conducted at University Hospital Bern, while Positrigo’s brain PET scanner has been accepted for use in an Alzheimer’s disease clinical trial at Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich.

rows.title: Starkes Wachstum für finpension
rows.summary: Nachdem finpension 2025 bereits deutlich zulegen konnte, setzt das Luzerner Fintech seinen Wachstumskurs fort. In weniger als einem Jahr ist das verwaltete Vermögen um 50 Prozent auf über 6 Milliarden Franken gestiegen.

rows.title: Travel-tech start-up Zerolook closes USD 1.9 million pre-seed financing round
rows.summary: Zerolook builds a B2B flight pricing API for OTAs and airlines that predicts itinerary prices directly with machine learning, instead of running a live search every time a price is needed. The start-up based in the canton of Zug was founded by an experienced team.

rows.title: Infomaniak announces its plan to go public
rows.summary: The shareholders of Swiss sovereign cloud provider Infomaniak have signed an agreement for the listing of the company on the SIX Swiss Exchange, through a reverse takeover transaction with Perrot Duval Holding SA. The listing would give Infomaniak the means to accelerate the development of its infrastructure and services while preserving its independence.

rows.title: Cutempa Medical startet klinische Studie in Deutschland
rows.summary: Das Basler MedTech-Startup Cutempa Medical spezialisiert sich auf die Entwicklung mineralbasierter Produkte zur Behandlung chronischer Wunden. Mit Curi01, einem innovativen Wundexsudat-Adsorptionsmittel in Pulverform, läuft seit Juli 2026 in Deutschland die pivotale Zulassungsstudie mit 280 Patientinnen und Patienten an rund 20 Studienzentren.

rows.title: Vaderis Therapeutics closes USD 152 million Series B Financing
rows.summary: Basel-based Vaderis Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing targeted therapies for rare vascular diseases, today announced the closing of a private $152 million Series B financing and initiation of HEROIC, the company’s global Phase 3 clinical study evaluating engasertib (VAD044) in patients with hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT).

rows.title: 3VC investiert in Aderis
rows.summary: Aderis automatisiert mit seiner KI-basierten Plattform die Buchhaltung von wachsenden Unternehmen. Nun hat das 2025 gegründete Tech-Startup das österreichische 3VC als Investor gewonnen und will mit seiner Lösung zum europäischen Marktführer in der FinTech-ERP-Kategorie werden.

rows.title: Cy Biopharma merges with Ensysce Biosciences
rows.summary: Ensysce Biosciences, a clinical-stage company developing a new class of highly novel opioids for the treatment of severe pain, has acquired Zug-based Cy Biopharma, a clinical-stage biotechnology company focussed on novel neuroplastogenic therapies for severe chronic pain disorders. The acquisition is structured as a stock-for-stock merger.

rows.title: Marktplätze von Schweizer Agrarmedien übernommen
rows.summary: Die beiden Heimtier-Marktplätze Tier-Inserate und petfinder sind nun Teil der Schweizer Agrarmedien AG. Damit baut das Unternehmen sein Angebot im Heimtierbereich weiter aus.

rows.title: U.S. federal court awards Timeline more than USD 5.3 million in damages
rows.summary: Longevity biotech Timeline pioneered the postbiotic ingredient Urolithin A and its branded form Mitopure, a postbiotic that stimulates mitophagy and supports mitochondrial and metabolic health. Now, the US District Court for the District of Massachusetts has entered default judgments and permanent injunctions in favour of Timeline and its US subsidiary, Timeline Longevity, Inc., against 19 online sellers found to have marketed and sold supplements falsely advertised as containing Urolithin A.

rows.title: Olympic Champion Iouri Podladtchikov joins AVEA
rows.summary: Zug-based startup AVEA develops science-backed longevity solutions based on the latest scientific research. The company has now brought Olympic gold medallist and two-time halfpipe world champion Iouri Podladtchikov on board as an investor and brand ambassador.

rows.title: LS Instruments joins Postnova Analytics
rows.summary: German Postnova Analytics GmbH has successfully completed the acquisition of LS Instruments AG. The milestone opens new opportunities for innovation, international growth and product development. Operations will continue unchanged from the company's headquarters in Fribourg, Switzerland, where the existing team will remain focused on developing, manufacturing and supporting LS Instruments' innovative light scattering and microrheology technologies.

rows.title: KI-Startups bauen ihre Angebote aus
rows.summary: Vier Startups haben in den vergangenen Wochen neue Funktionen und Anwendungen lanciert. Diese reichen von KI-Agenten für die Immobilienbewirtschaftung und einem Steuermodul für einen Rechtschatbot bis hin zu einer ChatGPT-Anwendung für die Lagerraumsuche und einem Tool zur Optimierung der Sichtbarkeit in KI-generierten Antworten.

rows.title: Three Swiss biotechs widen their reach into pharma, paediatrics and lung disease
rows.summary: SOPHiA GENETICS has signed its first companion diagnostics agreement with a pharmaceutical company, CRISPR Therapeutics has won US approval for CASGEVY in children as young as two, and Pilatus Biosciences is taking its lead antibody into chronic lung disease.

rows.title: Terra Quantum partners with Apex.AI on quantum-safe security
rows.summary: Swiss startup Terra Quantum and California-based Apex.AI have demonstrated a quantum-safe security solution for long-lived, cloud-connected software-defined systems. The joint solution is designed to help organizations prepare for the transition to post-quantum security.

rows.title: Erfolgreicher Start für Bauprojekt-Managementsoftware von Hamerly
rows.summary: Die beiden Gründerinnen Elaine Holl und Bianca Müller sind mit ihrer Software-Lösung seit rund eineinhalb Monaten am Markt. Hamerly kommt bereits bei 50 Bauunternehmen in Europa zum Einsatz als digitales Bautagebuch, für das Mängelmanagement oder die Koordination von Subunternehmen.

rows.title: FoodSave-Startup GoNina startet Pilotprojekt mit der SV Group
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup GoNina unterstützt Bäckereien und Gastronomiebetriebe mit KI-Prognosen bei der Produktionsplanung. Nachdem bereits mehr als 100 Bäckereistandorte auf die Software setzen, kommt sie nun auch in der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie in zehn Pilotbetrieben zum Einsatz.

rows.title: CAZ Cascara launches new sugar-free drink from upcycled coffee cherry
rows.summary: Zurich-based startup CAZ Cascara has turned the pulp of the coffee cherry—usually left to rot on plantation floors—into a naturally caffeinated soft drink now listed in around 50 bars and restaurants. The company launched a sugar-free variant in June in response to consumer demand and market feedback.

rows.title: Noriware launches sustainable seaweed packaging
rows.summary: Noriware has launched its seaweed-based packaging film norifresh in 300 Volg grocery stores across Switzerland. The successful pilot saw blueberries packed on the existing lines of Volg's packing partners, paving the way for further pilots in 2026.

rows.title: Exclaim Robotics raises USD 4.95 million for data centre repair robots
rows.summary: Exclaim Robotics has emerged from stealth with a USD 4.95 million pre-seed round co-led by Founderful and Playfair. The Zurich-based startup is building autonomous mobile robots that carry out routine repair and maintenance work inside AI data centres, and will use the capital to build its first prototypes and expand the engineering team.

rows.title: Frisches Kapital für Expansion nach Europa
rows.summary: PrivacyBee hat eine All-in-One-Plattform für das Management von Webseiten-Datenschutz für KMU entwickelt. Das Berner Startup zählt über 11'000 aktive Abos von Kunden aus dem DACH-Raum und mehr als 500 Vertriebspartner.

rows.title: Two Swiss biotechs clear US regulatory steps for heart and nerve therapies
rows.summary: HAYA Therapeutics has won Fast Track designation from the US Food and Drug Administration for its lead cardiac fibrosis candidate, while Oculis has received FDA feedback clearing the way for a filing that would take its neuroprotective candidate into acute multiple sclerosis relapse treatment.

rows.title: Via Oomnium-Plattform im Eiltempo zu frischem Kapital
rows.summary: Gleich mehrere Startups konnten in den vergangenen Wochen über die  Plattform Oomnium bei der Crowd oder privaten Investorinnen und Investoren frisches Kapital einsammeln – am schnellsten war GoCalma, welches innert Wochenfrist eine halbe Million Franken eingesammelt hat.

rows.title: AI Infrastructure Capital startet mit 16 Millionen US-Dollar
rows.summary: Das im Kanton Schwyz ansässige Startup AI Infrastructure Capital kauft KI-Server, betreibt diese in Island mit erneuerbarer Energie und vermietet deren Rechenleistung langfristig an Unternehmen. Rückenwind für den Start gibt eine kürzlich abgeschlossene Finanzierungsrunde von rund 16 Millionen US-Dollar.

rows.title: Nordfen brings drone simulation technology to Latvia
rows.summary: Zurich-based startup nordfen is teaming up with Latvia's Drone Force – Europe to develop drone simulation technologies and advance drone operator training. The collaboration aims to create training solutions that are expected to be used not only in Latvia but also across Europe.

rows.title: Digitalisierung im Unternehmensalltag: Drei Startups steuern Lösungen bei
rows.summary: fonea, Connect AI und botts.ai haben neue KI-Anwendungen für Unternehmen lanciert. Sie reichen von einem Telefonagenten für KMU über eine Software für Treuhandfirmen bis hin zu KI-Agenten für betriebliche Prozesse und sind bereits bei ersten Kunden im Einsatz.

rows.title: KI-Startup intonate nimmt Fahrt auf
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup intonate unterstützt mit seiner KI-gestützten Software Ärztinnen und Ärzte sowie weiteres medizinisches Fachpersonal bei administrativen Aufgaben rund um die medizinische Dokumentation. Im ersten Halbjahr 2026 hat sich die Zahl der Kundinnen und Kunden verdoppelt. Die Anwendung ist bereits bei hunderten Praxen, Kliniken und ersten Spitälern in der Schweiz und Deutschland im Einsatz.

rows.title: Synhelion erhält Fördermittel für kommerzielle Demo-Anlage
rows.summary: Die Treibstoffanlage von Synhelion gehört zu den neun Projekten für nachhaltige Schlüsseltechnologien, die vom Nordrhein-Westfälischen Förderprogramm Produktives.NRW ausgewählt wurden und für die insgesamt Mittel von rund 90 Millionen Euro zur Verfügung stehen. Die frischen Fördermittel unterstützen das Cleantech-Unternehmen beim nächsten Skalierungsschritt.

rows.title: AB2 Bio receives USD 30 million from Nippon Shinyaku
rows.summary: Lausanne-based AB2 Bio has received a USD 30 million payment after Japanese pharmaceutical company Nippon Shinyaku exercised its option to commercialise Tadekinig alfa in the US. AB2 Bio is eligible for up to USD 600 million in further milestone and royalty payments.

rows.title: Ex-Armeechef beteiligt sich an Subatron
rows.summary: Die Lösung für eine schnelle und reichweitenstarke Datenübertragung unter Wasser von Subatron kommt bei ersten Pilotprojekten zum Einsatz – etwa mit einer Seepolizei. Die auf Ultraschall basierende Technologie stösst zudem auf grosses Interesse im Defense-Markt.

rows.title: Drei Startups setzen auf Crowdinvesting für weiteres Wachstum
rows.summary: Das InsurTech-Startup Calingo hat auf CONDA.ch rund 1,4 Millionen Franken eingesammelt, während das ClimateTech-Startup Sixteen44 sein Finanzierungsziel auf Republic Europe deutlich übertroffen hat. Walnut Planet befindet sich derweil auf der Zielgeraden seiner Finanzierung für den weiteren Ausbau seiner Bio-Walnussplantagen.

rows.title: PropTech AssetOS auf Wachstumskurs
rows.summary: Das HSG-Spin-off AssetOS hat eine KI-gestützte Plattform entwickelt, die professionelle Immobilieninvestoren bei der Erfassung, Analyse und Prüfung von Renditeobjekten unterstützt. Seit der Gründung Ende 2024 und dem Go-live im Sommer 2025 verzeichnet das Startup ein kontinuierliches Wachstum und zählt bereits namhafte Unternehmen der Immobilienbranche wie Implenia und Avadis zu seinen Kunden.

rows.title: Delta Capacity completes Swedish battery project
rows.summary: Delta Capacity has brought a 70 MW / 160 MWh battery energy storage system in Ånge, central Sweden, into commercial operation. The company says it is the largest battery storage project currently in operation in the Nordics.

rows.title: Ahead Health raises USD 10 million and opens first markets outside Switzerland
rows.summary: Zurich-based Ahead Health has raised USD 10 million in a round led by Vienna-based 3VC and existing investor RTP Global, and is using the capital to launch in Germany and the Netherlands.

rows.title: Z-Kubator opens 2026 applications with a new staged model
rows.summary: Z-Kubator, the incubator run by Zurich University of the Arts (ZHdK), has opened applications for a restructured 2026 programme, with grants of up to CHF 6,000 per project. Backed by Zürcher Kantonalbank, the incubator has supported more than 1,200 students and alumni since 2016.

rows.title: Idorsia signs Saudi partner for insomnia drug
rows.summary: Allschwil-based Idorsia has granted Jamjoom Pharma exclusive rights to distribute and commercialise its insomnia treatment QUVIVIQ in Saudi Arabia and the Levant. It is the company's second Middle East distribution agreement this year, after a March deal covering five Gulf states.

rows.title: Valuemize raises seven-figure pre-seed for product cost software
rows.summary: Zurich-based valuemize has closed a seven-figure pre-seed round with participation from a consortium of VC offices and angel investors. The startup sells software that lets manufacturers see what a design decision will cost before the design is locked in.

rows.title: Quantonation leads USD 25.5 million seed round for ETH spin-off ZuriQ
rows.summary: ZuriQ has raised USD 25.5 million in a seed round to scale the trapped-ion quantum processors it is building on a two-dimensional chip architecture. The round was led by Quantonation, and includes fresh funding from several of its pre-seed investors.

rows.title: Von der Facebook-Gruppe zur Direktbuchungsplattform
rows.summary: Das Berner Startup Fewotech hat vor gut einem Jahr den Marktplatz für Ferienwohnungen FEWOlution.ch lanciert. Sowohl das Angebot als auch der Traffic auf der Plattform wachsen seither kontinuierlich.

rows.title: Four Swiss medtechs mark commercial, regulatory and clinical milestones
rows.summary: Arcoris bio has signed a distribution agreement to take its biomarker-detection kits into Europe and North America, Hi-D Imaging has secured expanded FDA clearance for its AI-driven heart-valve planning software and ABILITY Neurotech has carried out the first-in-human procedure for its brain-computer interface, while Alivion has published data supporting its platforms.

rows.title: Von Matcha bis Mocktails: Startups nehmen Fahrt auf
rows.summary: Drei Startups verzeichnen mit ihren Produkten für den Alltag und den Genuss erste Erfolge. Matcha and Friends ist inzwischen in 53 Coop-Filialen erhältlich und beliefert mehr als 50 Gastronomiebetriebe, Lion7 wächst mit seinem Deodorant aus essbaren Inhaltsstoffen und Tipiog erzielt erste Verkäufe mit brasilianischer Tapioka. Ausserdem bereitet PLASH die Lancierung seiner Mocktails mit Elektrolyten vor.

rows.title: First US Clinical Site for HeroSupport’s SHIELD Study
rows.summary: HeroSupport SA just announced that NYU Grossman School of Medicine is the first clinical site in the US to participate in the SHIELD clinical study, with Prof. Naamit Gerber as Principal Investigator. Dr. Gerber is a professor and vice chair of education in the Department of Radiation Oncology at NYU Grossman School of Medicine, as well as the co-director of the breast cancer and hematologic malignancies disease management groups at NYU Langone’s Perlmutter Cancer Center.

rows.title: Humboldt AI lanciert KI-Tool für den CV-Check im Schweizer Arbeitsmarkt
rows.summary: Das St.Galler Startup Humboldt AI hat eine KI-basierte Lösung zur Optimierung von Lebensläufen entwickelt. Nach dem Marktstart im Januar 2026 wurde die Plattform bereits von mehreren tausend Personen genutzt. Zudem sind erste Pilotprojekte mit institutionellen Partnern in der Schweiz und im Fürstentum Liechtenstein gestartet.

rows.title: Medyria raises CHF 3.5 million
rows.summary: Swiss catheter developer Medyria has raised CHF 3.5 million to finance FDA clearance and a US launch for its PyCath device.

rows.title: MoleSense and Impli selected for SPRIND Challenge on Continuous Hormone Monitoring
rows.summary: Two Swiss start-ups have been selected by the German Federal Agency for Breakthrough Innovation (SPRIN-D). The goal is to develop biosensors that continuously measure at least four hormones over seven days. Support from SPRIND includes funding the teams with up to €1.5 million in Stage 1.

rows.title: CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to scale autonomous fresh food deployments
rows.summary: The Basel-based Maus Robotics has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop autonomous robots that prepare fresh crêpes from raw ingredients in just 90 seconds. The food robotics startup is opening its first long-term installations in Basel this summer.

rows.title: “Our motto says: the magic is the people”
rows.summary: The application period for the third cohort of UPortunity, ETH Zurich’s start-up accelerator enabled by UBS, has begun. The programme supports recent ETH graduates in turning promising projects into scalable ventures through funding, coaching and access to the ETH Entrepreneurship ecosystem. We asked Frank Floessel, Lead ETH Entrepreneurship, and Jan Lederhausen, from UBS Growth Advisory, which supports start-ups through dedicated financing and equity fundraising, about the programme's impact so far, its unique approach, and its plans for the future.

rows.title: Swiss founders in the global spotlight
rows.summary: Logol CEO Marco Farina is the only person on this planet recognised with a Microsoft MVP Award in AI and ERP. DiverSsiTy is the winner of the global AI for Good Innovation Factory contest. UNBOUUND CEO and Founder Julien Wen Hsieh was awarded with a scientific Grand Prize and Urbio was named Heat Network Innovation of the Year in London.

rows.title: Zweiter Standort für kostenlose Programmier-Ausbildung
rows.summary: 42 Zürich eröffnet einen Bildungscampus in Zürich-Oerlikon. Die gemeinnützige Organisation bildet dort ab Januar 2027 Studierende kostenlos in Softwareentwicklung und KI-Systemen aus und soll so dem Fachkräftemangel entgegenwirken – auch bei Startups. Die Auswahlverfahren starten Mitte September.

rows.title: Centiel secures first order in the U.S. market worth USD 8.7 million
rows.summary: Centiel SA, a leading provider of uninterruptible power supply equipment (UPS), has received its first order under the strategic distribution agreement with Neo Critical Power LLC, Wyoming, announced in June 2026. The order has a value of USD 8.7 million and covers the delivery of a UPS system for a data center project in the United States.

rows.title: Pilatus Biosciences expands into Hong Kong with subsidiary and clinical trial
rows.summary: The Hong Kong Department of Health has granted Pilatus Biosciences, developing novel metabolic checkpoint immunotherapies for liver and gastrointestinal cancers, the Certificate for Clinical Trial / Medicinal Test for lead investigational therapy, PLT012 in patients with advanced solid tumors. Pilatus also announced the establishment of its Hong Kong subsidiary.

rows.title: Reise, Rettung, Rennvelo: Innovationen für den Sommer
rows.summary: Drei Unternehmen sind mit neuen Lösungen für die warme Jahreszeit gestartet und verzeichnen bereits erste Erfolge. SwimTech hat die erste Produktionsserie seiner aufblasbaren Badehose gefertigt, während IKARUS Cycling Factory mit seinem Rennrad von Fachmagazinen ausgezeichnet wurde und Empyrean den Verkauf seines Aluminium-Koffers aufgenommen hat.

rows.title: SeasON Energy erhält Millionenfinanzierung für saisonale Energiespeicherung
rows.summary: Das als Spin-off der Matica AG und Hochschule Luzern gegründete Startup SeasON Energy hat einen thermochemischen Speicher entwickelt, der Solarenergie aus dem Sommer für die Wärmeversorgung im Winter nutzbar macht. Nach der Inbetriebnahme erster Pilotanlagen und dem Abschluss einer Finanzierungsrunde, treibt das Team nun den Markteintritt im DACH-Raum voran.

rows.title: Neurimmune closes licensing deal of up to USD425 million
rows.summary: Neurimmune announced today that it has sold a portion of its royalty interest in cliramitug to Royalty Pharma for up to $425 million, including $125 million upfront. The transaction provides the company access to non-dilutive funding for the development of its R&D pipeline.

rows.title: England, the Middle East and India: Three start-ups are expanding with their digital solutions
rows.summary: AI connectivity specialist Kandou AI is opening a chip design headquarters in Hyderabad, India. Meanwhile, Bitcoin Suisse has obtained financial services permission to begin its expansion into the Middle East, and the digital agency ONELINE has opened its first foreign subsidiary in London, UK, to introduce its solutions to a new market.

rows.title: Loft Dynamics launches new simulator and expands to India
rows.summary: Loft Dynamics has launched the world's first multi-pilot VR simulator for the Airbus H145 and lined up its first simulator installation in India, extending the Dübendorf-based company's advanced helicopter training solution across the two continents.

rows.title: Hilo closes Series B extension round to fuel US expansion
rows.summary: Hilo secured a Series B extension round, totaling $19 million in new funding and bringing its total funding to date to over $119 million. The round included new investment from Dell Family Office, the family investment office of Michael Dell, Founder, Chairman and CEO of Dell Technologies, alongside continued support from existing backers, reinforcing confidence from leading global technology investors as Hilo expands into the U.S. market.

rows.title: KI-Startup Prodlane sammelt 4 Millionen Euro ein
rows.summary: Das Uni St. Gallen-Spin-off Prodlane schliesst eine Finanzierungsrunde über vier Millionen Euro ab. Frisches Kapital für die weitere Skalierung des deutsch-schweizerischen Unternehmens kommt vom TGFS Technologiegründerfonds Sachsen und der SBG - Sächsische Beteiligungsgesellschaft.

rows.title: New leaders take charge at four Swiss startups
rows.summary: VAULTED, Helveteq and Coople name new CEOs, while Oxyle brings in a CTO, as each company moves into its next growth phase.

rows.title: ImmitraBio secures CHF 2.4 million in pre-seed funding
rows.summary: Geneva based Immitra Bio completed an upsized CHF 2.4 million pre-seed financing round to advance its scalable in-vivo gene editing platform and its lead asset IB-003, a potential one-time curative in-vivo gene editing treatment for an inherited anemia.

rows.title: lawbuddy: KI-Bot für rechtliche Erstorientierung
rows.summary: Über 30 KMU nutzen die Plattform des Zuger Startups lawbuddy als digitale Rechtsabteilung – von der Vertragsprüfung bis hin zur Erstabklärung von Fragen im Personalrecht. Private können mit Unterstützung durch den Chatbot und Vorlagen ihre Vorsorge oder den Nachlass über die Plattform regeln.

rows.title: Swiss Startup Aionic Labs selected for funding initiative by Germany's federal agency SPRIN-D
rows.summary: Aionic Labs is one of ten selected teams for the "Next Frontier AI" funding initiative and will receive around three million euros in funding in the first stage of the program. The start-up brings together AI and time series analysis helping professionals identify complex relationships faster and make well-founded decisions.

rows.title: CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to accelerate infrastructure planning with AI
rows.summary: Following several paid pilots, goNEON Agentic Systems has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to transform how infrastructure is planned using agentic AI. The ICT startup helps planners and infrastructure operators generate technically feasible, regulation-compliant designs in minutes instead of months.

rows.title: Milestones and first pilots for Tortin Edtech
rows.summary: The last few months turned Tortin from an argument into something institutions such as HEC Lausanne, University of Geneva in partnership with the UN, the IOC and LUMS Pakistan, run on. Building on their validation, the Geneva edtech founded by Dr. Katya Tatarinov and Shahzad Ahmed is now set to turn pilots into wider paid institutional deployments across Europe and the Gulf.

rows.title: Japanischer Ingenieurdienstleister beteiligt sich an EnergieLink
rows.summary: Die japanische JFE Engineering Corporation beteiligt sich an EnergieLink, einem Schweizer Dienstleister im Bereich der Wartung, Instandhaltung, Modernisierung und Ersatzteilversorgung für Abfallverbrennungsanlagen. Die beiden Unternehmen haben zudem eine Geschäftsallianzvereinbarung abgeschlossen.

rows.title: AELER eyes oncoming large-scale roll-out
rows.summary: AELER, the Swiss start-up specializing in sustainable smart logistics, is set to scale up to industrial level in the coming months. To meet the demands of a rapidly growing market and take on its next chapter, the trailblazer modernizing shipping containers has raised over CHF 22 million since its last announcement and appointed a new CEO.

rows.title: NaturLoop ships first coconut-husk panels to paying customers
rows.summary: NaturLoop has begun commercial sales of Cocoboard, a formaldehyde-free panel that turns discarded coconut husks into an alternative to conventional wood panels. The company runs prototyping and concept-development projects with furniture manufacturers and designers to accelerate market entry, and is preparing to expand production.

rows.title: CDDS secures seed capital for further development steps
rows.summary: Defense startup CDDS (Counter Defense Drone Systems) has secured Swisscom Ventures as an investor in a seed funding round. With the fresh capital, the startup founded in 2025 plans to further develop its autonomous, kinetic interceptor drones and expand its team.

rows.title: Terasol ouvre son premier site de production à Renens
rows.summary: Dès juillet 2026, la startup vaudoise à impact portée par Cédric Coquelin produira localement des substrats fertiles sur le site des « Pallettes » à Renens, qu’elle occupera à titre transitoire, afin de régénérer les sols urbains et répondre au manque de terre végétale des communes.

rows.title: Switzerland tops the European Innovation Scoreboard once again
rows.summary: Europe's innovation performance continues to improve, with the EU's overall score rising by 11.6 percentage points since 2019, according to the 2026 European Innovation Scoreboard (EIS) released by the European Commission. Switzerland retains first place among all EU Member States and neighbouring countries.

rows.title: CERN and UK Home Office opt for Arktis Radiation Detection
rows.summary: The UK Home Office awards Level Peaks Associates, in partnership with Arktis Radiation Detectors, a contract for the supply of advanced Static Radiation Detection Device. In addition, CERN has awarded Arktis a contract for the design, manufacture, installation and commissioning of a new generation of Site Gate Monitors.

rows.title: Moonlake Therapeutics raises USD 230 million in public offering
rows.summary: The Nasdaq-listed Swiss biotech firm Moonlake Therapeutics raised a total of USD 230 million in a public offering. The issue and sale of the option shares were completed this week, increasing the total by USD 30 million.

rows.title: SWISSto12 raises US$70 Million to meet growing multi-orbit demand
rows.summary: SWISSto12, a leading enabler of the new space economy, today announced the close of its $70 million Series C. The Series C fundraise follows a period of sustained commercial growth for the company, with revenues of $140 million for 2025 and total contract values now exceeding $500 million, driving positive EBITDA in 2026.

rows.title: Helsana und Klenico starten Pilotprojekt für mentale Gesundheit
rows.summary: Im Rahmen eines Pilotprojekts erhalten alle Zusatzversicherten von Helsana Zugang zum Mental Health Check von Klenico. Damit erreicht Klenico eine neue Grössenordnung an Versicherten und unterstreicht seine Position als führende Plattform für digitale Diagnostik im Bereich psychische Gesundheit im deutschsprachigen Raum.

rows.title: Recoveris gains BTCS as investor and market partner
rows.summary: Zug-based Recoveris has signed an investment and cooperation agreement with BTCS, a digital asset treasury company listed in Warsaw and Frankfurt, opening a route into the Polish market for the blockchain-intelligence startup. BTCS will invest CHF 100,000 through a SAFE agreement.

rows.title: ACE & Company pushing ahead in the Private Equity Sector
rows.summary: Leveraging ACE & Company's more than two decades of private market investing experience and over $2.0 billion in assets under management, the firm launches ACE Private Equity, a dedicated business bringing together the firm's Independent Sponsors and Secondaries strategies under a unified platform.

rows.title: Proptech Nestermind mit Seed-Finanzierung im Millionenbereich
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup Nestermind hat eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde im siebenstelligen Bereich abgeschlossen. Das Kapital stammt von strategischen Investoren, darunter mehrere der renommiertesten Immobilienunternehmen der Schweiz. Es fliesst in die Weiterentwicklung des Produkts sowie in den Ausbau des Teams.

rows.title: Smallpdf sells PDF Tools to deepen its focus on PDF editing software
rows.summary: Smallpdf AG, the Swiss company behind sign.com and smallpdf.com, one of the world’s most popular PDF software suites, has sold its subsidiary PDF Tools to Apryse, a global leader in document processing technology trusted by more than 20,000 companies, including 85% of the Fortune 100.

rows.title: RAROG is off to a flying start
rows.summary: Zurich-based RAROG has secured CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick for a portable detector that finds missing people by picking up the radio signals emitted by their smartphones and fitness trackers, only nine months after the launch of the project by ETH’s accelerator UPortunity. The device is already being used in the Irish Wicklow Mountains and the Swiss Alps.

rows.title: Startfeld vergibt zehn Förderpakete
rows.summary: Mit seinen Förderpaketen unterstützt Startfeld  bis zu 15 Startups aus der Ostschweiz in der Gründungsphase. Im ersten Halbjahr 2026 wurden  bereits 10 Startups ausgewählt.. Die Bandbreite der geförderten Innovationen reicht von neuen Krebstherapien und Hirnstimulationssystemen bis hin zu Sicherheits-Apps und elektrischen Tourenski.

rows.title: ETH spin-off NexMR acquired by Germany's Magritek
rows.summary: Schlieren-based NexMR, an ETH Zurich spin-off, is joining the German benchtop NMR maker Magritek. NexMR's signal-enhancement technology for drug discovery will be integrated into Magritek's Spinsolve platform.

rows.title: CHF1.25 billion for Swiss start-ups – significant shifts across sectors and cantons
rows.summary: CHF 1.25 billion in venture capital went to Swiss start-ups in the first half of 2026 – 15.5% less than in the same period of the previous year. This investment volume is thus on a par with the levels of 2023 and 2024. The hardware sector and canton Vaud performed well, while the biotech sector and canton Zurich experienced a downward trend. Fundraising remains a challenge for venture capitalists, but they are nevertheless more optimistic than a year ago. These are the key findings of the half-year update to the Swiss Venture Capital Report, published by the online news portal startupticker.ch and the investor association SECA, in cooperation with startup.ch.

rows.title: 1.25 Milliarden Franken für Schweizer Startups - Grosse Veränderungen bei Sektoren und Kantonen
rows.summary: 1.25 Milliarden Franken Risikokapital sind im ersten Halbjahr 2026 in Schweizer Startups geflossen - 15.5 Prozent weniger als im Vorjahres-Halbjahr. Die investierte Summe liegt damit auf dem Niveau von 2023 und 2024. Die Zahl der Investments blieb mit 123 stabil. Positiv entwickelten sich der Hardware-Sektor und der Kanton Vaud. Nach unten zeigte der Trend für die Biotech-Branche und den Kanton Zürich. Für Risikokapitalgeber bleibt das Fundraising eine Herausforderung, dennoch sind sie optimistischer als vor Jahresfrist. Dies sind die zentralen Ergebnisse des Halbjahres-Updates zum Swiss Venture Capital Report, herausgegeben vom Online-Newsportal Startupticker.ch und der Investorenvereinigung SECA in Kooperation mit startup.ch.

rows.title: CHF 1,25 milliard pour les startups suisses
rows.summary: Au cours du premier semestre 2026, CHF 1,25 milliard de capital-risque ont été investis dans des startups suisses, soit 15,5 % de moins qu’au cours du même semestre de l’année précédente. Le montant investi se situe ainsi au même niveau qu’en 2023 et 2024. Le nombre d’investissements est resté stable, à 123. Dans le même temps, des changements importants ont été observés au niveau des secteurs et des cantons : le secteur du matériel informatique et le canton de Vaud ont affiché une évolution positive. Tels sont les principaux résultats de la mise à jour semestrielle du Swiss Venture Capital Report, publiée par le portail d’actualités en ligne Startupticker.ch et l’association d’investisseurs SECA, en collaboration avec startup.ch.

rows.title: Vorarlberger Traditionsunternehmen übernimmt St. Galler Textil-Startup
rows.summary: Die bisherige Phantomleaf Textiles GmbH firmiert ab sofort unter dem Namen MEMBRYX GmbH und ist künftig mehrheitlich Teil der Getzner Textil Gruppe. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert textile Schutzschichten sowie funktionale Flächenmaterialien für Einsatzkräfte wie Polizei, Militär und Rettungsorganisationen, aber auch für industrielle Anwendungen.

rows.title: Cleantech Arrhenius sichert sich Seed-Finanzierung
rows.summary: Mit seiner Technologie ermöglicht das Luzerner Startup Arrhenius, CO₂ mithilfe von Mikroalgen aus der Atmosphäre zu entfernen. Die frischen Mittel aus einer kürzlich abgeschlossenen Seed-Runde sollen nun die nächste Skalierungsphase ermöglichen. Geplant sind unter anderem eine 500 Quadratmeter grossen Pilotanlage sowie eine erste Anlage im Ausland.

rows.title: Schweizer Private-Equity-Gesellschaft beteiligt sich an Exentis Group
rows.summary: Die Haute Capital Partners beteiligt sich an der auf industrialisierte additive Fertigung spezialisierte Exentis Group. Der Transaktionswert beträgt knapp 5 Millionen Franken. Exentis wird bei der Transaktion mit rund 240 Millionen Franken bewertet.

rows.title: Deep-tech and biotech startups strengthen their leadership teams
rows.summary: Four Swiss startups have added senior leaders as they move into their next growth phase. Neural Concept appointed a board chairman and two executives, Corintis and Anaveon brought in a new CFO and CSO, and DEC Energy set up a strategic committee.

rows.title: 2026 WIPO Global Awards recognize Bearmind
rows.summary: Bearmind, a Lausanne-based startup in the Sports sector, has been named one of the 11 winners of the 2026 WIPO Global Awards, organized by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO). Bearmind is the winner of the Sport’s category. The company was chosen over 1300 applicants across 126 countries.

rows.title: Bubbles Crèches décroche un nouvel actionnaire majoritaire pour croitre
rows.summary: LD Education, filiale de Lavorel Kids, branche petite enfance du Groupe Lavorel, cède sa participation majoritaire dans Bubbles Crèches, réseau privé de crèches Premium implanté en Suisse Romande, au profit d’HELVEON, société d’investissement suisse spécialisée dans l’accompagnement de PME helvétiques. Cette opération s’inscrit dans le cadre d'un recentrage stratégique de ses activités sur les zones alémaniques. Noémie Benhamou reste aux commandes de Bubbles Crèches.

rows.title: From barcodes to biometrics: Scandit launches new tool
rows.summary: Scandit, a global leader in smart data capture solutions designed to empower workers, customers and businesses by providing actionable insights and automating end-to-end processes, developed an instant age-check tool. It marks the Company’s first entry into biometrics.

rows.title: Groupe Chaumont launches with two Swiss Startups
rows.summary: Vam Investments, a private equity operator specializing in buyout investments and buy-and-build strategies, just announced the creation of Groupe Chaumont following the completion of the acquisition of four Swiss companies including two startups: Efteor and Télôs Watch. All highly specialized in the design and manufacture of movements and components for the high-end Swiss watchmaking industry. The Group will be headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland.

rows.title: Borobotics secures CHF2.5 million from a Canadian funding agency
rows.summary: Borobotics has been selected as one of only ten companies to receive support for the development of novel drilling technologies as part of the Drilling Technology Challenge of Emissions Reduction Alberta (ERA). The goal of the project is to develop a compact and autonomous electric drilling robot for geothermal boreholes used in ground-source heat pumps.

rows.title: Banyan Software takes over a majority stake in Geneva-based Fintech WIZE
rows.summary: Banyan Software, an acquirer and long-term operator of growing software businesses, has completed a majority investment in WIZE, a leading wealth & asset management platform serving 120+ financial institutions across 27 countries. WIZE's top management equity stakes remain unchanged, partnering with Banyan to drive the company's next phase of growth.

rows.title: New startup space Lausanne by Venturelab stirs strong response
rows.summary: Building on the success of its Zurich-Schlieren site, Venturelab just opened Startup Space Lausanne. Offering 5,000 m² of office space, workshops and meeting rooms, this brand-new facility is situated right next to Etoy station and the motorway, between Lausanne and Geneva. So far, the response from the local community has been remarkably positive, and a third site in Uzwil is coming in 2027.

rows.title: Three Swiss biotechs advance fertility, cancer and neuro programmes
rows.summary: ReproNovo, Molecular Partners and FloBiotech have all reported progress across their drug pipelines. ReproNovo has dosed the first participant in a European Phase 2 fertility trial, Molecular Partners has begun dosing patients in an early cancer-radiotherapy study, and FloBiotech has signed an agreement with UCLA Health to advance a candidate for neurodegenerative disease.

rows.title: Hafnova is Adnovum Entrepreneur in Residence Program first participant
rows.summary: As part of their collaboration on innovation activities, Adnovum and Trust Valley have established an Entrepreneur in Residence Program. The program is designed to help bridge the gap between innovation and market readiness. Swiss cybersecurity company Hafnova has been selected as the first participant.

rows.title: Drei Scale-ups im Finale des Green Business Awards
rows.summary: AgroSustain, OceanSafe und Meteomatics stehen im Finale des Green Business Awards. Welche Unternehmen ökologischen Impact und wirtschaftlichen Erfolg am überzeugendsten verbinden, entscheidet im September eine Jury unter dem Vorsitz von Alt-Bundesrätin Doris Leuthard.

rows.title: Rhonexum receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: Electronics start-up Rhonexum has secured CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop electronics that run at the ultra-low temperatures found inside quantum computers—an approach the EPFL spin-off says could clear a key obstacle to building larger machines.

rows.title: Verve Ventures secures FINMA Securities Firm license
rows.summary: Verve Ventures, one of Europe’s leading venture capital firms with over CHF 400M in Assets under Management, has been granted a Securities Firm License by the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) - the only specialized venture capital firm globally to hold this license.

rows.title: Aylight raises €4.5M pre-seed to reinvent the laser behind AI's optical bottleneck
rows.summary: Aylight AG develops chip-scale multiwavelength lasers for AI data-center optical interconnects which can replace dozens of discrete lasers. The funding takes Aylight's laser from a research result to first prototypes, manufactured in a semiconductor foundry. It also lets Aylight expand its R&D team — the company is now hiring across core tech roles.

rows.title: Ten Swiss fintechs head to London for the 2026 Venture Leaders roadshow
rows.summary: A panel of investors and industry experts has selected ten innovative Swiss fintech startups to join the Swiss National Startup Team. These companies will take part in the Venture Leaders Fintech program, a unique opportunity to expand their networks and business knowledge during a roadshow in London this October.

rows.title: Fragrance giant Givaudan backs ETH spin-off Microcaps
rows.summary: Swiss microencapsulation company Microcaps has received an equity investment from fragrance house Givaudan and struck a strategic collaboration deal, in a move aimed at pushing its alcohol-free Perfume Pearls technology into wider commercial use across fine fragrance and beauty.

rows.title: CHF 1.2 Million to advance Treeless Biofabricated Materials for Industry
rows.summary: Treeless AG, the Swiss ETH Zurich spin-off pioneering microorganism-based material solutions, announced the successful closing of its second financing round. The round was significantly oversubscribed, with the company raising CHF 1.2 million from a group of high-profile business angels and family offices.

rows.title: Awards and Program Recognitions for Swiss startups
rows.summary: From Basel to Berlin, Swiss start-ups have been making a name for themselves at the start of this summer by joining prestigious programmes, being selected for top defense initiatives, or winning competitions in forward-looking fields such as AgeTech, metal 3D printing, sustainable property and Fintech.

rows.title: Führungsumbau für mehr Wachstum
rows.summary: Bei ServiceHunter übernehmen Gründer, um das Wachstum voranzutreiben. Novac Solutions setzt auf eine CEO von aussen. Der Gründer fokussiert sich als Verwaltungsratspräsident auf Innovation und das Anstossen neuer Projekte.

rows.title: Arviem strengthens Asian presence with new entities in Singapore and Vietnam
rows.summary: Arviem, a leading provider of supply chain security and cargo monitoring solutions, announced the incorporation of new subsidiaries in Singapore and Vietnam, reinforcing the company’s long-term commitment to Asia and supporting its continued growth across the region.

rows.title: Another record for newly founded companies
rows.summary: In the first half of 2026, 28,538 new companies were registered in the Swiss Commercial Register. Compared to the same period last year, this represents a 2.6% increase. A closer analysis, however, indicates that the growth in incorporations of startups in the narrower sense has been less dynamic.

rows.title: CHF 1.5M for Carewell to free Swiss healthcare managers from the staffing crisis
rows.summary: Lausanne-based Carewell has closed a CHF 1.5 million seed round, led by Lucian Wagner for StartAngels Network in Zurich, with further participation by SICTIC, Kickfund and business angels. The company’s platform is already used by more than 50 hospitals, nursing homes and home-care organizations across Switzerland to manage staff replacements and break the doom loop. Carewell is also the first start-up to complete the full FIT Digital track (Grant, Seed and Growth).

rows.title: Neur.on se rapproche d'un pure-player leader en Europe
rows.summary: Quelques mois après avoir cédé à l’allemande Noxtua son équipe spécialisée dans le traitement du langage naturel (NLP) appliqué au droit, la LegalTech romande Neur.on, éditrice de la plateforme d'IA de traduction juridique et financière Corrext, s'associe à Legal 230, leader européen de la traduction juridique humaine. Neur.on reste une société fribourgeoise : ses données restent hébergées en Suisse, soumises au droit suisse et gérées selon des processus certifiés ISO 27001, compatibles avec le secret professionnel de l'avocat et le secret bancaire.

rows.title: ETH-Startup lanciert autonome Cybersicherheitslösung für KMU
rows.summary: MB Cyber Security hat ein Plug-and-Play-Firewall-Gerät auf den Markt gebracht, das speziell für Unternehmen ohne eigene IT-Abteilung entwickelt wurde und ohne aufwendige Installation vor Cyberangriffen schützt. Die eigens entwickelte KI-basierte Lösung erkennt dabei sowohl bekannte Bedrohungen als auch bislang unbekannte Angriffsmuster. Das Zuger Startup hat erste zahlende Kunden aus dem KMU-Umfeld gewonnen.

rows.title: Techbio company ALP Bio obtains CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The biotech startup ALP Bio has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to help drug developers identify immune-related risks earlier in the development process. By combining human immune tissue models with artificial intelligence, the company aims to improve the safety and success rate of next-generation biologic medicines.

rows.title: Optohive enters the research market
rows.summary: Wearables and hospital monitors can track the heart, breathing and blood sugar in real time, but the brain's activity is far harder to capture. Optohive, an ETH Zurich spin-off, is now bringing a wearable brain-imaging headset to the research market, backed by confirmed orders in the six-figure range.

rows.title: Biotech and Food companies strengthen management teams on the business side
rows.summary: Several biotech companies hired Chief Business Officers, Chief Business Development Officers or Chief Commercial Officers. And Idorsia has a new CEO.

rows.title: Building on strong commercial momentum, Sonar launches new products to improve agentic effectiveness
rows.summary: AI agents now assist in generating more than 40% of committed enterprise code. Sonar’s new offerings improve quality of agentic output, decrease token usage by up to 36%, and autonomously burn down technical debt. The launch is backed by strong commercial traction. The company has surpassed USD 430 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) with accelerated growth.

rows.title: Crion strengthens its AI-powered outdoor platform with new B2B partnerships
rows.summary: The Lugano-based startup is expanding its AI-powered outdoor platform through B2B collaborations with partners including Smith Optics, while its selection for the Microsoft for Startups program supports the scaling of its AI platform.

rows.title: Soutien actif aux startups et nouvelle direction pour le CRF
rows.summary: Avec trois startups soutenues en 2025, et une déjà en 2026, Capital Risque Fribourg (CRF) continue à accompagner les entreprises innovantes, créatrices d’emplois dans le canton de Fribourg. Réunis en Assemblée générale ordinaire le 3 juin dernier, son Conseil d’administration et ses actionnaires ont par ailleurs confié la présidence de la société à Jonas Vonlanthen, entrepreneur et associé de Liip SA.

rows.title: CCRAFT closes USD 7.8 million funding round to scale up its photonic chips foundry
rows.summary: Photonic chip manufacturer CCRAFT has successfully completed its funding round, securing USD 7.8 million (CHF 6.3 million) with investors from Switzerland and Germany. The proceeds will support CCRAFT’s ambitious technical roadmap towards an industrialized production line, unlocking additional manufacturing capacity to serve key Tier-1 customers.

rows.title: DXC invests in LOXO to bring Level 4 autonomous logistics to scale
rows.summary: Following successful trials of its autonomous driving solution for commercial vehicles, Bern-based LOXO aims to industrialize its solution with a partnership with DXC Technology, US based multinational IT services and consulting company with more than 100,000 employees.

rows.title: Frankencoin erhält regulatorische Grundlage für Listings an europäischen Börsen
rows.summary: Frankencoin, der grösste an den Schweizer Franken gekoppelte Stablecoin, hat einen wichtigen regulatorischen Meilenstein für den europäischen Markt erreicht: Das Frankencoin MiCA-Whitepaper wurde im europäischen MiCA-Register publiziert. Regulierten Kryptobörsen in der EU wird damit erlaubt, ihren Kunden Frankencoins anzubieten.

rows.title: Sygnum to significantly expand its current EU market penetration
rows.summary: Sygnum, a global digital asset banking group, has been granted a CASP authorisation under MiCAR for its Sygnum Europe subsidiary.  The EU market entry marks one of Sygnum’s next growth areas, building on momentum across Sygnum Protect off-exchange custody, asset management, Lombard loans and private clients.

rows.title: Ipsen to acquire Memo Therapeutics for up to EUR 700 million
rows.summary: Ipsen has agreed to acquire all shares of Memo Therapeutics AG. Shareholders of Memo Therapeutics AG will receive a EUR 200 m at closing of the transaction and may receive additional EUR 700 m. Assets and employees not related to Memo’s lead molecule potravitug, will be transferred to a newly incorporated company, Memorises Bio, retained by Memo Therapeutics AG’s shareholders.

rows.title: InnoBooster backs three deep tech startups with CHF 450,000
rows.summary: The latest InnoBooster cohort comprises three deep tech startups developed at Swiss universities. Foldcast is developing recyclable paper moulds that cut concrete use in construction, Kyra is building AI software to forecast congestion on electricity grids, and Subatron is developing a polymer-based transducer for wireless underwater communication.

rows.title: Subatron receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: Zurich-based Subatron has secured CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop wireless technology that transmits data underwater, where conventional systems struggle to hold a reliable connection.

rows.title: Bacteria against chemical contamination: CellX secures eight pilots
rows.summary: Some bacteria will break down almost anything, even the "forever chemicals" that resist nearly every other form of disposal. CellX Biosolutions, an ETH Zurich spinoff, is putting that ability to work, and has secured eight pilot projects to test whether its microbes can destroy PFAS in industrial wastewater and contaminated soil.

rows.title: Drei Millionen Dollar für KI-Buchhaltungs-Startup infinity.swiss
rows.summary: Das bereits auf dem Markt erfolgreicher Zürcher Startup infinity.swiss will manuelle Buchhaltungs-Aufgaben durch KI erledigen lassen. Nun sicherte sich das Unternehmen drei Millionen Dollar von Schweizer VCs und prominenten Business Angels.

rows.title: Two Swiss family offices invest in Eldora
rows.summary: Eldora has announced a strategic investment from Caravage and GT Family Office, two institutional investors whose backing adds a layer of external validation to the platform's core model: 24/7, 1:1-backed tokenized US stock ownership for retail investors across 85+ countries, without a brokerage account.

rows.title: Sicherheitsanbieter SecuSuisse wird Teil der Prosero Security Group
rows.summary: Das auf Zutrittskontrollsysteme spezialisierte Zürcher Unternehmen SecuSuisse gehört neu zur Prosero Security Group und schliesst sich damit einer europaweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für technische Sicherheitslösungen an. SecuSuisse bleibt dabei eigenständig und erhält Zugang zu zusätzlichem Know-how und weiteren Ressourcen, während Prosero die Expansion im DACH-Raum weiter vorantreibt.

rows.title: Medizincampus Davos und Technopark Graubünden lancieren Angebot für Life-Science-Startups
rows.summary: Gemeinsam mit dem Medizincampus Davos ermöglicht der Technopark Graubünden jungen Unternehmen den Zugang zu professioneller Laborinfrastruktur sowie einem etablierten Forschungs- und Kliniknetzwerk. Das Angebot richtet sich insbesondere an Early-Stage-Startups mit skalierbaren Geschäftsmodellen in den Bereichen Kardiologie, Pneumologie, Dermatologie, Allergologie sowie weiteren medizinaltechnischen und biowissenschaftlichen Anwendungsfeldern.

rows.title: Swiss start-ups in the international spotlight
rows.summary: From an AI-powered anti-theft solution to FoodTech, DeepTech and batteries: Swiss start-ups impressed international juries with their innovations and their traction.

rows.title: ABCDx accomplishes multiple achievements with its acute stroke diagnostics platform
rows.summary: Following the successful completion of a Eurostars project, results published in a peer-reviewed journal support the scientific and commercial foundation of LVOCheck, the company’s point-of-care solution for large vessel occlusion stroke triage. To advance manufacturing and regulatory readiness, ABCDx has initiated the technology transfer of its LVOCheck platform to Creonate Manufacturing.

rows.title: FIT backs Isospec Analytics, MYSTONES and Skilder
rows.summary: The Foundation for Innovation and Technology (FIT) is awarding a Tech Growth loan of CHF 400’000 to Isospec Analytics, an EPFL spin-off specialising in the identification of biological molecules for medical research. MYSTONES and Skilder are each receiving a CHF 20’000 Digital Grant: the former for its athlete tracking platform, the latter for centralising companies’ expertise within their AI tools.

rows.title: “We are currently working on all aspects of our growth”
rows.summary: For seven years, Tim Beck and his team at BLP Digital have had to explain to clients what AI agents are and how they can be used to automate ERP processes. Now the boom is here and the successful start-up is growing rapidly. He explains how BLP is holding its own against newcomers in the market, the benefits the recent USD 50 million investment from Goldman Sachs will bring, and how the company plans to recruit more than 300 people.

rows.title: First Proxipel mobile pellet production unit inaugurated
rows.summary: Proxipel officially inaugurated the first Proxiflex unit commissioned for its client, Lémanpellet, in Gimel (VD). Developed in Switzerland, this innovative technology enables pellet production directly near forest resources and consumption areas, paving the way for a new generation of short-supply-chain energy solutions.

rows.title: Trois finalistes prometteurs pour le Prix BCN Innovation 2026
rows.summary: Pour tenter de décrocher le Prix BCN Innovation 2026, ils étaient au départ 23 à déposer leur candidature en début d’année. Les membres du jury ont pu une fois encore constater que le canton de Neuchâtel était un terreau propice à l’innovation. Présidé par Christophe Ballif, les jurées et jurés du Prix ont désigné courant juin les trois finalistes de la 17e édition du Prix BCN Innovation: Cassio-P, Novoviz et Solar Loop.

rows.title: Fintech Talentir sichert sich €4 Millionen für die internationale Expansion
rows.summary: Mit seiner Technologie ermöglicht Talentir, Freelancern, Creatorn und externen Teams weltweit schneller, günstiger und regelkonform auszuzahlen. Mit den frischen Mitteln wird das schweizerisch-österreichische B2B Fintech-Unternehmen die KI-native Payout-Infrastruktur ausbauen und international skalieren.

rows.title: Une startup neuchâteloise réinvente la carte à gratter
rows.summary: À la suite du succès remporté par sa première carte à gratter, écoulée à plus de 1500 exemplaires, l'équipe de Swisstastic à Neuchâtel lance la Swiss Travel Map, une carte à gratter grand format permettant de découvrir les 26 cantons suisses. Le projet est financé par une campagne WeMakeIt qui a démarré le 19 juin 2026.

rows.title: MoleSense enters Biopôle’s Investment Programme
rows.summary: Biopôle Investment Programme (BIP) is welcoming MoleSense. After joining the Vanguard Accelerator programme in January 2026, the EPFL-spinoff is gearing up for the next stages of development as it transforms its molecular wearable from breakthrough concept to real-world product. The BIP will help the MoleSense team to prepare for these critical next steps by providing key financial and entrepreneurial support.

rows.title: Bitcoin Suisse secures MiCAR licence for European expansion
rows.summary: After more than a decade operating mainly in Switzerland, Bitcoin Suisse is moving into the wider European market. Its Liechtenstein-based entity, Bitcoin Suisse (Europe) AG, has been granted a MiCAR licence by the Liechtenstein Financial Market Authority, allowing it to serve clients across selected European Economic Area markets, with Roman Przibylla appointed to lead the expansion.

rows.title: CHF 100 million fund launched to support Swiss start-ups in their critical growth phases
rows.summary: The Swiss Champion Fund was launched yesterday by two experienced Swiss investors. The closed-ended venture capital fund will invest in the lead or co-lead role in Series A and B rounds of start-ups selected from the Venture Leaders deal flow. The first closing is planned for Q4 2026; first investments will start in 2027.

rows.title: The Swiss National Medtech Team 2026 is set for Boston
rows.summary: Ten Swiss medtech startups have been selected for the Venture Leaders Medtech 2026 program and will travel to Boston from 11 to 16 October to pitch to investors, expand their networks and meet industry leaders. Their work spans mental health, neurosurgery, neurorehabilitation and the early detection of gastrointestinal complications.

rows.title: Three Swiss medtechs expand regulatory clearances for surgical devices
rows.summary: Distalmotion, LEM Surgical and CustomSurg have each cleared a new regulatory hurdle for their surgical devices, spanning expanded gynaecology indications for a surgical robot, a second US clearance for a spine-surgery robot and a European CE mark for a digital fracture-planning platform.

rows.title: Nicole Herzog zur «Business Angel of the Year 2026» gekürt
rows.summary: Seit über einem Jahrzehnt investiert Nicole Herzog in Startups und unterstützt Gründerteams bereits in frühen Unternehmensphasen. Mit dem von der SECA (Swiss Private Equity & Corporate Finance Association) vergebenen Preis würdigt die Jury ihr langjähriges Engagement als Investorin, Mentorin und Brückenbauerin im Schweizer Startup-Ökosystem.

rows.title: Von Haustierversicherung bis Methanreduktion: Viel Dynamik im Crowdinvesting
rows.summary: Das Climate-Tech-Startup rrreefs und das KI-Startup GoCalma haben ihre Crowdinvesting-Kampagnen auf OOMNIUM abgeschlossen. rrreefs hat dabei rund 900'000 Franken aufgenommen, GoCalma innerhalb nur einer Woche 500'000 Franken. Parallel dazu kommen fünf weitere Kampagnen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen gut voran, insgesamt wurden für sie bereits mehr als 3 Millionen Franken von über 500 Investorinnen und Investoren aus der Crowd zugesichert.

rows.title: Swiss FinTech Awards 2026 crown Porters and BLP
rows.summary: Porters and BLP Digital took the top startup honors at the 11th Swiss FinTech Awards in Zurich on June 23, in an edition dominated by artificial intelligence. Sven Siat and Mike Hofmann shared the FinTech Influencer of the Year award for their work on open banking.

rows.title: InkVivo advances iron deficiency anemia program toward human validation
rows.summary: The ETH Zurich spin-off is advancing three programs based on its proprietary drug delivery platforms. Its iron deficiency anemia candidate is approaching human validation, while a second program targeting neurodegenerative diseases is advancing through preclinical development.

rows.title: RY3T’s NOVA verwandelt überflüssigen Solarstrom in bezahlte Rechenleistung
rows.summary: Nach der Nutzung von Abwärme beim Bitcoin-Mining fürs Heizen lanciert RY3T ein weiteres Produkt: Zu viel produzierter Solarstrom wird mit NOVA in bezahlte Rechenleistung verwandelt. Zwei Wochen nach Vorverkaufsstart hat RY3T mit dem zweiten Standbein bereits über 35 Kunden gewonnen.

rows.title: Trilateral defense initiative awards Hydromea a USD 1 million grant
rows.summary: Together with Florida Atlantic University (FAU), Hydromea SA, the Swiss pioneer in subsea Free-Space Optical communication, has won a $1 million award granted through the AUKUS Maritime Innovation Challenge. The joint team will now develop a next-generation underwater communication and networking system capable of operating in contested and congested environments.

rows.title: GENILEM accélère Orchestral, RiveLock et SunFlower Grid
rows.summary: En rejoignant le programme d’accélération de GENILEM, ces trois jeunes entreprises obtiennent un accompagnement personnalisé de 3 ans afin de structurer et accélérer leur développement sur le marché. Coaching stratégique, soutien opérationnel, formations ciblées et accès à un vaste réseau d’entrepreneuses et entrepreneurs romands sont autant d’atouts dont bénéficieront ces entreprises.

rows.title: Swiss Founders Fund launches venture studio for AI-first companies
rows.summary: With its AI-native approach and comprehensive support SFF Studio aims to compress what traditionally takes 12-18 months into a much shorter timeframe through rapid iteration cycles and intensive execution. This week the first batch of seven venture builders, who have been selected from 500 applications, begin a 14-week journey in Zurich to create the next generation of Swiss startups.

rows.title: Two Geneva ventures awarded FIF Growth and FIF Seed Tech funding
rows.summary: Backbone and Crìa Technologies are the latest Geneva-based companies to receive funding from the FIF, the Canton of Geneva's innovation financing programme supporting technology-driven startups, scale-ups, and SMEs. Backbone has been awarded CHF 400,000 in FIF Growth funding for its AI marketing platform serving real estate professionals, while Crìa Technologies has received CHF 100,000 in FIF Seed Tech funding to advance its breakthrough cold chain technology for the life sciences sector.

rows.title: ConTech UrbanMetrix Launches Site Analysis Software with Strong Momentum
rows.summary: The Ticino-based startup UrbanMetrix has launched a software solution for environmental site analysis and early-stage design. It provides insights into factors such as views, sunlight exposure, noise and wind conditions for empty building sites and facades. The solution has already been tested in all key application areas through pilot projects with urban planners, real estate developers, as well as architecture and engineering firms. In addition, the startup received the Public Award at the Prix SIA 2026 last week.

rows.title: HAIMAT automatisiert Telefonate auf Schweizerdeutsch
rows.summary: Das Schwyzer Startup HAIMAT hat eine vollständig selbst entwickelte KI-gestützte Lösung für die Kundenkommunikation auf Schweizerdeutsch lanciert. Die Plattform soll insbesondere KMU bei der Erreichbarkeit und im Umgang mit steigenden Anrufaufkommen entlasten. Erste produktive Einsätze sind noch diese Woche geplant.

rows.title: Growing number of financial players adopt Silex
rows.summary: Banque Cantonale de Genève ("BCGE") has selected and deployed Silex, the Swiss AI platform for legal research and productivity through an enterprise license across several internal teams. This latest addition comes as the legal tech Ex Nunc Intelligence led by Kyriaki Bongard is experiencing growing demand from financial institutions.

rows.title: SOPHiA GENETICS raises USD 57.5 million through a public offering
rows.summary: SOPHiA GENETICS, a global leader in AI-driven precision medicine, closed an oversubscribed public offering with full exercise of the underwriters' option to purchase additional shares. SOPHiA GENETICS is positioning the raise as both a growth milestone and a signal of investor confidence in the wider opportunity around AI-driven precision medicine.

rows.title: Four Swiss start-ups secure EIC support in latest round of the EIC Accelerator
rows.summary: Four of the 38 companies selected for the EIC Accelerator are based in Switzerland. The country accounts for one of the largest groups in the selection. Three of the four start-ups are active in the cleantech sector and one in medical technology.

rows.title: USD 8.3M to unify treasury, risk and compliance across stablecoins and traditional currencies
rows.summary: Range raises $8.3M Series A to build the platform for companies operating across stablecoins and traditional currencies, with traditional fintech funds TX Ventures and SixThirty among the backers. The funds will be used to invest deeper in Range’s products, grow engineering and go-to-market teams, and extend coverage across more networks and integrations.

rows.title: Swiss startups win international awards for their precision solutions
rows.summary: Verity was awarded the IERA Award in recognition of the development and market launch of its warehouse intelligence system. EPFL spin-off ORYL Photonics and CSEM researchers have overcome a bottleneck in drug development, winning them the EARTO Innovation Award 2026. Two Swiss start-ups are also part of the 2026 BioTools Innovator cohort.

rows.title: Swiss biotechs display their innovations at BIO 2026 in San Diego
rows.summary: The BIO International Convention 2026 will take place from June 22 to 25 in San Diego, California. The swisstech pavilion features 21 leading Swiss startups. The event provides companies with a platform to showcase their innovations and network with a global audience to forge partnerships or attract investors and customers.

rows.title: Ferrari setzt auf Schweizer Startup
rows.summary: Das in Lugano ansässige Startup Natzka ist neuer offizieller Partner von Ferrari Competizioni GT. Die Zusammenarbeit markiert den jüngsten Erfolg des Unternehmens, das Kunden in der Schweiz und Italien betreut. Nun soll die internationale Präsenz, insbesondere in Europa, dem Nahen Osten und Afrika (EMEA), weiter ausgebaut werden.

rows.title: SmartHelio Secures Strategic Investment from quantumEDGE Ventures
rows.summary: Earlier this year, SmartHelio launched GAIA, an AI agent purpose-built for energy infrastructure operations, with which customers automate up to 90% of daily monitoring and reporting activities. The partnership will support SmartHelio's expansion across global energy markets, with a particular focus on accelerating deployments in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region.

rows.title: Detectra, TUUS Solutions and Anyway Systems get FIT support
rows.summary: The Foundation for Innovation and Technology (FIT) is supporting three new startups in the Vaud region through Tech Seed loans. DETECTRA receives 100’000 CHF to develop its solution for remote monitoring of joint inflammation in patients with inflammatory arthritis. TUUS Solutions has received a 100’000 CHF loan to advance its dietary gel, designed to improve nutrient absorption. Anyway Systems has also received 100’000 CHF for its platform enabling companies to deploy AI models directly on their own infrastructure.

rows.title: Equadis brings a private equity firm on board for its next phase of growth
rows.summary: Cathay Capital has acquired a majority stake in Equadis, a SaaS software provider headquartered in Geneva. Existing shareholders and the management team are reinvesting alongside Cathay Capital. Equadis aims to become the European reference in product data management platform for brands and retailers seeking to manage, distribute, and optimize product data.

rows.title: Minysa awarded CHF 150'000 to develop next-gen control chips
rows.summary: The electronics startup Minysa has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop next-generation control chips for more compact, energy-efficient, and reliable power electronic systems. The chips use gallium nitride (GaN), enabling higher power and lower heat than silicon. Initial applications include space and other high-reliability sectors, where efficiency, radiation resistance, and supply-chain security are essential.

rows.title: Fresh money to scale Rflect’s infrastructure
rows.summary: Zurich-based EdTech startup Rflect has closed a seed round of close to CHF 1 million. The round was led by Friedrich Hoepfner, a former German Business Angel of the Year, through the Start Angel Network and other Business Angels with Edtech expertise. The plattform of Rflect is used by over 40 universities to integrate authentic human skill development into their study programmes.

rows.title: Healthtech Computer Vision sammelt 700’000 Franken für Expansion ein
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup Computer Vision hat die erste Tranche seiner Wachstumsfinanzierung erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Mit den frischen Mitteln soll die internationale Skalierung der Software «Emeralgo», die Radiologen bei der Interpretation von tomografischen Scans in der Orthopädie unterstützt, in den USA und Europa vorangetrieben werden.

rows.title: Grosse Namen setzen auf vollautomatische Bildverbesserung von Viesus
rows.summary: Viesus verbessert Fotos automatisch – für professionelle Qualität, in jedem Massstab. Bereits über hundert Unternehmen aus Europa und den USA vertrauen auf die KI-basierte Lösung des Dielsdorfer Startups, darunter ifolor, der amerikanische Fotodienstleister Mixbook und die Reise-App Polarsteps.

rows.title: Uber und WeRide spannen mit Schweizer Startup für Robotaxi-Dienst zusammen
rows.summary: Noch in diesem Jahr wollen WeRide, Uber und Rydera im Grossraum Zürich einen kommerziellen Robotaxi-Dienst starten. Rydera, eine Ausgründung von Carvolution, wird dabei für den Betrieb der Flotte zuständig sein.

rows.title: Bisocibex ravit le Prix Créateurs BCVs 2026
rows.summary: Les sciences de la vie s'invitent au palmarès du Prix Créateurs BCVS. Jeudi dernier, Bioscibex a remporté la 17e édition du prix, organisée à l'ancienne usine de Chandoline à Sion, en présence de 450 invités. La start-up basée au BioArk de Monthey développe un bioréacteur innovant qui simplifie radicalement la fabrication de thérapies contre les cancers et les maladies auto-immunes. Bioscibex repart avec une récompense de CHF 25'000.–. Le lauréat du Coup de cœur des anciens finalistes sera connu en octobre 2026, à l'occasion de la Foire du Valais.

rows.title: Switzerland extends its lead as deep tech hub
rows.summary: The Swiss Deep Tech Report 2026 ranks Switzerland first in the world for the share of venture capital going to deep tech, ahead of China and the United States, and first in Europe for deep tech investment per capita. Fuelled by a persistent trend towards larger investments in AI start-ups, the momentum has accelerated since last year.

rows.title: Zwei Startup-Lösungen für weniger Bildschirm-Zeit
rows.summary: Immer mehr Menschen kämpfen im Alltag mit digitaler Ablenkung, Doomscrolling und zu viel Zeit am Smartphone. Zwei Startups wollen mit ihren Tools den Smartphonenutzerinnen und -Nutzern zu mehr Selbstdisziplin verhelfen: FocusNow hat dazu eine Schliessfach-Anlage mit Ladestation für Schulen entwickelt. LOKD setzt ebenfalls auf eine physische Sperre fürs App-Blocking.

rows.title: >>venture>> awards ceremony shaped by AI
rows.summary: Edwatec, an EPFL startup, developing photonic systems for next-generation AI infrastructure and communications, took the evening's CHF 150,000 Grand Prize at the >>venture>> 2026 final in Lausanne. Noemon won the inaugural Spotlight Award for the boldest use of Apertus, Switzerland's open AI model. Four of the six category winners rely heavily on the use of AI.

rows.title: Big Sack s’allie à Jumbo et se lance au Tessin
rows.summary: En s'associant à Jumbo, la start-up romande Big Sack intensifie ses activités commerciales et étend sa présence à 51 nouveaux magasins à travers le pays. Par ailleurs, la jeune entreprise a lancé ses activités au Tessin dans le cadre de son expansion nationale. Traitant désormais plus de 4 000 tonnes de déchets par an, la start-up connaît une traction encourageante, notamment dans le secteur B2C.

rows.title: Immitra Bio receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The ETH spin-off Immitra Bio has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop a new treatment approach for rare genetic diseases. The biotech startup aims to replace complex stem cell transplantation procedures with a single injection, making potentially curative therapies more accessible.

rows.title: ClearideBio Therapeutics AG attracts Japanese CVC as lead investor
rows.summary: LOTTE HOLDINGDS Healthcare and Biopharmaceutical CVC invests in Basel-based ClearideBio Therapeutics, an early-stage biotechnology company developing antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of solid tumors. LOTTE HOLDINGDS CVC participated as lead investor in ClearideBio’s pre-seed financing round,

rows.title: Transcendance s'allie à TEC Group Swiss
