rows.summary: Transcendance, leader dans le domaine de la décoration horlogère dont l’expertise est reconnue par les marques horlogères les plus prestigieuses, a été rachetée par TEC Group Swiss — avec le soutien de Sienna Private Equity (« SPE »), un fonds européen de capital-investissement axé sur la valeur et spécialisé dans les entreprises de taille moyenne, qui a investi dans TEC Group aux côtés de son fondateur et PDG, Arnaud Faivre, en octobre 2025

rows.title: ABILITY Neurotech receives approval to start clinical trial
rows.summary: ABILITY Neurotech develops a fully implantable Brain Computer Interface system to restore autonomy for patients living with debilitating neurological conditions, including ALS, spinal cord injury, and stroke. The Geneva-based company has received Investigational Medical Device Dossier (IMDD) approval in the Netherlands to initiate the first chronic implantation study.

rows.title: $5 Million to accelerate the launch of TVL Capital’s Chain-Traded Products
rows.summary: TVL Capital, an institutional digital asset infrastructure firm, closed a $5 million funding round. The round was led by San Francisco-based venture Framework Ventures and joined by Amsterdam-based Flow Traders, as well as multiple other strategic investors. The funding will be used to build out TVL Capital’s core engineering and business development capabilities, accelerating the launch of Chain-Traded Products (CTPs).

rows.title: Proptech SCAIT closes oversubscribed pre-seed round
rows.summary: SCAIT helps construction companies process complex tenders faster. The company has attracted a high six-figure amount from Joachim Sorba who joined as an investor and strategic partner, and several other private investors among them are members of the Venture Kick jury. The funds will be used to begin the scaling process.

rows.title: Two Swiss startups recognized as WEF’s Technology Pioneers
rows.summary: The World Economic Forum announced its 2026 Technology Pioneers. The chosen companies are tackling problems from nuclear fusion and lunar resource extraction to neurosurgical robotics and post-quantum cryptography. From Switzerland, Atinary and Metafuels were recognized.

rows.title: Veraxa Biotech goes public at NASDAQ
rows.summary: VERAXA Biotech AG has successfully completed its previously announced business combination with Voyager Acquisition Corp. and commenced trading on the NASDAQ Capital Market on 11 June. At the start of the second trading day, the market capitalisation stood at just over 500 million US dollars.

rows.title: First paid pilots and validations for Femtech TrialHer
rows.summary: Since launching TrialHer’s Innovation Sandbox in February of this year, the startup led by CEO and Founder Hyatt Antognini-Amin started converting early demand into paid pilot work with two femtech companies so far in the UK and Europe. In another milestone for a Swiss early-stage venture, the Geneva-based Femtech was selected to participate in the WHO/Europe Public Health Innovation Platform.

rows.title: MassChallenge Switzerland selects its 2026 accelerator cohort
rows.summary: MassChallenge Switzerland has named 21 Swiss startups to its 2026 early-stage accelerator, selected from 1,961 applicants across 47 countries. The four-month programme spans five industry tracks and offers mentoring, corporate access and up to CHF 1 million in equity-free prizes distributed across participating startups in the Swiss and UK cohorts.

rows.title: Kantone setzen auf Technologie von FOOD2050 für nachhaltige Gastronomie
rows.summary: Mit MenuCheck bietet das Zürcher Startup FOOD2050 eine Anwendung, die die Klimawirkung von Menüs mit wenigen Klicks sichtbar macht und nachhaltige Menüplanung im Küchenalltag erleichtern soll. Die Kantone Basel-Stadt, Luzern und Zürich sowie die Stadt Zürich stellen das Tool Betrieben in ihren Regionen zur Verfügung.

rows.title: Three Swiss biotech companies secure grants
rows.summary: AC Immune, AveoliX and Combioxin have received funding for R&D projects. The funders vary widely.

rows.title: Healthcare start-ups dominate this year’s W.A. de Vigier Foundation Awards
rows.summary: Five young entrepreneurs were honored with a coveted W.A. de Vigier Award on June 10. Selected from more than 200 applicants, they were recognized at the Annual Award Ceremony in Solothurn for their innovation, entrepreneurial drive, and potential to create lasting impact.

rows.title: La startup en robotique Pick Place passe en mains belges
rows.summary: TG-Group et la startup valaisanne Pick Place s'engagent dans un rapprochement stratégique qui consolide la position de la société belge TG-Group comme partenaire d'avenir dans l'emballage, la robotique et l'automatisation industrielle. Pick Place conservera son équipe actuelle, son expertise et son esprit d'entreprise.

rows.title: Three Swiss start-ups selected for the inaugural Google DeepMind Accelerator batch
rows.summary: 15 robotics companies from across Europe have been selected to join the Google DeepMind Accelerator program. It provides three months of intensive mentorship and technical support.

rows.title: AlpineAI macht Zürcher Gemeindeverwaltungen fit für KI
rows.summary: Das KI-Startup AlpineAI hat eine Ausschreibung der Zusammenarbeitsorganisation von Gemeinden, Städten und dem Kanton Zürich egovpartner gewonnen und entwickelt nun ein skalierbares Basisportfolio für KI-Anwendungen. Die Plattform soll im Anschluss den Gemeinden und Städten im Kanton zur Verfügung gestellt werden.

rows.title: findependent beschleunigt Wachstum
rows.summary: Nach der FINMA-Bewilligung als kontoführendes Wertpapierhaus Anfang Jahr setzt das Aargauer Startup findependent seinen Wachstumskurs fort. Das Wachstum hat dabei zusätzlich an Dynamik gewonnen: Das verwaltete Vermögen hat sich gegenüber dem Vorjahr mehr als verdoppelt.

rows.title: Energy data and intelligence company TGS acquires Apparition Geoservices
rows.summary: Oslo-based TGS acquired Apparition Geoservices GmbH, securing exclusive access to its proprietary simultaneous source acquisition and separation technology.

rows.title: Swiss delegation set for VivaTech 2026
rows.summary: Twenty-five Swiss startups will showcase their technologies at Viva Technology 2026 in Paris from 17 to 20 June. Exhibiting at the Swiss Pavilion, they will present solutions ranging from AI and robotics to cleantech, ICT, healthtech and cybersecurity.

rows.title: Giotto.ai Portable AI for Enterprises launches successfully
rows.summary: In May Giotto.ai launched the first portable general-purpose AI model and operating system, designed to deliver advanced reasoning in a more efficient, flexible, and controllable format than traditional large-scale AI systems. To date, the solution for enterprises has generated strong demand, and the start-up led by Aldo Podesta expects further good news soon.

rows.title: Four new startups awarded FIT support
rows.summary: Four new startups are receiving support from the FIT: a Tech Seed loan of CHF 100,000 for EM Path and its ‘wave camera’, which visualises and measures electromagnetic fields; a second Tech Seed loan of CHF 100,000 for REMA and its innovative electrolysers that reduce the investment and operating costs of green hydrogen; and a third Tech Seed loan for Verretex and its solution to recycle glass fibre waste from end-of-life composites. Finally, Polytax has received a Digital Grant of CHF 20,000 for its tax return automation platform.

rows.title: Idorsia secures CHF250 million loan
rows.summary: Idorsia Ltd, a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, entered into a senior secured term loan agreement of up to CHF 250 million with investment funds managed by Pharmakon Advisors, LP. The funding enables Idorsia to move beyond a period that has constrained their strategic flexibility.

rows.title: calmea receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The ETH spin-off calmea has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to support the commercialization of its sleep-monitoring technology. The solution enables bed manufacturers to transform conventional beds into intelligent sleep systems that provide users with actionable insights into their sleep quality, without requiring wearables or devices in bed.

rows.title: Neural Concept Opens First APAC Office in Seoul
rows.summary: Neural Concept, the Swiss leader in AI-driven physical product development, opened its first direct office in Seoul and its first in APAC. The new office will deepen the direct collaboration with existing customer Hanwha Ocean, a world-class shipbuilder specializing in commercial vessels and offshore plants, and other leading global automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the region. In general the opening reflects growing demand from Korean manufacturers that are moving beyond isolated AI pilots and toward production-scale deployment across engineering teams.

rows.title: FINMA licence to bring Sequence’s vision to life
rows.summary: In a major milestone, Geneva-based Sequence has obtained a FINMA FinTech license under Art. 1b of the Swiss Banking Act — making it the fifth licensed FinTech institution in Switzerland, and the only one based in Geneva. Thanks to the license, the company is set to rebuild the financial backbone of Swiss businesses — integrated finance, ERP, and operational infrastructure on a single platform.

rows.title: Global Impulse Program supports ten pioneering Vaud startups
rows.summary: Through the Global Impulse Program, ten pioneering companies from the Vaud region are being supported to expand their impact worldwide. Selected by a jury of experts, these solutions reflect the strength and creativity of Vaud’s cleantech and circular economy innovation ecosystem.

rows.title: maison blanche secures strategic investment of CHF 4 Million
rows.summary: The Zurich-based luxury fashion and creative brand maison blanche has secured strategic growth capital from Dubai-based investment firm Dale Ventures FZE. The fresh money will be used to  accelerate the next phase of growth and to further strengthen the brand’s global presence.

rows.title: Startup ecosystems: Mixed Results for Switzerland
rows.summary: The Global Tech Ecosystem Index 2026 by Dealroom delivers mixed results for Switzerland. While Swiss startup hubs struggle to compete with the world's largest ecosystems on scale, they perform considerably better when startup activity is measured relative to population size. In the report, Lausanne is actually named as a global density leader.

rows.title: Temenos acquires additiv to accelerate AI-driven orchestration
rows.summary: Temenos AG, a global leader in banking technology, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire additiv AG, a Switzerland-based fintech company. Additiv integrates process steps and data into a single orchestration layer for wealth and other financial services workflows. Temenos is acquiring 100% of additiv with the consideration paid c.50% in cash and c.50% in equity.

rows.title: rrreefs: Sammelziel vor Kampagnenstart schon in Sichtweite
rows.summary: Das ETH-Zürich-Spin-off rrreefs startet eine Seed-Investmentrunde bei seiner Crowd. Beim öffentlichen Start der Kampagne haben Angel Investoren und Family Offices bereits Investments in der Höhe von über 620’000 Franken zugesagt. Hinzu kommt ein Darlehen vom Innovationsfonds der Alternativen Bank Schweiz von 100'000 Franken. Mit dem frischen Kapital will rrreefs neue Märkte erschliessen und den Break-even bis 2027 anpeilen.

rows.title: Swiss Economic Award 2026 goes to Lightium, Swiss Cluster and enshift
rows.summary: On the second day of the Swiss Economic Forum, the presentation of the Swiss Economic Awards is traditionally one of the highlights. This year, two microtechnology companies and a cleantech service provider took the top spots on the podium.

rows.title: Tech4Trust Crowns AURIGIN.AI as Grand Prize Winner
rows.summary: The Tech4Trust awards ceremony took place on 4 June and brought together 130 attendees at the unlimitrust campus. The diverse audience included Trust Valley partners, investors, start-ups and representatives from the wider innovation ecosystem. This year, Zurich-based Aurigin.ai stood out for its cutting-edge solutions for real-time detection of audio deepfakes and combating voice spoofing, which protect communication platforms and biometric systems against AI-generated voice cloning.

rows.title: Resilio acquires Greenoco and strengthens commitment to sustainable tech
rows.summary: Resilio, leading provider of environmental impact assessment and data solutions for the tech sector, today announced the acquisition of Greenoco, a SaaS platform specializing in measuring and reducing the carbon footprint of websites. This strategic acquisition enables Resilio to offer an end-to-end solution to its clients, incorporating a key dimension: web eco-design.

rows.title: Strategic Partnership opens US Market to Saporo
rows.summary: In a major move, Swiss preemptive identity security startup Saporo is partnering with Columbus-based performance venture OH.io to lead its expansion into the North American market, becoming the first international company in OH.io’s portfolio. Saporo helps organizations reduce exploitable identity exposure before breaches occur.

rows.title: Finalisten der Swiss FinTech Awards 2026 stehen fest: KI dominiert
rows.summary: Vier Startups haben sich für das Finale der Swiss FinTech Awards 2026 qualifiziert. Die 11. Ausgabe steht dabei ganz im Zeichen der künstlichen Intelligenz: von Betrugsbekämpfung und Prozessautomatisierung im Backoffice und ERP bis hin zu KI-Governance. Die Gewinner werden am 23. Juni in Zürich gekürt.

rows.title: GR3N closes a €15.5M Series B round
rows.summary: GR3N is revolutionizing PET and polyester recycling. In a Series B round, the Swiss cleantech company has raised €15.5 million. The round was led by 360 Capital, a leading Franco-Italian VC firm, with the participation of VP Textile. The proceeds will finance GR3N's first industrial-scale plant, located in Spain, with a capacity of 40,000 tons of virgin PET chips per year.

rows.title: Beste Start-ups der Ostschweiz: Zwei nachhaltige Unternehmen geehrt
rows.summary: Die St. Galler Kantonalbank hat die jährlichen Jungunternehmerpreise verliehen: Catchfree gewinnt mit pflanzlichem Seafood den Startfeld Diamant. Fortyfour gewinnt mit ihrer CO₂-Filter-Technologie den Rohdiamanten für das beste Early-Stage-Startup.

rows.title: TheraPPI completes second closing of pre-seed financing
rows.summary: TheraPPI has closed a pre-seed equity round and appointed pharma executive Christopher Meyer as chairperson of its board. The round will support development of the company's lead oncology program targeting the Ras-MAPK pathway.

rows.title: Thirteen companies join Technology Fund portfolio
rows.summary: The Technology Fund has added 13 companies to its portfolio since July 2025, extending loan guarantee backing to cleantech startups working on solutions ranging from battery recycling, EV charging, solar and low-drag ship coatings. The Fund's portfolio now spans 134 companies with an estimated cumulative impact of 12.9 million tonnes of CO₂ equivalent over the past decade.

rows.title: KI-Startup Zenline treibt internationale Expansion voran
rows.summary: Zenline AI ist seit letztem Jahr deutlich gewachsen und hat namhafte Kunden aus verschiedenen Branchen gewonnen. Nun fokussiert sich das Zürcher Startup auf die Expansion in die USA und nach Grossbritannien. Für zusätzliche Aufmerksamkeit sorgte vergangene Woche ein Besuch des kosovarischen Premierministers.

rows.title: Creapole SA cesse ses activités
rows.summary: Réunis en Assemblée générale ordinaire le mercredi 3 juin dernier, les actionnaires de Creapole SA ont finalement décidé de dissoudre et de liquider la société. L’entreprise a certes réalisé de bons résultats en 2025, toutefois, la viabilité de la structure selon sa composition et mission actuelles ne peut pas être assurée à moyen terme. Ceci est notamment dû à la décision de réduction, dès 2026, de 60% des subventions versées par l’actionnaire majoritaire, le Canton du Jura.

rows.title: Quantum Design completes acquisition of Qnami
rows.summary: Quantum Design has acquired Qnami, a leading developer of diamond-based quantum sensing technologies with its roots at the Physics Department of the University of Basel. Established in 1982 in San Diego, California, Quantum Design is the leading commercial source for automated materials characterization systems offering a variety of measurement capabilities.

rows.title: Motif’s AI-based financial intelligence system off to flying start
rows.summary: Zug-based motif has launched Clarity, an AI financial intelligence system that tracks how markets, assets and financial relationships connect, and how and why they change over time. Multiple financial institutions have contracts ahead of launch, collectively representing over 1.5 million end users and billions in assets under management.

rows.title: CENSE sammelt 6,5 Millionen Euro für Expansion ein
rows.summary: CENSE hat eine Krypto-Compliance-Plattform für Finanzinstitute entwickelt. In einer Seed-Runde hat das Zuger Startup 6,5 Millionen Euro eingesammelt. Die Runde angeführt haben G+D Ventures und Rabo Investments.

rows.title: SEALSQ acquires majority in Wecan, closes Miraex deal
rows.summary: Following an initial 28% equity stake acquired one year ago, SEALSQ increases its ownership in Wecan Group to a majority position, strengthening its ability to deliver secure, AI-powered compliance solutions and post-quantum financial infrastructure for the global financial industry. In addition, SEALSQ has acquired entire issued share capital of Miraex SA.

rows.title: The Startup Days Barometer reveals a better mood than last year
rows.summary: For the second year running, the Swiss Startup Days used the SUD Barometer to gauge the mood among founders. The sentiment was slightly better than the previous year. In particular, access to experienced staff appears to have improved, whilst, on the other hand, bureaucracy and regulation are perceived as being even more of a hindrance.

rows.title: Typewise treibt Ausbau seiner KI-Software voran
rows.summary: Typewise startete einst mit einer KI-gestützten Tastatur-App und positioniert sich heute als AI-Agent-Plattform für Unternehmen. Bereits mehr als ein Viertel der bestehenden Unternehmenskunden nutzt die AI Agents. Mit dem neuen «AI Operator» will das Unternehmen deren Einrichtung und Steuerung ab dem kommenden Monat weiter vereinfachen.

rows.title: Le Prix Digitourism 2026 sacre HooRa et Téléverbier
rows.summary: Grâce à une solution innovante de recrutement numérique développée en partenariat avec la startup valaisanne HooRa, Téléverbier a remporté le Prix Digitourism 2026, doté de 15 000 francs suisses. S'appuyant sur les réseaux sociaux, l'automatisation et l'intelligence artificielle, ce système a permis à l'entreprise d'optimiser le recrutement de travailleurs saisonniers dans un contexte de grave pénurie de main-d'œuvre. Le prix a été remis lors des Digitourism Days qui se sont tenus à Champex-Lac.

rows.title: Coachbetter sichert sich 6.4 Millionen Franken und gewinnt DFB als Investor
rows.summary: Mit einer erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Pre-Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde startet das Thurgauer Startup Coachbetter in seine nächste Wachstumsphase. Der Deutsche Fussball-Bund steigt als strategischer Investor ein und unterstützt als grösster Sportverband der Welt das weitere internationale Wachstum des Unternehmens.

rows.title: CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to simplifiy pharmaceutical and fine chemical manufacturing
rows.summary: The techbio startup hephaistos.bio helps manufacturers to replace complex and energy-intensive chemical processes with more resilient and sustainable production methods. Combining computational biology, chemistry, and machine learning, the startup develops custom protein catalysts tailored to industrial reactions to make pharmaceutical and fine chemical manufacturing easier, sustainable, cost-effective and resilient.

rows.title: Oculis cancels plans to seek approval for OCS-1 for diabetic macular oedema
rows.summary: Oculis Holding AG announced results from its Phase 3 trials of OCS-01 eye drops in patients with diabetic macular edema (DME). The primary endpoint in both studies was not met. Oculis will focus its developmental efforts and financial resources on the ongoing Privosegtor PIONEER registrational program in optic neuropathies and the Licaminlimab PREDICT-1 registrational trial in dry eye disease.

rows.title: Zürcher Drohnen-Startup gewinnt Ex-Armeechef als Investor
rows.summary: Mit Unterstützung aus dem Verteidigungsumfeld treibt Avientus die Entwicklung autonomer Transportdrohnen weiter voran. Das Startup hat bereits einen ersten Prototyp an eine europäische Armee verkauft und weitere Pilotprojekte vereinbart.

rows.title: NUCLIDIUM's Series B reaches CHF 105 million with latest extension
rows.summary: Basel-based biotech NUCLIDIUM has closed an oversubscribed CHF 26 million Series B extension, bringing the round to CHF 105 million, to advance its copper-based cancer diagnostic and therapy programs into expanded Phase 1/2 trials and scale up global manufacturing.

rows.title: Next Gen Arena and Tech to power up SONIX Gaming
rows.summary: SONIX, the Swiss gaming company specializing in AI-powered ultra-low latency voice communication, recently announced the full integration of the former RUSH.gg tournament software into the SONIX product ecosystem. In addition to the new competition arena, the company, together with the HEIG-VD is set to bring deep AI audio technology to mobile gaming through an ambitious Innosuisse project.

rows.title: Wo Hunde Könige sind: Züripets verzeichnet starkes Wachstum
rows.summary: Züripets hat sich im Raum Zürich als Premiumanbieter im Bereich professioneller Hundebetreuung etabliert. Das 2022 gegründete Startup verzeichnete im vergangenen Jahr ein Umsatzwachstum von rund 45 Prozent. Besonders stark entwickelt sich aktuell die Nachfrage bei Expats, internationalen Gästen und Geschäftsreisenden während ihres Aufenthaltes in Zürich.

rows.title: Lean Projects acquired by Belgian IT-group Cegeka
rows.summary: Lean Projects, a Swiss software company specializing in enterprise resource planning solutions for the print and packaging industry, has been acquired by Belgian IT group Cegeka. The Lean Projects team will continue to develop the solution, backed by Cegeka's international delivery and support capabilities.

rows.title: CHF 3.5M to Build Stellar Alpina Detonation-Based Propulsion for Mobility After Launch
rows.summary: The Zurich-based startup is developing compact rotating detonation rocket engines (RDRE’s) to make movement between orbits faster, smaller, and more efficient. Just 82 days after incorporation, Stellar Alpina completed Europe’s first known commercial RDRE hotfire campaign. The CHF 3.5 million, approximately USD 4.5 million pre-seed round is led by Founderful.

rows.title: Biotech companies Veraxa and Curatis strengthen financial positions
rows.summary: Ahead of its planned listing on NASDAQ, VERAXA has secured financing of USD 27.5 million in the form of a senior secured convertible note with High Trail Capital LP. In addition, VERAXA has entered into a share purchase agreement of up to USD 50 million with Lincoln Park Capital Fund, LLC. Curatis closed a private placement of a convertible instrument of CHF 3.0 million with a strategic Swiss investor.

rows.title: Proptech Benetics AI verzeichnet starkes Wachstum
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup Benetics AI konnte in den vergangenen Monaten die Marke von 300 Unternehmenskunden knacken und etabliert sich nun zunehmend auch ausserhalb des DACH-Raums. Schub verleiht eine KI-Agenten-Lösung namens Ben.

rows.title: Eight Swiss startups receive international recognition
rows.summary: Five Swiss startups have made Hello Tomorrow's Top 100 Deep Tech ranking for 2026, while three more—PeelPack, BitVault and Reilo—have secured places in international accelerator programs, in a run of selections spanning subsea robotics, proteomics, women's health, sustainable packaging, Bitcoin security and agricultural finance.

rows.title: Branchenorganisationen arbeiten mit Startups zusammen
rows.summary: Das Zuger Startup smartconext sowie das Zürcher FoodTech-Startup Localfish haben neue Kooperationen angekündigt. Während smartconext gemeinsam mit dem Schweizerischen Maler- und Gipserunternehmer-Verband die Digitalisierung von Akquise-Prozessen vorantreiben will, setzen Localfish und der Verein Responsible Hotels of Switzerland auf nachhaltigen Fisch für die Hotellerie.

rows.title: Lilly to acquire LimmaTech Biologics for up to USD 780 million
rows.summary: LimmaTech Biologics AG, a clinical-stage biotech company developing vaccines for common bacterial infections, entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Lilly. Under the terms of the agreement, Lilly will acquire LimmaTech for up to $780 million in cash, inclusive of an upfront payment and additional potential payments based upon the achievement of certain clinical and regulatory milestones.

rows.title: SwissVC repositions as a peer network for active venture investors
rows.summary: The Swiss venture capital community SwissVC, founded in 2015, is repositioning itself to a smaller, structured network for full-time venture capital investors deploying capital in Switzerland. The change comes with new leadership, a board overhaul and a plan to incorporate as a non-profit association.

rows.title: Terra Quantum changes its IPO plans
rows.summary: Following an initial announcement in April regarding an IPO via SPAC, Terra Quantum has now presented a new plan involving a different shell company and has slightly increased its target valuation to USD 3.6 billion. The transaction is targeted to close in the second half of 2026.

rows.title: TUUS awarded CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The foodtech startup TUUS has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance a plant-based hydrogel platform for the controlled release of nutrients and active compounds. The technology aims to provide more stable absorption and improved tolerance in applications ranging from sports nutrition to pharmaceuticals.

rows.title: AI firm Visium secures funds to scale across Europe and US
rows.summary: Visium has closed its first institutional funding round after eight years as a bootstrapped company. Now employing 100 people across Europe, the firm provides AI and data services to clients in highly regulated industries. The round was co-led by Columbus Venture Partners and Concentric.

rows.title: Following the breakthrough of the Eggsorter, Bionomous launches its second product
rows.summary: Bionomous new product Sortivo automates the screening, sorting and plating of complex biological entities from 300 µm to~2 mm such as zebrafish embryos and organoids, workflows that, until now, have relied on hours of manual pipetting under a stereomicroscope. Three years ago, Bionomous launched its novel EggSorter, which is now used in academic institutions, contract research organisations (CROs) and pharmaceutical companies around the world.

rows.title: Social Impact Catalyst 2026: 12 Startups im Final
rows.summary: Aus über 160 spannenden Bewerbungen haben zwölf wirkungsorientierte Startups den Sprung ins Finale und damit ins Investment Readiness Programm des Social Impact Catalyst geschafft. Die Startup-Teams werden in den kommenden Monaten gezielt mit Investorinnen, Investoren und Stiftungen vernetzt.

rows.title: InSphero acquires PhenoVista to expand US presence
rows.summary: InSphero has acquired PhenoVista Biosciences, a California-based contract research organization specializing in imaging-based laboratory assays. The deal expands the Swiss company's presence in the United States and adds high-content imaging and phenotypic analysis to its drug-testing services.

rows.title: Über 1 Million Franken für 8 Innovationen von der Klimastiftung Schweiz
rows.summary: Die erste Förderrunde 2026 der Klimastiftung Schweiz unterstützt 8 Unternehmen – darunter überwiegend junge Cleantech-Startups - mit über 1,08 Millionen Franken. Die Innovationen reichen dabei von der Verpackungsfolie aus Algen, einer Lösung für drahtlose Energieübertragung für Elektrobusse bis zur Hochvolt-Second-Life-Speicherplattform für Industrie und Gewerbe.

rows.title: DePoly's new plant sparks high demand
rows.summary: DePoly has secured contracts worth a total of CHF 50 million for its demonstration plant in Monthey, which is currently in the final stages of construction and is expected to begin operations this summer.

rows.title: Voltiris' fourth one-hectare facility to open in the Netherlands
rows.summary: Voltiris will equip Genson Group, a Bakker Barendrecht grower, with its spectral filtering modules, generating up to 25 kWh of renewable electricity per m² per year directly from the greenhouse. The project builds on strawberry trials in which Voltiris delivered a 26% increase in premium fruit yield. This will be the company’s fourth one-hectare installation, with eight planned by 2026 - in Switzerland, France, and the Netherlands.

rows.title: “Through our BlackArmor process technology, we aim to replace metallic implants.”
rows.summary: Following approval of its first spinal Carbon/PEEK implants in the US, it took icotec only a few years to achieve annual sales of more than USD 50 million. To finance its continued development, the company is relying on a growth credit from UBS. We spoke to Group CEO Roger Stadler, CFO Remo Keller and Lukas Reinhardt, Head of Growth Advisory at UBS, about icotec’s success, financing and future plans.

rows.title: The Swiss start-up scene gathered in Bern
rows.summary: For two days, Bern was all about start-ups. On Wednesday, the Collective Gathering took place, and on Thursday, the Swiss Start-up Days were held. Keynotes, workshops and discussions provided opportunities to learn and exchange experiences. The atmosphere was good, but not overly exuberant.

rows.title: Swiss biotechs progress across cardiology, oncology and allergy clinical programs
rows.summary: Four biotechs report progress in their clinical programs: HAYA Therapeutics dosed the first cohort in a Phase 1 cardiac fibrosis trial, Mabylon reported positive Phase 1a safety results for its peanut allergy candidate, Molecular Partners published Phase 1 oncology data in Nature Cancer, and Anaveon is seeking partners for its oncology portfolio following its pivot to immunology.

rows.title: HSG Start Accelerator: investment for Aithon Robotics and Surface Cleantech
rows.summary: Eight deep-tech startups have successfully completed the second cohort of the HSG START Accelerator, presenting their solutions at the Demo Day. Two of the participating start-ups secured investments as part of the accelerator.

rows.title: Flappie bedient seine ersten 2'500 Kunden
rows.summary: Das Warten war nicht für die Katz: Drei Jahre nachdem Flappie die ersten smarten Katzenklappen verkauft hat, erfolgt nun Schritt für Schritt die Auslieferung der vorbestellten Türchen mit KI-basierter Beute-Detektion und Zugangsregelung.

rows.title: New record takes NeoCarbons closer to market
rows.summary: NeoCarbons, a Swiss biotechnology startup building stainless-steel photobioreactors just delivered the highest productivity ever recorded, opening the door to pharma-grade microalgae at industrial scale. The upstream gain feeds a system designed to cut downstream purification cost by 65%, and the company is set to begin pharma-grade validation in Q2 2026 with its turnkey partner De Dietrich Process Systems.

rows.title: brutal güet produziert an der Eishockey-WM
rows.summary: Mit Projekten in der Schweiz sowie vereinzelt in den Nachbarländern hat sich brutal güet in den vergangenen Jahren im Bereich Live-Produktionen ein breites Portfolio aufgebaut. Mit dem Einsatz an der Eishockey-Weltmeisterschaft 2026 für ProSiebenSat.1 erweitert das Walliser Startup dieses nun um ein internationales Sportgrossereignis.

rows.title: Infomaniak's founder transfers control of his company to a foundation
rows.summary: Geneva-based cloud provider Infomaniak generated CHF 56 million in revenue in 2025 and has more than 340 employees in Switzerland. Infomaniak Group SA is now majority-owned by the Infomaniak Foundation, a Swiss public-interest foundation. The new structure safeguards its mission which centres around sovereignty, independence and sustainability.

rows.title: «Mathilde» neu im halbautomatisierten Betrieb unterwegs
rows.summary: Planzer geht neue Wege: Das Logistikunternehmen setzt ein autonomes Lieferfahrzeug des Startups LOXO im Strassenverkehr ein. Das Fahrzeug «Mathilde» transportiert Pakete vom Berner Güterbahnhof zu mehreren Umschlagspunkten im Stadtgebiet.

rows.title: Neurosoft Bioelectronics Closes $7.5M Oversubscribed Seed Round
rows.summary: Neurosoft Bioelectronics, a Swiss neurotechnology startup developing scalable and soft brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), today announced that it has raised a $7.5 million oversubscribed seed financing round to build stretchable and scalable brain-computer interfaces. Funding will advance minimally invasive brain interface platform already tested in 10 patients and accelerate development of a cortical foundation model for next-generation BCIs.

rows.title: 20 Years Venture Leaders with strong track record
rows.summary: Since 2006, Venturelab has been accelerating Switzerland’s most promising startups onto the international stage through the Swiss National Startup Team and its flagship program, Venture Leaders. As the program celebrates its 20th anniversary, new figures underline its impact. 650 Venture Leaders alumni have created 20,550 jobs, raised CHF 9.5 billion in growth capital, and strengthened Switzerland’s position as a globally relevant innovation hub.

rows.title: AVIAN raises CHF 2 million to expand its industrial fire detection system
rows.summary: AVIAN, a Zurich-based developer of thermal cameras for early fire detection in industrial environments, has closed a CHF 2 million round led entirely by Founderful. The company will use the capital to scale its engineering and sales teams across the United States and Europe.

rows.title: ESA BIC Switzerland onboards six startups in 20th cohort
rows.summary: Six Swiss startups have joined the 20th cohort of ESA BIC Switzerland, the European Space Agency's local incubator operated by ETH Zurich. The participants are developing solutions ranging from underwater navigation, terahertz components, in-space propulsion and AI-generated simulation environments. Each will receive up to EUR 200,000 and two years of business and technical support.

rows.title: exnaton: Neue Plug-and-Play-Lösung für intelligentes Energiemanagement
rows.summary: Gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Heimenergiemanagement-Softwareanbieter clever-PV bringt exnaton eine Plug-and-Play-Integration auf den Markt, mit der sich dynamische Stromtarife ohne komplexe IT-Integration in die automatische Steuerung von Haushaltsgeräten überführen lassen. Ein in Deutschland führender kommunaler Energieversorger hat die Lösung bereits implementiert.

rows.title: Swiss startups strengthen C-suite across AI, biotech and engineering
rows.summary: Six Swiss startups across AI, biotech and engineering have brought in new C-level executives. Zurich-based nextesy promoted co-founder Dario Fazlic to Co-CEO and named a new Chief Commercial Officer, while CustomSurg, AMYRA Biotech, BLP, Yuvoi and Neural Concept all hired new executives across several roles.

rows.title: CHF 1.5M to build Cigno's leading AI infrastructure for management consulting
rows.summary: Cigno, a Swiss startup building the leading AI infrastructure for management consulting has closed its first CHF 1.5 million financing round. This brings together exclusively leaders and entrepreneurs from consulting, finance and tech. The funds raised will accelerate product development and structure commercial deployment across Europe.

rows.title: Bei grossen Retailern im Regal: Getränke-Startups expandieren
rows.summary: Gleich drei Spezialgetränke-Startups bekommen die Möglichkeit, ihre Produkte bei bekannten Detailhändlern zu listen. ph. gewinnt einen der grössten US-Retailer für Sportnahrung als Vertriebspartner für sein jüngstes KA-EX-Getränk. Der Kombucha von Komeo und der Matcha Soda von Soully sind neu in über 600 Coop-Filialen erhältlich.

rows.title: Schweizer Crowdfunding-Markt kehrt auf Wachstumskurs zurück
rows.summary: Der Schweizer Crowdfunding-Markt hat 2025 wieder zugelegt. Nach drei rückläufigen Jahren stieg das Volumen um 14 Prozent auf 629 Millionen Franken, wie die jährliche Studie der Hochschule Luzern zeigt. Beim Crowdinvesting von Startups war hingegen ein Rückgang zu verzeichnen: Das Volumen sank gegenüber dem Vorjahr um rund 15 Prozent.

rows.title: Swiss start-ups shine in Lausanne competitions
rows.summary: With the competition season in full swing, several Swiss start-ups have distinguished themselves at high-profile events in Lausanne such as the Prix Strategis, the Sport Innovation Challenge and the START Contest. Some companies are already well known, such as Irmos and Aiving, whilst others are on the verge of becoming so.

rows.title: Swedish outdoor group acquires Swiss dog supplies company curli AG
rows.summary: Thule has signed an agreement to acquire Swiss-based curli AG. Over the past decade, curli has established a leading position in high-quality dog harnesses, which are sold in approximately 60 countries. The initial purchase price amounts to CHF 10.1 million; an additional purchase price of up to 6.8 million CHF will be paid based on future financial results.

rows.title: SEF.Growth High Potential Label awarded to five scale-ups
rows.summary: The SEF.Growth High Potential Label has been awarded to five fast-growing Swiss scale-ups working across fast-casual dining, employee insurance, body-temperature sensing, unified payments and real-world health data. The label is intended to strengthen the recipients' positioning and visibility among customers, suppliers and financing partners.

rows.title: BE WTR accelerates growth in southeast Asia with the acquisition of Porla
rows.summary: Premium locally bottled water company BE WTR acquires operations of Porla in Singapore and Hong Kong. The acquisition doubles BE WTR’s team in Singapore, brings the Hong Kong operations under its management, and marks the brand’s entry into Thailand.

rows.title: Investor ermöglicht Complemedia die Expansion im DACH-Raum
rows.summary: Der 2010 gegründete Golfmedienanbieter Complemedia holt einen von Arnia Partners beratenen Investorenkreis an Bord. Das Investment soll das Wachstum in der Schweiz stärken und den Ausbau im deutschsprachigen Raum unterstützen.

rows.title: Von KI-Lernapps bis Textilkreislauf: Startups und Projekte ausgezeichnet
rows.summary: Acht Startups und Innovationsprojekte konnten sich in den vergangenen Wochen über Förderungen und Auszeichnungen freuen. Drei Startups erhalten einen Platz im genisuisse-Coachingprogramm und SeasON Energy wurde beim German Innovation Award ausgezeichnet. Weitere Preise gingen unter anderem an Tide Ocean, CAZ Cascara, Mano Games sowie an Projekte mit Beteiligung der Startups Work-ID und ALPINA+SANA.

rows.title: Oncobit launches uveal melanoma assay with TrilliumBiO in the US
rows.summary: Precision oncology company Oncobit has launched Oncular, a blood-based monitoring assay for uveal melanoma, in the United States in partnership with US diagnostics firm TrilliumBiO.

rows.title: Ten finalists advance to W.A. de Vigier 2026 final
rows.summary: Cleantech and healthtech ventures dominate the recently revealed ten-strong shortlist for the 2026 W.A. de Vigier Award. Selected from more than 200 applicants, the finalists will pitch on June 10 in Solothurn, where up to five will each receive CHF 120,00.

rows.title: Pushing the Limits of Wind Energy: RTDT wins ZKB Pionierpreis Technopark
rows.summary: RTDT Laboratories took first place in the ZKB Pionierpreis Technopark, which comes with a prize of 100,000 Swiss francs, for its sensor system designed to optimize wind turbines. The jury was impressed by the company’s complete combination of innovation, market access, impact, and team. The Audience Award, valued at CHF 5,000 and decided by a live vote on the evening, went to photonic chip start-up CCRAFT.

rows.title: Nalgoova Therapeutics enters Biopôle’s Vanguard Accelerator
rows.summary: Nalgoova Therapeutics has joined Biopôle’s Vanguard Accelerator as it enters a new phase of development, moving from early validation toward clinical execution and market preparation. Nalgoova Therapeutics is a Swiss healthtech company working to redefine how severe headaches are understood and treated—by making pain visible and actionable.

rows.title: Oxoia erhöht Wachstumstempo
rows.summary: Das Aargauer Cleantech Oxoia passt seine Strategie an: Statt Gebäudeeigentümer stehen nun auch Energieoptimierungs-Dienstleister im Fokus. Das Unternehmen, das eine Software zur Reduktion des Energieverbrauchs in Gebäuden entwickelt, hat zuletzt sein Wachstum deutlich beschleunigt.

rows.title: Barrierefreier an den ESC und die Eishockey-WM: Accessify machts möglich
rows.summary: Menschen mit einer Hör- oder Sehbehinderung, fehlenden Sprachkenntnissen oder dem Wunsch nach mehr Informationen kommen dank Accessify an Live-Events gleichermassen auf ihre Kosten: Die Plattform, betrieben vom gleichnamigen Verein und dem Tech-Unternehmen iRewind, ermöglicht Hörunterstützung, Live-Transkription, Echtzeit-Übersetzung und die Integration von Gebärdensprache und Audiodeskription.

rows.title: New Funding to Scale AMP IT Private EV Charging in Switzerland and Beyond
rows.summary: AMP IT, a Geneva-based energy and mobility startup, today announced the successful completion of a new funding round to accelerate the deployment of its private EV charging and energy management platform across Switzerland and international markets. The round brings AMP IT’s total funding to €7 million.

rows.title: >>venture>> 2026 names 18 finalists and debuts Spotlight Award
rows.summary: Around 450 startups applied for this year's >>venture>> award—more than any previous edition. Three finalists in each of six verticals will pitch for the 2026 Grand Prize, worth CHF 150,000. Three further startups compete for the inaugural Spotlight Award, themed around the Swiss open-source LLM Apertus.

rows.title: KI-Dokumentationslösung von 44ai erhält Medizinprodukt-Status
rows.summary: Über die Plattform Haidy können Kunden von 44ai mittels inhouse entwickelter KI medizinische Notizen und Berichte automatisiert erstellen, Krankengeschichten aktualisieren und so eine strukturierte Datengrundlage für Ärztinnen und Ärzte schaffen. Die Software ist bei führenden Gesundheitsinstitutionen in der DACH-Region im Einsatz.

rows.title: Data science and AI start-ups secure support
rows.summary: Data science projects from two start-ups are supported by the Swiss Data Science Center and the Canton of Vaud. Neurosoft Bioelectronics has been awarded a computational support grant by the Swiss AI Initiative to access Alps, the supercomputer operated by the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre.

rows.title: Drei Startups sichern sich Kapital für die nächste Wachstumsphase
rows.summary: Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen haben über Crowdfunding erfolgreich Kapital aufgenommen, um ihre Projekte voranzutreiben. Die Bandbreite reicht von digitalen Luftfahrtlösungen über Blockchain-Infrastruktur bis hin zu Schuhen aus Schafswolle. Insgesamt beteiligten sich über 700 Investorinnen und Investoren und stellten Kapital für die jeweiligen Wachstumspläne bereit.

rows.title: Nine start-ups selected for the Digital Health Accelerator
rows.summary: After a highly competitive selection process, digital health center bülach (dhc) and Tenity reveal the 9 startups chosen for the fourth batch of the Digital Health Accelerator. The selected companies span a broad range of sectors, including clinical workflows, care navigation, rehabilitation, medication safety, mental health, oncology, robotics and cognitive assessment.

rows.title: EPFL Deeptech Trailblazers in the spotlight
rows.summary: EPFL’s pioneers shone once again at the 15th edition of Startup Champions Seed Night, held at EPFL’s Rolex Learning Center. Twenty early-stage startups were invited to pitch in 90-second pitches. The evening also featured a discussion with Pierre Baqué of Neural Concept on scaling technology from Switzerland. In another rich Seed Night Story, Florent Héroguel, cofounder of Bloom Biorenewables, reflected on the journey behind a breakthrough Swiss cleantech company.

rows.title: Happy Pot verzeichnet starkes Wachstum
rows.summary: Mit seiner Geldsammel-Plattform verzeichnet Happy Pot ein starkes Wachstum: In den vergangenen 9 Monaten hat sich die Zahl der eröffneten Sammel-Pots verfünffacht. So verzeichnete das Startup im ersten Quartal 2026 bereits mehr Umsatz als im gesamten vergangenen Jahr. Zudem nutzen immer mehr Personen aus weiteren europäischen Ländern die Plattform von Happy Pot.

rows.title: Fruitful AI closes strategic investment round
rows.summary: 40Factory announces a strategic investment in FruitfulAI AG, a Zurich-based startup specializing in AI Machine Vision technologies applied to industrial environments. The investment aims to integrate new capabilities into 40Factory’s Industrial IoT & AI platform, based on the intelligent analysis of video streams from industrial video surveillance cameras.

rows.title: NIRLAB acquired for up to USD 23 million
rows.summary: US-based 908 Devices has completed the acquisition of Lausanne start-up NIRLAB, which developed a handheld device for field chemical analysis. 908 Devices paid USD 15 million upfront, and agreed to a further USD 8 million in stocks upon completion of performance milestones.

rows.title: Terra Quantum reports progress on its way into defense and telecommunications markets
rows.summary: Terra Quantum has announced two operational deployments of its quantum-secure communications technology—one with the U.S. Air Force, the other on Maltese operator Melita's live fiber network—marking important steps from research into real-world defense and commercial use.

rows.title: Bioscibex ships first SW1NGO bioreactors-incubators
rows.summary: Just a few months after its public unveiling, Bioscibex has reached a major milestone by beginning to deliver SW1NGO to its first customers. With its novel device, the Monthey-based biopharmaceutical startup led by CEO Chloé Albietz is set to disrupt the bioprocess manufacturing industry and help its customers drastically simplify their seed train operations.

rows.title: Market momentum for thriving Kitro
rows.summary: After temporarily losing most of its customers during the COVID-19 pandemic, Kitro has shown resilience, regaining momentum on market, driven by a growing awareness of the issues surrounding food waste and sustainability. Today, the platform serves more than 500 professional kitchens in 40 countries, including Switzerland, with renowned users such as the Berghaus Niesenbahn restaurant and hotels in the Marriott and Four Seasons chains.

rows.title: Swiss medtechs hit milestones in cardiovascular care
rows.summary: Two Swiss medtechs reached regulatory and clinical milestones: CorFlow Therapeutics moved its FDA pivotal trial into a second phase and launched a new clinical trial in parallel, while SQ Innovation cleared CE marking and received EMA review acceptance for its subcutaneous device.

rows.title: PAVE Space ravit le Trophée PERL 2026
rows.summary: Le palmarès des Prix Entreprendre Lausanne Région 2026 a été dévoilé mercredi soir à l’issue de la cérémonie de remise des prix organisée à Beaulieu, Lausanne. Le Trophée PERL, doté de CHF 50'000.-, a été attribué à PAVE Space. Trois Prix de l’innovation de CHF 10'000.- chacun ont récompensé WasteFlow, Rea Diagnostics et SurfAce Cleantech. Le Prix coup de cœur du jury et le Prix du public, dotés chacun de CHF 10'000.-, ont été remis à Birds&Co.

rows.title: DuraMon in Europa auf Wachstumskurs
rows.summary: DuraMon hat den Einsatz seiner Sensortechnologie zur Überwachung von Stahlbetoninfrastruktur im DACH-Markt sowie in weiteren europäischen Ländern in den vergangenen Monaten kontinuierlich ausgebaut. Besonders in Österreich konnte sich das Zürcher Startup zuletzt mehrere Projekte sichern, darunter die Installation von 160 Sensoren in einer Tiefgarage in Innsbruck. Weitere Projekte zur Stärkung der Präsenz in der Region sind bereits geplant.

rows.title: Neuer Accelerator setzt auf Marktzugang für KI-Startups
rows.summary: Mit AcceleratorX startet ein neues Programm für KI-Startups, das frühe Marktvalidierung über ein europäisches Netzwerk von Marketing- und Kommunikationsagenturen ermöglichen soll. Einer der Gründer ist der St. Galler Unternehmer Axel Thoma, der den Accelerator als Programmdirektor begleitet.

rows.title: New MiFID license opens European Market to Taurus
rows.summary: Taurus SA, a FINMA-regulated securities firm and a leader in digital asset infrastructure technology solutions, announced that its Cyprus-based subsidiary, Taurus (Europe) Ltd, has been granted an investment firm license under MiFID regulation by the Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission (CySEC).

rows.title: GenTwo crosses USD 7 billion in assets under service
rows.summary: GenTwo has crossed USD 7 billion in assets under service, reaching the milestone less than a year after passing USD 6 billion in July 2025. The Zurich-based B2B fintech lets asset managers, banks and financial intermediaries securitise assets off-balance sheet.

rows.title: Moonlight AI raises $3.3 million to transform hematology labs with AI-powered diagnostics
rows.summary: Moonlight AI AG, a Swiss startup building image analysis software for clinical-grade diagnostics, has closed a $3.3 million USD Seed round. By converting medical images into actionable insights, Moonlight AI empowers hematologists and pathologists to make faster, more accurate treatment decisions for cancer patients worldwide.

rows.title: NewcelX: fresh money and on track with its lead program
rows.summary: Biopharmaceutical company NewcelX, focusing on developing transformative stem-cell-derived therapies for Type 1 Diabetes, recently closed a financing of up to approximately 3.4 million dollars. After the merger last year, the company is advancing the development of its lead program and expects significantly accelerated development progress with the fresh financing.

rows.title: First Ventures backs private 5G, humanitarian design and medication cooling
rows.summary: Three student startups have secured a total of CHF 225,000 in non-dilutive funding from the Gebert Rüf Stiftung, including a private 5G network system, a modular privacy solution for asylum centers and a portable medication cooler. The capital will be used to advance prototyping, technical validation and go-to-market preparation.

rows.title: Swiss Biotech Report confirms the sector’s strong performance
rows.summary: In 2025 the Swiss biotech industry set two new records. Privately funded companies attracted CHF 1.15 million, thanks to start-ups led by convincing, experienced teams. Total revenues reached CHF 7.5 billion with more companies maturing to the commercial stage. Start-ups have an increasing chance of reaching commercialisation without an IPO.

rows.title: Windward Bio secures USD 165 million to advance clinical trials
rows.summary: Windward Bio, a private, clinical-stage biotechnology company focussing on immunological diseases, announced an upsized $165M crossover financing. Since launching in January 2025, Windward Bio has in-licensed 2 clinical-stage assets, raised $365M, and rapidly advanced both programs in the clinic.

rows.title: Strategic Investments to advance Biodelphis Therapeutics Development
rows.summary: On the occasion of the Swiss Biotech Day 2026 in Basel, HAS Healthcare Advanced Synthesis and EPFL spin-off Biodelphis Therapeutics announced the signing of a strategic agreement to support the development and GMP manufacturing of Antibody Protease Inhibitor Conjugates, an emerging class of targeted therapeutics designed to selectively inhibit disease‑driving proteases.

rows.title: Sovereign Swiss AI Clinical Documentation Platform goes live
rows.summary: The rising administrative burden is a leading cause of burnout for clinicians. To address this major healthcare issue, Swiss healthtech DOCumenter led by Dr. Ismaël Olivier Rophé and Dr. Francesco Tommasini, is launching its fully sovereign Swiss AI Clinical Documentation Platform, with unique privacy-by-design architecture after more than a year of field testing.

rows.title: Erste Hotels setzen auf Premium-Textilien von Skin Euphoria
rows.summary: Das Textil-Startup Skin Euphoria ist ambitioniert unterwegs und verzeichnet im zweiten Geschäftsjahr bereits ein starkes Wachstum. Mit dem Neuzugang in der Person von Soeder-Mitgründerin Hanna Åkerström, gewinnt Bert Goren zusätzliches Knowhow für die weitere Markenentwicklung und den Aufbau von Vertriebspartnerschaften.

rows.title: InnoBooster supports three early-stage startups with CHF 450'000
rows.summary: The latest InnoBooster cohort comprises three deep tech university spin-offs companies working on innovations in dynamic technology sectors. Immitra Bio is developing in-vivo gene-editing therapies for blood disorders, Qendra focuses on control hardware for neutral-atom and trapped-ion quantum computers, and SurgExplore develops AI software for cataract surgery workflows.

rows.title: USD 3.8 million to bring real-time spatial intelligence to every consumer device
rows.summary: Mosaic SoC is building next-generation perception chips that help devices see and understand their environment in real time at minimal power. In its first year, Mosaic SoC has already generated meaningful revenue through engineering contracts. The ultimate goal is to generate scalable product revenues tied to chip sales.

rows.title: Swiss startup days reveals Newcomers 2026 deep tech cohort
rows.summary: From AI cardiac screening tools to grid-edge software and waste-heat data centre cooling, 18 Swiss startups in the pre-seed and seed phase have been selected for Newcomers 2026, the pitching competition staged at Swiss startup days. This year, the nationwide business and networking platform for startups, investors, enablers and SMEs & corporates in Switzerland, will take place on 21 May in Bern.

rows.title: BioCopy raises CHF 9 million for bispecific antibody pipeline
rows.summary: Basel-based biotech BioCopy has raised CHF 9 million as part of its Series A round to advance a pipeline of TCR-mimetic bispecific antibodies for cancer immunotherapy. The financing will fund IND-enabling studies for the company's lead candidate, with a Phase 1 trial targeted for late 2027.

rows.title: PAZZI opens fully automated pizzeria in Madrid
rows.summary: Swiss foodtech PAZZI has opened a fully automated pizza restaurant in central Madrid, the brand's first location under new Swiss ownership following the 2022 liquidation of its French predecessor. The company plans to expand across Europe and the Middle East through a master-franchise model.

rows.title: SECA publishes Impact Investing Guide
rows.summary: The Swiss Private Equity & Corporate Finance Association (SECA) has released its SECA Impact Guide 2026, a new roadmap for institutional investors, family offices, and wealth managers navigating the rapidly shifting impact investing landscape.

rows.title: ALP Bio AG raises CHF 1.75 million pre-seed to de-risk antibody development
rows.summary: Schlieren-based ALP Bio AG closed its CHF 1.75 million (USD 2.2 million) pre-seed financing round. The funding will accelerate ALP Bio’s platform, which combines human immune organoid biology with generative AI to help antibody developers identify, understand, and reduce immunogenicity risk earlier in drug development.

rows.title: Mehrfachunternehmer lanciert zweites Klima-Startup
rows.summary: Resilens unterstützt Kommunen, Institutionen und Unternehmen dabei aus standortspezifischen Klimarisiken finanzierbare, priorisierte Anpassungspläne abzuleiten. Erste Projekte im Bereich Hitzeschutz werden bereits durchgeführt. Hinter Resilens steht Oliver Marchand, Gründer des 2019 von MSCI übernommenen Klima-Fintechs Carbon Delta. Mit Investor Karl Gutbrod ist ein zweiter langjähriger Startup CEO mit Exit-Erfahrung an Bord.

rows.title: Innovationsfonds: Neue Finanzierungen für Startups in der Frühphase
rows.summary: Der Innovationsfonds hat 2025 mehrere Startups aus den Bereichen CleanTech, Food und Health unterstützt, wie sich dem kürzlich publizierten Jahresbericht entnehmen lässt. Vier neue Unternehmen erhielten Darlehen, zwei weitere eine Aufstockung bestehender Finanzierungen, während zwei Startups mit Eigenkapital unterstützt wurden. Die Mittel stammen aus Zuwendungen der Alternative Bank Schweiz (ABS) sowie aus Erträgen und Rückflüssen bestehender Engagements.

rows.title: Three Swiss deep tech startups secure Eureka funding
rows.summary: Allegria Therapeutics, Mabylon and Alivion have secured non-dilutive funding through the Eureka network, supporting drug discovery for chronic urticaria, a new therapeutic candidate for inflammatory bowel disease and a market feasibility study for portable methanol detection in Brazil. The grants come through Eureka's Eurostars and Innowwide programs, totaling EUR 2.8 million.

rows.title: Ecorobotix Global Growth to gain momentum
rows.summary: In line with its global growth strategy and vision, Ecorobotix acquires Maya, a Belgian company specializing in AI-powered operational intelligence platforms for lawn and land management, to shape the future of digital agronomy. In addition, Ecorobotix is investing $50 million to expand its operations in the United States and make Swiss-developed precision spraying technology available to American farmers.

rows.title: Biotech FERROSA raises USD 3.5 Million
rows.summary: FERROSA, a Basel-based biotech founded by Forty51 Ventures, has raised USD 3.5 million in seed financing to advance a bispecific antibody designed to correct iron restriction and restore erythropoiesis in patients with anemia of inflammation.

rows.title: DPhi opens access to space beyond traditional players
rows.summary: DPhi Space recently launched and activated its satellite-based computing server. During an initial test, an AI model (LLM) described an image of Earth from orbit. Beyond this demo, the mission aims to make such infrastructure public: developers can deploy software directly on a satellite, like a cloud server, to analyze space data such as imagery. The system is developed, integrated, and operated from Lausanne, with early Swiss users like ClearSpace already on board.

rows.title: Bug Bounty Switzerland: 12 Millionen Franken für die internationale Skalierung
rows.summary: Das Luzerner Startup Bug Bounty Switzerland hat in einer Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde 12 Millionen Franken für die internationale Expansion seines KI-gestützten Cyber Resilience Shield eingesammelt. Die Runde angeführt hat Direttissima Growth Partners, mit gleichwertiger Beteiligung der Deutsche Beteiligungs AG.

rows.title: Milestone win to power Neology US Expansion
rows.summary: As part of a major step in its expansion into the United States, Neology has won the “Sustainable Cities Challenge” organized by the Toyota Mobility Foundation in Detroit. This award comes with a $500,000 grant to support the project's implementation. Neology will deploy a small-scale hydrogen refueling solution based on its ammonia cracking technology, which enables on-site hydrogen production for clean mobility applications. Meanwhile, the company continues to gain ground.

rows.title: Cleantech-Startup Solar Manager gewinnt EMERAM als Investor
rows.summary: Der Münchner Private Equity Fonds EMERAM beteiligt sich an Solar Manager. Das Aargauer Startup bietet Handwerksfachbetrieben und Energiedienstleistern ein herstellerunabhängige Home Energy Management System. Zusammen mit dem neuen Investor will Solar Manager seine Marktposition in der Schweiz und Deutschland weiter ausbauen und zusätzliche europäische Märkte erschliessen.

rows.title: Vier Startups für nachhaltige Innovationen ausgezeichnet
rows.summary: Von ultradünnen Festkörperbatterien über digitale Recyclingplattformen bis hin zu nachhaltigen LED-Lösungen und mikrobiellen Bodeninnovationen: Die Startups BTRY, klaro Solutions, Lumvin und ERDIG Living Soils wurden in den vergangenen Wochen bei Award-Verleihungen in verschiedenen Regionen der Schweiz und an der Hannover Messe ausgezeichnet.

rows.title: Qendra obtains CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The ETH spin-off Qendra has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to improve how advanced quantum computing experiments are coordinated and operated. The solution aims to make these systems more reliable and easier to scale, supporting the next generation of this emerging technology.

rows.title: Iron Energy: First customer for 3 GWh high-temperature iron-air battery
rows.summary: The ETH spin-off Iron Energy has developed a battery that can store electricity through a chemical rusting of iron using hydrogen and steam as electrolytes in a cost-efficient and environmentally friendly manner. The young company has now won its first customer in the form of the Swiss data centre operator NTS Colocation AG. The large 3 GWh battery is to be commissioned in Bern in 2028.

rows.title: Findmee erhält Unterstützung des Kantons Graubünden
rows.summary: Nach dem Start im vergangenen Jahr ist die Lösung des in Landquart ansässigen Startups Findmee bereits in mehreren Projekten im Einsatz. Im Rahmen der «Innovationsstrategie Graubünden 2028» erhält das Unternehmen nun Fördermittel des Kantons, um seine Dienstleistungen weiter auszubauen und die Produktion am Standort zu stärken.

rows.title: Medtech scale-up vVARDIS achieves unicorn status
rows.summary: vVARDIS Holding AG, a Zug-based dental medtech company pioneering non-invasive cavity treatment, attracted a strategic minority investment from Apollo-managed funds. The investment establishes vVARDIS as one of Europe’s few privately owned, billion-dollar-plus, healthcare companies. vVARDIS’ founders and co-CEOs, Drs. Haley and Goly Abivardi, will retain a substantial majority shareholding in the company.

rows.title: First Delivery of H55 Certifiable Battery Modules for SFX1 Aircraft
rows.summary: Smartflyer announces the successful delivery of the first batch of Adagio battery modules from H55, marking not only a key milestone in the development of the Smartflyer SFX1 aircraft, but also a significant step in the industrialization and commercial deployment of H55’s certified electric propulsion technologies.

rows.title: Three Swiss startups join accelerator programmes
rows.summary: Oncology spin-off Cancentus, proptech company WolkenVision and AI commerce startup SOORT have each been selected for accelerator programmes spanning Switzerland, Italy and the global venture network.

rows.title: noii: Schweizer Real-Life-Dating-App startet erfolgreich in Deutschland
rows.summary: Der erste noii-Event ausserhalb der Schweiz fand als Morning Coffee Party im Citizen Long in Stuttgart statt. Nun sollen monatlich mindestens drei weitere Events in der Stadt sowie die weitere Expansion nach München und Köln folgen. In der Schweiz finden in sechs verschiedenen Städten bis zu 15 Kennenlern-Events mit insgesamt bis zu 2'000 Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmern pro Monat statt.

rows.title: Bubble Robotics: $5M to build the ocean’s autonomous workforce
rows.summary: The Dubendorf-based startup Bubble Robotics has closed a $5 million pre-seed funding round, led by Episode 1 Ventures, Asterion Ventures, and Norrsken Evolve. This following the startup’s launch out of Entrepreneurs First. Bubble is developing a fleet of intelligent robotic systems that can operate continuously at sea for months, without the need for human intervention.

rows.title: US semiconductor company acquires Polariton
rows.summary: Marvell Technology, Inc, a leader in data infrastructure semiconductor solutions, has acquired Polariton Technologies, a developer of high-speed, low-power plasmonics-based silicon photonics devices. The acquisition takes place in the context of the rapid evolution of AI and cloud data center infrastructure.

rows.title: 9T Labs deep tech to power Biwi's future
rows.summary: Biwi, based in Switzerland’s Jura region, has completed the acquisition of all assets and patents from 9T Labs, a Zurich-based deeptech company specializing in continuous carbon fiber additive manufacturing. The transaction consolidates a highly advanced composite materials portfolio and accompanies the introduction of NEOCARB, a new class of high-performance materials unveiled at Watches and Wonders 2026.

rows.title: Four Swiss companies appoint new CEOs across tech and pharma
rows.summary: Wealth management platform Altoo, IT consulting firm Inacta and specialty pharmaceutical company Santhera have each named new chief executives. Meanwhile at edtech company evulpo, co-founder Jonas Fehlmann is stepping into the CEO role, succeeding fellow co-founder Christian Marty.

rows.title: Westhive sichert sich frisches Kapital für Expansion
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Unternehmen Westhive hat eine weitere Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen. Der profitable Anbieter flexibler Büroflächen, der bereits an acht Standorten in der Schweiz aktiv ist, wird sein Angebot mit den frischen Mitteln weiter ausbauen.

rows.title: Die Startup Nights bekommen einen neuen Direktor
rows.summary: Gabriel Riedo übernimmt per Anfang Mai 2026 die Rolle des Managing Directors des grössten Schweizer Startup-Events. Riedo folgt auf Alyssia Kugler, die den Anlass in den vergangenen Jahren massgeblich geprägt und weiterentwickelt hat.

rows.title: Giotto.ai and RUAG cooperate to distribute and deploy of state-of-the-art AI
rows.summary: Giotto.ai will provide RUAG, the technology partner to the Swiss Armed Forces, with its portable intelligence system for enterprise deployments. RUAG will integrate Giotto.ai’s technology in its AI platform LLARA to unlock new high-impact industrial applications. The partnership represents a crucial step for Giotto.ai towards industrial validation of its proprietary technology.

rows.title: Cleaning robot manufacturer KEMARO secures USD 5 million to fuel global expansion
rows.summary: Swiss robotics pioneer KEMARO has successfully secured $5 million in an initial pre-closing of its Series B financing round. The fresh capital is earmarked to accelerate the company’s international growth, with a primary focus on scaling operations in the United States and expanding its product portfolio of industrial AI-native cleaning robots.

rows.title: Eight startups advance in the Sword Startup Challenge 2026
rows.summary: From an initial group of 15 companies, eight AI, fintech and cybersecurity startups have been selected for the next stage of the Sword Startup Challenge. They will now receive tailored support to expand their network of customers and partners, expert insights and pitch training before pitching at the Final Jury Pitch Day in May.

rows.title: Nau Media wächst mit Unterstützung von Christoph Blocher
rows.summary: Neuer Name, neuer Mitbesitzer und starker Ausbau: Die Interact Media Group AG, früher Nau Media AG, übernimmt die Zeitungshaus AG und damit Gratiszeitungen in der ganzen Deutschschweiz. Christoph Blochers ROBINVEST AG, die vormalige Eigentümerin der Zeitungshaus AG, beteiligt sich im Gegenzug mit 15 Prozent an der IMG.

rows.title: Steady adoption drives Lawcodex launch
rows.summary: Lawcodex, a Lausanne LegalTech startup, is continuing to expand its Swiss AI-assisted legal intelligence platform, launched in March 2026. Developed for individuals, SMEs, and legal professionals, the solution designed to simplify access to legal information, accelerate research, and structure case analysis has seen steady adoption and is now used by several hundred users, including organizations from Geneva, Valais and Vaud.

rows.title: Three Geneva Startups awarded FIF Seed Funding
rows.summary: UNBOOUND Medical Technology SA has been awarded CHF 100,000 in FIF Seed Tech funding for its standardised olfactory assessment platform. Two further Geneva-based digital startups have each received CHF 50,000 in FIF Seed Digital funding: Precise Intelligence, an AI platform automating workflows in the maritime chartering market, and Ystorian, a cybersecurity solution providing continuous security assurance for SMEs.

rows.title: DARE Campus opens deep tech hub in Schlieren
rows.summary: A handful of Swiss deep tech startups, including robotics venture FORGIS and regenerative medicine company ClexBio, have become the first tenants of DARE Campus, a new 3,000 m² hub for deep tech companies at The JED in Zurich-Schlieren.

rows.title: AI scale-up BLP Digital secures USD 50 million from Goldman Sachs
rows.summary: Zurich-based BLP Digital, which automates enterprise resource planning processes with AI agents, already counts more than 450 corporate customers in over 40 countries. The main reasons for the investment were BLP’s profitable growth, strong customer traction, and leadership in AI-driven enterprise process automation.

rows.title: rayne verzeichnet starkes Wachstum
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup rayne ist im zweiten Halbjahr 2025 deutlich gewachsen. Das Unternehmen entwickelt eine Menstruationsdisc mit patentiertem Design, das auf Nachhaltigkeit und Kosteneffizienz ausgerichtet ist. Das Produkt ist über mehrere Vertriebspartner im DACH-Raum sowie in Frankreich erhältlich.

rows.title: Parkn’Sleep sichert sich 600'000 Franken für den nächsten Ausbauschritt
rows.summary: Nach dem Aufbau eines Netzwerks von mehr als 10’000 Stellplätzen in zwei Dutzend Ländern und dem Erreichen des operativen Break-even nimmt das Camping-Startup Parkn’Sleep den nächsten Wachstumsschritt in Angriff. Geplant sind zusätzliche Standorte, automatisierte Stellplätze sowie die geographische Expansion. Das erfolgreiche Fundraising wird per Crowdfunding fortgeführt.

rows.title: Three Swiss biotechs secure regulatory and clinical milestones
rows.summary: Oculis, Babylat and Novigenix AI have all reported progress on the regulatory and clinical fronts, spanning a PRIME designation from the European Medicines Agency for an optic neuritis therapy, an FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for a preterm infant feeding device, and the first clinical evidence linking radioligand cancer therapy to immune activation.

rows.title: Swiss Fintech Awards reveals the Top 10 finalists
rows.summary: The 11th edition of the Swiss Fintech Awards has advanced to the next level with ten promising startups selected to compete in the categories, “Early-Stage Start-up of the Year” and “Growth Stage Start-up of the Year”. The winners will be announced during the award ceremony on June 23rd.

rows.title: Cosaic secures $6 million as industry leaders back next-generation food ingredients
rows.summary: Cosaic, the Swiss food biotech startup developing yeast-derived multifunctional ingredients, today announced a $6 million seed extension round. The round will support three priorities over the coming phase of growth to become market ready: regulatory work, production scale-up, and industrial trials with large clients.

rows.title: CHF 15M to Accelerate Daphne Technology Methane Abatement System Sales
rows.summary: Daphne Technology, an industrial decarbonization company solving the methane slip problem in natural gas engine exhaust, just announced the first close of its current round, led by Taranis, a London-based sustainability investor. Taranis will join Shell Ventures and Trafigura as key investors supporting Daphne.

rows.title: Gates-backed ProteQ Health brings automated mosquito net production to Nigeria
rows.summary: As World Malaria Day approaches, a Lausanne-based company is preparing to deploy its first automated production line for insecticide-treated mosquito nets in Nigeria. Developed by ProteQ Health with support from the Gates Foundation, this technology aims to bring manufacturing closer to areas of use, in a context where logistics still account for a significant portion of costs.

rows.title: Startups gewinnen Awards im In- und Ausland
rows.summary: Vier Startups wurden in den vergangenen Tagen für ihre Innovationen ausgezeichnet. Das Robotik-Startup Forgis wurde im Rahmen der ABB Startup Challenge ausgewählt, Winduction sicherte sich einen Branchenaward. Ein Startup holte Gold bei Best of Swiss Web. Und die Biotech-Unternehmerin Stefanie Flückiger-Mangual wurde mit einem POWHER Award ausgezeichnet.

rows.title: CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to automate 3D design for engineers
rows.summary: The ICT startup nureo has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop intelligent 3D design tools that reduce manual work and speed up product development. The solution aims to help engineering teams move faster from concept to production-ready designs.

rows.title: Planetary raises CHF 22 million to scale global fermentation infrastructure and licensing platform
rows.summary: Planetary SA, the Swiss-based full-stack fermentation company, closed a CHF 16 million Series A equity financing round, supplemented by CHF 6 million in credit, bringing total funding to approximately CHF 32 million. The diverse investment syndicate, brings together carbohydrates producers, food corporates, venture capital funds, and family offices.

rows.title: Successful first trading day for Centiel
rows.summary: Today, Centiel, a Swiss-based technology group that designs, manufactures and supplies advanced uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems for mission-critical applications, started trading on SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol CNTL. The share price rose considerably on the first day of trading.

rows.title: Norwegischer Energietech-Konzern übernimmt Gashandel-Software-Startup dispoEnergy
rows.summary: Das im Bereich Elektrifizierung und Energietechnologie global führende Unternehmen Volue übernimmt das Solothurner Startup dispoEnergy (vormals dispoGas). Mit der Akquisition von dispoEnergy verfügt Volue nun über eine moderne, cloudbasierte Lösung, die auf kleinere Energieversorger, Händler und Anlagenbetreiber zugeschnitten ist.

rows.title: Stanford AI Index 2026: Switzerland ranks first in AI talent
rows.summary: Switzerland leads the world in AI researchers and developers per capita, according to the 2026 AI Index Report published by Stanford University's Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence. Talent alone tells only part of the story: the report finds Swiss startup investment lagging behind global and European leaders, even as AI adoption among Swiss businesses and workers continues to climb.

rows.title: StreamUp selects nine food-tech companies for second accelerator cohort
rows.summary: United Against Waste has selected nine participants, eight startups and one established company, for the second cohort of its StreamUp accelerator, which supports solutions to reduce food losses across the Swiss supply chain. The solutions span pasta made from old bread, plant-protein producers looking to valorize side streams, and transformation of unsold fruit and vegetables into valuable products such as snacks and broth.

rows.title: Von Nahrungsergänzung bis Blockchain: Mehrere Millionen Franken aus der Crowd
rows.summary: Vier Startups können sich über frisches Kapital freuen: Besonders KA-EX sticht mit einer deutlich überzeichneten Crowdinvesting-Runde von mehr als 4 Millionen Franken hervor. Auch MPower Ventures konnte sich im Rahmen einer Kapitalerweiterung zusätzliche Mittel sichern. Bei den laufenden Kampagnen steht Baabuk kurz vor dem Finanzierungsziel, während Minima dieses bereits übertroffen hat.

rows.title: Le Prix PERL 2026 annonce ses 5 finalistes!
rows.summary: Les PERL 2026 ont suscité un vif intérêt, avec près de 60 entreprises candidates issues des 27 communes membres de Lausanne Région. Au terme du processus de sélection, cinq projets ont été retenus pour la finale. Ils sont en lice pour un montant total de CHF 100'000.–, qui sera distribué lors de la cérémonie de remise des prix le mercredi 6 mai 2026 à Beaulieu.

rows.title: ONWARD Medical raises over EUR 40 Million in capital increase
rows.summary: ONWARD Medical successfully raised an amount of EUR 40.6M in gross proceeds by way of an accelerated bookbuild offering through a private placement with institutional investors. The successful transaction includes an EUR 25.0M investment by EQT Life Sciences. ONWARD’s cash runway now extends into Q1 2028.

rows.title: VidaSense advances wearable prenatal monitoring into clinical studies
rows.summary: A wearable fetal-maternal monitoring technology developed from years of CSEM applied research is now being tested during labor, marking a major milestone for spin-off VidaSense. Conducted with the Women's Hospital, Inselspital, Bern University Hospital, as a clinical partner, the study brings Swiss engineering and obstetrics expertise together in a real care setting.

rows.title: Innosuisse awards certificates to Hystrix Medical, Eleven Dynamics, Soobr and IRAYE
rows.summary: Five tech startups obtained the Innosuisse Certificate, a readiness label for startups positioned for sustainable growth, in the first quarter of 2026. The awarded solutions range from medical product procurement platform, quality control, schedule management to lymphatic skincare.

rows.title: Centiel secures CHF 30 million prior to IPO
rows.summary: Centiel SA, a global technology leader in three-phase uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems will go public this week via a reverse merger with HT5. At the Annual General Meetings last Monday, the shareholders of HT5 AG and Centiel SA approved the merger of the two companies. Today HT5 published the results of a successful ordinary cash capital increase.

rows.title: Swiss founders featured in Forbes European 30Under30 List
rows.summary: Twelve personalities in the startup ecosystem made it to this year’s European Forbes 30under30—the highly regarded annual list spotlighting the region's young innovators, entrepreneurs and changemakers shaping the future of Europe and beyond. The Swiss listed founders are working on solutions across AI, digital health, robotics and manufacturing.

rows.title: CONDA.ch setzt auf eigene Crowd und sammelt 586’000 Franken ein
rows.summary: Die Finanzierungsplattform CONDA.ch hat ihre zweite Crowdinvesting-Runde abgeschlossen. Die Mittel sollen insbesondere in den Ausbau der Plattform sowie in den verstärkten Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz fliessen. Mehr als 300 Investorinnen und Investoren aus der eigenen Community beteiligten sich und übertrafen das ursprüngliche Finanzierungsziel deutlich.

rows.title: Acutronic raises $25 million to expand defense technology operations
rows.summary: Following a fourth consecutive year of record revenue, bookings, and profitability in 2025, Acutronic closed a first institutional private equity investment. The Zurich-based company has raised $25 million from U.S. private equity firms InterAlpen Partners and Hale Capital Partners to expand production capacity, develop new products, and pursue acquisitions in the defense technology sector.

rows.title: AlpineAI raises double-digit million seed round for sovereign AI
