rows.summary: Davos-based AlpineAI has raised a double-digit million seed round led by Swiss KMU Partners to scale its sovereign AI platform for regulated industries. AlpineAI plans to use the funds to expand its product, scale in Switzerland and expand into the European market.

rows.title: Awards für regionale und KI- Innovationen
rows.summary: Von der lokalen klimaneutralen Fischzucht über branchenspezifische Innovationen wie einer 3D-Kopplung bis hin zu GenAI-Lösungen für die Forschung: Die vier Startups 3D Nexum, Localfish, Studyond und Virtuosis AI stehen bei drei Award-Verleihungen zuoberst auf dem Treppchen.

rows.title: Prix Strategis 2026 Five Finalists unveiled
rows.summary: On Monday, March 9, the jury of the Prix Strategis met to select the five finalist start-ups of this year’s edition. The decision was particularly challenging given the high quality and diversity of the projects that reached the semi-final stage. The winner will be announced on April 30th at the Centre Patronal in Paudex.

rows.title: Laine Neural Network launches hybrid legal platform
rows.summary: Laine Neural Network is launching a hybrid legal platform in Switzerland. Designed as the infrastructure layer for modern legal work, Laine solves an impossible equation: making high-quality legal services affordable for businesses while giving independent lawyers a ready-to-use workspace that connects them with paying clients, with no upfront costs. The company aims to handle 50,000 contracts this year.

rows.title: Berner Startup lanciert AudioShorts-Plattform und holt erste Partner an Bord
rows.summary: Yuvoi hat eine Plattform für kurze Audioformate lanciert und startet mit Fokus auf Fussball-Content, wobei erste Partnerschaften bereits abgeschlossen sind. Hinter dem Projekt steht unter anderem Simon Klopfenstein, Mitgründer von Nau.ch.  Ebenfalls an Bord ist Hockey-Star Roman Josi als Investor.

rows.title: LightSeeds awarded CHF 150,000 to turn walls into watts
rows.summary: Swiss cleantech startup LightSeeds has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to accelerate the commercialization of its dedicated vertical solar system. Operating in the fast-growing global solar market, the company focuses on unlocking the potential of vertical infrastructure by turning unused surfaces along roads, railways, and commercial and industrial buildings into scalable energy assets at competitive cost.

rows.title: Eighteen foodtech startups selected for investor showcase
rows.summary: Eighteen Swiss startups spanning cultivated meat, seaweed packaging and AI microbiome optimization tools, among others, have been selected to present to international investors at the Swiss Food & Nutrition Valley's Investing in the Valley event on April 22.

rows.title: Clinical study proves integrated insulin delivery and glucose monitoring feasible
rows.summary: PharmaSens AG, a Swiss developer of next-generation insulin patch pump systems, announced that the Journal of Diabetes Science and Technology (JDST) has published data from a first clinical study. Findings from the clinical feasibility trial of the wearable PharmaSens niia device demonstrate for the first time ever that development of an insulin patch pump that combines glucose sensing at the site of insulin delivery is feasible.

rows.title: USD 1.3 million to speed Insurteam European Deployment
rows.summary: Insurteam has just closed its second funding round. This milestone marks an important step in Insurteam’s development as it accelerates the deployment of its technology and insurance capabilities across Europe. Since launch, more than 100,000 customers have used insurance policies powered by Insurteam’s technology. The company operates already across Italy, the Netherlands, and the DACH region.

rows.title: Large grants back four Swiss deep tech startups
rows.summary: Four Swiss startups have secured grant funding across cleantech, medtech and autonomous logistics, including support for a first commercial synthetic aviation fuel plant in Rotterdam, a European proton therapy consortium, an autonomous drone delivery system and a carbon-capture venture. The total project and grant volume amounts to around CHF five million.

rows.title: Bewy receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The proptech startup Bewy has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop an AI-first property management service that increases transparency and reduces costs. The company addresses widespread dissatisfaction among landlords while improving service quality for tenants.

rows.title: Nine Swiss startups recognized globally
rows.summary: Swiss startups have earned recognition across three international rankings awarding the most innovative and fast-growing companies. Lemna Bio was selected to join the long-term support program DayOne NEXT, while Beech Biotech wins the Mission BioCapital Platinum Program.

rows.title: Terra Quantum AG to go public at Nasdaq in $3.25 billion SPAC deal
rows.summary: Terra Quantum AG, a leading quantum technology company, and Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. II, a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), today announced that they have signed a non-binding letter of intent to enter into a business combination that values Terra Quantum at $3.25 billion.

rows.title: Timestamp acquires Digital SupplAI to expand market footprint
rows.summary: Lausanne-based DigitalSupplAI, alongside Spanish company iMep.net, is in the process of being integrated into the Portuguese group Timestamp to strengthen its international presence and expand into the Swiss and French markets.

rows.title: Staynex Group acquires Travel-Tech platform Sleap.io
rows.summary: Singapore-based Staynex Group today announced the full acquisition of Sleap.io, the award-winning European hotel booking technology company, headquartered in Zug. The acquisition creates a unified global platform that brings together Sleap’s European technology and market position with Staynex’s Asian distribution, community, and token ecosystem, strengthening both product infrastructure and market reach.

rows.title: Herbert Ventures launches CHF 30 million seed fund
rows.summary: Zurich-based Herbert today announced the official public launch of Herbert Ventures Fund I, a CHF 30 million industry agnostic venture capital fund focused on pre-seed and seed investments across Europe. The fund has completed its first close in Q1 and made its first investment.

rows.title: Amundi invests in Youdera to scale distributed energy infrastructure
rows.summary: Youdera Group SA has announced the closing of a strategic investment by Amundi Energy Transition. The investment will support Youdera’s next phase of growth and a €150 million deployment plan in distributed energy infrastructure for commercial and industrial customers across Europe.

rows.title: Swiss startups appoint new CEOs and senior hires across biotech, AI and proptech
rows.summary: Biotech company Anaveon and AI-powered cognitive diagnostics startup NeurodАIgnostics have each named new CEOs, while equity management platform Ledgy has consolidated its co-CEO structure under a sole chief executive. Robotics company ANYbotics has hired a Chief Revenue Officer, and at proptech company Allthings the founder returns as Chief of Growth.

rows.title: €600,000 to power Mountly launch in the French Alps
rows.summary: Food delivery platform Mountly has just secured a €600,000 investment from Amitours, an Alpine travel ecosystem serving around 250,000 customers annually and generating €19.5 million in revenue. The startup led by Katia Sogreeva-Peyron, aims to to solve the French Alps food-delivery gap.

rows.title: ZEISS Vision Care acquires Vivior assets
rows.summary: ZEISS Vision Care acquired key assets of Vivior AG, a Swiss-based innovator in digital health technologies for eye care, thereby strengthening its research capabilities and innovation potential in this rapidly evolving field. The technology enables the development of hyper-personalized lens solutions.

rows.title: Connectome raises $2m to track brain changes sooner
rows.summary: By focusing on longitudinal measurement rather than isolated snapshots, Connectome aims to provide more reliable insight into how brain activity varies within individuals and how it may shift in relation to lifestyle, environment, and health. This could support earlier identification of change and more informed intervention strategies.

rows.title: CycloWatt receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The electronics startup CycloWatt has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop a low-cost power meter that makes precise performance tracking accessible to a broader range of cyclists.

rows.title: Fast Casual Sushi: Tiny Fish wächst weiter
rows.summary: Aufbauend auf einer zentralen Produktion und der Verarbeitung von nachhaltigen Zutaten hat Tiny Fish mit seinen Sushi-Take-Aways in Zürich, Bern und Zug den Durchbruch geschafft. Das Startup beschäftigt rund 140 Mitarbeitende und betreibt 11 Standorte, weitere Eröffnungen sind noch in diesem Jahr geplant.

rows.title: Ark Labs raises $5.2M backed by Tether to build programmable finance on Bitcoin
rows.summary: Lugano-based Ark Labs, the leader in open, programmable finance, raised $5.2M in a seed round to unlock Bitcoin capital using its flagship technology, Arkade. The funding coincides with the launch of stablecoin and digital asset support on the platform.

rows.title: Delta Labs raises EUR 4.4 million for AI customer simulation platform
rows.summary: Delta Labs has raised EUR 4.4 million in a seed round led by Cusp Capital and Auxxo Female Catalyst Fund. The company develops AI-powered customer simulation tools that help businesses anticipate how customers will respond to decisions before they are made.

rows.title: UBS makes a strategic investment in Artificialy
rows.summary: Lugano-based Artificialy announced an a strategic investment from UBS, strengthening the partnership between Artificialy and the global banking group. Alongside the investment, UBS plans to significantly expand its collaboration with Artificialy through an enhanced commercial relationship, working to further scale and embed AI solutions across the firm.

rows.title: BIND 2026 Crowns Four Swiss Health Gems
rows.summary: Four Swiss life sciences startups were honored at BIND - BioInnovation Day 2026, an event brimming with discoveries and insights. Dexterous Endoscope won the award for Best Startup, while PreciMune received the award for Best University Project. Impli AG and MoleSense secured support from H4 and CSEM.

rows.title: Cohaga sammelt Millionenbetrag und lanciert Tool für Präsenz in KI-Antworten
rows.summary: Die St. Galler cohaga AG betreibt die führende Schweizer Direktmarketing Plattform LeadHub. Das 2020 gestartete Unternehmen ist bootstrapped auf 30 Personen gewachsen. Nun wurde erstmal eine Finanzierungsrunde durchgeführt. Gleichzeitig wurde ein neues Tool lanciert, das Unternehmen so positioniert, dass sie von KI nicht nur erkannt, sondern aktiv empfohlen und zitiert werden.

rows.title: Covalo sichert sich Finanzierung in Millionenhöhe für nächste Wachstumsphase
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup Covalo hat in einer Seed-Erweiterungsrunde 3,5 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, angeführt von Hi inov und mit Beteiligung bestehender Investoren. Mit dem frischen Kapital will das Unternehmen seine Plattform für Inhaltsstoff- und Produktdaten ausbauen und KI-gestützte Innovationen weltweit vorantreiben.

rows.title: Milestones and Enhanced Governance drive dEEGtal forward
rows.summary: Geneva-based dEEGtal, a company specializing in health technology that develops artificial intelligence solutions aimed at improving care in neurology and psychiatry, has reached significant milestones in its development and announced the appointment of entrepreneur in the medical device sector and venture investor Ann Bunnenberg to its board of directors as an independent member.

rows.title: Younger investment firms turn to diversity
rows.summary: Only 7% of venture funding goes to women-led startups—a gap the FE+MALE Think Tank aimed to address through its first Biennal & Award event, which brought together over 100 interested stakeholders. Investors and support organisations highlighted the stronger performance of diverse teams at the event. The young impact investment firm iGravity was among three organizations recognized at the award ceremony for its efforts to direct capital toward women-led businesses.

rows.title: Lobby raises USD 2.2 million to automate group bookings across the travel industry
rows.summary: Lobby’s AI-driven platform automates the entire process of group bookings to ensure faster response times, more accurate quotes, among others. The proceeds from the funding round will be used to expand beyond the hospitality sector with the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions (MICE) vertical, experiences and attractions business, cruises and airlines.

rows.title: GENILEM accélère quatre jeunes pousses romandes prometteuses
rows.summary: DentalReport, H2REMA, Même Pas Peur! et The Undiet Plan bénéficieront d’un accompagnement global et personnalisé pour une durée allant jusqu’à 3 ans, combinant coaching stratégique, mises en relation ciblées et soutien opérationnel, pour structurer et accélérer leur développement.

rows.title: OOMNIUM sichert sich 870'000 Franken über eigene Plattform
rows.summary: Die Finanzierungsplattform OOMNIUM will verstärkt die Möglichkeiten von KI nutzen und plant zudem, einen digitalen Business-Angel-Club aufzubauen. Um sich die dafür notwendigen frischen Mittel zu sichern, setzte OOMNIUM auf die eigene Plattform. Mit Erfolg: das ursprüngliche Ziel von 600000 Franken wurde deutlich übertroffen.

rows.title: KI-Tool erleichtert Ausdauersport-Coaches weltweit die Arbeit
rows.summary: Letzte Woche lancierte das Zürcher Startup augo seinem KI-Assistenten für Triathlon-, Lauf- und Rad-Coaches. Schon jetzt wird das Tool für das Training in Ausdauer-Sportarten international genutzt: Rund 150 Nutzerinnen und Nutzer aus verschiedenen Teilen der Welt haben die Plattform in der Beta-Phase getestet.

rows.title: DeltaSpark receives CHF 150'000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The EPFL spin-off DeltaSpark has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance a technology that converts CO₂ into stable minerals while producing cheap and clean hydrogen on-site. The cleantech startup aims to help industries reduce emissions while generating valuable byproducts.

rows.title: Five deep-tech pioneers shortlisted for the ZKB Pionierpreis Technopark 2026
rows.summary: Five Swiss startups working in photonics, robotics, pharmaceutical technology and renewable energy storage have been named finalists for the ZKB Pionierpreis Technopark 2026. The finalists are competing for a CHF 100,000 top prize at one of Switzerland’s leading deep-tech awards and will present their technologies live on May 12 at Technopark Zurich.

rows.title: Zürich-based Starmind acquired by US AI platform company Capacity
rows.summary: Swiss AI pioneer Starmind has been acquired by US-based support automation platform Capacity. Starmind's technology, which identifies which employees hold undocumented organizational knowledge, will be integrated into Capacity's platform.

rows.title: 10 scale-ups selected for the first Project Switzerland batch
rows.summary: Project Switzerland pairs promising founders who already have a strong track record with a group of more than 20 of Switzerland’s most successful entrepreneurs. The 10 selected companies were narrowed down from 160 nominations and 60 applications through a rigorous, multi-stage process involving deep-dive interviews with veteran entrepreneurs and ecosystem experts.

rows.title: Lancôme and Timeline spark new skincare era
rows.summary: Together with Swiss longevity biotech Timeline, Lancôme is driving a revolution in skin longevity. At the heart of this collaboration is Mitopure, a breakthrough molecule developed by Timeline. Backed by 15 years of research, it is clinically proven to re-energize mitochondria through cellular renewal. This partnership marks a shift from a reactive approach to aging toward a proactive vision of beauty. The goal is no longer just to correct signs of time, but to restore the skin’s biological vitality from within.

rows.title: Migros-Testlauf für YourStarter
rows.summary: YourStarter hat seine Frühstücksdrinks bereits bei über 50'000 Privatkundinnen und -kunden sowie mehreren hundert Unternehmen etabliert. Jetzt setzen die St. Galler ihren Fokus auf den Detailhandel: Nach der Aufnahme ins Sortiment in mehreren Coop-Filialen in der Ostschweiz startet das nächste grosse Detailhandelsunternehmen eine Testphase. Die Produkte sind nun in 50 Migros-Filialen erhältlich.

rows.title: Marco Odermatt investiert in Obwaldner Startup
rows.summary: Wie der Tages-Anzeiger berichtet, steigt Skistar Marco Odermatt neu als Investor bei Gaisbock ein. Damit folgt er dem Beispiel anderer prominenter Spitzensportler wie Dario Cologna, Lara Gut-Behrami oder Wendy Holdener, die sich ebenfalls unternehmerisch engagieren.

rows.title: CHF 1 million to Scale Miros Swiss Network of Connected Workpods
rows.summary: miros, a Lausanne-based startup founded in 2023 out of the EPFL ecosystem, announced the closing of a CHF 1 million Pre-Seed funding round from various business angels supporting the vision. The company will use the funds to deploy a network of connected and bookable workpods across Switzerland, with a target of more than 100 units by the end of 2026.

rows.title: EyeFitU to be acquired by MySize subsidiary Naiz Fit
rows.summary: Fashion-tech company MySize plans to acquire several assets from Zurich-based sizing technology startup EyeFitU through its subsidiary Naiz Fit. The deal would transfer EyeFitU's proprietary sizing algorithms, brand partnerships and platform technology into the Naiz Fit platform.

rows.title: Plair attracts investment from bioMérieux
rows.summary: bioMérieux, a global leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, has invested more than CHF 1 million in Plair, a scale-up company offering a breakthrough solution for real-time microbial detection and air sampling. PLAIR sees this partnership as a major endorsement of its flagship innovation, RAPID-C+, and a decisive step toward setting a new global standard for cleanroom monitoring.

rows.title: Solar Monkey and Eturnity merge and attract fresh capital
rows.summary: Eturnity and Solar Monkey merge to form the European leader in installer software. The new company is backed with fresh capital by a group of European investors.

rows.title: Tech4Regen 2026 unveils new 15 deeptech cohort
rows.summary: The EPFL Innovation Park led program kicked off with a launch event on March 24, which brought together founders, coaches, mentors, and strategic partners. This session marked the start of a collaborative journey aimed at defining clear, measurable goals and accelerating the development of effective solutions in the coming months.

rows.title: UK patient data platform Sanius Health acquires Kielo Research
rows.summary: Sanius Health, a leading real-world evidence and patient-generated data company focused on rare and underserved conditions, has acquired Zug-based Kielo Research. Founded in 2022, the company focusses on integrating the patient perspective into the development and evaluation of medicines, medical technologies and healthcare services.

rows.title: HSG START Accelerator launches second batch
rows.summary: The HSG START Accelerator officially introduced its second batch during START Summit 2026. This time, eight startups from the fields of robotics, health tech, climate tech, AI, and hardware are joining the program.

rows.title: 1,000 deeptech companies launched with Venture Kick
rows.summary: With the founding of Stellar Alpina (in-space transportation), Venture Kick reaches a major milestone: its 1,000th startup has emerged from the program. In total, the supported companies created over 16,000 jobs and attracted more than CHF 10 billion in follow-on financing.

rows.title: Switzerland could be more innovation-friendly
rows.summary: A new study by the State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI) shows how long-standing structures are hampering the rise of start-ups. These include regulation, as well as funding opportunities and established companies that prefer to collaborate with other established firms rather than with start-ups. Similar factors also hold SMEs back. A more innovation-friendly environment would help both.

rows.title: 1.8M Seed Round to fuel SolidWatts Industrial Process Heating Vision
rows.summary: SolidWatts announces the closure of CHF 1.8 million Seed funding to accelerate the development and market entry of its innovative industrial process heating technology. This seed funding will be used to scale SolidWatts’ platform to higher power levels and to conduct pilots with industrial partners and clients actively seeking to reduce their energy consumption and expenditure by electrifying heating processes.

rows.title: Coteries s'unit à Idéative
rows.summary: Idéative annonce l’intégration de l’agence Coteries SA, renforçant ainsi son pôle de compétences digitales. Cette étape importante du développement de l’entreprise s’accompagne de l’ouverture d’une succursale à Bienne. Par cette expansion géographique, Idéative consolide son ancrage dans le Mittelland.

rows.title: MESH secures US$3.8 million seed round to automate rebar construction globally
rows.summary: MESH, an ETH Zurich spin-off, closed an oversubscribed US$3.8 million seed funding round backed by industry leaders and experienced investors including ABB Robotics Ventures and Sika. This investment round marks a pivotal milestone for MESH as it transitions from a regional innovator to a global technology provider.

rows.title: Pivotal WECHEER AI to power new business perspectives
rows.summary: In a milestone move, WECHEER is providing brand managers worldwide with 20 million real-world data points. The data reveals exactly which message, promotion or reward prompted a person to visit a physical shop and purchase a product. In the physical world, where 85% of FMCG sales still take place, WECHEER AI unique insights are set to open new business perspectives.

rows.title: Swiss Startup Association names new CEO
rows.summary: Michael Stucky, a co-founder of two ETH spin-offs and a decade-long figure in Swiss venture capital and innovation, has been named CEO of the Swiss Startup Association, effective April 7.

rows.title: SEALSQ to acquire Miraex
rows.summary: SEALSQ Corp, a subsidiary of WISeKey International has signed a Letter of Intent (“LOI”) to acquire 100% of the equity interest of Miraex SA, a developer of photonics-based quantum interconnect solutions that bridge quantum processors and quantum networks. The LOI provides for a 60-day exclusivity period during which the parties will conduct confirmatory due diligence and negotiate definitive transaction documents and is binding on the part of Miraex.

rows.title: PAVE Space raises $40M to disrupt satellite deployment
rows.summary: PAVE Space, a Swiss space infrastructure company, today announced it has raised USD 40 million in seed funding to develop a new generation of spacecraft designed to move satellites rapidly between orbits. The new funding will help PAVE Space move from development into real-world testing and early commercial operations. The investment ranks among the largest seed financings in the global space sector in recent years.

rows.title: «Digital Shapers 2026» puts 100 digital visionaries in the spotlight
rows.summary: After a two-year hiatus, BILANZ, Handelszeitung, PME and digitalswitzerland have once again published a list of one hundred individuals who are significantly shaping digital Switzerland. The eighth edition once again features numerous start-up founders.

rows.title: NanoZymeX receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The biotech startup NanoZymeX has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance a new platform for enzyme replacement therapy using lipid nanoparticles. The technology aims to improve treatment options for rare genetic conditions by increasing therapeutic activity in affected tissues.

rows.title: Riverkin, Orthosens and Tinamu win pitching competitions at START Summit 2026
rows.summary: Three Swiss startups won pitching competitions at the 2026 START Summit in St. Gallen. Riverkin took home a combined prize of CHF 50,000 in cash and legal credits for its water monitoring platform, while healthtech Orthosens and drone automation company Tinamu each won their respective competitions without cash prizes. In parallel, Tobias Reichmuth was awarded founder of the year by St. Gallen University.

rows.title: New Climate VC VitaminC Raises $20 million
rows.summary: VitaminºC, a new venture capital firm, today announced the first close of its €18M ($20M) debut early-stage climate fund. Operating from Zurich and San Francisco, the firm invests in pre-seed and seed climate technology companies across Europe and America.

rows.title: Continuing trend towards deep tech
rows.summary: Lakestar, Walden Catalyst, and Dealroom have published ‘The 2026 European Deeptech Report’ underscoring a record surge for Europe’s deep tech ecosystem. VC funding for Deep Tech rose to $20.3bn and made up an all time high of 32% of all VC investment. The report which excludes traditional life sciences provides detailed insights into various sectors, country performance and comparisons with the US and other topics.

rows.title: Soeder baut aus und um
rows.summary: Der Zürcher Naturpflegehersteller Soeder steigerte den Umsatz vergangenes Jahr um 25 Prozent und schloss im September eine Finanzierungsrunde ab. Gleichzeitig wurde die Führung neu geordnet. Mit Karoline Huber hat eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit in der internationalen Luxusgüterbranche die Unternehmensleitung übernommen.

rows.title: Proptech nestermind erfolgreich mit KI-Software
rows.summary: Vor einem Jahr gestartet, hat nestermind bereits einen Umsatz im mittleren sechsstelligen Bereich erreicht. Die modulare Lösung des Startups automatisiert zentrale Prozesse im Immobilienverkauf auch mit Hilfe von KI-Agenten.

rows.title: Kandou AI closes $225m Series A round to break memory bottlenecks in AI
rows.summary: Kandou AI, a leader in high-speed, energy-efficient connectivity and system solutions for the AI era, closed its $225mm strategic funding round led by Maverick Silicon with strategic participation from SoftBank Group Corp., Synopsys, Inc., Cadence Design Systems, Inc. and Alchip Technologies Limited. The group of strategic investors shows the strong market conviction in Kandou AI’s mission to solve the critical data movement challenges in AI infrastructure.

rows.title: Umlaut.bio extends pre-seed round to EUR 3 million
rows.summary: Umlaut.bio, a German-Swiss biotech company developing first-in-biology tRNA-modifying small molecules, has extended its pre-seed financing to around EUR 3 million through the support of BaseLaunch. In addition, the start-up has strengthened its Advisory Board.

rows.title: Milestone Hafnova Family app launches
rows.summary: In response to the sharp rise in cyber scams, Swiss cybersecurity start-up Hafnova is launching a mobile app designed to protect families from online threats. This initiative is a natural extension of Hafnova’s business, which is now shifting towards a B2B2C model thanks to the expertise gained from working with critical infrastructure operators.

rows.title: EVis Bioscience successfully closes €740K pre-seed round on Capital Cell
rows.summary: Zurich-based EVis Bioscience AG, an ETH Zurich spin-off developing next-generation RNA delivery systems, has raised €740,000 on Capital Cell, surpassing the original funding target. The funding strengthens EVis’s position in next-generation RNA therapeutics.

rows.title: New fund and foundation to back founders with disabilities and neurodivergent minds
rows.summary: The Global Inclusive Founders Fund was launched today at the Start Summit; together with an associated foundation (Giff), it focuses on high-potential founders who have navigated systemic barriers — including disability, neurodivergence, or chronic conditions. The initiative is backed by Swiss national councillor and former entrepreneur Islam Alijaj, serial entrepreneur and investor Hermann Arnold, and Louise Maunoir.

rows.title: Amazon acquires robotics start-up RIVR
rows.summary: Following an investment two years ago, Amazon has acquired ETH Zurich spin-off RIVR Technologies AG. The company has developed and trained their quadrupedal robots to walk, drive, stand upright on two legs and manipulate packages with wheeled end effectors. The robots are in use in several countries.

rows.title: Mobilezone übernimmt Apfelkiste
rows.summary: Die mobilezone holding ag übernimmt die AK Group, in deren Besitz sich die E-Commerce Plattform Apfelkiste.ch und die auf Entwicklung von Eigenmarken und Beschaffung von Produkten für den Retailmarkt fokussierte Marein AG befinden. Der Transaktionspreis (Enterprise Value) beträgt rund 180 Millionen Franken. 2021 hatte sich die Private Equity Gesellschaft Invision an der AK Group beteiligt.

rows.title: Swiss biotechs advance clinical programs across multiple therapeutic areas
rows.summary: Five biotech companies announced recent developments ranging from FDA Fast Track and Orphan Drug designations to the start of Phase 1 and Phase 3 clinical trials. The updates highlight progress in oncology, rare blood disorders, neurodegenerative diseases, multidrug-resistant infections, and Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

rows.title: Swiss Economic Award 2026: Nine start-ups progress to the final
rows.summary: The finalists for the Swiss Economic Award 2026 have been announced: on 5 June, they will compete at the Swiss Economic Forum (SEF) in Interlaken for the prestigious award.

rows.title: FIT recognition for Diverssity, MoleSense and Performance MouthGard
rows.summary: Three innovations have been recognized by the Foundation for Innovation and Technology (FIT), with three start-ups receiving Tech Seed loans: digital health company Diverssity, femtech MoleSense medtech start-up MouthGuard.

rows.title: Taste Match startet Expansionsphase für personalisierte Restaurant-Empfehlungen
rows.summary: Mit der Taste Match-App können Gäste, diejenigen Restaurants finden, die ihren persönlichen Vorlieben entsprechen und Restaurants erhalten gleichzeitig gezielte Werbemöglichkeiten. Nach einem gelungenen Start in drei Städten und mehreren Dutzend Kunden auf Restaurantseite, hat nun die Expansionsphase mit der Ausweitung des Angebots nach Luzern begonnen.

rows.title: Rhonexum cryogenic electronics attracts USD 1 million investment
rows.summary: Cryogenic electronics startup Rhonexum has raised $1 million in pre-seed funding led by equity investment from QDNL Participations. The funding, which also includes participation from Venture Kick, as well as grant funding, will allow Rhonexum to accelerate product development and begin to commercialize its first product, designed to drive the development of scalable quantum computers to initial customers.

rows.title: Rivia raises $15M Series A to bring clinical trials into the agentic AI era
rows.summary: Rivia’s data engine unifies clinical trial data, applies scientific logic at scale, and embeds AI agents directly into review workflows to reduce trial costs by up to 50%. The Zurich based start-up has closed a $15M Series A round led by Earlybird. The fresh capital will accelerate team expansion, scale agentic product development, and expand Rivia’s international footprint, particularly in the US.

rows.title: Ten Swiss biotech startups selected for Boston roadshow
rows.summary: Ten startups have been selected for the 2026 Venture Leaders Biotech program, which will take them to Boston from May 31st to June 5th as part of the Swiss National Startup Team. During their roadshow, the entrepreneurs will connect with international investors and industry leaders, acquiring expertise to help scale their ventures internationally.

rows.title: Ecorobotix: 1,000 ARA ultra-high-precision sprayers sold worldwide
rows.summary: Over the past five years, 1,000 ARA ultra-high-precision sprayers developed by Ecorobotix have been put into operation in more than 30 countries. The robots are primarily used in the cultivation of high-value vegetable crops. Since this year, Ecorobotix has also been addressing professional turf and grassland weed management with a new sprayer.

rows.title: Agora Care increases capital to power AI Experience
rows.summary: Geneva-based Agora Care announces a capital increase of CHF 2.2 million from its key shareholders. This investment will support the launch and promotion of powerful new features on its platform, marking a significant leap forward in the way it serves patients and caregivers.

rows.title: Circunis s’ouvre à la Suisse romande
rows.summary: Opérationnelle en Romandie, la place de marché B2B dédiée aux excédents alimentaires s’ouvre à l'ensemble du pays. Il est désormais plus facile pour les entreprises romandes de garder les excédents alimentaires dans le circuit du système alimentaire: établie depuis deux ans déjà en Suisse alémanique, la place de marché B2B circunis.ch permet aux producteurs et acheteurs de vendre ou d'acheter des produits en surplus.

rows.title: Dexterous Endoscopes receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick
rows.summary: The EPFL spin-off Dexterous Endoscopes develops endoscopes with variable stiffness to enable new minimally invasive procedures in hard-to-reach areas within the sinuses and larynx, with future applications in other organs. The CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick will support validation of the technology with surgeons and hospitals worldwide.

rows.title: New high-profile Operator Circle to support growth companies with expertise and investment
rows.summary: 35 Swiss scaleup executives who have successfully built up scaleups in various founder and C-level roles have together launched the Operator Circle. They offer deep tech companies in the growth stage executive expertise and access to their network putting their skin in the game by investing via the Operator Syndicate.

rows.title: Swiss startups racking up recognitions
rows.summary: Five Swiss ventures have made the 2026 FT1000 listing Europe’s Fastest-Growing Companies. The top performer is a bootstrapped AI scale-up from Zurich. In addition, Fribourg-based Bcomp has been recognized at the prestigious JEC Composites Innovation Awards in Paris for its collaboration with BMW. Last but not least, Zurich venture UAC Labs has been selected to participate in the Bank of England’s Synchronisation Lab.

rows.title: SEF.WomenAward 2026: Gewinnerinnen gekürt
rows.summary: Beim diesjährigen SEF.WomenAward, der am vergangenen Freitag zum sechsten Mal verliehen wurde, standen erneut herausragende Unternehmerinnen im Rampenlicht. In der Kategorie «Jungunternehmerin des Jahres» setzte sich Deana Mohr, Co-Gründerin und CEO des Biotech-Startups MUVON Therapeutics, durch.

rows.title: SwissBorg secures MiCA approval from French AMF
rows.summary: Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) has granted BlockNodes SAS, a French entity within the SwissBorg corporate ecosystem, MiCA authorisation. BlockNodes SAS is authorised to provide a broad spectrum of crypto-asset services in the EU.

rows.title: Investor und Experte unterstützt Docdok.health beim nächsten Wachstumsschritt
rows.summary: Der Fachanwalt Christian Schulze wird docdok.health bei der Weiterentwicklung und Markteinführung von ePACURA als Investor und mit seiner Expertise im Aufbau, der Strukturierung und Skalierung von Unternehmen in regulierten Märkten strategisch unterstützen. Die KI-unterstützte digitale Lösung ePacura dient der effizienten Strukturierung und Nutzbarmachung medizinischer Daten.

rows.title: BrainChip to use Klepsydra’s software framework for neuromorphic edge AI
rows.summary: Klepsydra’s software framework is capable of processing up to 10x more data with 50% less power consumption. It will be integrated directly with the neuromorphic architecture of BrainChip’s Akida processor family, aiming to simplify AI deployment in space, defence and automotive systems.

rows.title: Nuventus dental implant system launches in the US
rows.summary: Dental implants company Nuventus officially launched its Nuventus NV.C implant system in the United States at the annual meeting of the Academy of Osseointegration, held in Washington, D.C., from March 5 to 7. Based in Sarnen, in the canton of Obwalden, and Anaheim Hills, California, the company led by Dr. Stefan Holst is supported by an experienced management team.

rows.title: Swiss startups bring in new leadership across health tech, AI and clean mobility
rows.summary: Five Swiss startups have announced leadership changes. Healthtech companies Docjo and MindMaze have named new CEOs, as has Zurich-based AI company Squirro. Flux Mobility has hired a new CTO, while Santhera Pharmaceuticals has appointed a new CCO following the retirement of its previous one.

rows.title: NZZ und ZHAW kündigen Rankings von Akteuren des Startup Ökosystems an
rows.summary: Mit der «Startup Selection Switzerland» wollen die Neue Zürcher Zeitung (NZZ) und die Zürcher Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften (ZHAW) zentrale Akteure wie Startups, Investoren, Programme und Hochschulen erfassen und bewerten. Die erstmalige Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen ist für den November 2026 geplant.

rows.title: Schweizer Startups gewinnen Awards im In- und Ausland
rows.summary: Drei Startups haben sich auf internationalen und nationalen Wettbewerben durchgesetzt: Ionic Wind überzeugte in Oulu mit seiner geräuschlosen Kühllösung, Gravis Robotics gewann in Las Vegas mit einem Nachrüst-Kit für Baumaschinen und in Zürich fand die STEAM Challenge erstmals statt, bei der BlueGreens mit modularen Vertical-Farming-Systemen punktete.

rows.title: Neur.on team joins European legal AI scale-up Noxtua
rows.summary: The legal natural language processing (NLP) team from Fribourg-based legal tech startup Neur.on joins Noxtua. While Neur.on remains dedicated to optimizing legal and financial translation processes, the eight-member NLP team will allow Noxtua to build additional expertise in the quadrilingual Swiss market while supporting further European expansion. Both companies will share a location in Fribourg going forward.

rows.title: Fintech companies providing technological building blocks for established financial institutions
rows.summary: For the first time, the IFZ Fintech study identified more than 500 companies in Switzerland. Even more striking than the moderate growth in the number of companies, however, is the increasing importance of AI, which is being driven by both new and existing Fintech companies.

rows.title: Hyperscale Power raises EUR 5 million to advance solid-state transformers
rows.summary: Zurich-based Hyperscale Power has raised EUR 5 million in a seed round co-led by World Fund and Vsquared Ventures. The startup is developing solid-state transformers designed to meet the power demands of data centers and EV fast-charging infrastructure.

rows.title: Fintech company Axiym receives strategic investment from Tether
rows.summary: Tether, the issuer of the world's largest stablecoin, has taken a strategic stake in Axiym, a Zug-based fintech that routes cross-border payments across 140 countries.

rows.title: InnoBooster supports five early-stage startups with CHF 750’000
rows.summary: The latest cohort of the InnoBooster program comprises five startups developing a range of solutions, from AI-powered 3D design tools, medical devices addressing osteoarthritis, aortic valve disease and endoscopic surgery, to a process that converts CO₂ into construction materials.

rows.title: Pregnolia secures equity funding to bring preterm birth prediction to clinical practice
rows.summary: Following EIC funding, Pregnolia has closed its third round of financing. A total of CHF 3.4 million will be allocated to the femtech company. The funds will advance the company's cervical stiffness diagnostic system toward clinical use across Europe.

rows.title: Emerald Global Water Fund II reaches €100 million
rows.summary: After announcing the first close of €60 million late in 2025, Emerald’s Global Water Fund started the year by welcoming two additional investors Temasek and Grundfos Foundation. The fund with a target size of €150–180 million will accelerate innovation across the entire water value chain.

rows.title: Chain4Travel wird Teil von deutschem Startup
rows.summary: Das Zuger Travel-Tech-Startup Chain4Travel wird vom deutschen Unternehmen Travel Token Marketplace (TTM) übernommen. Die von Chain4Travel entwickelte Blockchain-Struktur des Camino Network bleibt unverändert bestehen. Durch die Übernahme gewinnt Chain4Travel einen strategischen Partner, der die technologische Weiterentwicklung des Netzwerks sicherstellt und das Konsortium durch eigene Produkte stärkt.

rows.title: CHF 12.25 million to roll out Seprify's procurement-ready cellulose for industry
rows.summary: Seprify, the Swiss bio-materials company developing high-performance cellulose-based ingredients for industrial applications, today announced the transition of its cellulose platform from pilot validation into procurement-ready industrial supply. This enables manufacturers to move from trials into repeatable sourcing and longer-term commercial agreements. To support this, Seprify has raised €13.4 million (CHF 12.25 million) in Series A funding.

rows.title: First Ventures funds digital and agritech innovations
rows.summary: Three startup projects from Swiss Universities of Applied Sciences have secured non-dilutive funding from the First Ventures program, including agriculture pellets supporting soil health, a personal finance app aimed at young people and a new digital collaboration tool for the construction sector. The capital will be used to advance their go to market and scale-up.

rows.title: Divea on track to scale novel industrial CO2 capture
rows.summary: Using graphene membranes with microscopic pores to capture CO2 from industrial chimneys, Divea, an EPFL spin-off based at Energypolis in Sion, operates industrial demonstrators at Gaznat in Aigle and Tridel in Lausanne. Working with clients spanning from Canada to Japan, the start-up led by co-founder Karl Khalil is set to reach an important milestone this spring.

rows.title: Three Swiss medtechs launch clinical studies
rows.summary: Opterion Health, Piomic Medical and Qnomx have all reported progress in clinical development, spanning a first-in-human study in peritoneal dialysis, a post-market trial in wound care and a clinical performance study in oncology genomics.

rows.title: Blockstrom wird Teil von ista swiss
rows.summary: Blockstrom gehört zu den Pionieren bei Dienstleistungen für die gemeinsame Nutzung von lokal produziertem Solarstrom. Per Anfang März haben sich die Berner mit dem Immobiliendienstleister ista swiss zusammengeschlossen.

rows.title: Occlutech to gain Alkem as majority shareholder
rows.summary: Indian pharmaceutical company Alkem MedTech plans to acquire a majority stake in Swiss medtech company Occlutech. Alkem intends to buy up to 55% of Occlutech for EUR 99.4 million, subject to statutory and regulatory approvals. The transaction is expected to close by June 2026.

rows.title: Startfeld Diamant: Finalisten bekannt
rows.summary: Mit dem Startfeld Diamant rückt die Ostschweiz auch 2026 vielversprechende Jungunternehmen ins Rampenlicht. Sechs Finalteams haben sich durchgesetzt und präsentieren ihre Projekte nun vor der Jury.

rows.title: MSCI acquires Compass Financial Technologies
rows.summary: MSCI Inc. is enhancing its index calculation capabilities in alternative and multi-asset classes, including commodities and cryptocurrencies, through the acquisition of index services provider, and Swiss fintech Compass Financial Technologies.

rows.title: Swiss MedTech HeroSupport Secures CE Mark for VENUS SHELL
rows.summary: On International Women’s Day, HeroSupport announced that its first medical device, VENUS SHELL, has received CE Mark certification and is now authorised for marketing across the European Union and Switzerland.

rows.title: Investments in women-led companies set a clear record
rows.summary: In 2025, female CEOs broke a record for a third year in a row. While they closed 37 funding rounds – only one more than last year - they attracted CHF 357.31 million. This means that, for the first time, more than 10% of the total invested capital went into female-led startups.

rows.title: Novigenix spins-out AI-Powered Immune Intelligence pionneer
rows.summary: Novigenix SA, a leader in immunotranscriptomic diagnostics, just announced the formal spin-out and launch of Novigenix AI, a new precision medicine company dedicated to transforming therapy development through AI-powered immune intelligence. The spin-out launches with established revenue and a proven commercial track record.

rows.title: SaveSpace: Expansion nach Finanzierungsrunde
rows.summary: SaveSpace war bisher vor allem im deutschen Markt aktiv. Nach dem Abschluss einer Finanzierungsrunde expandiert das Storage-Startup nun in die Deutschschweiz, baut aber auch in Deutschland weiter aus. Weitere europäische Länder sollen folgen.

rows.title: Future of Health Grant 2026 Spring cohort unveiled
rows.summary: The Future of Health Grant (FoHG), the digital health innovation programme driven by CSS and EPFL Innovation Park, has selected seven start-ups for its Spring batch from a record 352 applications. This unprecedented level of interest highlights the rapid acceleration of digital health innovation in Switzerland and confirms the growing impact of the FoHG programme across the ecosystem.

rows.title: Radiobotics to join Medimaps Group
rows.summary: Geneva-based Medimaps Group S.A., a global leader in AI-driven bone microarchitecture imaging solutions, and Danish Radiobotics ApS, a leader in AI-powered MSK radiology solutions, announce that they have entered into a strategic merger agreement. The merger will combine the two specialized AI medical imaging analysis companies to accelerate the adoption of AI-enabled musculoskeletal with the goal to to solve the silent crisis of bone health.

rows.title: Investment für KI-gestützte Altersvorsorge
rows.summary: Das Zürcher FinTech Selma Finance erhält frische Mittel: Die Zuger Unita Capital Group, ein Investment-Club für technologiegetriebene Unternehmen, ist als Investor eingestiegen.

rows.title: «Die Rolle von Business Angels wird oft unterschätzt»
rows.summary: Thilo Veil wurde gestern an der Basler health.tech von der Investorenvereinigung MEDKAP zum HealthTech Business Angel of the Year gewählt. Er hat selbst zwei HealthTech-Startups aufgebaut und verkauft und ist seit drei Jahren hauptsächlich als Business Angel tätig. Im Interview spricht er über seine Strategie, die Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Angels und über die unterschätzte Rolle der Angels im Startup-Ökosystem.

rows.title: Nouvelle acquisition stratégique pour Backbone
rows.summary: Fondée en Suisse et présente dans 6 pays européens, Backbone, entreprise technologique spécialisée dans les solutions marketing pour les professionnels de l'immobilier en région DACH, annonce l'acquisition de la division immobilière suisse d'IBA Virtual. Cette opération renforce son ancrage sur son marché d'origine avec le lancement de sa flotte interne de photographes.

rows.title: Kickfund reaches 100 portfolio companies
rows.summary: Kickfund, a Swiss venture capital firm focused on early-stage deep tech, has crossed the 100-company mark – a milestone it reached in under two years, with a current team of three people. The Swiss deep-tech VC built one of the country’s broadest investment portfolios through a co-investment strategy.

rows.title: Four Swiss fintechs acquire international partners
rows.summary: Zurich-based Securosys has partnered with crypto-company Ripple, while CYBERA is working with threat intelligence company Recorded Future. Meanwhile, Allasso has entered a partnership with decentralized finance company Margarita Finance and LEASETEQ is collaborating with luxury-car company Genesis.

rows.title: USD 50 million to advance Polares Medical U.S. expansion
rows.summary: Polares Medical SA, a Lausanne headquartered clinical-stage structural heart company developing the MRace Posterior Leaflet Replacement (PLR) system for mitral regurgitation (MR), today announced the closing of a $50 million Series C financing. The financing builds on accelerating clinical momentum for MRace, which has now been implanted in more than 70 patients.

rows.title: Frisches Kapital für KMU-Finanzierer Kredo
rows.summary: Das Waadtländer Fintech Kredo hat sich in der Westschweiz etabliert und plant nun schweizweit zu expandieren. Die Mittel dazu stammen aus einer kürzlich abgeschlossenen Finanzierungsrunde in Millionenhöhe.

rows.title: Four startups secure prizes and support
rows.summary: Qendra and CellKinetica have won USD 100,000 each at the Constructor Start Program Demo Day pitching competition. In addition, Enlightra has been accepted into the NVIDIA Inception Program and NanoZymeX won first place at the BioCampus Upper Rhine Investor Day Pitching Competition.

rows.title: Alithea Genomics closes CHF 6.9M round and names new CEO
rows.summary: Alithea Genomics, an emerging leader in the field of large-scale RNA sequencing and transcriptomics, announced today the closing of its seed financing round with an additional CHF 3 million. This additional funding brings the total seed round to CHF 6.9 million ($8.9 million). The proceeds will be used primarily to accelerate commercialization of its new 1536‑well MERCURIUSTM DRUG-seq kits unlocking greater potential of using cell transcriptomics in primary drug screening and exploratory toxicology.

rows.title: Swisspreneur teams up with Yokoy founders to launch its Scaleup Circle
rows.summary: Last Friday at the Scaleup Slopes event, Swisspreneur officially launched its Scaleup community. The Scaleup Circle includes dedicated content, curated events, a closed community maintained via Slack and access to capital. The Circle is co-led by Lars Mangelsdorf and Philippe Sahli, co-founders of Yokoy.

rows.title: Innosuisse awards Enerdrape, 4K-Mems and ShareP with the Innosuisse Certificate
rows.summary: The three tech startups obtained the Innosuisse Certificate, a readiness label for startups positioned for sustainable growth, in the second half of 2025. The awarded solutions range from geothermal renewable energy, mini-infrared emitters, to EV parking software. This is the last article in our series about the companies which received the Certificate in 2025.

rows.title: New leadership for six Swiss startups
rows.summary: Six companies are shaking up their executive leadership. IMPLANZ expands its founding team, while TECregen has named a new CEO and Vivent Biosignal adds a new CEO to its leadership team. At Yapeal, the Chairman of the Board of Directors takes on the role of CEO. Menhir Photonics and GlobalM strengthen their leadership with the appointment of a Chief Operating Officer and a Chief Revenue Officer, respectively.

rows.title: Erste Flotte autonomer Quarero-Roboter im Kundenbetrieb
rows.summary: Quarero Robotics befindet sich im Übergang von technologischer Validierung zur strukturierten Skalierung. Nach einer Finanzierung von über 5 Millionen Franken im vergangenen Jahr zeigen sich nun die ersten Erfolge auf Kundenseite. Rückenwind erhält das Unternehmen zusätzlich durch das im Januar verabschiedete deutsche KRITIS-Gesetz, das höhere Anforderungen für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur bringt.

rows.title: 2026 IC Awards recognize three Swiss Startups
rows.summary: The fifth edition of the International Cooperation Forum (IC Forum) was held on February 26-27th at the Geneva International Conference Centre (CICG) with Federal Councillors Ignazio Cassis and Martin Pfister in attendance. The central theme was the future of humanitarian aid in an international context marked by a proliferation of crises and a significant reduction in funding. On this occasion, three Swiss startups were recognized.

rows.title: storabble integriert Technologie von deutschem Mobile-Storage-Startup
rows.summary: Nach der Expansion nach Österreich und der Etablierung in Deutschland tätigt das St. Galler Startup storabble, Anbieter einer Vergleichs- und Buchungsplattform für Lagerflächen, nun seine erste Akquisition. Durch die Integration der Technologie von on-storage will das Unternehmen seine Plattform ausbauen und bereitet weitere Expansionsschritte im europäischen Markt vor.

rows.title: Oversubscribed $7M Series A to boost Xsensio biosensing clinical deployment
rows.summary: Xsensio SA, a Swiss deep-tech company pioneering near real-time continuous biochemical monitoring, today announced the successful closing of a $7M oversubscribed Series A financing round. The new funding will enable Xsensio to accelerate the development and clinical validation of its Lab-on-Skin wearable biosensing platform, designed to provide dynamic, multi-modal, biochemical information to support clinical decision-making in the hospital and beyond.

rows.title: CHD enters Biopôle Vanguard Accelerator
rows.summary: Biopôle is welcoming CHD (Connected Health Development) SARL into the Vanguard Accelerator programme, a distinctive six-month initiative, run in collaboration with Swiss Healthcare Startups, that supports promising digital health businesses at key points in their growth. The Swiss femtech startup is developing Moni2, a solution for monitoring vitals during high-risk pregnancy.

rows.title: CHF 150,000 to build Fainite Physics-based AI engine for engineering simulations
rows.summary: Fainite AG has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to accelerate physics-based simulations and make advanced engineering analysis accessible across a wider range of applications. The technology enables accurate predictions without relying on large historical datasets.

rows.title: EY Startup Barometer: Invested capital rebounds – AI gaining importance
rows.summary: According to EY, the Swiss startup market is picking up again. Within the DACH region, Switzerland positions itself as a relatively stable market with a strong capital rebound. The investment rebound is mirrored by a healthy increase in AI-related startups. At the same time, gender diversity is stagnating.

rows.title: STS Digital raises USD 30 million to scale its crypto options trading platform
rows.summary: STS Digital is a regulated principal trading firm specialising in digital asset options and institutional market access. The new capital will be deployed to rapidly scale the firm’s institutional-grade spot and options platform, deepen its market-making capabilities, and materially strengthen its balance sheet and liquidity position- laying the foundation for long-term dominance in core markets.

rows.title: L.E.S.S. raises $22 million Series C Financing
rows.summary: L.E.S.S. SA, which develops ultra-thin nano active fiber lighting solutions for industrial vision, automotive applications and medical illumination, has successfully closed a USD 22 million (CHF 17 million) series C financing. The financing will be used to scale up the business.

rows.title: CHF 1.2M to power Verretex production capabilities
rows.summary: EPFL spin-off Verretex regenerates recycled glass fibers into high-performance textiles. The Saint-Sulpice-based cleantech startup secured CHF 1.2 million in dilutive and non-dilutive funding to strengthen its industrial operations and accelerate its push into wider markets.

rows.title: Spirecut enters the scale-up phase
rows.summary: Muttenz-based medtech company Spirecut has passed the threshold of 5,000 treated patients with its single-use, minimally invasive hand surgery kits. Spirecut is thus embarking on its growth phase in a huge market: carpal tunnel syndrome affects roughly 1 in 7 people during their lifetime.

rows.title: Fintech findependent erhält FINMA-Bewilligung als Wertpapierhaus
rows.summary: Als erster reiner ETF-Vermögensverwalter erlangt findependent von der Eidgenössischen Finanzmarktaufsicht FINMA die Bewilligung als kontoführendes Wertpapierhaus. Kundinnen und Kunden profitieren von einem schnelleren Anlageerlebnis in der App und einem erweiterten Angebot.

rows.title: InVirtuoLabs closes R&D agreement with Helsinn
rows.summary: Global pharmaceutical group Helsinn Healthcare SA and In Virtuo Laboratories SA, entered a strategic collaboration. InVirtuoLabs will apply its generative chemistry platform, InVirtuoGEN, to design, optimize, and prioritize novel drug candidates. The collaboration aims to identify optimized lead compounds with drug-like properties, suitable for advancement into preclinical development for the proposed indications.

rows.title: Four Swiss start-ups secure a spot in EIC Accelerator
rows.summary: Since the beginning of 2025, Swiss start-ups have been able to apply for funding under the EIC Accelerator Programme again after a four-year hiatus. Neutrality, Verity, Pregnolia and DePoly have now been selected as the first start-ups and are eligible to receive a mix of blended finance and grant-only support.

rows.title: Guter Start für die KI-gestützte Buchhaltungslösung von Arcarius
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup Arcarius setzt auf KI, um wiederkehrende Buchhaltungsaufgaben ganzheitlich zu automatisieren. Nach einer Pilotphase mit ausgewählten Treuhandunternehmen und KMU ist das Unternehmen Anfang Februar live gegangen und konnte bereits erste Kundinnen und Kunden gewinnen.

rows.title: The Swiss start-up support scene excels in European rankings
rows.summary: The Financial Times has published a ranking of the best European ‘start-up hubs’. Fourteen Swiss organisations from across Switzerland made it onto the list, with Venture Kick coming in at number five.

rows.title: Polaroid Therapeutics obtains CE mark for antimicrobial wound dressing
rows.summary: Schlieren-based Polaroid Therapeutics has received CE marking for its first product, POLTX_Fiber, a Class IIb antimicrobial gelling fiber dressing. The company is preparing to introduce the wound dressing in selected European markets.

rows.title: 46 new ETH Zurich Ventures launched in 2025
rows.summary: ETH Zurich registered the foundation of more new companies than ever before in 2025. 24 new ETH Spin-offs and 22 ETH Start-ups were recognised. The distinction and the new category of ETH Startups were introduced as part of the new Business Creation Regulations. In addition, a new business accelerator funding programme has been launched for ETH Startups.

rows.title: Seed financing to advance Clee Medical brain imaging for neurosurgery
rows.summary: Clee Medical, a Swiss neurotechnology startup developing novel ultra-high-resolution real-time imaging for brain surgery, today announced the successful closing of its Seed financing round. With the Seed financing, Clee Medical plans to expand its development and clinical programs and advance toward key milestones required for early clinical adoption, specifically their first in human clinical study.

rows.title: Bayer nutzt Resmonics’ Software für Online-Hustenchecker
rows.summary: Resmonics hat für ein neues Einsatzgebiet seiner KI zur Hustenüberwachung Bayer als Kunden gewonnen. Der deutsche Konzern hat einen Online-Husten-Checker lanciert. Das Angebot ist weltweit einzigartig. Gleichzeitig arbeitet Resmonics auf Basis derselben Technologie am Soft-Launch eines Frühwarn-Sensorsystems für Gesundheitsversorger.

rows.title: Swiss Rockets acquires Complete Genomics
rows.summary: Basel-based biotech group Swiss Rockets has acquired U.S. life sciences company Complete Genomics. The acquisition will strengthen Swiss Rockets’ portfolio, adding sequencing capabilities to support its activities in targeted cancer therapies and developing next-generation vaccines.

rows.title: Startfeld fördert innovative Projekte aus der Ostschweiz
rows.summary: Von smarten Schlafmatratzen bis zu nachhaltigen Hanf-Baustoffen: Im vergangenen Jahr durfte sich eine Reihe von Startups aus der Ostschweiz über Förderpakete von Startfeld freuen, um ihre Ideen auf die nächste Stufe zu bringen. Insgesamt profitierten 17 Teams von der Unterstützung.

rows.title: Millionenfinanzierung für globale Lancierung umweltfreundlicher Fäden
rows.summary: Mit seiner Technologie macht das Schwyzer Unternehmen CLIMATEX Textilien recycelbar – schon beim Design der Fäden. Für die weltweite Einführung seines Lizenzmodells sichert sich das Unternehmen nun über 3 Millionen Franken.

rows.title: Enerdrape, Bioneris and Divea awarded FIT boost
rows.summary: The Fondation pour l'Innovation Technologique (FIT) is supporting Enerdrape and its thermal panels, that capture and reuse energy from underground spaces, with a Tech Growth loan of CHF 400,000. Two other Tech Seed loans worth CHF 100,000 each were granted to Bioneris for its food bacteria detection device and to Divea for its filters that capture carbon at source.

rows.title: Further increase in startup liquidations
rows.summary: The wave of startup liquidations in Switzerland has intensified for the third consecutive year. In 2025, 158 startups had to shut their doors. However, early signals indicate that the ecosystem has approached the climax after two years of consolidation.

rows.title: Österreichische Verwertungsgesellschaft investiert in Luzerner Startup
rows.summary: Weltweit werden jährlich rund 15 Milliarden US-Dollar an Urheberrechtszahlungen an Musikerinnen und Musiker ausgeschüttet, doch die Erfassung der gespielten Werke, insbesondere bei Live-Konzerten, bleibt komplex. Ab Mitte dieses Jahres führt nowon deshalb seine Musikerkennung im Live-Bereich ein. Gemeinsam mit der österreichischen Verwertungsgesellschaft AKM soll bis nächstes Jahr der gesamte österreichische Markt abgedeckt und jährlich rund 80’000 Veranstaltungen automatisiert erfasst werden.

rows.title: Hamilton Medical acquires STIMIT AG
rows.summary: Hamilton Medical has successfully completed the acquisition of STIMIT AG, based in Biel. The integration of STIMIT AG into the Hamilton Group will take place gradually, with the aim of strategically combining the respective competencies and fostering joint growth.

rows.title: Seprify sets foot in European Cosmetics Industry with Grolman Group
rows.summary: A few months after entering the food industry with Danish company Oterra, Seprify is taking another step forward in its commercial development. The Fribourg-based developer and manufacturer of high-performance cellulose-based materials and German Grolman Group have announced the joint launch of Seprify's SilvaLuma™ ingredient, supporting its widespread adoption in the European cosmetics and personal care market.

rows.title: Kaspar& wird Teil eines etablierten Vorsorgeanbieters
rows.summary: Das auf digitale Anlagelösungen spezialisierte St.Galler FinTech Kaspar& wird zu 100 % von der Liberty Vorsorge AG in Schwyz übernommen. Mit der Akquisition stärkt Liberty gezielt ihre Technologie- und Digitalisierungskompetenz. Kaspar& wird als eigenständige Gesellschaft innerhalb der Liberty-Gruppe weitergeführt.

rows.title: Baxiva receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop first-in-class Escherichia Coli vaccine
rows.summary: ETH Zurich spin-off Baxiva has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance a new vaccine designed to prevent diseases caused by Escherichia coli (E. coli). The biotech startup aims to tackle one of the major drivers of antibiotic resistance worldwide and reduce severe complications such as sepsis.

rows.title: Rising Quanthome set for European expansion
rows.summary: Patrimonium Asset Management, a Swiss Investment-Management company group is now using Quanthome’s platform, data and AI tools within its transaction department and CFO's office for transaction due diligence, market analysis, peer benchmarking and broader market intelligence. Quanthome serves today over 30 institutional real estate players and is entering a phase of European expansion.

rows.title: Metafuels raises $24M to bring synthetic aviation fuel to market at scale
rows.summary: Metafuels' process converts renewable methanol into jet fuel with a significantly higher yield, making it more efficient and cost-effective. The new capital will drive the realization of Metafuels’ commercial projects – advancing flagship facilities toward final investment decisions and implementation, while laying the strong engineering, delivery, and organisational foundations needed for multi-plant deployment across Europe and beyond as SAF mandates gain momentum.

rows.title: Scantrust cements APAC Leadership with new acquisition
rows.summary: Lausanne-based Scantrust, the all-in-one QR code solution for global brands, has announced the acquisition of the business and assets of Trust Codes Global. This strategic acquisition extends the Scantrust team’s foothold in the New Zealand and Australian markets.

rows.title: KA-EX secures $3.5M from U.S. partner
rows.summary: Performance supplement company KA-EX has announced an additional $3.5M investment from Mediaforgrowth, a platform for media capital investment, which had already backed the company in 2025 with $3M. The funds will be used to accelerate growth in the U.S.

rows.title: More stages, more visibility: START Summit strengthens its pitching programme
rows.summary: START Summit is expanding its pitching competitions this year, offering startups more opportunities for funding, investor visibility and direct exchange. In addition to multiple vertical competitions, the organisers are introducing a new Pitching Lounge designed to facilitate follow-up discussions between founders and investors.

rows.title: Rapidata raised USD 8.5 million to eliminate the feedback bottleneck in AI development
rows.summary: Using crowd intelligence and a global network of human participants, Rapidata dramatically reduces the time and cost required to label, validate, and refine datasets used to train and evaluate AI models. The company has raised $8.5 million in a new Series Seed round to expand its unique, high-quality human feedback platform.

rows.title: Femtech FimmCyte closes wide-ranging agreement with Richter
rows.summary: FimmCyte, a femtech company developing new treatments for endometriosis, has entered into a research collaboration and option-to-license agreement with Richter, a leading Hungarian pharmaceutical company, to advance research on its lead clinical candidate, FMC2. The parties have fully negotiated a definitive, exclusive and worldwide license agreement for the future development and commercialization of the antibody.

rows.title: Erfolgreiches Jahr für Alpha Augmented Services
rows.summary: Das Zuger Startup Alpha Augmented Services nutzt KI, um Verpackung, Lagerung und Transport von Waren effizienter zu gestalten. Internationale Grossunternehmen zählen bereits zu den Kunden und der Umsatz wurde 2025 nahezu verdoppelt. Mit neuen Standorten und Kooperationen im asiatischen Raum treibt das Unternehmen seine Expansion weiter voran.

rows.title: FIF Seed Funding for Three Digital Startups and One Impact Project
rows.summary: Three Geneva-based digital projects have each been awarded CHF 50,000: fintech startup Scenario X and ICT startups Flottando and Axy. In addition, an impact-driven life sciences project, Nose Switzerland, has received CHF 20,000 in funding.

rows.title: Baselbieter Startup automatisiert Videobearbeitung mit KI
rows.summary: Nach mehreren Testphasen, in denen die Technologie unter anderem im Umfeld grösserer europäischer Videoproduktionen zum Einsatz kam, lanciert das Tech-Startup Avlana seinen Videoeditor «EditWithAva». Das Startup setzt auf eine chatbasierte Bedienung und KI-gestützte Schnittprozesse und tritt damit in den Markt für digitale Videobearbeitung ein.

rows.title: Terralayr übernimmt Spezialist für Batterieprojekte
rows.summary: Terralayr übernimmt sämtliche Anteile an BBD (Big Battery Deutschland), einem langjährigen Joint Venture für die Entwicklung von Greenfield-Batterieprojekten, von der auf deutschen Averdung Gruppe. Das Unternehmen baut damit seine internen Kapazitäten für Batterieprojekte aus und sichert sich die Kontrolle über eine Projektpipeline von mehr als 1 Gigawatt in Deutschland.

rows.title: ENGIE secures stake in ExerGo
rows.summary: ENGIE, through its ENGIE New Ventures investment fund for startups that accelerate the energy transition, announces a strategic investment, alongside the Eren group, in ExerGo, a Swiss startup that markets district heating and cooling network technology using CO2 as a low-temperature-energy-carrier.

rows.title: Switzerland Innovation Park Zurich sichert sich 445 Millionen für Neubauten
rows.summary: Auf dem Militärflugplatz Dübendorf entsteht der Switzerland Innovation Park Zurich – ein Campus für angewandte Forschung, technologische Entwicklung und innovative Startups. Im Herbst erfolgte der Spatenstich für den ersten Neubau. Mit einem Kredit von bis zu 445 Millionen Franken treibt der Park nun den Bau neuer Labor- und Büroflächen voran.

rows.title: Axmed secures $6 million grant from the Gates Foundation
rows.summary: Axmed, a sourcing and distribution platform for essential medicines, has received a $6 million non-dilutive grant from the Gates Foundation, bringing its total funding to $13 million to date. The company plans to use the grant to expand its operations in Africa, supporting procurement programs in multiple therapeutic areas.

rows.title: New funding to boost CompPair market deployment and growth
rows.summary: Lausanne-based CompPair Technologies Ltd. announces the successful closing of its latest fundraising round, aimed at strengthening the company’s sales and operational capabilities to support rapid growth. With a strong and diversified commercial pipeline already secured, this investment marks a turning point in CompPair’s journey: not a question of if the company will grow, but how it will sustainably manage and scale that growth.

rows.title: Carewell, KnowThee and Alpi get FIT Digital boosts
rows.summary: The Foundation for innovation and technology (FIT) has announced its support for three new innovations at the start of the year. Carewell has been awarded a Digital Growth loan of CHF 200,000 to support its software that connects replacement healthcare staff with healthcare institutions. KnowThee receives a CHF 50,000 Digital Seed loan for its system that helps managers and HR professionals make informed staffing decisions, and finally, Alpi receives a CHF 20,000 Digital Grant for its platform that automates the administrative tasks of insurance advisors.

rows.title: PropTech startup Optiml secures €8 million to expand real estate AI platform
rows.summary: Optiml has secured €8 million in seed financing from KOMPAS VC, Planet A Ventures, and other investors to scale its real estate decision intelligence platform. This financing round follows a notable year where the company secured €2M in contracted ARR and onboarded several new clients.

rows.title: Japanese chemical group chooses Zurich as hub for Physical AI investments
rows.summary: DIC Corporation, a globally leading fine chemicals company, is launching a USD 62 million investment platform to back startups developing Physical AI technologies. DIC plans to establish a startup investment management subsidiary in Zurich in spring 2026. Emerald Technology Ventures will act as DIC’s strategic venture partner.

rows.title: AI Startup Center feiert einjähriges Jubiläum
rows.summary: Ein Jahr nach der Eröffnung baut das AI Startup Center des Technopark Zürich seine Rolle als Hub für KI-Startups weiter aus. Auf Basis der 30 bereits aktiven Unternehmen aus der Schweiz und dem Ausland will das Zentrum seine Aktivitäten ausweiten und Innovationen im Bereich Künstlicher Intelligenz vorantreiben.

rows.title: Five Swiss start-ups secure national and international accolades
rows.summary: Oxyle wins the Green Business Award. Cybera, Nestermind and Fume have been selected for international accelerator programs, while the machine vision publication inVISION has named NovoViz among its Top Innovations.

rows.title: Winduction raises CHF 1.15M to move wireless charging into real-world testing
rows.summary: ETH Zurich spin-off Winduction is developing a wireless charging system that delivers power from the road directly to the wheels of electric vehicles, with an initial focus on buses in public transport. With a PostAuto demonstrator under development, the startup has secured CHF 1.15 million pre-seed funding backed by private investors to advance system validation and vehicle integration.

rows.title: Following a pre-seed-round, ScyAI launches AI risk intelligence for real assets and insurance
rows.summary: Zurich-based startup ScyAI has closed a €2 million pre-seed round led by AENU and co-led by PT1. Founded by by an experienced insurance and risk tech team, ScyAI developed a solution that makes AI-powered risk intelligence accessible to companies with large real asset portfolios. Companies with strong risk management benefit from substantial insurance premium reductions.

rows.title: Auterion and Airlogix launch Joint Venture to scale autonomous drone production
rows.summary: Auterion, the global leader in autonomous drone operating systems, and Airlogix, a Ukrainian defense technology company, announced during the Munich Security Conference the formation of a joint venture to manufacture AI-guided unmanned aerial systems for Ukraine and allied nations.

rows.title: Ten Swiss tech startups selected for Silicon Valley roadshow
rows.summary: A panel of investor and industry experts has selected ten innovative Swiss tech startups to join the Swiss National Startup Team. These Swiss startups will participate in the Venture Leaders Technology 2026 program, an exclusive opportunity to expand their networks and business knowledge during a Silicon Valley roadshow this April.

rows.title: Hemora bringt KI in Schweizer Arztpraxen
rows.summary: Digitalisierung und Fachkräftemangel setzen Schweizer Arztpraxen zunehmend unter Druck. Das St. Galler Startup Hemora reagiert darauf mit einer KI-Lösung, die Laborberichte automatisch verständlich aufbereitet. Nach erfolgreichen Tests soll sie nun in weiteren Praxen eingeführt werden.

rows.title: OOVIE Studios receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to create Music Interactive Movies
rows.summary: Lugano-based OOVIE Studios SA has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop a new kind of interactive films that combines live music and cinema. The fund will be used to accelerate business development and the development of the OO App, an application that will enable anyone to create a movie directly from music.

rows.title: Leading Southern European marketplace to deploy Albatross AI discovery across its platform
rows.summary: Wallapop, the leading Spanish C2C platform connecting 21 million monthly users, who collectively create more than 100 million listings annually, entered into a strategic partnership with Swiss AI company Albatross. Wallapop will deploy Albatross’ real-time AI discovery across its platform, advancing user engagement and seller visibility at unprecedented scale.

rows.title: Strong industry interest in Polariton’s chips
rows.summary: Polariton, focussed on high-performance photonic integrated circuits (PICs), recorded large double-digit growth in sales in 2025. Now the start-up has shipped ultra-fast plasmonic modulator samples to three leading transceiver manufacturers, which proves that the industry sees plasmonics as a path towards power‑efficient connectivity for AI and hyperscale data centres.

rows.title: USD 10 million for a new approach to treat heart failure patients
rows.summary: Berlin Heals Holding AG, a Swiss-German MedTech company focused on transformative therapies for heart failure, raised over USD 10M from a combination of existing shareholders and new investors. The funding will be used to advance the company's cardiac microcurrent technology and expand its clinical research program.

rows.title: Infotel acquires stake in Swiss aviation company AeroEx
rows.summary: Infotel, a French IT service company, has acquired a 20% stake in Swiss aviation compliance company AeroEx and plans to take control of the company within three years. The acquisition is in line with Infotel's strategic goal of generating a larger share of its revenue from software sales.

rows.title: Drei Startups stärken Wachstum mit Crowdinvesting
rows.summary: Mitipi, Chronic. und Baabuk starten mit frischem Schwung ins neue Jahr und sammeln auf der Crowdinvesting-Plattform Conda.ch neues Kapital für ihre Wachstumspläne. Insgesamt beteiligen sich über 300 Investorinnen und Investoren und stellen mehr als 800’000 Franken für Sicherheitstechnologie, Kaffee und nachhaltige Schuhe bereit.

rows.title: Nouvelle visibilité pour les finalistes PERL 2026
rows.summary: Lausanne Région et La Télé font évoluer les Prix Entreprendre Lausanne Région (PERL) avec un dispositif inédit mêlant télévision, événementiel et contenus digitaux. Pour l’édition 2026, le concours adopte un nouveau format visant à renforcer la visibilité des entreprises finalistes, à valoriser le processus de sélection et à toucher un public plus large, tout en conservant la cérémonie officielle à Beaulieu.

rows.title: Dario Cologna steigt als Investor bei KAEX ein
rows.summary: Der vierfache Olympiasieger Dario Cologna engagiert sich neu als Investor und Markenbotschafter beim Schweizer Getränke-Startup KAEX. Mit Fabian Cancellara und Lara Gut-Behrami unterstützen bereit zwei weitere Spitzensportler das Unternehmen.

rows.title: InVirtuoLabs to lead €2.3M Eurostars grant project NEUROSPARK
rows.summary: InVirtuoLabs and partners from Italy, Spain, and Greece have been awarded a €2.3 million Eurostars grant. The research effort aims to identify and experimentally validate 3–5 lead small molecules for a rare neurodegenerative movement disorder using its Virtual Cell Models—AI-based simulations of diseased cells that predict responses to drug candidates.

rows.title: From trials to market: medtechs advance clinical programs
rows.summary: Swiss medtechs advance on multiple fronts. Aspivix and Argà MedTech report positive study results, while KYLYS Aesthetics and ONWARD Medical launched new clinical trials. SQ Innovation’s drug-device combination is available in the U.S.

rows.title: Porters raises €2.7 million to build AI‐native banking operations
rows.summary: Zürich-based fintech Porters has raised €2.7 million in a pre-seed funding round led by pan-European investor Earlybird to modernise banking operations through AI-driven automation.

rows.title: Une plateforme dédiée aux voyageurs autonomes
rows.summary: Née à Fribourg à Bluefactory, Poulpigo est la première plateforme suisse pour planifier, réserver et centraliser ses voyages. Développée initialement pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels d’agents spécialisés dans le voyage sur mesure, Poulpigo est désormais accessible au grand public sans frais.

rows.title: Seven new startups awarded Scale-up Vaud Label
rows.summary: On its 10th anniversary, Scale-Up Vaud has grown its community to 44 certified scale-ups.
