This number, which includes seven new companies, highlights the depth and the ability of the Vaud innovation ecosystem to generate tangible economic impact: Collectively, the 44 scale-ups have created 2,822 jobs in Switzerland and 5,102 jobs in total.

rows.title: Physical AI start-up Algorized secures USD 13 million Series A funding
rows.summary: Algorized transforms standard wireless sensors infrastructure into reliable human-aware perception moving the industry beyond "detect-and-stop" systems toward machines with true physical awareness. The capital from the Series A round accelerates the global rollout of a new standard in industrial robotics.

rows.title: Entrepreneurial activity in Switzerland: strong expertise, low growth
rows.summary: The new Swiss country report from the Global Entrepreneurship Monitor paints a mixed picture of early-stage entrepreneurial activity. On the one hand, there is strong resilience in the number of new entrepreneurial projects, more scalable business ideas and more ambitious export targets. On the other hand, teams remain small and the fear of failure remains high.

rows.title: Voltiris and Oxyle in the final round of the Green Business Award competition
rows.summary: The Green Business Award recognises Swiss solutions that combine ecological impact with economic success. The jury selected three companies from 37 nominations for the final round, two of which are start-ups.

rows.title: Umanitek expands its global AI safety mission with a strategic investment
rows.summary: AI safety startup Umanitek has appointed HRH Prince Khaled bin Alwaleed bin Talal Al Saud to its advisory board, supported by a strategic investment from his investment vehicle KBW Ventures, to drive its Middle East expansion.

rows.title: Startup-Nation Schweiz: Agenda für mehr Innovation und Wachstum
rows.summary: Die Schweiz will ihre gute Position als Startup-Standort weiter verbessern. Die Startup-Agenda Schweiz, die durch die Swiss Startup Association entworfen und in Zusammenarbeit mit 18 Partnern im Februar 2026 verabschiedet wurde, beschreibt konkrete Reformen, um Innovation zu fördern, Kapital zu mobilisieren und bürokratische Hürden abzubauen – bevor Talente und Ideen ins Ausland abwandern.

rows.title: High growth for thin-film coating startup Swiss Cluster
rows.summary: In just five years, Swiss Cluster has achieved impressive growth, securing national and international clients and over CHF 1.5 million in external funding. This upward trajectory is set to continue. Swiss Cluster is growing its team and aims to complete another capital increase by year end.

rows.title: OOMNIUM verdoppelt Investmentvolumen
rows.summary: Die Zürcher Finanzierungsplattform OOMNIUM profitiert 2025 von ihrer strategischen Erweiterung Richtung B2B. Mehr Runden, mehr Kapital und eine breite Branchenabdeckung prägen das vergangene Jahr. Insgesamt sicherten sich 17 Startups 8.6 Millionen Franken.

rows.title: Memo Therapeutics enters into a collaboration with CSL
rows.summary: Memo Therapeutics AG (“MTx”), a late-stage biotech company translating unique immune responses into superior medicines to treat viral infections and cancer, today announced it has entered into a strategic collaboration and exclusive option-to-license agreement with CSL, a global leader in developing and delivering high-quality medicines that treat people with rare and serious diseases, for MTx’s recombinant polyclonal IgG technology.

rows.title: Limula transitions to commercial phase
rows.summary: Limula’s solution team completed a fully automated, 7-day end-to-end CAR T-cell therapy production; from cell input to finished product. In addition Limula reports first revenues. The Lausanne-based start-up has now established a growing pipeline of customers committed to using its solution towards clinical use. To support this next chapter, a new CEO takes over.

rows.title: Clear growth in the Swiss PropTech sector
rows.summary: According to the new SwissPropTech Report, start-ups from the vertical are growing in number, revenue and headcount while largely funding themselves. For the second year running, AI stands out as the sector’s dominant megatrend.

rows.title: Chiral raises $12M to unlock post-silicon computing beyond Moore’s Law
rows.summary: Chiral is a Swiss deeptech company developing tools and processes for the scalable integration of nanomaterials into next-generation semiconductor devices. The investment will accelerate the step from development into deployment.

rows.title: Oxara welcomes investment from Medley Ventures
rows.summary: Medley Ventures, the entrepreneurial fund backed by the founders of Too Good To Go, joined Oxara as an investor during the company’s Pre-Series A funding round. The funds will enable Oxara to accelerate product development, certification pathways, and industrial partnerships, leading to broader deployment in Switzerland and across international construction markets.

rows.title: Un nouveau programme pour rapprocher startups et PME au Jura
rows.summary: Après des années de travail de développement continu, Basel Area Business & Innovation vient de lancer InnoJura, un nouveau programme conçu pour rassembler les startups et les PME de la région du Jura afin de les aider à poursuivre leur développement dans les meilleures conditions.

rows.title: EPFL Startups celebrate record 2025
rows.summary: In 2025, EPFL has reached a historic milestone: 39 startups have been launched, nearly double the annual average over the past two decades. The entrepreneurial momentum on campus has reached an extraordinary level, confirming the rise of the Swiss deep tech ecosystem.

rows.title: Innosuisse recognizes growth potential of medtech and digital health startups
rows.summary: In the second half of 2025 five medtech and digital health startups obtained the Innosuisse Certificate, a readiness label for startups positioned for sustainable growth. Their products range from diagnostic tests to AI-based training software.

rows.title: H55 goes from validation to scale
rows.summary: Electric aviation has faced a single unresolved bottleneck: proving to regulators that high-energy propulsion batteries can safely contain worst-case failures. Valais based H55 has just completed the industry’s first regulator-required and authority-witnessed propulsion battery module certification test sequence, removing a critical barrier to the commercialization and financing of electric aircraft programs.

rows.title: Loxy übernimmt Assets und Team des IoT-Spezialisten Tracker.com
rows.summary: Die Loxy Schweiz AG übernimmt die Assets der tracker.ch AG. Damit baut Loxy den IoT-Bereich seines Angebots gezielt aus. Das Tracker-Team bleibt an Bord.

rows.title: Startups make leadership changes amid growth
rows.summary: Recent executive changes at five startups come at a pivotal moment of continued growth across the diverse companies. Loft Dynamics and sportstech firm Sensopro have appointed new CEOs. At properti, an experienced manager takes on the roles of CFO and COO. Fashion-tech startup Vestir and Otter have named new Chief Technology Officers, and biotech company CDR-Life has added a new Chief Medical Officer.

rows.title: Tenity und Finanz und Wirtschaft Forum spannen für Swiss Fintech Week zusammen
rows.summary: Im Juni wird in Zürich die erste Swiss Fintech Week über die Bühne gehen. Etablierte Formate wie das FuW „FinTech“ Forum, die Swiss FinTech Awards, die SFTA Fintech Fair, das Point Zero Forum und Swiss Hacks werden in die Woche integriert, um die Strahlkraft der Schweiz als führendem Innovations- und Investitionsstandort besser zur Geltung zu bringen.

rows.title: Two publications and an FDA fast track designation for Swiss biotechs
rows.summary: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics has received FDA Fast Track designation for the treatment of palmoplantar pustulosis with its novel IL-17 inhibitor, speeding up drug development. Meanwhile, Alys Pharmaceuticals and iOnctura both published high-impact papers confirming the potential of their lead assets.

rows.title: Startup trio lands accelerators and €30k Austrian prize
rows.summary: Medtech startup Visienco and quantum startup qendra have been selected to join renowned accelerator programs in Switzerland and abroad, gaining access to top industry experts and infrastructure to help scale their businesses. In Austria, Mindset Technologies has been awarded €30,000 to further develop the solution it created during a recent hackathon challenge.

rows.title: Besso erhält neue Förderung
rows.summary: Handels- und Zollvorschriften sind für Unternehmen oft unübersichtlich und unterscheiden sich von Markt zu Markt. Das Berner Startup Besso schafft hier Transparenz: Mit seiner SaaS-Plattform automatisiert es die Analyse, zeigt Sparpotenziale auf und sichert die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften.

rows.title: MoleSense wins over Vanguard Accelerator
rows.summary: MoleSense is joining the Vanguard Accelerator programme. Led by Gian Luca Barbruni and Ata Golparvar, the Swiss femtech advancing women’s healthcare through molecular wearable technology will benefit from the six-month initiative from Biopôle SA and Swiss Healthcare Startups offering tailored mentorship, expanded industry access and strategic support to drive market acceleration.

rows.title: Haelixa secures EUR 2 million to boost global growth
rows.summary: DNA-tracing company Haelixa has raised a EUR 2 million pre-series A round led by Verve Ventures and Zurich Kantonalbank to accelerate the global adoption of its unique solution for supply chain transparency.

rows.title: UNISERS enters commercial phase following first system shipment
rows.summary: UNISERS, a Zurich-based microchip toolmaker advancing contamination control in semiconductor manufacturing, has shipped its first fully automated, volume-production-ready fab tool to a leading-edge semiconductor manufacturer based in the United States. This marks the company’s first commercial deployment and sets the foundation for broader in-fab rollout discussions.

rows.title: FluidSolids gains momentum with bio-composites
rows.summary: With the growing demand for sustainable materials, FluidSolids continues to lead in providing bio-compostable solutions across diverse industries. The company now supports over ten customers worldwide, and its recent partnership with Corvaglia expands the production and global marketing of products made from natural, fiber-based materials.

rows.title: Significantly more money for Swiss start-ups
rows.summary: Investment in knowledge-based start-ups rose by 23.9% to CHF 2.9 billion in 2025, according to Swiss Venture Capital Report, published by the online news portal startupticker.ch and the industry association SECA in cooperation with startup.ch.

rows.title: Massiv mehr Geld für Schweizer Startups
rows.summary: Die Investitionen in wissensbasierte Jungunternehmen stiegen 2025 um 23.9 Prozent auf 2.9 Milliarden Franken. Dies zeigt der Swiss Venture Capital Report (SVCR), herausgegeben vom Online-Newsportal Startupticker.ch und der Branchenvereinigung SECA in Kooperation mit startup.ch.

rows.title: Hausse massive des fonds pour les startups suisses
rows.summary: Les investissements dans les jeunes entreprises basées sur le savoir ont augmenté de 23,9 % en 2025, pour atteindre 2,9 milliards de francs. C'est ce que révèle le Swiss Venture Capital Report (SVCR), publié par le portail d'information en ligne Startupticker.ch et l'association professionnelle SECA, en collaboration avec startup.ch.

rows.title: GuestReady expands into the Canary Islands
rows.summary: With Lightbooking, GuestReady made its 12th acquisition since inception and the third in the last 12 months. Based in the Canary Islands, Lightbooking is one of Spain’s leading vacation rental management and distribution operators, with over 200 units.

rows.title: Zurich-based VC firm closes $110 million Fund I
rows.summary: Constructor Capital, the Swiss venture engine of the Constructor Group ecosystem, has closed its first fund at $110 million to support Seed and Series A startups in DeepTech, software, and EdTech. The fund focuses on science-first companies making the transition from lab to market. Capital deployment is already underway, with investments in startups including Qnami from Switzerland.

rows.title: CHF 150,000 to build purpose-built AI tools for modern diplomacy
rows.summary: Swiss ICT startup DiploTools has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick as the first funding recipient of the year to develop software designed specifically for diplomatic and policy work. The platform aims to reduce bureaucracy, improve coordination, and free up time for strategy in an increasingly complex international environment.

rows.title: Eight startups join MedTech Booster Program in 2026
rows.summary: Dedicated to supporting MedTech and Health Science startups in their earliest phases of development, the Sitem Startup Club has welcomed eight new startups from Switzerland and abroad to its MedTech Booster Program. For 12 months, the selected early-stage startups will obtain support to advance their solutions.

rows.title: Terapet enters the Japanese market with Ansai Medical
rows.summary: Terapet has begun marketing its Qualyscan through Anzai Medical Co., Ltd., a leading provider of advanced medical technology in Japan, a key particle therapy market. The groundwork for this launch was laid during the company's last trip to Japan in November 2025, thanks to JASTRO (Japanese Society for Radiation Oncology) and the signing ceremony for a MoU with the Kobe Proton Centre, which will serve as a reference center.

rows.title: ORamaVR secures $4.5M to scale medical XR simulations
rows.summary: Athens-based VC firms Big Pi Ventures and Evercurious VC have invested $4.5M in ORamaVR, the startup pioneering Computational Medical Extended Reality platform. With their solutions being used by medical professionals across 10 countries worldwide, the company is now set to further scale operations.

rows.title: Technis rachète un pionnier genevois de la performance énergétique
rows.summary: Technis renforce son leadership de la gestion énergétique des bâtiments et des installations thermiques avec l’acquisition de l’entreprise précurseur genevoise E-NNO. À l’heure où la performance énergétique joue un rôle croissant dans la valorisation du parc immobilier, le groupe entend accélérer son déploiement de solutions technologiques à grande échelle, en Europe comme à l’international.

rows.title: The Italian Tech Forum 2026: Exploring the Innovative Future
rows.summary: On February 4th, Technopark Zurich will host the 2026 edition of the Italian Tech Forum. For the third consecutive year and the second under the ITF (Italian Tech Forum) brand, the Italian innovation ecosystem will take the stage in Zurich, under the aegis of the Italian Chamber of Commerce for Switzerland, to build bridges and foster connections.

rows.title: Venture Leaders with impressive 20-year results
rows.summary: Since 2006, Venturelab has been selecting and supporting Venture Leaders. At the 2025 Graduation Ceremony, the organisation presented its results: 630 start-ups took part in 63 roadshows around the globe. In total, the companies raised over 9 billion Swiss francs.

rows.title: Hybrid X8 drone obtains two European market approvals
rows.summary: Xer Tech has obtained an operational approval for flights Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) with Xer Tech’s X8 drone in Switzerland and in Hungary. The approval opens a gateway to commercialize the drone and attract new collaboration partners.

rows.title: Venture Kick backs 130 startups with CHF 8.3 million in 2025
rows.summary: Since 2007, Venture Kick has invested CHF 102 million in 1,251 startup projects from Swiss universities and research centers, resulting in 16,100 jobs created. Last year alone 130 startups obtained CHF 8.3 million direct investment, representing a 34% increase compared to 2024. These companies have further attracted over CHF 1.25 billion in follow-on financing.

rows.title: European community for ambitious founders just launched
rows.summary: The ETH AI Center joins other European institutions to boost the local innovation ecosystem via the Relativity Collective, a pan-European founder network designed to connect top talent at a formative stage of their entrepreneurial journey.

rows.title: Eleven startups selected for Microsoft for Startups AI Tech Accelerator
rows.summary: The third cohort of the Microsoft for Startups Switzerland AI Tech Accelerator comprises 11 startups building AI-powered solutions across a wide range of industries. From February 2 to mid-April 2026, the companies will advance their solutions supported by experts.

rows.title: beUnity expandiert in die englischsprachige Welt
rows.summary: Über 500 Vereine, Verbände und Genossenschaften im DACH-Raum nutzen bereits beUnity. Für die nächste Wachstumsphase holt das Zürcher Startup internationale Erfahrung an Bord: Alberto Toledo übernimmt den CEO-Posten. Er verantwortete bei Wingtra den Marktausbau in Amerika und trieb bei Beekeeper die Expansion in die USA voran.

rows.title: MedTech company secures EUR 20 million from the EU
rows.summary: SamanTree Medical received a EUR 20 million grant from the European Investment Bank. The funds will be used to expand across the EU and US markets and to continue product development for their point-of-care tissue scanner, which has already proven to reduce re-operation rates by 67% after breast cancer surgery.

rows.title: LeadiNNg to Scale-up set to propel promising 5th cohort
rows.summary: A record number of seventeen start-ups were selected for the fifth edition of the LeadiNNg to Scale-up programme, organised by Innovaud and IMD. Coming from a wide range of sectors, the start-ups met for the first time on January 20th in Lausanne for an inspiring first session.

rows.title: Zurich-based biotechs make headway
rows.summary: Virometix has revealed encouraging Phase 1 data for their lead vaccine asset, V-212, a synthetic vaccine designed to prevent pneumococcal disease caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae. In parallel, InterAx Biotech announced a strategic research and licensing agreement with US-based company Alveus Therapeuticsto advance the development of its therapeutic candidate. The deal includes an undisclosed upfront payment to InterAx.

rows.title: Scholé AI Raises $3M to Transform Workforce Learning
rows.summary: Lausanne-based Scholé AI, an AI-native learning platform built for the modern workforce, today announced it has raised $3 million in funding led by ACE Ventures. The funding will be used to expand enterprise deployments, grow the team, support expansion into the U.S., and further develop Scholé AI’s adaptive learning platform.

rows.title: Largo scales international operations with US-based E-Poll acquisition
rows.summary: Leading global provider of advanced AI-driven solutions for the film, television and advertising industries, Largo, has acquired US consumer research and market insights firm E-Poll Market Research. By combining nearly three decades of trusted, longitudinal audience intelligence with next-generation AI-driven predictive technology, the landmark deal is set to boldly redefine how brands, studios, agencies and advertisers understand and anticipate audience behaviour.

rows.title: Swiss venture capital firm b2venture closes €150 million Fund V
rows.summary: b2venture, one of Europe’s most experienced early-stage investors, has closed its Fund V at the hard cap of EUR 150 million, the firm’s largest early-stage fund to date since founding 25 years ago. The new fund will focus on supporting European startup founders building scalable, defensible technologies and digital business models from the earliest stages. Thirty-five companies will benefit from this fund.

rows.title: New studies validate Aesyra and Comphya devices
rows.summary: In a recent clinical study, Aesyra reported positive results for its flagship product, AesyBite Active—a smart, data-driven oral medical device that uses biofeedback to treat and prevent sleep bruxism. Meanwhile, Comphya announced that results from its first-in-human clinical study of the CaverSTIM system, developed to address erectile dysfunction, have been published in two peer-reviewed journals.

rows.title: 12 Swiss startups recognized by the global FoodTech 500 list
rows.summary: The FoodTech 500 list, announced this week, offers a comprehensive view of the current state of food technology by featuring the latest advancements from companies throughout the supply chain. 12 Swiss start-ups across the food supply chain have been selected, with half in the AgTech sector.

rows.title: Fundraising platform RaiseNow obtains growth loan to fuel growth and expansion
rows.summary: For the past decade, RaiseNow has been providing infrastructure to support non-profit and charity organizations to run modern digital fundraising. More than 54,000 organizations across Europe use the platform, processing over €300 million in donation volume. The company has now secured a growth loan to further support this trajectory.

rows.title: Cash prizes and support to propel Swiss startups
rows.summary: The Digital Accelerator Basel, launched to support startups across logistics and supply chain, has selected four startups for its four months accelerator program to further advance their early-stage solutions. SimplexDNA was awarded CHF 25’000 in the Innovate for Nature competition while Vivent Biosignals garnered recognition in Poland.

rows.title: Boring robot startup awarded CHF 150,000 by Venture Kick
rows.summary: Under Industries has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop technology that enables faster and cleaner underground utility installation. The approach aims to reduce road closures, noise, and surface disruption in dense urban environments.

rows.title: terralayr reaches financial close on a €60 million BESS portfolio financing in Germany
rows.summary: Swiss-German energy company terralayr has achieved financial close on a €60 million senior secured debt financing to support its portfolio of battery energy storage projects in Germany. The transaction also provides for a €100 million accordion facility to finance further pipeline projects.

rows.title: Erfolgreicher Start für KI-Versicherungsberatung
rows.summary: Das Schwyzer Startup Credura lanciert eine KI-basierte Plattform für Privatkundinnen und -kunden, die Versicherungsverträge laufend überprüft und Optimierungen vorschlägt. Ein sechsmonatiges Pilotprojekt mit mehreren hundert Teilnehmenden verlief erfolgreich. Insgesamt 17 grosse Schweizer Versicherer sind bereits mit an Bord.

rows.title: Scandens gewinnt Kunden
rows.summary: Nach einem erfolgreichen Jahr im B2B-Bereich hat das Zürcher Startup Scandens kürzlich ein erstes Projekt mit PostFinance abgeschlossen. Nach erfolgreichen Pilotprojekten konnten weitere Kunden gewonnen werden.

rows.title: Six startups join the ESA BIC Switzerland program
rows.summary: The newly selected startups for the ESA BIC Switzerland accelerator program are will receive financial and technical support to advance their solutions during the next two years. This year’s cohort comprises startups working on energy, photonics and communication solutions that address key challenges across space systems and downstream applications.

rows.title: New leadership for ICT and Life Sciences Swiss startups
rows.summary: Startups across industries have reshuffled their executive teams by appointing new leaders to steer their next phase of growth. The companies are advancing innovations to support aerial robots for inspection, enable seamless data analytics, advance cancer treatments and restore movement.

rows.title: Belgium-based team.blue acquires Windsor.ai
rows.summary: Windsor.ai, a leading Swiss AI-powered data integration and marketing attribution platform has established itself as a trusted partner for businesses seeking enterprise-grade data integration at accessible pricing, currently serving more than 5,000 customers across 120 countries. The company has joined the team.blue family, a Belgium based AI-powered digital enabler.

rows.title: Edtech start-up Sparkli raises $5M pre-seed funding
rows.summary: Three Google veterans have teamed up to create the curiosity-enhancing edtech startup Sparkli, for children aged 5 to 12. The company recently emerged from stealth, announcing a $5M pre-seed round led by Founderful.

rows.title: LatticeFlow acquires AI discovery platform from Dublin
rows.summary: Through the acquisition of Dublin-based AI Sonar Ltd, LatticeFlow is expanding its AI governance capabilities with the introduction of the industry’s first evidence-based AI governance solution, which securely connects on-premise AI discovery and evaluation with centralized governance operations. LatticeFlow will assume full ownership of AI Sonar, including its IP and team, and establish a presence in Ireland.

rows.title: Ypsomed Innovation Award: three start-ups receive CHF 100,000
rows.summary: Biotech startup Visienco AG has won the CHF 50,000 first prize in the Ypsomed Innovation Award 2026. The two runners-up, medtech startups Optohive and Rhovica Neuroimaging, received CHF 25,000 each. With the prize money, the award supports the next steps into independence or further growth for awardees.

rows.title: Growth funding to scale Tech5 market expansion
rows.summary: Over the past years, Tech5 has established a strong footprint in multiple countries worldwide, offering its Biometrics and digital identity solutions. The company has now secured non-dilutive growth capital from Salica Investments to further fuel this momentum.

rows.title: Swiss startups garner national and international recognition
rows.summary: Six Swiss scale-ups made it to the TechTour Growth 50 Europe list after raising a combined EUR 592.4 million. Neurosoft Bioelectronics won the regional Startup World Cup in Las Vegas while HeroSupport CEO was recognized for her community contributions in Geneva. Meanwhile GraphEnergy Tech and Enerdrape joined international accelerators.

rows.title: Audiospace signs major deal with U.S.-based Connoisseur Media
rows.summary: Audiospace, the Swiss startup operating digital platforms for radio and audio operators through its software, has secured a major deal with U.S.-based Connoisseur Media, to develop 240 digital radio platforms. This deal accelerates the company’s expansion into the U.S market, where it now powers over 400 platforms. Audiospace is also actively expanding in several other markets across Europe, notably Germany.

rows.title: Digitalhealth company Oviva banks USD 220M Series D funding
rows.summary: Oviva, a leading European provider of digital care for weight-related and chronic conditions, has secured USD 220M in a series D investment round led by Kinnevik with participation of various investors. This funding will be used to Oviva’s scale evidence-based, personalized care to many more people.

rows.title: FAIRTIQ erobert Europa
rows.summary: Nach einem positiven Jahr mit über 131 Millionen über die FAIRTIQ-Technologie abgerechneten Fahrten und dem Start in sechs neuen Ländern treibt das Mobility-Startup seine Expansion mit neuen Integrationen in Deutschland und Frankreich weiter voran.

rows.title: Exeon Analytics expands product portfolio amid strong market momentum
rows.summary: Building on its strong growth—evidenced by double-digit annual revenue growth and an expanding customer base—cybersecurity specialist Exeon Analytics has broadened its product portfolio to further accelerate this trajectory. The newly launched Exeon.UEBA complements the existing Exeon.NDR solution, extending advanced security analytics beyond the network layer to include identities and applications.

rows.title: Une cessation d'activité envisagée par Smood
rows.summary: Dans un contexte concurrentiel et économique exigeant, le Conseil d’administration de Smood SA annonce l’ouverture d’une phase de consultation avec son personnel et de négociation d'un plan social, en vue de la possible cessation de ses activités. Parallèlement, Smood SA entend accompagner ses partenaires dans leur recherche d'une solution alternative si elle devait cesser ses activités.

rows.title: Vi Partners: first closing of new CHF 150 million fund completed
rows.summary: In conjunction with its 25th anniversary, Vi Partners has launched a new CHF 150 million venture capital Fund, targeting Series A and early-stage technology and healthcare startups. The first closing has been completed with strong backing from existing limited partners.

rows.title: Swissto12 raises over €100M for HummingSat industrialization
rows.summary: SWISSto12, a fast-growing aerospace company and leading manufacturer of advanced satellite systems and radiofrequency (RF) products, has secured €73 million ($84.8 million) in financial support from European Space Agency (ESA) member states through the HummingSat ARTES partnership project. The Renens company also raised additional funding from European private investors in the second half of 2025, bringing its total funding to more than €100 million.

rows.title: Kanton St.Gallen und IFJ machen digitale Gründung praxistauglich
rows.summary: Von der Unternehmensgründung bis zur Handelsregistermutation: Mit dem Startup-Guide steht Gründerinnen und Gründern im Kanton St.Gallen nun ein durchgängiger digitaler Service für zentrale rechtliche Prozesse zur Verfügung. Entwickelt wurde das Online-Portal in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Institut für Jungunternehmen (IFJ), das die Plattform betreibt.

rows.title: Cloover secures $22M in equity and a $1.2 billion debt facility
rows.summary: Swiss-German startup Cloover has secured $22 million in Series A equity financing alongside a $1.2 billion debt facility. The equity round was led by MMC Ventures and QED Investors. The funding will be used to further accelerate growth, with Cloover aiming to reach $500m sales volume in 2026. Last year, the company revenues grew more than 8x, approaching $100 million in sales. The company remains profitable.

rows.title: Frigg launches renewable energy project finance platform
rows.summary: Last year, Frigg onboarded 174 projects to its marketplace and analytics platform for small and mid-sized renewable energy developments from across the globe. The platform hosts a total of EUR 760 million worth of capital expenditure, and several projects have successfully secured funding worth EUR 12 million. Following this successful beta phase, the company officially opened the platform for self-onboarding at the beginning of the year.

rows.title: ZKB Pionierpreis Technopark presents shortlist
rows.summary: The jury of the ZKB Pionierpreis Technopark 2026 has selected 13 outstanding deep-tech startups to advance to the next stage of the competition—contesting for a total prize of CHF 125,000. The winners will be revealed on 12 May.

rows.title: Startups rely on each other’s strengths
rows.summary: Fintech startups Taurus and Wyden have joined forces to empower automated trading-to-custody workflows for regulated institutions by combing Wyden’s institutional trading platform, Wyden Infinity and Taurus-PROTECT. Meanwhile Quantum startups YQuantum and Rhonexum combine their expertise to overcome the hardware bottlenecks that currently limit the scalability of quantum computers.

rows.title: Ten years of support for greater growth
rows.summary: How can scale-ups be supported effectively? The Scale Up Vaud team has the most experience in answering this question. Since 2016, it has supported rapidly growing, innovative companies by encouraging exchange, providing tailored feedback and learning opportunities, and strengthening the network through events.

rows.title: Advertima expandiert nach Nordamerika
rows.summary: Advertima treibt seine internationale Expansion voran: Gemeinsam mit Walmart Connect Mexico rollt das Retail-Tech-Startup seine Technologie für zielgruppengerechte Werbung in Läden in hunderten Walmart-Supercentern aus.

rows.title: GetYourGuide peilt Börsengang an
rows.summary: Laut Berichten in deutschen Wirtschaftsmedien bereitet sich die Tourismusplattform GetYourGuide auf einen Börsengang an der Wall Street noch in diesem Jahr vor. Das Unternehmen könnte dabei mit einer Bewertung von bis zu fünf Milliarden US-Dollar an den Markt gehen.

rows.title: Babylat secures bi-lateral grant and advances into the clinical stage
rows.summary: Medtech startup Babylat has obtained a three-year Swiss-Polish government grant to support the development of its device — the first automated tabletop device for human milk protein and fat enrichment in neonatal diet. Along with the funding, the startup has secured a pilot project in Poland, bringing it into the clinical phase.

rows.title: Von Schlafoptimierung bis Frühgeburtsprävention: SwissFinTechDiversity Award 2026 verliehen
rows.summary: Zum dritten Mal wurde der SwissFinTechDiversity Award verliehen und würdigt herausragende Leistungen von Frauen im Unternehmertum. Yainvest, Pregnolia und Undae überzeugten die Jury mit technologischer Innovation und unternehmerischer Expertise.

rows.title: Terralayr secures €192 million to further grow its grid-scale battery storage portfolio
rows.summary: Terralayr closed a financing round led Eurazeo – through its Eurazeo Transition Infrastructure Fund (ETIF) - alongside RIVE Private Investment and other existing shareholders. In a first step, the investors are putting in €112 million. On top of that, the financing includes a €80 million upsizing option.

rows.title: Embotech’s Autonomous Tractor Solution approved for production deployment
rows.summary: The TÜV SÜD EC-Type Examination Certificate granted to Embotech for its Autonomous Tractor Solution and CE marking confirm the system is approved for autonomous operations in industrial logistics. Embotech now holds two independently certified Level-4 systems, making it the first company with multiple autonomous driving solutions.

rows.title: Growth capital to fuel SIS Medical's next steps
rows.summary: SIS attracts Claret Capital Partners as investor. The investment will support SIS Medical’s continued international expansion, commercial scale-up, and innovation roadmap.

rows.title: Sustainable materials company secures CHF 4 million ahead of market launch
rows.summary: The market launch of noriware’s plastic-free packaging solution, norifresh, is anticipated to take place this year — a six-figure pre-order has already been placed. The startup has obtained fresh funding of CHF 4 million from family offices and private investors to support this next step.

rows.title: Recognition for cleantech startups: Watt d’Or holds final prize
rows.summary: Two projects involving three Swiss startups were awarded the Watt d’Or prize for their contribution to the clean energy transition. The 2026 award ceremony marked the final edition of the competition after 19 years. The Canton of Fribourg has awarded GreenGT CHF 290,000 to develop an optimized low-carbon supply chain and logistics project, while Composite Recycling secured a ticket to pitch its solution at the World Economic Forum in Davos.

rows.title: MyBikePlan wird Teil der deutschen Nr.1 für Fahrrad-Leasing
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Start-up MyBikePlan, das sich seit seiner Gründung 2019 zum grössten Buy-Now-Pay-Later-Anbieter für Velos und E-Bikes der Schweiz entwickelt hat, wird von der JobRad Holding SE mit Sitz in Freiburg (DE) übernommen. JobRad wird MyBikePlan bei der europaweiten Expansion unterstützen.

rows.title: Copresence launches photorealistic 3D avatars with AAA gaming companies
rows.summary: Since the release of its Version 1.0 platform, Copresence has seen over 30,000 avatars created by indie developers and 3D artists. The company has now partnered with multiple AAA gaming studios to integrate end-user scanning, allowing every player to play as themselves. As part of its strategic B2B expansion, Copresence is set to go live in 2026 within major AAA titles that reach audiences of multiple millions.

rows.title: First EIC Information Day after regaining access to the European programme
rows.summary: With a budget of € 1.4 billion for 2026, the EIC programme offers great opportunities for Swiss-based researchers and innovators. This full-day event will cover the entire EIC portfolio — from early-stage ground-breaking research to market-ready deep-tech innovation and scale-up support — delivered with insights directly from experts of the European Innovation Council.

rows.title: Santhera obtains regulatory approval in Switzerland
rows.summary: Swiss Agency for Therapeutic Products (Swissmedic), has approved Santhera Pharmaceuticals’ drug candidate AGAMREE (vamorolone) for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in patients four years of age and older. The marks Santhera's seventh global marketing approval and grants the company a 15-year exclusivity period under Swiss orphan drug status. Launching in Switzerland is anticipated later in 2026.

rows.title: Diplotools, Impli and Hafnova get FIT funding
rows.summary: The Lausanne-based Foundation for Innovation and Technology (FIT) is supporting three new innovations. Impli is receiving a CHF 100,000 Tech Seed loan for its biosensor for monitoring fertility hormones. Meanwhile, Diplotools, with its platform aimed at optimising the efficiency of foreign ministries, and Hafnova, with its European cybersecurity solution focused on user protection, are each receiving a Digital Seed loan worth CHF 50,000.

rows.title: CHF 3.4M to scale AlphaLum optics and sensing platform for smart glasses
rows.summary: AlphaLum, developing advanced optics and sensing technologies for augmented reality, has closed its CHF 3.4 million seed financing round. With this funding, the company accelerates its transition from advanced engineering to becoming a core technology supplier for upcoming smart glasses and spatial-computing product generations, positioning AlphaLum as a key European provider of high-efficiency optical technologies.

rows.title: 20 top entrepreneurs join Project Switzerland to scale next tech leaders
rows.summary: Today marks the launch of Project Switzerland, a national initiative aiming to support the next generation of global market leaders. The initiative focuses on direct exchange between CEOs of fast-growing start-ups and successful entrepreneurs.

rows.title: Gründer verkaufen PLAKATIV, um weiteres Wachstum zu ermöglichen
rows.summary: PLAKATIV bietet Künstlerinnen und Künstlern eine Plattform, um ihre Poster- und Kleidungsdesigns zu verkaufen. Um die Marke in die nächste Wachstumsphase zu führen, haben die Gründer ihr Unternehmen nach drei Jahren eigenständiger Skalierung per Anfang 2026 an eine private Holding verkauft.

rows.title: SayNode sammelt frische Mittel für eigene Softwarelösungen ein
rows.summary: SayNode Operations hat in einer Finanzierungsrunde rund 600’000 Franken von sechs Angel-Investoren eingesammelt. Das Berner Startup entwickelt nicht nur Blockchain-basierte Software-Lösungen im Kundenauftrag, sondern plant nun auch den Ausbau seiner eigenen Produkte SkillBuddy und Stutz.

rows.title: Stiftungen bündeln Kräfte für Fachhochschul-Spin-offs
rows.summary: First Ventures unterstützt seit sieben Jahren Fachhochschul-Spin-offs und wurde bisher von der Gebert Rüf Stiftung getragen. Nun erhält das Programm mit der Albert Koechlin Stiftung eine Partnerin, die für die Jahre 2026 bis 2029 bis zu 1,2 Millionen Franken bereitstellt, um gezielt Ausgründungen der Hochschule Luzern (HSLU) zu fördern. Dieses Partnerschaftsmodell soll auch in anderen Regionen repliziert werden.

rows.title: Aiving powers ahead of Winter Olympics with figure skating champion
rows.summary: Swiss sports technology company Aiving has partnered with figure skating champion Kevin Aymoz as preparations intensify for the European Figure Skating Championships, introducing Swiss-engineered performance analysis into high-level training environments. The partnership with Kevin Aymoz is part of the strategy to launch Aiving's consumer product at the Milano-Cortina Winter Olympic Games in February 2026.

rows.title: FAB STUDIO acquired by influencer marketing world leader YKONE
rows.summary: With the acquisition of early-stage creative agency FAB STUDIO, France-based YKONE has established itself in Zurich with the aim of building the strongest creator and social media ecosystem in Switzerland. The Zurich-based agency will operate under the brand name YKONE Zurich.

rows.title: Executive hires to help startups scale
rows.summary: Six startups have made strategic changes in their executive teams by hiring new experienced leaders to fuel their growth. A new CEO has been appointed to lead SOPHiA Genetics while other startups welcomed a new Chief Operations Officer, and Chief Business Office and Chief Marketing Officers.

rows.title: Threema transfers ownership the second time
rows.summary: Swiss privacy-focused company Threema has transferred ownership to the Germany-based firm Comitis Capital GmbH. Since 2020, the company had been under the leadership of private equity firm Afinum Management GmbH which held a majority stake and supported the company through its growth phase.

rows.title: Johnson & Johnson invests in DistalMotion
rows.summary: DistalMotion, the Lausanne-based company empowering access to robotic surgery in outpatient sites of care, has secured a strategic investment from Johnson & Johnson, through its corporate venture capital organization, Johnson & Johnson Innovation. The funding will be used to advance the Ambulatory Surgery Centers expansion of the Dexter robotic surgery system.

rows.title: Swedish company to save Future Holding’s existence through acquisition
rows.summary: Following a review by the Issuer Committee of SIX Swiss Exchange, Management and the Board of Directors have decided to pause Future Holdings AG’s current project in its existing structure. The recently obtained $28 million in November 2025 has been reimbursed to investors and the company is set to be acquired by Swedish Bitcoin treasury company, H100, for a total purchase price of CHF 600,000.

rows.title: Preventive health startup Ahead Health secures $6 million
rows.summary: Ahead Health, the Zurich-based preventive healthcare company providing an AI-powered platform to democratise access to sophisticated preventative healthcare, has finalized its seed funding round, raising $6 million. Led by RTP Global, the proceeds of the round will be used to fuel growth and expansion by entering new geographies, expanding the team and enhancing the company’s capabilities.

rows.title: Life sciences and cleantech startups compete for CHF 100,000
rows.summary: Seven startups have reached the final round of the Ypsomed Innovation Award, which grants a total of CHF 100,000 to three outstanding founders. The winners of this year’s edition will be announced during the award night on 22 January 2026.

rows.title: Dank Millioneninvestment: Oxoia plant Expansion in EU-Märkte
rows.summary: Das CleanTech-Startup Oxoia hat über ein Convertible Loan Agreement (CLA) eine Million Franken eingesammelt. Mit seiner KI-gestützten Software zur Minimierung des Energieverbrauchs in Gebäuden konnte das Unternehmen sowohl auf Kunden- als auch auf Partnerseite zulegen und plant nun die Expansion in weitere europäische Märkte.

rows.title: FluoSphera Raises CHF 1.15M to Scale Human-Based Preclinical Platform
rows.summary: FluoSphera, the Swiss biotech startup redefining how new drugs are tested for safety and efficacy, has raised CHF 1.15 million. The funding round was led by Soulmates Ventures and a Swiss business angel, with participation from IndieBio New York. Already working with international pharma partners and research labs, FluoSphera will use the funding to scale commercial collaborations, grow its business development team, and expand its AI and automation capabilities for large-scale imaging analysis.

rows.title: USD 2.15M to build the backbone of Ex Nunc trustworthy legal intelligence
rows.summary: Ex Nunc Intelligence is building a new category of legal intelligence focused on reliability, traceability, and professional secrecy, an approach that has already attracted several hundred legal professionals to its Silex platform. The company has successfully closed an oversubscribed pre-seed round of USD 2.15 million, led by Spicehaus Partners.

rows.title: MedTech startups take home grants to advance their diagnostic technology
rows.summary: Two Basel-based MedTech startups have received prestigious grants to accelerate the development of their novel diagnostic technologies. MOMM Diagnostics, developer of a point-of-care test to detect preeclampsia, has received the Gates Foundation Grand Challenge grant, in the “Preeclampsia Burden” category. AiMorphous, which won first prize in the 2025 International IntelliSense InnovateX Contest in Shanghai, has received the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation Incu-Bio Programme Grant to bring their AI-powered blood diagnostics tool to clinical practice.

rows.title: CHF 10 million seed funding and new board chair for TECregen
rows.summary: TECregen, a Basel-based biotech company pioneering thymus regeneration, has secured CHF 10 million in a seed financing round led by the Boehringer Ingelheim Venture Fund with participation from several investors. The investment will be used to advance TECregen’s thymopoietic biologics, designed to rejuvenate thymic epithelial cells, restore immune function, and strengthen overall immune resilience. The company has also strengthened its board member with a new chairperson.

rows.title: TOFWERK joins the Bruker family
rows.summary: Bruker Corporation has secured an additional 60% equity stake in TOFWERK AG, granting it full ownership of the company. TOFWERK, a specialist in ultra-fast time-of-flight (TOF) mass spectrometry technology for small molecule applied markets, has grown into a well-established scale-up with a team of 130 employees and about  $40 million in revenue.

rows.title: Ready for take-off
rows.summary: UBS supports start-ups in their growth phase with debt capital. One such is Spacetek Technology: the Bern-based company makes measuring instruments for next-generation chip factories.

rows.title: Intelligence-Plattform für Public-Affairs und Corporate-Communications gut gestartet
rows.summary: Das Zuger Start-up Delos Analytica hat seine KI-gestützte Intelligence Platform Delos offiziell lanciert. Sie vereint Issue- und Stakeholderbeobachtung, politisches und mediales Monitoring sowie teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit für Grossunternehmen und weitere Grossorganisationen. Die Lösung ist bereits bei über 20 Kunden im Einsatz.

rows.title: Pupsic joins forces with Kainjoo SA
rows.summary: Kainjoo SA announces the acquisition of Pupsic, a revenue operations agency headquartered in Morges with distributed engineering capabilities across Bosnia, Ukraine, Hungary, and Mexico. The acquisition creates a group structure serving organizations from four-person startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, with each requiring distinct execution models at different stages of growth. The acquisition includes Pupsic's portfolio of over 40 active clients across Europe.

rows.title: Zug-based ZenChain secures $8.5 million
rows.summary: ZenChain, a Layer1 blockchain solution designed to enhance cross-chain interoperability, particularly between Bitcoin and Ethereum, has closed $8.5 million in funding, led by Watermelon Capital, DWF Labs, and Genesis Capital to accelerate its growth. The company secured an additional $1.5 million committed by angel investors ahead of ZenChain’s upcoming Token Generation Event.

rows.title: Significant Advances in Pharmaceutical Pipelines for Underserved Diseases
rows.summary: Oculis, Legacy Healthcare and Neurosterix are advancing their drug pipelines with major clinical milestones. Oculis’ Privosegtor received breakthrough therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the treatment of optic neuritis, while Legacy Healthcare is advancing its first botanical medication Cinainu to Phase 3 trials after the FDA cleared their investigational new drug (IND) filing. Neurosterix has started Phase 1 trials for NTX-253, a drug-candidate to treat schizophrenia.

rows.title: Global demand for smart diabetes management systems fuels OneTwenty’s growth
rows.summary: The bioX software, embedded into existing medical hardware such as insulin pumps, is an intelligent system that predicts metabolic shifts and enables autonomous, individualized insulin delivery. With early adopters worldwide already testing bioX in their devices, OneTwenty has achieved 182% revenue growth in 2025.

rows.title: Strategische Neubesetzungen in Deep-Tech und IT-Startups
rows.summary: In der drei Startups aus dem Kanton Zürich stehen Managementwechsel an. UNISERS ernennt einen neuen CEO, Ason Payroll Engine besetzt die Geschäftsleitung mit einem erfahrenen Serial-Gründer und CircleUp gewinnt einen neuen CTO zur Verstärkung der technischen Entwicklung.

rows.title: Erfolgreicher Start für Bee People
rows.summary: Das St. Moritzer Startup Bee People hat vor wenigen Monaten den Vertrieb seiner Nahrungsergänzungskapseln und Bio-Propolis- und Honigprodukte aufgenommen. Die Produkte sind bereits in über 20 führenden Apotheken und Drogerien in der Schweiz erhältlich. Nun plant das Unternehmen den Markteintritt in China.

rows.title: Techponics wins Major Commercial Project in Kuwait
rows.summary: Techponics, Swiss innovator in automated crop production systems, announces the launch of a strategic commercial project in Kuwait in partnership with Green Life Company, a trusted regional leader in sustainable agriculture. This collaboration highlights Techponics’ unique global innovation - dynamic spacing technology - and demonstrates strong market traction for efficient, high-yield leafy greens production in extreme climatic conditions.

rows.title: Switzerland Shines as a Deep Tech Hub at CES 2026
rows.summary: The first days at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) have already been exciting for several Swiss startups—Algorized and the KUKA Group unveiled a new robot with intuition, Punkt. showcased its new minimalist smartphone, and Nutrix secured the CES Innovation Award. The Global Deep Tech Battle powered by swisstech has attracted a global audience with 48 startups representing 12 countries, positioning Switzerland as the Deep Tech hub for CES. Neurosoft Bioelectronics is taking home one of the first prizes.

rows.title: Profit-Plus: sun2wheel und convoltas erschliessen neues Ertragspotenzial für Solarstrom
rows.summary: Die von sun2wheel neu entwickelte Technologie bündelt zahlreiche PV-Anlagen in der ganzen Schweiz zu einem grossen virtuellen Kraftwerk. Gemeinsam mit convoltas vereinfacht das Luzerner Startup Besitzern von PV-Anlagen die Teilnahme am Regelenergiemarkt und ermöglicht ihnen damit zusätzliche Einkünfte.

rows.title: Thriving Revario hits milestone CHF 1M turnover
rows.summary: The Fribourg-based sportswear startup Revario has just hit CHF 1 million in sales. This achievement is even more remarkable given that the company, founded by Michael Ingram, has so far sold its technical outdoor gear almost exclusively in Suisse Romande.

rows.title: Windward Bio signs new licensing agreement to expand clinical pipeline
rows.summary: Windward Bio announced at the end of 2025 a licensing agreement between its affiliate company LE2025 Therapeutics AG and Qyuns Therapeutics for the development and commercialization of WIN027 (previously known as QX027N), a highly potent, long-acting bispecific antibody with best-in-disease potential in respiratory and dermatology diseases. With a deal of up to $700M, this licensing agreement allows Windward Bio to develop and commercialize WIN027 globally, excluding China.

rows.title: First OEM Adopts Gapfruit’s Birth Certificate Provisioning Service
rows.summary: Miromico, a Zurich-based high‑tech engineering company, has become the first Original Equipment Manufacturer to adopt the Gapfruit Birth Certificate Provisioning Service in full-scale production. With this strategic move, Miromico ensures that every device leaves the factory equipped with a tamper-resistant, hardware-rooted identity certificate, providing cryptographic proof of origin.

rows.title: Startups sichern sich mehrere Millionen von der Crowd
rows.summary: Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen haben mittels Crowdfunding frisches Kapital eingesammelt, um Expansion, Produktentwicklung und neue Technologien voranzutreiben. Die Projekte reichen von KI-gestützten Katzenklappen über AR-Skibrillen und nachhaltige Outdoor-Kleidung bis zu Plattformen für Emissionsgutschriften und Specialty Coffee.

rows.title: Taskbase acquires Micromate redefine corporate learning
rows.summary: Taskbase, the Swiss edtech startup focused on personalized learning solutions, has acquired Micromate, a corporate micro-learning startup. The companies will combine their expertise, setting a major step for Taskbase to deliver the best AI coaches for companies, reshaping how employees learn at work.

rows.title: Verstärkung für die Expansion
rows.summary: Vier Start-ups haben ihr Management für die anstehende Wachstumsphase gestärkt: Wyden, Cancret, sallea und LEASETEQ. Das nachhaltige Baustoff-Startup Cancret hat dabei mit dem neuen CEO, auch einen neuen Hauptaktionär gewonnen.

rows.title: InstaHeat signs first customer deal under new ohmic heating standards
rows.summary: Following its influence on the change of the global regulation for the ohmic heating, InstaHeat is advancing the development of its Heatflow device for a range of appliances, including coffee machines. The startup has signed its first commercial deal with Rex Royal, one of the largest coffee machine manufacturers.

rows.title: SpacePNT achieves green light for manufacturing its multi-GNSS receiver in larger quantities
rows.summary: SpacePNT has completed the extensive qualification testing of its second-generation product. Products have already been ordered by several customers to fly in various demanding Earth observation, in-orbit servicing and space exploration missions. A second generation product will be also used for the ESA GENESIS satellite mission.

rows.title: Tenity turns 10: next chapter focuses on AI-enabled digital finance on blockchain
rows.summary: More than 250 startups have undergone the Tenity proprietary programs since its inception in 2015, with over 70% of them still operational. Over the past decade, the organization has expanded its investment activities to include CHF 120 million assets under management, holding more than 200 portfolio companies. In the next phase, Tenity will focus its investments and programmes around AI, Blockchain and Digital Assets.

rows.title: CHF 55 million committed for Übermorgen’s fund
rows.summary: Übermorgen Ventures completed the first closing for its semi-liquid Übermorgen Ventures Investment Fund just before the Christmas. The fund's total committed capital now stands at around CHF 55 million.

rows.title: More start-ups – more bankruptcies
rows.summary: Accordig to a new analysis by IFJ - Institut für Jungunternehmen a clear new record was set in 2025 for the number of companies founded. 55,654 new companies were entered in the commercial register. At the same time, the number of bankruptcies also rose to a record high. This resulted in a net increase of 40,669 companies in the commercial register in 2025.

rows.title: Rise PropTech Fund investiert in viboo
rows.summary: Gebäudeenergie-Optimierer viboo erhält Unterstützung vom belgischen Rise PropTech Fund. Das zusätzliche Investment erfolgt im Anschluss an das bereits kommunizierte Funding in Höhe von 3,3 Millionen Franken.

rows.title: NEMIS Technologies gains a foothold in North America
rows.summary: NEMIS's N-Light system is already trusted by major European food producers across industries ranging from meat and seafood to dairy, retail, and ready-to-eat products enabling them to conduct simple, reliable, and rapid pathogen detection directly on-site. California-based Hardy Diagnostics will introduce NEMIS's solutions to the North American market as part of an exclusive strategic partnership.

rows.title: DiNAQOR spin-off emerges from stealth with new CEO and peer-reviewed publication
rows.summary: DiNAQOR’s new percutaneous platform enables highly precise, organ-isolated delivery of advanced therapies. To accelerate clinical translation and commercialization, initially with a focus on kidney-targeted gene therapy, DiNAQOR has spun out this technology and its dedicated renal development programs into, DiNATEQ AG. DiNATEQ AG will be led by Dr. Christian Thirion as Chief Executive Officer and Delegate of the Board of Directors.

rows.title: YeastUp set for industrial-scale production
rows.summary: In light of the growing demand for its functional yeast protein Yeastin and dietary fiber ingredient UpFiber (Beta-Glucan), YeastUp has opened a state-of-the-art production plant in Lyss. The new facility enables industrial-scale production of up to 40 hectolitres per hour, marking a key milestone in the company’s growth.

rows.title: Major customers for sustainable synthetic ice and fuel
rows.summary: Two cleantech startups have won major clients to support their sustainable solutions.  Luzern-based sportstech innovator, Glice, has installed its first zero-power ice rink featuring new technology StellarGlide™ at LEGOLAND Deutschland Resort, covering 550 m². Synhelion and the Swiss international Air Lines have also expanded their partnership to five years, setting the foundation to decarbonize flight operations.

rows.title: SCALE receives CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to democratize laser-based sensing
rows.summary: SCALE Lasers has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to create a new class of mid-infrared semiconductor lasers designed for portable and multicolor sensing. Its technology has the potential to transform high-end mid-infrared sensing applications into ubiquitous, everyday technology.

rows.title: Matrix One acquires Swiss digital health company
rows.summary: Dokspot GmbH, a Zurich-based globally active SaaS platform specialized in electronic Instructions for Use for the medical and life sciences industry is now part of Germany based company, Matrix One.

rows.title: LumRisk undergoes restructuring with USD 5 million in new capital
rows.summary: LumRisk, a fintech company specializing in state-of-the-art risk consolidation, analysis and reporting services for institutional clients has announced a corporate reset which includes the restructuring of legacy obligations and the reinforcement of the company’s balance sheet. Shareholders have committed $5 million in fresh funding to support these developments and the launch of a new platform.

rows.title: Regulatory approval and a milestone payment for Swiss biotechs
rows.summary: Memo Therapeutics has obtained orphan designation in the European Union for its drug candidate potravitug for the treatment of BK polyomavirus (BKPyV) infection in kidney transplant recipients. Numab Therapeutics on the other hand has achieved a milestone payment from its partner Boehringer Ingelheim. This achievement will see the pharma giant further advance two Numab programs into preclinical development.

rows.title: Xlife Sciences transitions from Sparks segment to main segment of SIX Swiss Exchange
rows.summary: The Sparks segment was established by SIX Swiss Exchange in 2021 to give SMEs a listing option tailored to their needs. Now, Xlife Sciences, the only company listed in the Sparks segment, is transitioning to the main market of the Swiss stock exchange.

rows.title: Key recognitions and awards for Swiss Startups
rows.summary: From Paris to Boston and Yverdon-les-Bains, four Swiss startups have made a name for themselves with novel solutions in key areas such as space cybersecurity, rare earth recycling and advanced tools to accelerate the development of safe, life-changing therapies for patients.

rows.title: Peelpack financially braced to transform waste into packaging
rows.summary: Foodtech startup PeelPack is developing biodegradable and compostable packaging made from upcycled potato peels. By offering an alternative to conventional plastic and paper punnets, the startup aims to reduce the environmental footprint of fresh produce distribution and waste management. The financial support from Venture kick will accelerate further developments.

rows.title: €13.9 million for glucose-monitoring wearable
rows.summary: Liom, the developer of the world’s first non-invasive glucose-monitoring wearable, has secured additional €13.9 million (CHF 13 million) in its Series A extension round, bringing its total Series A to CHF 38 million and total funding to date to CHF 63 million. The funds will fuel product developments, with the launch anticipated for 2028.

rows.title: Five scale-up companies awarded SEF.Growth High Potential Label
rows.summary: The SEF.Growth High Potential Label has been awarded to five fast-growing startups offering technologies and solutions that transform agriculture, asset mapping, fraud management, nutrition, and digital plant purchases. The label will enhance the startups' market positioning and visibility.

rows.title: A key acquisition and AI lab to power BackBone
rows.summary: With the acquisition of Volted.ai, a revolutionary generative AI technology for high-quality image and video workflows, Geneva-based Backbone is set to accelerate the real estate industry’s shift to AI-driven marketing. With this move, a dedicated Backbone AI lab is now being established to drive better visuals, faster delivery times, and smarter across the entire platform.

rows.title: Enlightra raises USD 15 million to tackle the biggest bottleneck in AI infrastructure
rows.summary: Enlightra, a Swiss-American deeptech startup building chip-scale multiwavelength lasers for next-generation data transmission, announced it has raised a total of $15 million to make data transfer faster and more energy efficient.

rows.title: Levitate Aerospace sichert sich Kapital für Weiterentwicklung und Pilotprojekte
rows.summary: Kurz nach dem Erstflug eines Prototypen seines Hybrid-Gleiters hat sich das Berner Startup Levitate Aerospace eine Brückenfinanzierung im niedrigen sechsstelligen Bereich gesichert. Das Kapital fliesst in die Weiterentwicklung der Plattform, in regulatorische Vorbereitungen für autonome Flüge sowie in die Umsetzung erster Pilotprojekte mit Infrastrukturkunden.

rows.title: Neural Concept closes $100M funding round to scale AI-Native engineering
rows.summary: Neural Concept, a global AI platform and leader in Engineering Intelligence powering next-generation product development, today announced it raised a $100 million Series C funding round led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives. The company has generated a fourfold increase in enterprise revenue over the past 18 months.

rows.title: Bumpy stock market start for Mindmaze
rows.summary: MindMaze Therapeutics Holding SA completed its business combination with NeuroX Group SA (NeuroX), a commercial-stage company delivering evidence-based, precision digital treatments for neurological diseases. After a sharp decline in the first half of the week, the share price has recovered and is now fluctuating around CHF 2.75, valuing the company at around CHF 425 million.

rows.title: like2camp wird Teil von Nomady
rows.summary: Zwei Camping-Startups werden eins: Nomady integriert die Österreichische Plattform like2camp, um ein gemeinsames Angebot für naturnahes Camping in der DACH-Region zu schaffen. Die Plattform nomady.camp wird künftig der zentrale Marktplatz für alle bestehenden und neuen Angebote sein. like2camp bleibt als Produkt und Marke innerhalb von Nomady bestehen – mit dem Ziel, im österreichischen Tourismusumfeld weiter an Bekanntheit zu gewinnen und regionale Expertise auszubauen.

rows.title: Executive reshuffle in ICT and Biotech startups
rows.summary: Four seasoned industry leaders have assumed new executive roles in Swiss startups, bringing with them vast experience to drive the companies through their envisioned growth phase. Their new responsibilities include supporting expansion plans and the ongoing clinical trials.

rows.title: FoRx Therapeutics raises $50 million to advance clinical trials
rows.summary: In August this year, FoRx Therapeutic initiated its first human trial Phase 1 clinical development of its lead drug candidate, FORX-428,  designed to target and disrupt the DNA Damage Response in advanced solid tumors. The company has now obtained USD 50 million (CHF 40 million) Series A funding to advance the study.

rows.title: Validation and growth for Genknowme
rows.summary: With CHF 500,000 in funding raised earlier this year and a growing adoption of its products by Swiss health insurers, Swiss epigenetic startup Genknowme co-founded by Semira and Sébastien Nusslé, is thriving.

rows.title: Augmented Reality für die Baustelle: Siresca setzt Expansion fort
rows.summary: Siresca digitalisiert Elektroinstallationen auf Baustellen: Mit seiner cloudbasierten App und Webplattform erleichtert das Zürcher Startup Messungen, Positionierungen und Dokumentation für Installateure und Projektleiter. Nach starkem Wachstum in der Schweiz und der DACH-Region expandiert das Unternehmen nun auch nach Norditalien.

rows.title: Von Ferienunterkünften bis Einbruchschutz: Startups sammeln Kapital aus der Crowd
rows.summary: Vier Startups setzen derzeit auf Crowdfunding, um ihre Angebote weiterzuentwickeln – von exklusiven Ferienunterkünften über Orientierungshilfen für Menschen mit Sehbehinderung bis hin zu Sicherheits- und Gesundheitslösungen. Während Oazo Homes Services und Lighthouse Tech ihre Kampagnen bereits erfolgreich abgeschlossen haben, sammeln Malaica und Mitipi weiterhin Kapital.

rows.title: CCRAFT, Databaum and Lemna Bio get FIT financing
rows.summary: The first loan supports the world's first foundry capable of producing TFLN chips, an innovation developed by start-up CCRAFT; another loan supports Databaum, an artificial intelligence platform for farmers that transforms raw data from the field into intelligent decisions; and the last to Lemna Bio, where artificial intelligence is used to understand biological interactions. All three companies are supported by the Foundation for Innovation and Technology (FIT) in the form of Tech Seed loans worth CHF 100,000 each.

rows.title: DayOne Digital Health programs deliver impressive results
rows.summary: Start-ups from the current DayOne accelerator batch presented their work at the first DayOne Innovation Showcase event, which took place in Basel last week. The results of the Innovation Booster Digital Health Nation programme powered by Innosuisse, which is coming to an end after four years, were also presented.

rows.title: Swiss-US startup HomeBuddy acquired for $190 million
rows.summary: Established by Schwyz-based SIREN GROUP AG, HomeBuddy is a digital marketplace platform that matches homeowners with the most appropriate home services professional. QuinStreet, a leader in performance marketplaces and technologies for the financial and home services industries, has now acquired HomeBuddy for a total of $190 million — including $115 million in cash at closing.

rows.title: Swiss mobile startups ready to grow internationally
rows.summary: For the upcoming Mobile World Congress in Barcelona, Venturelab has selected ten mobile startups with diverse solutions to travel to Spain. Besides exploring new trends, they will showcase and pitch their solutions to a global audience as well as meet potential investors and partners.

rows.title: FIF Grants awarded to three Academic Spin-off Projects from Geneva
rows.summary: In a first for the Fonds pour l’Innovation et le Futur de Genève (FIF), two startup projects from the University of Geneva and one project from CERN have each received a grant of CHF 50,000 The beneficiaries include POSICS, a spin-off from the Faculty of Science, Vectopia, a spin-off from the Faculty of Medicine, and Geneva Connection Technologies, a spin-off from CERN.

rows.title: Soverli raises $2.6M pre-seed capital
rows.summary: ETH Zurich spin-off Soverli is developing a sovereign operating system layer that works alongside Android and iOS to make any commercial smartphone secure. In a pre-seed round led by Founderful, the company secured $2.6 million to support product development and pilot projects.

rows.title: Scriveo lanciert KI-Rechtsplattform und wächst mit Partnern
rows.summary: Scriveo hat einen hybriden Rechtsservice für Unternehmen und Privatpersonen lanciert. Das LegalTech-Startup kombiniert eine KI-basierte Plattform mit der Expertise erfahrener Juristinnen und Juristen. Mit ersten Partnerschaften und Blick auf eine Expansion im DACH-Raum treibt das Unternehmen sein Wachstum weiter voran.

rows.title: Los Angeles cloud production studio acquires PRODUCER
rows.summary: PRODUCER.io is a Swiss-based production management platform trusted by with more than 20’000 users, including in-house media departments worldwide. The company has joined the family of CREE8, a cloud production studio platform that helps creative teams work more efficiently — complementing the parent company’s cloud-powered workstations.

rows.title: KI für mehr Sicherheit am Berg: Mantis wächst im Ausland
rows.summary: Mantis Ropeway Technologies treibt seine internationale Expansion voran: Nach ersten Installationen in der Schweiz und Österreich kommen die KI-gestützten Sicherheitssysteme inzwischen auch in Italien, Deutschland, Kanada und den USA zum Einsatz. Gleichzeitig baut Mantis sein Portfolio aus und lanciert ein zweites Produkt.

rows.title: Ionic Wind secures US $2.1M to industrialize Solid-state cooling technology
rows.summary: Empa Spin-Off Ionic Wind has closed an oversubscribed US $2.1 million pre-seed round led by SICTIC to fast-track the industrialization of its solid-state airflow technology. The funding will accelerate the rollout of Ionic Wind’s ultra-thin, silent airflow accelerators – a new class of cooling modules with unprecedented design freedom that can eliminate the need for mechanical fans.

rows.title: Altiscreen obtains support to accelerate rapid drug test
rows.summary: Medtech startup Altiscreen has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to build and accelerate the development of a portable drug-testing solution that delivers clear results in just three minutes. Its device is designed to support roadside checks, workplace screening, and mobile healthcare teams that need reliable information on the spot.

rows.title: Fresh funding for defence tech startup MindGuard
rows.summary: MindGuard AG, the 2025-established company at the interface of artificial intelligence, military psychology, and neuroscience, has secured funding from Mountain Alliance AG, representing the company’s second transaction in the defence industry. The funding allows applying this technology into real world security-related applications.

rows.title: SK Capital acquires majority stake in Swixx Biopharma at EUR 1.5 billion valuation
rows.summary: HBM Healthcare Investments, together with the founders and other shareholders such as Mérieux Equity Partners, will sell a majority of their current stake in Swixx Biopharma to SK Capital Partners, while retaining a significant minority stake. The investment by SK Capital values the company in excess of EUR 1.5 billion.

rows.title: CE Mark for Swiss medical devices
rows.summary: Medtech startups Artiria Medical, Compremium and Enantios have obtained a CE Mark under the new European Medical Device Regulation, allowing them to commercialize their solutions in the European market.

rows.title: USD 5 million to accelerate ALLEGRIA’s anti-allergy portfolio
rows.summary: ALLEGRIA Therapeutics, a biotech company redefining the treatment landscape of therapeutics for mast cell-mediated diseases, has secured USD 5.1 million in its seed extension financing led by ALK Abelló. The proceeds from the round will be used to fast track the company’s growth.

rows.title: Swiss delegation warms up for CES 2026 in Las Vegas
rows.summary: The upcoming year will again kick off with the annual Consumer Electronic Show (CES) in Las Vegas, held on 6-9 January 2026. Close to 150’000 professional visitors from the technology sector including Swiss startup founders will convene to explore and showcase new trends and innovations. The majority of the Swiss delegation – 12 out of 17 startups – will be supported by Innosuisse to exhibit, network and get the latest insights in their application fields.

rows.title: New strategic investor to support Testmate US efforts
rows.summary: Biopôle-based Testmate Health and Intermountain Health have announced a strategic partnership and investment to accelerate access to rapid, low-cost molecular tests for sexually transmitted infections (STIs) in the U.S. Set to become a shareholder in Testmate, Intermountain Health will support the company in clinical validation and trials until FDA approval.

rows.title: EM Technologies lanciert Lösung zur Stressreduktion
rows.summary: Nach der Markteinführung seines stressreduzierenden EMTech Chairs beginnt für die Berner EM Technologies die Expansionsphase in der Schweiz und im Ausland. Zur Unterstützung der Expansion hat das Spin-off der Universität Bern eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen.

rows.title: Growing demand takes INERGIO next level
rows.summary: With test requests almost fully booked until February 2026 and new customers in key markets in Europe and North America, INERGIO is booming. As 2025 draws to a close, the Swiss cleantech is preparing to embark on another pivotal year.

rows.title: Biotechs advance therapies against bacterial infections and peanut allergies
rows.summary: Biotech startups BioVersys and Mabylon have initiated their phase 3 and phase 1 clinical trials to evaluate their lead candidates BV100 for drug-resistant infections and MY006 for peanut allergy, respectively. AC Immune’s phase 2 study has concluded, and interim results have been published.

rows.title: Aukera Therapeutics welcomes industry veteran as investor and board member
rows.summary: Founded as a spin-off from the University of Basel, Aukera is officially coming out of stealth as it enters preclinical efficacy studies for its first‑in‑class, fully selective mTORC1 (RAPTOR) inhibitors. The company has raised some CHF 4.5M to date and attracted former Numab Therapeutics CEO David Urech as board member and investor.

rows.title: Startups score prizes across Asia and Germany
rows.summary: In recognition of their innovative solutions — from digitally printed solar cells and scenario-based modelling to sono-instruments and solar fuels — juries in Taiwan, the Middle East, China, and Germany awarded startups with cash prizes and support.

rows.title: zevvy stärkt Partnernetzwerk
rows.summary: Das Luzerner Jungunternehmen zevvy vereinfacht die Abrechnung von Solarstrom, Wärme, Wasser und Elektroladestationen. Neben neuen Kooperationen in der Schweiz hat das Unternehmen inzwischen auch mehrere Partnerschaften im Ausland abgeschlossen.

rows.title: Startups überzeugen mit nachhaltigen Lösungen
rows.summary: Die EKT Energiestiftung unterstützt zwei innovative Energieprojekte, während ecomade mit seinen recycelbaren Matratzen beim deutschen Bundespreis Ecodesign überzeugt. Zudem erhalten drei weitere Startups Fördermittel für Lösungen in den Bereichen Mehrwegversand, CO₂-Management und Solarstromhandel.

rows.title: DigeHealth secures CHF 1.25 million seed round
rows.summary: Biopôle-based DigeHealth SA, a Swiss medtech company developing a wearable device that “listens to the gut” to support early detection and management of gastro-intestinal complications, today announced the successful closing of a CHF 1.25 million Seed round.

rows.title: New members of the Executive Committee and reorganisation of the Innosuisse Office
rows.summary: Innosuisse is appointing new members to its Executive Committee and aligning its organisational set-up: from 1 January and 1 February 2026 respectively, Agnès Petit Markowski will become Head of the new Project & Programme Funding division and Noemi Rom will take on her role as Head of the new Advisory, Networks and Strategy division. Both of them will play key roles in the ongoing reorganisation of the Office, which will will make Innosuisse more agile, more focused on its impact and more closely in touch with the innovation ecosystem.

rows.title: KEMARO bringt Reinigungs-Roboter in die USA
rows.summary: Das Ostschweizer Startup KEMARO gründet mit KEMARO INC eine Tochtergesellschaft in den USA. Das Unternehmen hat dort bereits erste Installationen und Pilotprojekte umgesetzt und baut nun zusammen mit neuen Partnern den lokalen Service weiter aus. Für die Unterützung der Expansion ist KEMARO eine strategische Partnerschaft mit der ELT System Group eingegangen.

rows.title: First study on Swiss Venture Capital returns provides encouraging findings
rows.summary: One important reason why pension funds and other institutional investors have not invested in Swiss VCs in the past was the lack of performance data. A new study, conducted by the University of Basel, partnered with and co-published by SECA and Deep Tech Nation Switzerland Foundation, provides this data. And the results are respectable.

rows.title: Assaia finalises $26.6m Series B round to scale aviation technology
rows.summary: Assaia, the Zurich-based aviation technology company dedicated to optimizing the commercial aircraft turnaround process, has raised $26.6m in an oversubscribed Series B funding round led by Armira Growth. The funds will enable the company to scale and expand its product range.

rows.title: Proptech startup vyzn secures seed funding to accelerate further growth
rows.summary: In the light of its current developments and the growing demand in Switzerland and Germany, vyzn has obtained fresh capital in a seed funding round to further scale. The ETH spin-off leveraged artificial intelligence to transform planning for new construction and renovation projects.

rows.title: Promising progress for therapies against critical medical needs
rows.summary: The key milestones reached by iOnctura, AL-S Pharma, Aurealis and CUTISS through positive clinical trials set appositive stage to bring innovative therapies addressing unmet medical needs. The companies initiated and reported promising results from clinical trials on therapies addressing solid tumor and hematological malignancies, lateral sclerosis, diabetic foot ulcers. CUTISS’ Phase II results have been published.

rows.title: IMD Startup Competition announces 2026 Winners
rows.summary: Now in its 27th year, the IMD Startup Competition has announced the 13 startups that will work with the two IMD EMBA cohorts in 2026, including accompanying them to Palo Alto, in the Silicon Valley in May and July. These companies are working on promising solutions for different sectors, including robotics, bioinformatics, medtech, cleantech and next generation hydrogen-powered mobility.

rows.title: EPFL’s grant program dedicated to AI takes off
rows.summary: EPFL and UBS announced the six inaugural grantees of the Startup Launchpad AI Track – powered by UBS, a new grant program dedicated to AI. Selected from over 50 proposals, these projects will receive funding and tailored support to accelerate their journey from prototype to market readiness.
