rows.title: Switzerland Global Enterprise supports Swiss SMEs with new discount in connection with US tariffs
rows.summary: Switzerland Global Enterprise (S-GE) is supporting Swiss companies affected by the latest US tariffs with a new price reduction. From October 2025, eligible SMEs will benefit from a 20% discount on fee-based services – a targeted contribution to strengthening their international competitiveness.

rows.title: Executive hires for four startups
rows.summary: Olymp and Ventostream have found a co-founder to support the further development of secure AI solutions and an innovative wind turbine. EvlaBio and Opterion strengthened their executive teams with experienced industry leaders to help them accelerate their growth and improve healthcare.

rows.title: Forbes 30Under30 spotlights Swiss innovators
rows.summary: Twenty-three personalities in the startup ecosystem made it to this year’s Forbes 30under30 — the annual premier list that presents influential personalities in Switzerland, Germany, and Austria who positively impact business and society. They represent startups offering solutions in various sectors and prominent figures supporting the ecosystem.

rows.title: Xlife Sciences AG announces exit of 12 project companies to Grupo Landsteiner
rows.summary: Mexican Grupo Landsteiner has signed a binding framework to acquire 12 of Xlife Sciences’ advanced biotech, medtech and digital health projects for a total of USD 450 million, payable in shares of Grupo Landsteiner. The transaction represents a strategic exit for Zurich-based Xlife Sciences, while both organizations enter a long-term strategic collaboration.

rows.title: A further USD 25 million for Corintis
rows.summary: Following the closing of a 24M USD Series A earlier this year, Corintis has secured additional $25M Series A1 funding round led by Applied Digital. Focused on their advanced chip-cooling solutions designed to improve efficiency and power density in data centers, Corintis will deploy the funds to accelerate its global expansion, scale manufacturing, and support commercialization with major technology and data-center operators worldwide.

rows.title: SensorX Solutions secures pre-seed funding to fuel growth
rows.summary: SensorX Solutions, developer of the FluX Multi methane-detection platform, has secured close to CHF 0.5 million in pre-seed financing to support its growth trajectory. With new customers across Europe adopting its advanced natural-gas leak inspection technologies, the startup is poised for strong growth in 2026.

rows.title: HSG START Accelerator completes first batch with Demo Day and investment offer
rows.summary: The HSG START Accelerator reached an important milestone with its first official Demo Day on 2 December 2025. Eight selected deep‑tech start‑ups presented their business models to an audience of investors, partners and guests on the demo day. One of the companies obtained an investment offer.

rows.title: Neurimmune to receive up to $780m in extended partnership with AstraZeneca
rows.summary: Building on their existing partnership since 2022, Neurimmune and AstraZeneca have inked an exclusive global collaboration and license agreement to advance an antibody targeting amyloid light chains. Neurimmune will receive an undisclosed upfront payment and milestone payments of up to $780 million.

rows.title: New Tech4Trust Cohort unveiled in Geneva
rows.summary: For its fifth edition, the Trust Valley Day was held for the first time at the CICG Geneva and brought together more than 1,000 participants. On this special occasion, the new Tech4Trust Season 7 cohort was announced. Of the 29 companies from nine different countries around the world, 15 are from Switzerland.

rows.title: Swiss innovators garner recognition
rows.summary: Seven startups at the forefront of transforming the femtech, retail-tech, space food and glass fiber recycling sectors have impressed juries in various award competitions and accelerator programs in Switzerland and abroad. Winning a prize not only recognizes their achievements but also gives them the momentum and resources to advance their groundbreaking solutions.

rows.title: Energy Vault deployed first energy storage installation in Switzerland
rows.summary: At Schindler Group’s global headquarters in Ebikon (Canton of Lucerne), Energy Vault has deployed an energy storage system which is operating and qualified by Swissgrid.  Energy Vault has also signed an agreement with Energie Wettingen AG. Switzerland is a cornerstone of Energy Vault’s European strategy, with the company moving decisively to expand its presence with multiple projects per year.

rows.title: SwissHealth Ventures doubles fund volume to CHF 100 million
rows.summary: SwissHealth Ventures, the digital health investment arm of health insurer CSS, is set to continue backing high-growth start-ups in the healthcare sector over the coming years. The Evergreen Fund is being enlarged by CHF 50 million, allowing for around twelve further investments in the coming years.

rows.title: SwimTech, StaffUp et Birds&Co sacrées au PRÊT? PARTEZ, PITCH! 2025
rows.summary: 151 secondes, c’est le temps imparti qu’avaient les 6 finalistes du grand concours de pitch de GENILEM, PRÊT ? PARTEZ, PITCH ! pour convaincre le jury et le public venu en nombre les écouter le 3 décembre dernier sur la scène du Musée Olympique. SwimTech, StaffUp et Birds&Co ressortent vainqueurs de cette édition et remportent des prix permettant de booster leur développement sur la prochaine année.

rows.title: EspeRare receives a grant from the Gates Foundation to fight preeclampsia
rows.summary: EspeRare, a pioneering Geneva-based nonprofit biotech, has been awarded a Grand Challenges grant from the Gates Foundation. EspeRare's program aims to repurpose an oral small molecule originally developed for cardiovascular disorders as a novel therapy for preeclampsia, a severe and potentially life-threatening pregnancy complication.

rows.title: Healthcare start-ups finish in the top spots at the Boldbrain Startup Challenge
rows.summary: Medtech start-up CC Cardio wins the eighth edition of the Boldbrain Startup Challenge – the audience award and the second prize goes to the biotech project MethylX. The prizes were presented yesterday at an award ceremony attended by 600 guests.

rows.title: Inaugural cohort to receive sitem-insel Innovation Voucher
rows.summary: Seven medtech startups have been selected to receive the newly launched sitem-insel Innovation Voucher. This allows them to secure in-kind support from experts in order to advance their solutions. Based on project evaluations from the first phase, excelling projects will receive the voucher worth CHF 70’000.

rows.title: Four biotech startups reach key milestones
rows.summary: Muvon reported postive results from its phase 2 trial evaluating its novel cell-based platform technology in female stress urinary incontinence. Vandria and Vaderis both achieved positive results in their first in human trials for therapies addressing cognitive impairment in Alzheimer’s patients and the genetic disorder, Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia, respectively. Vaderis results have been published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Meanwhile, Numab signed a licensing and co-development partnership with Japan-based Kaken Pharmaceutical for drug candidate NM81 targeting inflammatory bowel disease.

rows.title: Oncobit set for growth after CHF 1.9 million capital increase
rows.summary: Oncobit AG, a precision oncology company developing next-generation cancer monitoring solutions, has completed more than CHF 1.9 million in a new financing round. The funds will, among other activities, flow into advancing clinical developments and expansion into new markets.

rows.title: Jaipur Robotics accelerates growth with Waste-to-Energy automation
rows.summary: Ticino startup Jaipur Robotics uses AI-driven automation to make Waste-to-Energy plants safer and more efficient. So far, 10 energy recovery facilities across Switzerland and EU countries rely on this technology. In light of its strong growth momentum, the company has opened a new equity funding round to scale its platform across Europe.

rows.title: Cybersecurity company Saporo banks €7M
rows.summary: Saporo, the graph-native identity security company that lets defenders see enterprise environments the way attackers do, has raised €7 million in Series A funding led by TIN Capital. With 140% customer retention and 100% year-on-year revenue growth, the startup will deploy the fresh funding towards global expansion and team growth.

rows.title: New Swiss Startup Radar: Uncovering the growth of Swiss start-ups
rows.summary: The Swiss start-up ecosystem is performing better in terms of growth than is often claimed, as the new Swiss Startup Radar shows in a data-based comparison with benchmark countries. Nevertheless, performance still lags behind potential.

rows.title: Reshape Systems obtains CHF 150K to simplify risk analysis with AI
rows.summary: CERN spin-off Reshape Systems is creating a digital co-pilot that helps engineers of complex technical systems to cut development time, reduce costs, and improve product reliability across industries. With the funding from Venture Kick, the company is positioned to fast track the development of its AI-powered software platform.

rows.title: Tailored support to accelerate startup growth and development
rows.summary: Four startups—providing cleantech solutions, advanced audio engineering and sound control technologies, and real estate services—have secured spots in accelerator programs, gaining access to experts, tailored support, and funding to advance their innovations.

rows.title: Gravis Robotics completes $23M round to accelerate international expansion
rows.summary: ETH spinoff Gravis Robotics, the startup enabling next-generation earthmoving autonomy that boosts job site performance, has finalised a $23 million funding round co-led by IQ Capital and Zacua Ventures. The capital be used to accelerate growth across the UK, US and EU, as well as expand the team and network of partnerships with OEMs, contractors, and dealers.

rows.title: Pacrim acquires Swiss cannabis pioneer Medropharm
rows.summary: Valais based Pacrim SA has acquired a controlling majority of Medropharm, positioning the group including Alponics as a wholly integrated Swiss medicinal cannabis enterprise.

rows.title: MoleSense gewinnt Swiss Innovation Challenge 2025
rows.summary: Die Swiss Innovation Challenge hat ihre diesjährigen Gewinner gekürt: Aus über 100 teilnehmenden Projekten aus Schweizer KMU und Start-ups setzten sich MoleSense, Aurigin.ai, Novonexile und VAULTED durch. Ihre Technologien liefern Lösungen für Herausforderungen in Medtech, Cybersicherheit und nachhaltigem Bauen.

rows.title: Italian HR-tech company acquires Arca24
rows.summary: Arca24, the startup offering AI-powered talent acquisition software, has been acquired by TeamSystem, an Italian tech group that provides digital business management software and services.

rows.title: Swisspod unveils world’s largest hyperloop and secures $13 million
rows.summary: During its second U.S. Hyperloop Day event in Colorado, Swisspod unveiled the world’s largest hyperloop test track, presenting Aerys 1, its first hyperloop capsule model, which reached 65 mph (102 kph) during a live test. Along with this milestone, the company announced the closing of a $13 million seed round to accelerate its US expansion.

rows.title: 300 Prozent Wachstum und erfolgreiche Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde für Enshift
rows.summary: Enshift hat sich auf nachhaltige Energielösungen für Renditeimmobilien aus einer Hand fokussiert. Nach starkem Wachstum im Jahr 2025 und Projekten im Umfang von 60 Millionen Franken will das Unternehmen seine Expansion in Europa vorantreiben. Dazu hat das Zuger Unternehmen sich ein Investment über 16 Millionen Franken gesichert und ist eine Partnerschaft mit der UBS eingegangen.

rows.title: Humbrela set to build the first unified insurance intelligence layer
rows.summary: Insurtech startup Humbrela is developing an AI-driven platform that unifies insurance and warranty data, enhancing how brokers, wholesale brokers, and Managing General Agents support their customers. With the CHF 150’000 from Venture Kick, the company is now positioned to further advance the platform.

rows.title: Xcert AI secures CHF 1.1 million to advance aerospace AI certification platform
rows.summary: Headquartered in Geneva, Xcert AI is developing digital platform powered by artificial intelligence to automate certification and compliance in the aerospace industry. The company has closed CHF 1.1 million in its first funding round with Spicehaus Partners. The capital will support further product development.

rows.title: Le premier DSR Award sacre la startup genevoise Cycloo
rows.summary: Après une sélection exigeante, la première édition du concours « DSR Award » doté d'un prix de CHF 50 000.– a couronné Cycloo, une startup genevoise pionnière de la collecte des biodéchets à vélo.

rows.title: New corporate and government customers fuel startup growth
rows.summary: The ICT startups Loanboox, Tech5 and Calingo have acquired new customers for their solutions, which enable seamless debt financing closing processes, real-time AI biometric identification, and hassle-free insurance coverage for pets. This growing trust not only validates growing demand but also drives revenue and growth for the startups.

rows.title: Schweizer Awards gehen an nachhaltige und digitale Lösungen
rows.summary: Diese Woche wurden in Pharmazie, SaaS, Cleantech und Textilwirtschaft mehrere Innovationspreise vergeben. Ausgezeichnet wurden unter anderem digitale Gesundheitslösungen, skalierbares Word-of-Mouth-Marketing, biologisch abbaubare Golfbälle und kreislauffähige Mode.

rows.title: Fresh funding to scale K2 Photonics’ sensing technology worldwide
rows.summary: K2 Photonics, an ETH Zurich spin-off developing next-generation ultrafast lasers for precision sensing, has closed its seed funding round led by Singapore-based Paeonia Group. The funding will help K2 Photonics accelerate development and deployment of its laser and frequency comb technology for industrial and scientific use.

rows.title: Spacetek secures CHF 9.6 Million in new financing and expands global presence
rows.summary: Spacetek Technology AG, the Bern-based deep-tech company revolutionizing industrial process analysis through space-inspired time-of-flight mass spectrometry (TOF-MS), closed a new funding round totaling CHF 9.6 million. The company’s TOF-MS systems are already installed in some of the world’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing facilities.

rows.title: Swiss Technology Award 2025: Nanotechnology and precision medicine lead the way
rows.summary: The winners of this year's Swiss Technology Award have been announced. The award went to Chiral in the Inventors category, Navignostics in the Start-ups/Rising Stars category and SWD AG in the Industry Innovation category.

rows.title: Schwyzer Startup bringt interaktive Video-Lösung in den Bewerbungsprozess
rows.summary: Online Recruiter unterstützt Jugendliche und Lehrbetriebe mit interaktiven Bewerbungsvideos. Das Tool Talent Booster wird bereits an über 30 Schulen im Unterricht eingesetzt, um Schülerinnen und Schüler auf den Bewerbungsprozess vorzubereiten. Erste Partnerschaften mit Unternehmen wurden ebenfalls abgeschlossen.

rows.title: Klimastiftung Schweiz unterstützt neun Startups mit über 1 Million Franken
rows.summary: Die Klimastiftung Schweiz fördert in ihrer zweiten Förderrunde 2025 neun innovative Projekte von Schweizer Startups mit insgesamt 1,044 Millionen Franken. Zusammen mit der ersten Runde in diesem Jahr profitieren damit 20 Projekte, die den Klimaschutz und nachhaltige Technologien in der Schweiz vorantreiben, von einer Gesamtsumme von 2,4 Millionen Franken.

rows.title: Swiss Startup Association's Scaleup Chapter gains momentum
rows.summary: The challenges faced by scale-ups differ from those faced by young start-ups, and they have specific needs. To support these companies, ANYbotics’ CCO Enzo Wälchli has launched a Scaleup Executives Chapter under the umbrella of the Swiss Startup Association. Already boasting 140 members, the Scaleup Chapter has now hosted its inaugural Scaleup Summit.

rows.title: Propfy boucle un premier tour de table pour son lancement
rows.summary: Propfy, la jeune proptech qui ambitionne de réinventer les outils numériques des courtiers immobiliers, annonce avoir bouclé avec succès son premier tour de table, injectant les CHF 500’000 nécessaires au lancement de sa version inaugurale et au déploiement commercial. La startup portée par Anouck Reber prépare désormais une deuxième levée de CHF 1'000’000 destinée au développement d’une V2 qui intégrera des fonctionnalités étendues et une architecture technologique renforcée.

rows.title: Financial support for a new AI platform for scientific collaboration
rows.summary: Axy has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to develop an AI-powered platform that helps researchers get more out of scientific conferences, turning large academic meetings into more connected, accessible, and productive spaces for discovery. The company is already on track with having supported conferences with more than 1,000 participants and achieved an adoption rate of up to 80 percent.

rows.title: Cerrion banks $18M Series A funding to fuel international growth
rows.summary: Zurich-based Cerrion has secured $18M in a series A funding round led by Creandum, supported by existing investors and business angels. The proceeds will be used to accelerate US growth and bring its real-time video AI intelligence to more factories.

rows.title: Key leadership roles filled across multiple startups
rows.summary: Spectroplast, Alentis, Cortexia and Urban Connect have strengthened their executive teams with the appointment of a new Chief Executive Office, General Counsel, Chief Business Officer, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Commercial Officer. Bringing a wealth of experience, the new leaders will support the startups to achieve further growth.

rows.title: Digital music distributor Octiive gets acquired by US-based GoDigital Media Group
rows.summary: Octiive, a global hub for artists to create, release, and promote their music worldwide, has served more than 20,000 artists and over 3,000 labels since its launch. The company has now been acquired by US-based GoDigital Media Group, allowing it to establish a European headquarters in Zurich.

rows.title: Emerald Technology Ventures mandated to further lead the Technology Fund through 2030
rows.summary: The Swiss Government, through the Federal Office for the Environment, has officially extended the mandate for Emerald Technology Ventures to manage the Technology Fund through 2030. The Technology Fund is a federal climate policy instrument that offers loan guarantees to innovative Swiss companies whose technologies contribute to the sustainable reduction of greenhouse gas emissions. More than 207 companies have already been supported.

rows.title: SEF.WomenAward 2026: Diese drei Gründerinnen stehen im Finale
rows.summary: Das Finale der sechsten Ausgabe des SEF.WomenAward findet am 13. März 2026 in Zürich statt, bei dem Frauen mit herausragenden Leistungen im Bereich Unternehmertum geehrt werden. Die Jury hat nun die drei Finalistinnen in der Kategorie «Jungunternehmerin des Jahres» bekanntgegeben.

rows.title: Ten finalists selected for the Boldbrain Startup Challenge 2025
rows.summary: The 8th edition of the Boldbrain Startup Challenge, organised by Fondazione Agire in collaboration with USI Startup Centre, is now entering its final phase. The Regional Jury has selected the ten finalists who will present their innovative projects at the Awards Ceremony on 3. December in Lugano.

rows.title: Frisches Kapital aus der Crowd
rows.summary: Im Herbst hat die Crowdinvesting-Plattform Oomnium drei sehr erfolgreiche Kampagnen gemeldet. Aber auch auf der zweiten Schweizer Plattform ist viel los: Flappie Technologies hat bereits fast sein Fundingziel von 700'000 Franken erreicht. Zwei weitere Kampagnen wurden kürzlich erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

rows.title: GENILEM accélère Arcalignum, Badger et LittleCubes
rows.summary: Les startups romandes Arcalignum, Badger et LittleCubes intègrent la nouvelle promotion du programme d’accélération de GENILEM. Actives respectivement dans les secteurs de la construction, du commerce de proximité et de la santé, elles se démarquent par des approches innovantes et un fort potentiel de développement.

rows.title: Swiss startups across industries in the global spotlight
rows.summary: A host of awards were bestowed upon Swiss startups developing innovative solutions across sectors such as medtech, robotics, energy, and fashion. Along with cash prizes, the winners gain access to industry leaders, investors, and global visibility for their companies.

rows.title: ETH spinoff finalizes CHF 1.7M funding round
rows.summary: Riverkin, provider of ultra-low power sensors and predictive software to monitor freshwater systems in real time, has secured CHF 1.7 million to further scale deployments with early adopters.

rows.title: Flexion raises $50M to build the brain of humanoid robots
rows.summary: A team of top-notch engineers, including Nvidia researchers and experts from Google, Meta, Tesla and Amazon, have joined forces and established Flexion Robotics. The startup is developing a reinforcement learning platform that will act as the ‘brain’ for humanoid robots, making them adaptable and autonomous systems. The Zurich-based startup has now closed $50 million in Series A funding to support further developments.

rows.title: Pure-DEL secures funding to unlock drug discovery for undruggable diseases
rows.summary: ETH spin-off Pure-DEL has received CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance its technology for tackling some of the most challenging drug targets. The funding will support the expansion of Pure-DEL’s DNA-Encoded Library (DEL) portfolio, opening access to billions of precisely designed molecules that can reach disease targets conventional treatments cannot address.

rows.title: Global leader in digital crop diagnostics Vivent Biosignals raises €7.5m
rows.summary: Vivent Biosignals, the Swiss-based pioneer of “wearables for plants”, has announced new investment from Agri Investment Fund (AIF), Horticoop, Pymwymic and Swiss private investors. The funding will accelerate Vivent’s commercial scaling of its breakthrough plant biosignal monitoring technology, which is transforming crop management and sustainable food production.

rows.title: Solarify.ch sichert Finanzierung für Innovationen im Solarsektor
rows.summary: Solarify.ch hat die Finanzierung für die Weiterentwicklung des Digital Energy Hubs, einer Plattform für das intelligente Management und die Optimierung von Solarkraftwerken in einem flexiblen Energiesystem, gesichert. Das Berner Unternehmen erhält eine Bürgschaft vom Technologiefonds. Zudem hat die Pensionskasse Abendrot ihr Engagement ausgeweitet.

rows.title: LOXO bringt autonome Lieferfahrzeuge nach Deutschland
rows.summary: Das Berner Startup LOXO testet erstmals Level-4-autonome Lieferfahrzeuge in Deutschland: In Bochum liefert ein fahrerloser VW ID.Buzz im Rahmen eines Pilotprojekts Einkäufe für REWE aus. Damit baut LOXO seine Präsenz im deutschen Markt weiter aus.

rows.title: Austrian Group acquires Novaccess smart lighting technology
rows.summary: Tridonic, a leading global provider of lighting control systems, is expanding its expertise in outdoor lighting with the acquisition of NovaLight. The formerly division of Yverdon-based Novaccess S.A., develops intelligent, cloud-based control systems. The NovaLight team has been working under the Tridonic umbrella since August 2025. The Austrian company has also acquired the IP rights for the product portfolio and now offers the solutions directly to the market.

rows.title: Sechs Startups erhalten einen Platz im «Büro Züri»
rows.summary: Ab 2026 werden calmea, Impact.build, Kolbev, Stellar Alpina, YURO und Forgis Teil des Büro Züri im Switzerland Innovation Park Zürich. Sie haben die Jury mit ihren nachhaltigen Lösungen in den Bereichen Umwelt, Mobilität, Bildung und Industrie überzeugt.

rows.title: Switzerland leads the way in spin-offs
rows.summary: Swiss universities and the Swiss innovation system as a whole consistently perform very well in rankings, while the start-up ecosystem usually revealed some weaknesses. The situation is different for deep tech spin-offs: here, Switzerland can compete with countries such as France and Germany in absolute terms and is clearly in the lead on a per capita basis, as the European Spinout Report 2025 shows.

rows.title: Startups across industries impress juries in Switzerland and beyond
rows.summary: Case prizes amounting to CHF 25,000 have been bestowed onto different Swiss startups, with Irmos Technologies securing the highest cheque as non-dilutive funding. Further winning solutions include plant-based fish products, wastewater treatment solutions and a wearable biosensor for women hormone monitoring.

rows.title: FinTech-Startup tiun ermöglicht innovatives Bezahlmodell auf Blick.ch
rows.summary: Mit seinem Pay-per-use-Modell ermöglicht das Zürcher Startup tiun, digitale Inhalte nach tatsächlichem Verbrauch zu bezahlen. Nun startet das Startup die Zusammenarbeit mit Ringier Medien Schweiz und weiteren Partnern.

rows.title: State of European Tech report notes stagnation in the European start-up ecosystem
rows.summary: Atomico's new report offers a comprehensive diagnosis of the European tech ecosystem in more than 200 pages. Although the sector has grown significantly over the past ten years, only slight improvements are apparent compared to 2024, while development in the US is being driven by the AI hype. The report also describes measures to better exploit European potential.

rows.title: A $16M round and key milestones strengthen Sunflower Labs’s position
rows.summary: Sunflower Labs, creator of the Beehive autonomous security drone system has obtained nationwide FAA approval to operate beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) across the United States, launched an interactive property configuration tool, and closed a $16 million Series B funding round led by Sequoia Capital. These milestones strengthen its position in areal security.

rows.title: Tasteomics gets financial boost to advance its natural flavor enhancers
rows.summary: Founded as a spinoff of the University of Bern, Tasteomics is pioneering a new approach to taste modulation that enables food producers to create healthier, great-tasting products while reducing production costs. Their product, Peakaroma, is a natural ingredient that boosts flavor intensity without adding salt, sugar, or off flavours. The CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick will support further developments.

rows.title: $150 million to scale DEXTER the surgical robot across the US
rows.summary: Distalmotion, the developer of surgical robot DEXTER which is designed to empower access to the benefits of robotic surgery in outpatient sites of care, has finalized its Series G financing round, raising $150M USD. The round was led by Revival Healthcare Capital and included inside investor participation.

rows.title: SmarterChains on the rise
rows.summary: One year after launching its Manufacturing Value Intelligence platform, with leading supplier of corrugated packaging solutions DS Smith as its first Enterprise client, Geneva-based SmarterChains is gathering pace with Veolia as a second client, validation from paid pilots and a recent deep tech recognition at the Startup Nights. Having reached early six figure ARR, the company is on track to grow further.

rows.title: Albatross raises CHF 9.7 million to reinvent product discovery for the web
rows.summary: Former Amazon AI leaders raise CHF 9.7 m to deploy AI that understands user intent in real time, transforming how they discover products and content online. The platform learns continuously from live behavior, replacing static recommendation systems with dynamic intelligence that adapts moment-to-moment.

rows.title: Swiss Medtech startups reach key development milestones
rows.summary: LEM Surgical, with its intelligent surgical system and Regenosca, provider of advanced regenerative mesh technology, have both achieved promising results in their clinical studies, paving the way for further large-scale studies. Meanwhile ONWARD Medical’s ARC-EX device, the first and only FDA-cleared technology demonstrated to improve hand strength and sensation in people with spinal cord injury is now cleared for home-use in the US.

rows.title: University projects receive up to CHF 150K in First Ventures program
rows.summary: Three startup projects have secured up to CHF 150’000 in non-dilutive funding, the highest amount in the First Ventures program in the category 'Execute'. The capital will be used to advance their solutions, including a robotic assistant, new products from upcycling biogenic CO₂ from fermentation and biogas and an in-bed leg press to enable mobilisation of bed-ridden patients.

rows.title: Acurast secures $11 million to turn phones into a global compute network
rows.summary: Acurast, the Zug-based Web3 startup developing the real decentralized compute network using smartphones to provide verifiable, confidential compute, has raised a total of $11 million, including non-dilutive grants and token-based rounds. Prominent investors participated in the round.

rows.title: FIF expands support and rewards five Geneva startups
rows.summary: Five Geneva-based startups have received support from the Fonds pour l’Innovation et le Futur de Genève (FIF Genève). The recipients include three digital companies, an impact-focused project, and a scale-up specializing in quality control. The FIF is now expanding its support with two new areas: Digital and Impact. FIF Digital aims to accelerate cutting-edge digital technologies, while FIF Impact supports early-stage projects with positive social, environmental, or economic impact.

rows.title: Indivi secures CHF 15 million
rows.summary: TechBio company Indivi has closed a CHF15 million investment round led by Ava Investors to accelerate the validation and deployment of precision medicine tools in early-phase neuroscience drug development, targeting Alzheimer’s disease.

rows.title: Schweizer Software-Haus übernimmt Kollabo
rows.summary: Die Zürcher Plattform Kollabo, die Fachkräfte im Handwerk und in gewerblichen Berufen vermittelt, wurde von enovetic übernommen. Kollabos KI-gestützte Vermittlungsplattform wird in enovetics international etablierte Softwarelösung EasyTemp integriert, Kollabo bleibt aber als eigene Marke bestehen.

rows.title: InnoBooster supports six early-stage startups with CHF 900’000
rows.summary: The latest cohort of the InnoBooster program comprises six startups that are developing a range of solutions including medical devices to address preterm births, vaccines against bacterial infections in humans and poultry, sensors and robotic additive manufacturing methods to decarbonize the construction industry.

rows.title: GlioCART receives financial boost to fight the most aggressive form of brain cancer
rows.summary: Based in Allschwil (Baselland), GlioCART is developing a new type of cell therapy – the first CAR-T cell therapy – designed to target both glioblastoma tumors and the surrounding immune-suppressive environment. The company has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to advance their solution.

rows.title: Seprify enters commercial phase with Danish company Oterra
rows.summary: After two years of collaborative testing across more than 15 food applications, Denmark-based Oterra, a global leader in natural food colors has entered a commercial agreement with Seprify to incorporate its natural white cellulose into food color formulations. This milestone marks Seprify’s official market debut in the food and beverages industry.

rows.title: $4.5M pre-seed funding to fuel the next industrial revolution
rows.summary: Forgis is bringing AI-powered intelligence directly to factory floors, making factories smarter, more efficient and adaptive by connecting and optimizing machines and production lines using advanced automation and intelligence. The startup has now raised $4.5M in a pre-seed funding round led by redalpine with contribution from several Swiss investors and supporters including Venture Kick.

rows.title: CHF 172 million for growth start-ups
rows.summary: Following the first closing of the Swisscanto (CH) Private Equity Switzerland Growth II fund, managed by Zürcher Kantonalbank, investment activities will now commence. The majority of the investments will flow into companies based and operating in Switzerland.

rows.title: Kickstart announces newly established partnerships
rows.summary: Twenty innovation partnerships between startups and corporates have been established in the 10th edition of Kickstart. Six Swiss startups will collaborate with some of Switzerland’s industry players such as Coop, MSD, Sanitas and Swisscom to advance solutions in the finance and insurance, food and retail as well as health and well-being space.

rows.title: KI-Startups und Initiativen ausgezeichnet
rows.summary: Bei der diesjährigen Verleihung des Digital Economy Awards stand künstliche Intelligenz im Mittelpunkt. Ausgezeichnet wurde mimic robotics als «Next Global Hot Thing», Akenza gemeinsam mit ISS in der Kategorie «Digital Excellence Commercial» sowie die KI-Sandbox des Kantons Zürich in der Kategorie «Digital Excellence GOV & NPO».

rows.title: Wyss Zurich celebrates its tenth anniversary with impressive results
rows.summary: Wyss Zurich was founded to pave the way from basic research to the market. Its ten-year track record shows that it has been highly successful in this endeavour.

rows.title: Masaba Coffee raises almost one million Swiss francs through crowdinvesting
rows.summary: Ticino-based start-up Masaba Coffee has completed its crowdinvesting campaign on Oomnium, raising almost one million Swiss francs. The company plans to use the funds to expand the newly established Masaba Coffee House & Roastery in Monteceneri and strengthen its presence across Switzerland.

rows.title: KI, Mobilität, Forstmanagement, Batterien: Startups mit Awards ausgezeichnet
rows.summary: Fünf Startups wurden kürzlich mit Awards ausgezeichnet: Unbound Potential gewann beim Falling Walls Venture Wettbewerb.in Berlin. QUMEA erhielt den i-care Award für seine KI-Lösung zur Sturzprävention in Pflegeeinrichtungen, während bei den Best of Swiss Apps und Best of Swiss Software Awards drei weitere Startups für ihre innovativen Anwendungen ausgezeichnet wurden.

rows.title: Swiss Activities schliesst Finanzierungsrunde ab
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup Swiss Activities, das Freizeitaktivitäten in der Schweiz über seine Plattform zur Buchung anbietet, hat eine neue Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen. Mit dem frischen Kapital plant Swiss Activities sein Wachstum durch Investitionen in Team, Angebot und Plattform weiter voranzutreiben. Zusätzlich hat das Startup seine Geschäftsleitung verstärkt.

rows.title: Virometix completes $15 million financing round
rows.summary: Schlieren-based Virometix, the company pioneering fully synthetic vaccines to generate targeted and protective immune responses against infectious diseases and cancer, has secured $15 million in a financing round supported by existing shareholders. The funds will support continued clinical and development activities for V-212, its lead serotype-independent pneumococcal vaccine candidate, currently in Phase I clinical evaluation.

rows.title: CASUS verkauft Produktlinie an LAWLIFT
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup CASUS hat seine Produktlinie CASUS Create an das Berliner Unternehmen LAWLIFT veräussert. Mit diesem Schritt fokussiert sich das Startup künftig vollständig auf seine KI-basierte Plattform für juristische Workflows.

rows.title: Swijin wins USD 250,000 at the Entrepreneurship World Cup in Riyadh
rows.summary: Claudia Glass, co-founder and CEO of sports apparel company Swijin, has stood out from among more than 10,000 candidates that applied for the Entrepreneurship World Cup 2025 in Riyadh. She has been awarded USD 250,000 in the category ‘Early Stage’. The funding will be used to expand its product portfolio.

rows.title: French Group acquires Swiss Insuretech GreenTriangle
rows.summary: Saretec Group, a French company specialized in loss prevention and claims assessment, has acquired Zoug-based GreenTriangle, a start-up focused on digital agricultural claims management and parametric solutions using satellite data. This move strengthens Saretec’s digital services and supports insurance clients and policyholders in addressing the growing challenges of climate change in the agricultural sector.

rows.title: Autonomyo secures €1.4M and Launches Crowdfunding to Scale Safe Home Rehabilitation
rows.summary: Renens-based Autonomyo, which specializes in medical technology and was founded at EPFL, has raised €1.4 million from private and public investors and is now launching a crowdfunding campaign on Capital Cell to develop its home rehabilitation technology internationally. With its Skywalk product, a safety system combined with a smart exoskeleton and a digital therapy platform, Autonomyo is bringing robot-assisted rehabilitation from the clinic directly to patients' homes.

rows.title: InSphero acquires DOPPL SA and Sun Bioscience Gri3D Technology
rows.summary: InSphero AG, the global market leader in 3D cell-based assays and organ-on-chip systems signed the definitive agreement to acquire DOPPL SA, a Lausanne-based innovator in the organoid space, including the Sun Bioscience Gri3D technology. The acquisition strengthens InSphero’s position as the most comprehensive provider of advanced 3D in vitro models, combining scalable spheroid and organoid technologies with integrated assay and data solutions for drug discovery and safety testing.

rows.title: NNAISENSE gets acquired by Germany asset management firm
rows.summary: Based in Lugano, NNAISENSE has built a generative AI framework for financial markets to enable the prediction of coherent market scenarios across multiple asset classes, data sources and modalities. The company has been acquired by German asset management firm, ACATIS Investment KVG.

rows.title: FIT supports SurfAce Cleantech, Healio, Nextrainers, and Sharelock
rows.summary: SurfAce Cleantech is reinventing compostable packaging and has been awarded a CHF 100,000 Tech Seed loan from FIT. Three other innovations each receive a CHF 20,000 Digital Grant, with their own specific objectives: simplifying healthcare staff planning at Healio, generating a football training session in less than a minute for Nextrainers, and structuring and analysing Due Digilence flows thanks to Sharelock.

rows.title: Delvitech closes USD 40 million Series B round to accelerate global growth
rows.summary: Delvitech, specializing in the development of AI-native Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) solutions for electronics, closed a Series B investment round of USD 40 million. Delvitech is now set to accelerate its next growth stage, reinforcing its global presence with a special focus on India, where the company plans to open a new manufacturing plant in 2026.

rows.title: Five Swiss startups awarded Foundation Valery support
rows.summary: Five new Swiss startups have joined the Fondation Valery's 2025 grant portfolio, which embodies innovation, collaboration, and environmental and social impact. Led by Yannick Ritschel, the institution bridges the gap between philanthropy and venture capital with a novel vision.

rows.title: Legaltech startup Omnilex banks USD 4.5 million to make legal research seamless
rows.summary: With already double its Annual Recurring Revenue in just three months and over 100 paying customers, Legaltech startup Omnilex is off to a good start with its legal AI workspace designed to optimize and simplify legal research. The company has secured USD 4.5 million to build the missing piece of legal AI: Commentary.

rows.title: Newly established Motley secures $1.5 million pre-seed funding
rows.summary: Motley has launched its AI-powered business reporting platform designed to automate and streamline business reporting, allowing teams to transform data into actionable documents and presentations in minutes instead of weeks. The startup has closed a $1.5 million pre-seed round led by Seedcamp to support further developments.

rows.title: Wellcome awards CHF 14 million for BioVersys’ BV100 Phase 2b study
rows.summary: BioVersys’ lead asset BV100, an innovative anti-infective developed for hospital infections caused by Acinetobacter baumannii, including carbapenem resistant strains (CRAB), has been selected to participate in the ADVANCE-ID clinical trial network. The first patient is expected to be dozed in H1 2026.

rows.title: AMINA Bank receives MiCA License through its Austrian subsidiary
rows.summary: AMINA (Austria) AG, the newly established subsidiary of AMINA Bank, has received a Crypto-Asset Service Provider license from Austria’s Financial Market Authority (FMA) under the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCAR) framework.

rows.title: Tausende Besucher und drei Awards an den Startup Nights 2025
rows.summary: Zum neunten Mal traf sich die Schweizer Startup-Szene am vergangenen Donnerstag und Freitag in den Winterthurer Eulachhallen. 150 Startups präsentierten sich an Ständen, 70 Referenten und Speakerinnen vermittelten Wissen und 3 Jungunternehmen sicherten sich Preise. Caterra, PeriVision und Verretex wurden mit Awards in den Kategorien Deep Tech, Health Tech und Impact Tech ausgezeichnet.

rows.title: YQuantum obtains funding to create hardware for nex-gen quantum computers
rows.summary: Established in 2024, YQuantum is an engineering startup dedicated to bridging the gap between laboratory prototypes and commercially viable systems, bringing practical quantum computing closer to everyday use. The startup has received CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to their develop miniaturized hardware components for the next generation of quantum computers.

rows.title: AstraZeneca acquires SixPeaks for up to USD 300 million
rows.summary: Following an initial investment of USD 15 million in 2024, AstraZeneca has acquired Basel-based SixPeaks Bio AG. SixPeaks is investigating potential therapies for weight-management with the aim of preserving lean muscle mass.

rows.title: Aeon acquires Holsain to strengthen expertise in preventative health
rows.summary: Zurich-based startup Aeon, a provider of preventative health solutions, has acquired Holsain, a startup in stealth mode, to strengthen its expertise in proactive, personalized health management. Following the acquisition, Aeon has appointed Holsain’s founder Florian Alexander Huber as its new Chief Medical Officer.

rows.title: Swisstech with 26 startups take active role at SLUSH 2025
rows.summary: With its swisstech Pavilion, Switzerland has remained a prominent guest at SLUSH, bringing a delegation of startups and key players to showcase their innovations and explore opportunities during the trade fair. This year, 26 startups will be hosted in the pavilion. Besides the exhibition, they will participate in various side events including the Global Deep Tech Battle, powered by swisstech.

rows.title: Development milestones and financing for biotech companies
rows.summary: From publishing clinical study results, dosing first patients to securing funding several Swiss biotechs are making strives in the development of therapies for a range of conditions — including aging, BK Polyomavirus infection in kidney transplant patients, Duchenne muscular dystrophy, inflammatory diseases, and multi-drug resistant (MDR) hospital infections.

rows.title: Top class founders, builders and investors join Swisspreneur’s new Advisory Board
rows.summary: Swisspreneur, the nonprofit platform dedicated to developing and advancing entrepreneurship in Switzerland, established an Advisory Board. The board members - some of the most accomplished Swiss and international founders, builders, and investors – have already provided hands-on support to Swiss start-ups through Swisspreneur.

rows.title: Tech and biopharma startups expand executive teams
rows.summary: Three startups have strengthened their management teams with seasoned executives to drive growth and innovation. The appointments were made at startups developing solutions such as a digital procurement platform for construction industry, cloud infrastructure, and novel antibacterial treatments to combat multidrug-resistant.

rows.title: Switchkine leads first Biopôle Investment Program recipient cohort
rows.summary: Biopôle SA recently unveiled the Biopôle Investment Programme (BIP), an evolution of its successful Start-up Fund, which launched in 2021. Built on feedback from Biopôle’s entrepreneurial community, the BIP goes beyond financial support to help start-ups master investor relations and build strong foundations for long-term growth. Among the new recipients are biotech Switchkine and six other promising ventures.

rows.title: CHF 6.3 million to advance next-generation biomarker technology
rows.summary: arcoris bio, a Swiss life science research tools and in vitro diagnostics company, has secured CHF 6.3 million in a seed financing round. The investment enables the Schlieren-based start-up to accelerate industrialization of its biomarker detection platform, expand of strategic partnerships, and launch new products.

rows.title: Positrigo on a growth momentum in the US
rows.summary: One year following the acquisition of its first customer in the US market, Positrigo continues to strengthen its position in America. The company has installed multiple NeuroLF systems at several clients' facilities to help to advance functional brain imaging. This development is pursuant to the growing demand for brain Positron Emission Tomography scans, which are key in diagnosing Alzheimer's disease.

rows.title: BTRY sichert sich 4,3 Millionen Franken für ultradünne Festkörperbatterien
rows.summary: BTRY hat eine Finanzierungsrunde mit einem internationalen Konsortium von Deep-Tech-Investoren abgeschlossen. Mit dem Kapital will das Zürcher Startup seine Prototypen zur Marktreife bringen und eine Rolle-zu-Rolle Fertigungslinie aufbauen.

rows.title: CDR-Life to receive up to CHF 456 million in license agreement with Boehringer Ingelheim
rows.summary: Building on their longstanding partnership in retinal health, Boehringer Ingelheim and CDR-Life, Inc. have entered a new global licensing agreement to develop CDR-Life’s antibody-based molecule CDR111 for autoimmune diseases. CDR-Life will be eligible for up to CHF 456 million in payments.

rows.title: Albert Koechlin Stiftung vergibt 380'000 Franken an Innerschweizer Startups
rows.summary: Am vergangenen Dienstag zeichnete die Albert Koechlin Stiftung innovative Startups mit dem Innerschweizer Startup-Preis aus. Das Urner Startup Moodtalk gewann den mit 100'000 Franken dotierten Hauptpreis. Weiter wurden sechs Jungunternehmen sowie zwei Gründerinnen mit einer Auszeichnung und Preisgeldern zwischen 30'000 bis 50'000 Franken prämiert.

rows.title: CHF 28 million for Switzerland’s new Bitcoin treasury company
rows.summary: Future Holdings AG, Switzerland’s premier Bitcoin treasury company, has closed a CHF 28 million strategic funding round anchored by cornerstone investors Fulgur Ventures, Nakamoto, and TOBAM. The investment will facilitate further developments as the company advances towards its launch.

rows.title: US-based company acquires AI sign language translator
rows.summary: Nagish, a leading accessibility tech company based in New York has acquired Switzerland’s early-stage startup sign.mt. The startup developed an open-source and AI-based application designed to facilitate real-time, bidirectional translation between spoken and signed languages.

rows.title: Switzerland leads 69 nations in digital competitiveness
rows.summary: Switzerland, the US, and Singapore are the most digitally savvy nations among an eclectic group of 69 global economies, according to the 2025 IMD World Competitiveness Center’s Digital Competitiveness Ranking (WDCR).

rows.title: NLS Pharma and Kadimastem finalise business combination
rows.summary: The discussion on the merger of NLS Pharmaceutics and Kadimastem have been concluded, with the companies forming a new combination company called Newcelx. The new company is focusing on the development of cell-based and small-molecule therapies for neurodegenerative and metabolic diseases, integrating regenerative medicine and neuroscience expertise within a unified platform.

rows.title: Zürcher Startup lanciert erfolgreich Kaffee-Alternative mit Vitalpilzen
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup GAYA Earth hat den Vertrieb seiner gesunden Kaffee-Alternative „Functional Mushroom Cacao“ aufgenommen. GAYA kombiniert funktionelle Vitalpilze wie Lion’s Mane, Reishi und Chaga mit Kakao zu einer koffeinfreien Alternative. Seit dem Launch Ende August haben bereits über tausend Kundinnen und Kunden das Produkt ausprobiert.

rows.title: DeepJudge closes $41.2M Series A round
rows.summary: With revenues growing over 500% year-over-year, DeepJudge continues to establish itself as the go-to AI platform for legal professionals worldwide. Alongside new customers, the startup has raised $41.2M in a Series A round led by Silicon Valley firm, Felicis, with participation from existing investors, Coatue. The funds will be used to accelerate product development and scale market adoption in the US and UK.

rows.title: Tezos Foundation invests in chainstaff
rows.summary: Swiss HR-tech startup chainstaff has secured a strategic investment from the Tezos Foundation to automate and scale referral-based recruiting using blockchain technology. Chainstaff has been thriving since inception in 2023 and now has over 1000 users using the platform and 100 jobs posted

rows.title: Business Parc blickt auf 25 Jahre Gründungsförderung zurück
rows.summary: Der Business Parc in Reinach feiert sein 25-jähriges Jubiläum. Seit seiner Gründung hat der Business Parc über 1'000 Unternehmensgründungen in der Nordwestschweiz begleitet. Neben dem Standort in Reinach besteht seit 2021 ein weiterer Standort in Liestal.

rows.title: Erfolg für zwei Graubündner Startups
rows.summary: Im Rahmen des Jungunternehmenforums fand an der Fachhochschule Graubünden in Chur die 13. Ausgabe der Founders-Night statt. Zwei Startups wurden für ihre innovativen Lösungen ausgezeichnet: MYNE erhielt den Founders Award 2025, während der Preis für das beste Tech-Startup der Südostschweiz an Findmee ging.

rows.title: FireDrone receives CHF 150,000 to develop heat-resistant drones for extreme environments
rows.summary: FireDrone has obtained CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to roll out temperature-resilient drones. The engineering startup is setting new safety standards in emergency response and industrial inspection, deploying drones that protect lives, infrastructure, and the environment while working to make high-risk operations safer worldwide.

rows.title: Obligate achieves profitability and raises $3 million
rows.summary: A leader in on-chain capital markets, Obligate has completed a US$ 3 million capital increase, led by Exponential Science Capital alongside a public crowdfunding campaign. Thanks to the growing demand for on-chain investment products and bespoke tokenisation solutions, Obligate has achieved profitability, positioning the company for sustainable growth.

rows.title: Mimic Robotics banks $16 million seed funding
rows.summary: Zurich-based robotics startup mimic has closed an oversubscribed $16 million funding round led by Elaia, alongside Speedinvest. The investment will be used to accelerate the development of mimic’s foundation AI model and humanoid robotic hands, and advance deployments with leading global industry players.

rows.title: Thriving Lookmove set for accelerated growth
rows.summary: After a strategic pivot in 2022 and CHF 4.3 million raised – 85% in equity – Lookmove is finally becoming a profitable company set for rapid growth. The Vaud proptech now generates annual recurring revenue exceeding CHF 660,000, primarily driven by API services powering real-time data for major proptechs and enterprise clients. In parallel, the company is expanding its suite of action-oriented tools on its platform data.lookmove.ch. And this is just the beginning.

rows.title: CUE Labs exits stealth after $10 million capital increase
rows.summary: Zug-based CUE Labs has emerged out of stealth, introducing the widely adopted CUE open-source configuration language. Its Configuration Control Plane is a central system that will turn enterprise configuration from a scattered liability into a strategic asset. The company has also secured $10M in early funding led by Sequoia Capital and OSS Capital.

rows.title: Luxembourg fund Alpha Star invests USD 1 Million in Art Recognition
rows.summary: Art Recognition, a Zurich-based pioneer in AI art authentication, has secured a strategic investment of USD 1 million from Alpha Star, a leading Luxembourg-based investment fund focused on innovative companies in the art market. The funds and partnership fuel the company's growth.

rows.title: 10th MassChallenge Switzerland Awards crown MYNERVA
rows.summary: MassChallenge Switzerland, part of MassChallenge’s global network for innovators and zero-equity startup accelerators, yesterday hosted its 10th Anniversary Awards Ceremony in Lausanne. The event gathered more than 500 guests from across the innovation ecosystem to celebrate the winners of its 2025 Early-Stage Startup Accelerator Program. This year two Swiss startups, MYNERVA and Apheros, took top honors cashing CHF 140’000 and 70’000.-

rows.title: Two accomplished SME managers share their experience and secrets to export success
rows.summary: The Chief Executive Officers of Maestrani and Data Migration International both had the goal to thrive in international markets. By adapting to local conditions, striking the right balance between planning and flexibility, and taking personal relationships seriously, they established a presence in foreign markets, proving that Small and Medium-sized companies can succeed outside Switzerland. In the 17th episode of the UBS Growth Talk, the two share their journey and tips for companies aspiring to pursue growth abroad.

rows.title: More than 20 Swiss biotech companies to exhibit at Bio Europe
rows.summary: BIO-Europe is the leading trade fair for the biotechnology industry across Europe and beyond, bringing together industry players in biotech, pharma as well as emerging tech companies and investors to explore latest trends and forge partnerships. Scheduled to take place from November 3-5, the event will feature a broad range of Swiss startups, among which 11 are supported by Innosuisse.

rows.title: Financial success for publicly traded biotech companies
rows.summary: Global net sales of Idorsia’s drug candidate QUVIVIQ increased by >130% year-on-year to CHF 91 million in nine months during 2025, setting Idorsia on track to reach profitability by 2027. Oculis, which is dedicated to addressing eye-related conditions, has raised an oversubscribed $110 investment to accelerate the development of its novel neuroprotective clinical candidate, Privosegtor.

rows.title: BE WTR wins strategic investor to grow in France
rows.summary: BE WTR France, the subsidiary of the Swiss premium, filtered, local and sustainable water brand, and Cafés Richard, France’s leading coffee supplier for the hospitality industry, announce the creation of a strategic joint-venture. Together, they aim to offer a complementary and responsible alternative to existing water solutions, in line with the growing expectations of professionals and consumers.

rows.title: Von KI bis Mikroalgen: Startups feiern Erfolge
rows.summary: Mehrere Schweizer Startups überzeugten mit ihren Ideen und erhielten dafür Plätze in Coachingprogrammen und wurden mit Preisen ausgezeichnet. Die Projekte decken ein breites Spektrum ab: Von künstlicher Intelligenz im Gesundheitswesen bis zu umweltbewussten Konzepten für eine nachhaltige Zukunft.

rows.title: ETH-Spin-off secures €3.5 million to advance its under water robot
rows.summary: Tethys Robotics has raised €3.5 million in a pre-seed financing round led by Redstone, to further develop and scale up its autonomous underwater drone, the Tethys ONE, on a global scale. With this funding, the company aims to set new standards for safe and efficient underwater inspection.

rows.title: Spitäler und Post setzen auf 44ai für KI-Lösung im Gesundheitswesen
rows.summary: Das Oltner Startup 44ai hat mit Haidy eine Plattform entwickelt, die mittels inhouse entwickelter KI medizinische Notizen und Berichte automatisiert erstellt, Krankengeschichten aktualisiert und so eine strukturierte Datengrundlage für Ärztinnen und Ärzte bietet. Mit dieser Lösung überzeugte das 2024 gegründete HealthTech-Startup bereits vor dem Launch einige Business Angels mit Klinik-Hintergrund.

rows.title: $2 million pre-seed funding for real-time data security and compliance platform
rows.summary: Qala AG, a Zurich-based startup redefining how enterprises achieve real-time data visibility and governance at source, has secured $2M in its pre-seed funding led by QBIT Capital and Haatch. The funds will flow into product enhancement in preparation for the market launch.

rows.title: Finalists revealed for three award competitions at Startup Nights
rows.summary: The Impact Tech, Deep Tech and Health Tech awards, offering a total cash prize CHF 30,000, will be presented to the most outstanding startups in the respective catories. Six finalists in each of the three competitions will present their solutions to the audience during the Startup Nights, where the winners will be announced and awarded.

rows.title: MoleSense to advance the first molecular wearable for maternity care
rows.summary: EPFL spin-off MoleSense has received CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to bring molecular wearables to maternity care. These devices will continuously and non-invasively monitor key biochemical markers in high-risk pregnancies, enabling doctors to make data-driven decisions and mothers to receive proactive care.

rows.title: Major customer deals for Swiss startups
rows.summary: Across the world, global companies look to Switzerland for innovative solutions. Recently companies such as Shell, Carahsoft, iq digital and PHI Air Medical entered partnership with the startups TVP Solar, Distran, Decentriq and Loft Dynamics, obtaining access to latest technology for renewable energy production, gas leak detection, flight simulation and secure data collaboration.

rows.title: Bewy bringt die Immobilienverwaltung ins KI-Zeitalter
rows.summary: Mit einer Kombination aus klassischer Verwaltung und KI-gestützten Prozessen bietet die Immobilienverwaltung Bewy privaten und institutionellen Eigentümern mehr Transparenz, Effizienz und Servicequalität. Erst dieses Jahr gestartet, verwaltet Bewy bereits Objekte im vierstelligen Bereich und will nun mit frischem Kapital weiterwachsen und die gesamte Deutschschweiz abdecken.

rows.title: Verkaufsstart für den Fingernagel-Chip
rows.summary: Das Luzerner Startup Smart Chip Switzerland hat den Vertrieb seines «Smart Chips» aufgenommen – eines auf den Fingernagel applizierbaren Chips, der kontaktlose Anwendungen wie etwa Bezahlen ermöglicht. Der Verkauf erfolgt an über 100 Standorten in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. Wichtigster Technologiepartner ist der deutsche Halbleiterhersteller Infineon.

rows.title: c.technology expandiert mit starkem Partner in die USA
rows.summary: Das SaaS-Startup c.technology spannt mit dem US-amerikanischen Unternehmen LiveWire, der Harley-Davidson-Tochter für Elektromotorräder, zusammen. LiveWire nutzt die von c.technology bereitgestellte digitale Plattform für Fahrerinnen und Fahrer seiner Motorräder. Mit dieser Partnerschaft erschliesst c.technology den Zugang zum US-Markt.

rows.title: Vista Equity Partners acquires majority in Nexthink in $3 billion deal
rows.summary: The transaction reinforces Nexthink’s standing as one of the most successful and innovative enterprise software companies in the world, serving more than 1,500 enterprise customers and 25 million employees globally. The strategic investment is set to accelerate Nexthink’s innovation and unlock a new era of AI-powered, agentic Digital Employee Experience (DEX).

rows.title: Capital increase to fuel ONWARD Medical's commercialization efforts
rows.summary: ONWARD Medical, the leading neurotechnology company pioneering therapies to restore movement, function, and independence in people with spinal cord injuries, has raised EUR 50,850,000 million in gross proceeds in a private placement. The proceeds support further developments and accelerate commercialization efforts for the ARC-EX System, among other activities.

rows.title: 21shares joins FalconX to advance digital asset investment products
rows.summary: FalconX is one of the largest and leading digital asset prime brokerage firms, providing deep liquidity, advanced technology solutions, and 24/7 access to global crypto markets. FalconX has now acquired 21Shares, the provider of the world’s largest suite of cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds and products (ETFs/ETPs) to accelerate the convergence of listed markets and digital assets, while strengthening its global presence worldwide.

rows.title: Zurich-based Trilliome awarded €50’000
rows.summary: Trilliome, the startup dedicated to developing precision bioactives that reprogram the gut microbiome to restore brain and immune health for healthy aging, has won 1st prize in the EIT Food Accelerator Network’s “Food as Medicine” programme. The obtained €50,000 cash prize will support further advancements and product validation.

rows.title: BOXS übernimmt Recoplast
rows.summary: Das 2016 gegründete Aargauer Cleantech-Unternehmen BOXS AG übernimmt die Recoplast AG, die sich auf die Wiederverwertung Ihrer Kunststoffrestmengen fokussiert. Durch die Übernahme kann die BOXS AG, die Recyclingplatten aus Plastikabfall herstellt, ihr Angebot ausbauen und Synergien nutzen.

rows.title: QUMEA attracts leading Private Equity fund as investor
rows.summary: GRO, a leading Northern European private equity firm focused on B2B software, announced a strategic investment in QUMEA, the market leader for digital mobility monitoring in patient rooms. The investment will support QUMEA’s continued expansion across Europe and further strengthen its position as the market leader in privacy-first patient monitoring.

rows.title: Relai: MiCA license opens a gateway to Europe
rows.summary: The French Financial Markets Authority has granted Relai authorization to become a Crypto-Asset Service Provider under the EU's MiCA Regulation. As one of the first bitcoin companies to obtain this license, Relai is now set to expand its European market reach, starting with France.

rows.title: bexio übernimmt Fintech-Startup Kontera
rows.summary: bexio, die führende Business-Software für Schweizer KMU und Treuhand-Software für die digitale Zusammenarbeit, wird die Kontera GmbH integrieren, deren KI-Agent eine vollautomatische Verarbeitung von Belegen ermöglicht.

rows.title: Symactiv ravit le Prix BCN Innovation 2025
rows.summary: La startup neuchâteloise Symactiv décroche le Prix BCN Innovation 2025. Elle empoche le montant de CHF 150'000 pour développer ses granulés de fertilisation pour régénérer les sols. La cérémonie de remise du Prix s’est tenue le jeudi 23 octobre 2025 au Théâtre de l’Heure bleue à La Chaux-de-Fonds, en présence de quelque 300 personnes.

rows.title: Mehr Visibilität für KA-EX dank Helmsponsoring für Lara Gut-Behrami
rows.summary: Lara Gut-Behrami startet am Samstag beim Weltcup-Auftakt in Sölden erstmals seit einem Jahr wieder mit einem Helmsponsor – und setzt dabei auf KA-EX. Die Ausnahmesportlerin hatte im Sommer in ph., das Unternehmen hinter der Nahrungsergänzung für schnellere Regeneration investiert. Die gute Zusammenarbeit führte nun zum Helmsponsoring.

rows.title: FIT Impact grants awarded to Omnitone, WWW and Red Drop
rows.summary: These three new projects from ECAL and H4 have each been awarded a FIT Impact grant of 10,000 Swiss francs. Omnitone develops sustainable, repairable, upgradeable and recyclable speakers. WWW (women work wear) designs workwear by and for women. Red Drop offers home self-sampling kits that use menstrual blood to obtain health information and receive healthcare support.

rows.title: NextIn Business zeigt Startups, die den Alltag verändern
rows.summary: Ende Oktober startet die vierte Staffel der TV-Sendereihe NextIn Business. In fünf neuen Folgen werden Themen, die von Drohnentechnologie bis zum Kampf gegen Antibiotikaresistenzen reichen, beleuchtet – mit Einblicken in Schweizer Startups, Labore und Innovationsprojekte. Zu sehen ist die Sendung auf SAT.1 Schweiz.

rows.title: Zürcher Proptech-Startup expandiert in die Westschweiz
rows.summary: Mit dem Erreichen der Schwelle von 5'000 aktiven Inseraten und zusätzlichen Kunden verzeichnet das PropTech-Startup maison.work ein deutliches Wachstum. Nun startet das Zürcher Startup den gezielten Marktausbau in der Westschweiz und konnte dort bereits erste Partnerschaften eingehen.

rows.title: Giovanna Dipasquale is the ‘Female Innovator of the Year’ 2025
rows.summary: The eighth edition of the Female Innovation Forum once again highlighted the leadership and creativity of women driving technological innovation. Giovanna Dipasquale was awarded Female Innovator of the Year, recognizing her economic and societal impact though HeroSupport, which develops personalized 3D-printed support systems for radiation therapy in breast cancer. Lara Gervaise, co-founder of Virtuosis AI, won the Recognition Award.

rows.title: Series A to boost exnaton intelligence platform for new energy
rows.summary: exnaton, a Swiss software company developing an AI-driven intelligence platform for utilities, has raised a Series A round from a global VC consortium. The funds will be used to to accelerate its European expansion and to deepen customer partnerships.

rows.title: Erfolgreiches Crowdfunding für zwei Startups
rows.summary: Zwei Startups haben kürzlich ihre Crowdinvesting-Kampagnen auf Oomnium erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Future Kitchens, das auf virtuelle Restaurantkonzepte setzt, konnte dabei rund 960’000 Franken einsammeln. Twiliner, Anbieter klimafreundlicher Nachtbusreisen mit Liegesitzen, erhielt Unterstützung von der Crowd in Höhe von 1.78 Millionen Franken.

rows.title: Promising results in oncology research
rows.summary: Two biotech startups, iOnctura and ImmunOs, have announced positive results from their ongoing Phase 1 clinical trials for cancer therapies. Meanwhile, Reconnect Labs has advanced to a Phase 2 trial for a treatment targeting sleep disturbances associated with post-traumatic stress disorder, enrolling its first patient for the study.

rows.title: Lausanne-based Leader in AI-driven text analysis for manufacturing acquired
rows.summary: MaintMaster, a leading Swedish provider of maintenance management and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) software, just announced the acquisition of Peoplegeist by FreshMarket GmbH, a leader in AI-driven text analysis for manufacturing.

rows.title: Sihuan Pharmaceutical invests in Swiss medical aesthetic company
rows.summary: Sihuan Pharmaceutical made an equity investment in Swiss medical aesthetic company Suisselle SA in September 2025, and the parties have formally entered into an investment and subscription agreement. This collaboration will enhance the strategic relationship between the Group and Suisselle to jointly explore the global medical aesthetic market.

rows.title: GetYourGuide becomes profitable with almost a €1 billion in revenues
rows.summary: GetYourGuide, the German and Swiss-based online travel experiences platform dedicated to transforming how people travel and book experiences, has become profitable for the first time, achieving positive adjusted EBITDA over the last 12 months while nearing €1 billion in net revenue in 2025.

rows.title: Fueling growth with global accelerators
rows.summary: Besides workshops and mentoring, accelerator programs provide startups with access to their broad networks to attract investment and facilitate partnerships. Jua, an AI cleantech company has inked a deal with Australia’s largest energy company, following its participation in the Free Electrons program. Similar opportunities are available for eFrontiers, Verretex and Wecan.

rows.title: Breakthrough US Launch and Validation for Aspivix
rows.summary: In a milestone US launch, Aspivix has officially made available its novel carevix device to physicians in Southern California and New York. Furthermore, a key report BMJ Sexual & Reproductive Health in Sweden has once again shown that carevix improves comfort and safety during IUD insertion, with high satisfaction rates among both patients and providers.

rows.title: Chipmind out of stealth with $2.4 million in funding
rows.summary: Zurich-based Chipmind is coming out of stealth with AI agents that accelerate chip development cycles, saving engineers in semiconductor companies 40% of their time by autonomously handling repetitive low-level tasks. The $2.4 million pre-seed investment led by Founderful allows the company to expand its team and boost product development.

rows.title: Erfolgreicher Start für Zürcher KI-Legal-Startup Lawise.ai
rows.summary: Das Zürcher LegalTech-Startup Lawise.ai hat mit «Jurilo» einen KI-basierten Rechtschatbot für Unternehmen lanciert. Nach zwei Jahren Entwicklung beantwortet Jurilo nun einfach und verständlich rechtliche Fragen aus dem Arbeits- und Vertragsrecht für Nicht-Juristinnen und Nicht-Juristen. Erste Kunden und Partner sind bereits gewonnen.

rows.title: $100’000 to accelerate structural non-contact sensor technology
rows.summary: TALPA Inspection has secured a convertible loan of $100K in a pitch competition held at the ETH. Their drone- and robot-enabled solution facilitates inspections on hard to reach engineering structures such as reinforced concrete bridges and coated metal objects. Besides reducing costs, preventing disruptions, and the solution provides digital 3D twins that empower predictive infrastructure maintenance and extend the asset lifetime.

rows.title: Anevo secures pre-seed funding
rows.summary: ETH Zurich Spin-off Anevo has closed a pre-seed funding round to support the development of its automation platform for the real estate industry. Several renowned investors and business angels in Switzerland participated in the round. The invested amount was not disclosed.

rows.title: EY Entrepreneur Of The Year 2025: Founders of nu glass and Meteomatics come out on top
rows.summary: Last Friday, the winners of the EY Entrepreneur Of The Year 2025 award were announced at a gala event in Bern. Two of the three winners are start-up founders: Luc Burnier and Martin Fengler.

rows.title: Subsquid acquisition to fuel agentic commerce and finance
rows.summary: Subsquid is a leading decentralized data-infrastructure platform offering a decentralized data lake and query engine that makes blockchain data instantly searchable and usable for AI systems. Founded in 2021, the startup has now been acquired by Rezolve Ai, a global leader in AI-driven commerce, which aims to unite blockchain data science, decentralized data lakes, and digital-asset payment rails into a single intelligent commerce infrastructure.

rows.title: From SaaS to watch companies: Global awards honour Swiss start-ups
rows.summary: Nexoya is among the winners of the Zurich Innovation Championship. Wemedoo has been named Innovator Start-up of the Year 2025 by the Society for Clinical Data Management (SCDM). And ELKA Watch’s Arinis won the start-up award at this year’s TEMPORIS Gala.

rows.title: Tech-Startup setzt mit KI-gestützter Auktionsplattform auf nachhaltigen Secondhand-Handel
rows.summary: Das Zuger Startup Shack AG, will mit seiner App Shack den nachhaltigen Secondhand-Handel revolutionieren – mit einem Freemium-Modell und KI-gestützt. Seit dem Launch im November 2024 verzeichnet die App über 50'000 Downloads, neu ergänzt durch den eigenen «Shack Token» auf der Solana-Blockchain zur Unterstützung der Weiterentwicklung. Nun plant das Unternehmen die Expansion in den gesamten DACH-Raum.

rows.title: General Intuition raises USD 134 million
rows.summary: General Intuition, a start-up with teams in Geneva and New York, closed a USD 133.7 million funding round. The spin-off from Dutch company Medal uses video interaction to build AI foundation models for environments that require deep spatial and temporal reasoning. Two of the co-founders are based in Geneva.

rows.title: New leadership drives growth in biotech and AI startups
rows.summary: Biotech experts Mark Pruzanski and Andrew Roberts have stepped into new roles as Chief Executive Officers of Alentis and InterAx to support and accelerate the companies’ clinical developments. At Artificialy, co-founder Luca Gambardella is now the CEO. His role includes strengthening the company’s position in the Ticino region and across Switzerland.

rows.title: «Höhle der Löwen»:  Plenio wächst ohne Investoren weiter
rows.summary: Das Badner Startup Cubra präsentierte in der neunten Folge von «Die Höhle der Löwen» seine KI-gestützte Headhunting-Plattform «Plenio» und erhielt ein gemeinsames Angebot von zwei Investoren. Ein Deal kam nach der Sendung jedoch nicht zustande.

rows.title: Cryptonow erhält Lizenz für europäische Expansion
rows.summary: Cryptonow erhält als erstes Schweizer Krypto-Unternehmen eine umfassende EU-Lizenz nach der Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA). Ausgestellt wurde die Lizenz von der österreichischen Finanzmarktaufsicht (FMA). Damit schafft Cryptonow die regulatorische Grundlage, sein erfolgreiches Schweizer Geschäftsmodell auf ganz Europa auszurollen.

rows.title: Pretty Good bringt Repair Pop-up an den Zürcher Hauptbahnhof
rows.summary: Mit dem Repair Pop-up am Zürcher Hauptbahnhof testet das Berner Startup Pretty Good, das defekte Gegenstände repariert und zur Weiternutzung aufbereitet, ein stationäres Reparaturangebot in Zusammenarbeit mit zuerich.repair. Parallel evaluiert das Pretty Good-Team gemeinsam mit der SBB ob Schliessfächer als weiterer Kanal für das Abgeben und Abholen von Geräten eignet.

rows.title: EssilorLuxottica acquires RetinAI
rows.summary: EssilorLuxottica announces the acquisition of Ikerian AG, the Swiss health technology company founded in 2017 and operating under the RetinAI brand, specializing in AI and data management in eyecare. Franco-Italian vision care giant EssilorLuxottica generated consolidated revenue of Euro 26.5 billion in 2024. Iconic brands include Ray-Ban, Oakley and Supreme. The Group is also known for innovation ranging from medical instruments and solutions for eye health to smart glasses.

rows.title: GradeSens and Transcality win 5th Boost My Startup Challenge
rows.summary: On October 9, 2025, six start-ups presented their innovative solutions to a jury of experts, entrepreneurs, and investors. For the first time since the challenge was launched, the jury selected two winners, GradeSens and Transcality, which impressed with their vision, creativity, and potential for real-world impact, and took home the top prize.

rows.title: Industry veterans join Lifesciences and fashion-tech startups
rows.summary: Life sciences companies metaLead, Onward Medical, and Topadur have strengthened their Boards of Directors with the appointment of distinguished leaders, including seasoned entrepreneurs and a renowned cardiac surgeon. In the fashion sector, Haelixa has added a former Puma executive to its board. With their extensive experience and networks, these new board members are set to play a crucial role in driving the startups’ growth.

rows.title: Swiss medtechs report clinical progress in heart, brain, and urological health
rows.summary: Three Swiss startups at the forefront of addressing cerebral arteries, erectile dysfunction and heart failure have made progress in their clinical journey. While Artiria Medical has treated more than 100 patients in the US, Comphya has implanted the first patient. Meanwhile, Berlin Heals has completed the enrollment of patients for its first clinical CMIC-III study.

rows.title: N-Dream investor KPIT becomes majority shareholder
rows.summary: KPIT Technologies Limited has increased its stake in Swiss startup N-Dream to 88.9%. With this EUR 16.35 million acquisition deal, KPIT aims to enhance automotive OEMs’ offerings by integrating N-Dream’s platform Airconsole with its software services.

rows.title: Market shifts in the drone industry
rows.summary: The latest Global State of Drones 2025 report by Drone Industry Insights (DII) highlights a resilient global market despite tighter funding and regulatory challenges. The Drone Industry Association Switzerland is using the report as an opportunity to highlight the latest developments in the industry.

rows.title: Successful investment round to power Neology vision
rows.summary: Neology has just announced the first closing of its CHF 2.5 million investment round, backed by CHF 1.7 million in equity commitments from leading Swiss and international investors. This strategic funding enables the Lutry-based startup to advance the rollout of its 50 kW Ammonia Power Generator (APG) units by late 2026 to early 2027.

rows.title: Financial boost for publicly traded scale-ups
rows.summary: ADC Therapeutics, a specialist in antibody drug conjugates, and Idorsia, the company commercializing a new insomnia therapy, have raised fresh funds through a private placement. The funds will strengthen the companies’ balance sheets and fuel the commercial expansion of their lead candidates.

rows.title: Aviation-Tech Startup setzt neuen Standard für digitale Flugbücher
rows.summary: Das Zürcher Startup capzlog.aero bietet eine Software zur digitalen Nutzung von Flugbüchern an und erfüllt als bislang einziger Anbieter sämtliche regulatorischen Anforderungen in der Schweiz. Mit rund 2500 zahlenden Nutzerinnen und Nutzern, Kooperationen mit Airlines wie Swiss und Edelweiss sowie einer laufenden Finanzierungsrunde bereitet sich das Unternehmen nun auf die Expansion in den DACH-Raum vor.

rows.title: SwissGPT wird zugänglicher
rows.summary: Im Rahmen einer strategischen Partnerschaft ist die Freiburger Navique die erste Firma, die den Zugang zur neuen SwissGPT API implementiert. Gemeinsames Ziel von AlpineAI, dem Unternehmen hinter SwissGPT, und Navique ist es, Schweizer Unternehmen den sicheren und souveränen Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz zu ermöglichen.

rows.title: Following FDA approval, SQ Innovation closes Series B financing
rows.summary: U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved SQ Innovation’s drug-device combination Lasix ONYU for the treatment of edema - due to fluid overload - in adult patients with chronic heart failure. In addition, the company has successfully closed its Series B financing, providing the capital necessary for the U.S. commercial launch of Lasix ONYU.

rows.title: Clinical milestones bring startups closer to launching new therapies
rows.summary: Biotech startups Oculis, Nuclidium, and Nouscom are advancing steadily in their clinical programs, launching new studies and reporting promising trial results. These milestones bring them closer to delivering next-generation cancer therapies.

rows.title: Ecorobotix secures USD 150 million to accelerate growth
rows.summary: Ecorobotix is the global leader in AI-powered Ultra-High Precision (UHP) spraying. Building on rapid growth, proven field results, and a strong financial foundation with $150 million raised in Series C ($45m, 2024) and Series D ($105m, 2025), the company will present its latest advancements at Agritechnica this November in Hanover, Germany.

rows.title: Zusätzliches Crowd-Startkapital für Coaching-System Ayon
rows.summary: Das im März 2024 gegründete Startup YARU hat insgesamt bereits über eine Million Franken an Investments eingesammelt. Ein Teil stammt von US-Unternehmer Dan Harden von Whipsaw, Business Angels wie dem ehemaligen ON-Manager Patrick Rupp oder Coople-Gründer Viktor Calabrò. Nun bereitet YARU eine Kickstarter-Kampagne vor, um die Fitness- und Ernährungscoaching-Lösung zur Marktreife zu bringen.

rows.title: >>venture>> restructures award competition
rows.summary: Starting 2026, >>venture>>, Switzerland’s leading early-stage startup competition, will introduce the Spotlight Award. Accompanied by a CHF 50,000 cash prize, the award will recognize an innovative startup that uses Apertus, Switzerland’s own large language model. Further changes have been to the category of award prizes and verticals.

rows.title: «Höhle der Löwen»: Doppel-Deal für Fan-Investmentplattform
rows.summary: Das SportTech-Startup Crowdsports überzeugte in der achten Folge der «Höhle der Löwen» gleich zwei Investoren mit seiner Investmentplattform für Sportbegeisterte. Der Deal wurde seit der Aufzeichnung allerdings noch nicht finalisiert.

rows.title: Swiss Future Award reveals finalists: public voting underway
rows.summary: Ten finalists are currently in the run for the first Swiss Future Award, which offers to receive 12 months of coaching and opportunities to scale their solution. The public voting is currently ongoing until 31 October.

rows.title: Startups secure a ticket for global accelerators
rows.summary: Three global accelerators focused on supporting AI advancements across various sectors have announced their latest batches. Swiss startups Manukai, Arqh, Amnis, and Moozz have joined the cohorts to benefit from tailored support and gain access to a broad network of experts and investors.
